        attempts.seed(self.state, "kalam", at(HOUR))
        attempts.mark_reported(self.state, "kalam", "x")
        mid = os.lstat(self.path()).st_mtime_ns
        attempts.mark_reported(self.state, "kalam", "x")
        self.assertNotEqual(before, mid)
        self.assertEqual(mid, os.lstat(self.path()).st_mtime_ns)


# -- the per-citizen lock -------------------------------------------------------------

class TestLock(h.FixtureCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.state = self.fx.state
        self.dir = self.state / "kalam.lock"

    def plant(self, pid=None, started=None):
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        if pid is not None:
            (self.dir / "pid").write_text(f"{pid}\n")
        if started is not None:
            (self.dir / "started").write_text(f"{started}\n")

    def test_take_then_busy(self):
        got = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertEqual((got.got, got.reclaimed), (True, ""))
        self.assertEqual((self.dir / "pid").read_text(), f"{os.getpid()}\n")
        self.assertEqual((self.dir / "started").read_text(), f"{NOW_S}\n")
        again = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getppid(), now=at(MINUTE), bound=600)
        self.assertFalse(again.got)
        self.assertEqual((again.holder.pid, again.holder.started), (os.getpid(), NOW_S))
        self.assertEqual((self.dir / "pid").read_text(), f"{os.getpid()}\n")

    def test_a_lock_whose_pid_is_gone_is_reclaimed(self):
        gone = dead_pid()
        self.plant(gone, NOW_S)
        got = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertEqual((got.got, got.reclaimed), (True, f"pid {gone} is gone"))
        self.assertEqual((self.dir / "pid").read_text(), f"{os.getpid()}\n")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(os.listdir(self.state)), ["kalam.lock"])

    def test_a_lock_older_than_twice_the_bound_is_reclaimed_even_with_a_live_pid(self):
        self.plant(os.getppid(), st(at(-20 * MINUTE)))
        self.assertFalse(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600).got)
        self.assertTrue(lock.held(self.state, "kalam", now=NOW, bound=600))
        got = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=at(MINUTE), bound=600)
        self.assertEqual((got.got, got.reclaimed), (True, "older than 1200 s"))
        self.assertFalse(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getppid(), now=at(2 * MINUTE),
                                   bound=900).got)

    def test_a_lock_with_no_pid_yet_is_judged_by_its_age(self):
        self.plant()
        self.assertFalse(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600).got)
        (self.dir / "pid").write_text("")
        self.assertFalse(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600).got)
        old = time.time() - 1300
        os.utime(self.dir, (old, old))
        got = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertEqual((got.got, got.reclaimed), (True, "older than 1200 s"))

    def test_a_pid_that_is_not_a_process_number_counts_as_none(self):
        for text in ("0", "-1", "abc", "12 34"):
            with self.subTest(pid=text):
                self.plant()
                (self.dir / "pid").write_text(text + "\n")
                (self.dir / "started").write_text(NOW_S + "\n")
                self.assertIsNone(lock.holder(self.state, "kalam", now=NOW).pid)
                self.assertFalse(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600).got)
                lock.release(self.state, "kalam")

    def test_held(self):
        self.assertFalse(lock.held(self.state, "kalam", now=NOW, bound=600))
        lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertTrue(lock.held(self.state, "kalam", now=at(20 * MINUTE), bound=600))
        self.assertFalse(lock.held(self.state, "kalam", now=at(21 * MINUTE), bound=600))
        lock.release(self.state, "kalam")
        self.plant(dead_pid(), NOW_S)
        self.assertFalse(lock.held(self.state, "kalam", now=NOW, bound=600))

    def test_release_only_by_its_holder(self):
        lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertFalse(lock.release(self.state, "kalam", pid=os.getppid()))
        self.assertTrue(self.dir.is_dir())
        self.assertTrue(lock.release(self.state, "kalam", pid=os.getpid()))
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(self.dir))
        self.assertFalse(lock.release(self.state, "kalam"))
        lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertTrue(lock.release(self.state, "kalam"))

    def test_a_reclaim_never_takes_a_lock_made_meanwhile(self):
        lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        stale = lock.Holder(dead_pid(), st(at(-HOUR)), 3600.0)
        with mock.patch.object(lock, "holder", return_value=stale):
            got = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getppid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertFalse(got.got)
        self.assertEqual((self.dir / "pid").read_text(), f"{os.getpid()}\n")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(os.listdir(self.state)), ["kalam.lock"])

    def test_a_stray_file_or_link_at_the_lock_path(self):
        self.state.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.dir.write_text("stray\n")
        old = time.time() - 1300
        os.utime(self.dir, (old, old))
        self.assertTrue(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600).got)
        lock.release(self.state, "kalam")
        target = self.fx.outside / "elsewhere"
        target.mkdir()
        (target / "pid").write_text(f"{dead_pid()}\n")
        self.dir.symlink_to(target)
        os.utime(self.dir, (old, old), follow_symlinks=False)
        got = lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW, bound=600)
        self.assertTrue(got.got)
        self.assertTrue(self.dir.is_dir() and not self.dir.is_symlink())
        self.assertEqual(sorted(os.listdir(target)), ["pid"])

    def test_beat_bound_is_read_as_the_fleet_reads_it(self):
        for value, want in ((None, 600), ("", 600), ("abc", 600), ("10", 600), ("29", 600),
                            ("30", 30), ("900", 900), ("-5", 600), (" 900 ", 600), ("900\n", 600),
                            ("\u00b2", 600), ("\u0669\u0660\u0660", 600)):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                env = {} if value is None else {"FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC": value}
                with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=False):
                    if value is None:
                        os.environ.pop("FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC", None)
                    self.assertEqual(lock.beat_bound(), want)
        self.assertEqual(lock.beat_bound("1200"), 1200)

    def test_take_uses_the_bound_from_the_environment_by_default(self):
        self.plant(os.getppid(), st(at(-25 * MINUTE)))
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC": "900"}):
            self.assertFalse(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW).got)
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC": "600"}):
            self.assertTrue(lock.take(self.state, "kalam", os.getpid(), now=NOW).got)


# -- is_due: one citizen, in memory ---------------------------------------------------

class TestIsDueOrder(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_safety_checks_come_first_in_order(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-10 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, soul=False, links=["REST"], midmerge=True).reason, "no-soul")
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, links=["REST"], midmerge=True).reason, "links")
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, midmerge=True).reason, "mid-merge")
        for d in (is_due(c, soul=False, summoned=True), is_due(c, links=["inbox"], summoned=True),
                  is_due(c, midmerge=True, summoned=True)):
            self.assertFalse(d.due)

    def test_a_summons_passes_any_pace_floor_back_off_and_block(self):
        rec = att(last=at(-HOUR), retry=at(DAY))
        for pace in (ASLEEP, LW, LISTENING, awake(365), None):
            with self.subTest(pace=pace):
                d = is_due(cadence_of(pace, last=at(-HOUR), blocked="x" if pace is None else ""),
                           rec, summoned=True)
                self.assertEqual(d, Due(True, "summoned", NOW))
                self.assertEqual(d.overdue_s(NOW), 0)

    def test_a_blocked_record_is_never_due(self):
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-10 * DAY), blocked="its REST text names neither")
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-5 * DAY)]), Due(False, "blocked"))

    def test_backing_off_holds_a_due_citizen_until_it_ends(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        d = is_due(c, att(retry=at(5 * HOUR)))
        self.assertEqual(d, Due(False, "backing-off", next_at=at(5 * HOUR)))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, att(retry=NOW)).reason, "schedule")
        later = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-HOUR))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(later, att(retry=at(5 * HOUR))).next_at, at(3 * DAY - HOUR))
        self.assertIsNone(is_due(cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-HOUR)), att(retry=at(HOUR))).next_at)


class TestIsDueByPace(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_awake_is_due_n_days_after_its_last_beat(self):
        for n in (3, 5, 365):
            with self.subTest(n=n):
                c = cadence_of(awake(n), last=at(-n * DAY))
                self.assertEqual(is_due(c), Due(True, "schedule", NOW))
                self.assertEqual(is_due(c, now=at(-MINUTE)),
                                 Due(False, "not-yet", next_at=NOW))
        late = is_due(cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-5 * DAY)))
        self.assertEqual((late.since, late.overdue_s(NOW)), (at(-2 * DAY), 2 * 86400))

    def test_an_awake_citizen_s_letters_wait_for_its_beat(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(5), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        d = is_due(c, mail=[at(-4 * DAY + HOUR)])
        self.assertEqual(d, Due(False, "not-yet", next_at=at(DAY)))

    def test_a_letter_to_an_asleep_citizen_beaten_two_days_ago_waits_a_day(self):
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-2 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-HOUR)]), Due(False, "floor", next_at=at(DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, now=at(DAY), mail=[at(-HOUR)]), Due(True, "letter", at(DAY)))

    def test_a_letter_is_due_from_the_later_of_its_arrival_and_the_floor(self):
        c = cadence_of(LISTENING, last=at(-10 * DAY))
        d = is_due(c, mail=[at(-2 * HOUR), at(-HOUR)])
        self.assertEqual(d, Due(True, "letter", at(-2 * HOUR)))
        self.assertEqual(d.overdue_s(NOW), 7200)
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-9 * DAY)]).since, at(-7 * DAY))

    def test_asleep_and_listening_without_mail(self):
        for pace in (ASLEEP, LISTENING):
            with self.subTest(pace=pace):
                self.assertEqual(is_due(cadence_of(pace, last=at(-90 * DAY))), Due(False, "no-mail"))

    def test_an_unreadable_pace_gets_letters_at_the_floor_and_nothing_else(self):
        c = cadence_of(None, last=at(-90 * DAY), pending=pending(awake(3), at(-80 * DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c), Due(False, "unreadable"))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-HOUR)]).reason, "letter")
        self.assertEqual(is_due(cadence_of(None, last=at(-HOUR)), mail=[at(-HOUR)]),
                         Due(False, "floor", next_at=at(3 * DAY - HOUR)))

    def test_letters_wait_ignores_mail(self):
        c = cadence_of(LW, last=at(-90 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-30 * DAY)]), Due(False, "letters-wait"))

    def test_no_clock_yet_starts_now(self):
        self.assertEqual(is_due(cadence_of(awake(3))), Due(False, "not-yet", next_at=at(3 * DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(cadence_of(ASLEEP), mail=[at(-DAY)]),
                         Due(False, "floor", next_at=at(3 * DAY)))


class TestShowBack(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_owed_once_to_asleep_letters_wait_and_listening(self):
        for pace, more in ((ASLEEP, LISTENING), (LW, ASLEEP), (LISTENING, awake(5))):
            with self.subTest(pace=pace):
                c = cadence_of(pace, last=at(-3 * DAY), pending=pending(more, at(-3 * DAY)))
                self.assertTrue(due.show_back_owed(c, at(-3 * DAY), True))
                self.assertEqual(is_due(c, confirm_beat=True), Due(True, "show-back", NOW))
                self.assertEqual(is_due(c, now=at(-HOUR), confirm_beat=True),
                                 Due(False, "floor", next_at=NOW))

    def test_letters_wait_gets_its_show_back_beat_and_still_ignores_mail(self):
        c = cadence_of(LW, last=at(-4 * DAY), pending=pending(ASLEEP, at(-4 * DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-DAY)], confirm_beat=True), Due(True, "show-back", at(-DAY)))
        done = att(last=at(-HOUR))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, done, mail=[at(-DAY)], confirm_beat=True), Due(False, "letters-wait"))

    def test_none_for_awake_for_one_said_on_a_show_back_or_with_the_switch_off(self):
        said = at(-4 * DAY)
        cases = (
            cadence_of(awake(7), last=said, pending=pending(awake(3), said)),
            cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=said, pending=pending(LISTENING, said, on_show_back=True)),
            cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=said),
        )
        for c in cases:
            with self.subTest(c=c):
                self.assertFalse(due.show_back_owed(c, said, True))
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=said, pending=pending(LISTENING, said))
        self.assertTrue(due.show_back_owed(c, said, True))
        self.assertFalse(due.show_back_owed(c, said, False))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, confirm_beat=False), Due(False, "no-mail"))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(cases[1]), Due(False, "no-mail"))

    def test_not_owed_again_after_a_later_landed_beat(self):
        said = at(-10 * DAY)
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=said, pending=pending(LISTENING, said))
        self.assertTrue(due.show_back_owed(c, said + 30 * MINUTE, True))
        self.assertFalse(due.show_back_owed(c, said + 3 * DAY, True))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, att(last=said + 3 * DAY)), Due(False, "no-mail"))

    def test_a_letter_beat_comes_instead_of_a_show_back(self):
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-5 * DAY), pending=pending(LISTENING, at(-5 * DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, mail=[at(-HOUR)], confirm_beat=True).reason, "letter")
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, confirm_beat=True).reason, "show-back")

    def test_a_show_back_keeps_the_floor_after_the_last_beat(self):
        said = at(-4 * DAY)
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-30 * DAY), pending=pending(LISTENING, said))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c, att(last=said + 50 * MINUTE), confirm_beat=True).since,
                         said + 50 * MINUTE + FLOOR)

    def test_the_switch_is_one_committed_constant_the_call_reads(self):
        # Yu's answer is committed before the merge, True or False (spec section 9 step 4)
        self.assertIsInstance(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, bool)
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-4 * DAY), pending=pending(LISTENING, at(-4 * DAY)))
        with mock.patch.object(due, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT", False):
            self.assertEqual(is_due(c).reason, "no-mail")
        with mock.patch.object(due, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT", True):
            self.assertEqual(is_due(c).reason, "show-back")
        self.assertEqual(is_due(c).reason, "show-back" if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT else "no-mail")

    def test_no_environment_variable_changes_the_switch(self):
        src = (h.TOOLS / "citizen_pace_lib" / "due.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        found = re.findall(r"^WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT = .*$", src, re.M)
        self.assertEqual(len(found), 1, found)
        self.assertRegex(found[0], r"^WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT = (True|False)$")
        self.assertNotIn("environ", src)
        self.assertNotIn("getenv", src)
        env = {"PATH": h.SYSTEM_PATH, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT": "0", "PACE_WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT": "false",
               "FLEET_WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT": "0"}
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-c",
                            "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); "
                            "from citizen_pace_lib import due; print(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT)",
                            str(h.TOOLS)], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        self.assertEqual(r.stdout.strip(), str(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT), r.stderr)


class TestLastBeat(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_later_of_cadence_and_the_attempt_record(self):
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-5 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(due.last_beat(c, att(last=at(-2 * DAY))), at(-2 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(due.last_beat(c, att(last=at(-9 * DAY))), at(-5 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(due.last_beat(c, att()), at(-5 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(due.last_beat(cadence_of(ASLEEP), att(last=at(-DAY))), at(-DAY))
        self.assertIsNone(due.last_beat(cadence_of(ASLEEP), att()))
        self.assertIsNone(due.last_beat(cadence_of(ASLEEP), {}))

    def test_a_time_later_than_now_is_not_a_last_beat(self):
        c = cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(300 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(due.last_beat(c, att(last=at(-DAY))), at(300 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(due.last_beat(c, att(last=at(-DAY)), NOW), at(-DAY))
        self.assertIsNone(due.last_beat(c, att(), NOW))
        self.assertEqual(is_due(cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(300 * DAY)), att(last=at(-3 * DAY))).reason,
                         "schedule")


class TestTheClock(h.FixtureCase):
    """The attempt record and is_due together, as the fleet and the beat script use them."""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.state = self.fx.state

    def check(self, c, now, mail=()):
        return due.is_due(c, attempts.load(self.state, "an"), now, list(mail), True, [], False)

    def test_a_silent_beat_counts_as_the_beat(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY), name="an")
        self.assertTrue(self.check(c, NOW).due)
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "an", "f-1", "silent", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(self.check(c, NOW), Due(False, "not-yet", next_at=at(3 * DAY)))

    def test_a_failed_beat_moves_no_clock(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY), name="an")
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "an", "f-1", "home-failed", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(self.check(c, at(11 * HOUR)).reason, "backing-off")
        d = self.check(c, at(12 * HOUR))
        self.assertEqual((d.reason, d.since), ("schedule", NOW))

    def test_no_catch_up_after_a_long_outage(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-10 * DAY), name="an")
        self.assertEqual(self.check(c, NOW).since, at(-7 * DAY))
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "an", "f-1", "spoken", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(self.check(c, at(3 * DAY - MINUTE)).reason, "not-yet")
        self.assertTrue(self.check(c, at(3 * DAY)).due)

    def test_a_summoned_beat_moves_no_clock(self):
        c = cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-2 * DAY), name="an")
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "an", "hand-1", "summoned", NOW)
        self.assertTrue(self.check(c, at(DAY)).due)


# -- due_for_home: one home on disk -------------------------------------------------

class HomeCase(h.FixtureCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.state = self.fx.state

    def home(self, slug, pace=None, last=None, pending_=None, set_by=None, **kw):
        if pace is not None:
            c = cadence_of(pace, last=last, pending=pending_, name=slug, set_by=set_by)
            kw["cadence"] = cad.render_cadence(c)
        return self.fx.make_home(slug, when="2026-10-01T00:00Z", **kw)

    def due(self, home, slug, now=NOW, record=None, **kw):
        return due.due_for_home(home, slug, self.state, record or {}, now, **kw)


class TestDueForHome(HomeCase):
    def test_an_awake_home_is_due_on_its_schedule(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an"), Due(True, "schedule", NOW))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", now=at(-HOUR)).reason, "not-yet")

    def test_a_lost_record_starts_the_clock_now_once(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an"), Due(False, "not-yet", next_at=at(3 * DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "an")["seeded"], "now")
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", now=at(DAY)).next_at, at(3 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", now=at(3 * DAY)).reason, "schedule")
        (self.state / "an").write_text("lost\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", now=at(5 * DAY)).next_at, at(8 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "an")["last_beat"], st(at(5 * DAY)))

    def test_no_seed_when_asked_not_to_write(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", write_seed=False).next_at, at(3 * DAY))
        self.assertFalse(self.state.exists())

    def test_cadence_s_last_beat_needs_no_seed(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3), last=at(-DAY))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an").next_at, at(2 * DAY))
        self.assertIsNone(attempts.load(self.state, "an")["last_beat"])

    def test_a_letter_wakes_an_asleep_home_at_its_floor(self):
        home = self.home("kalam", ASLEEP, last=at(-2 * DAY))
        self.fx.letter(home, "2026-11-15-hello.md", "hello\n", when=at(-HOUR))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam"), Due(False, "floor", next_at=at(DAY)))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam", now=at(DAY)), Due(True, "letter", at(DAY)))
        self.fx.write(home, "inbox/.seen-2026-11-15-hello.md", "surfaced 2026-11-16\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam", now=at(DAY)).reason, "no-mail")

    def test_a_letter_set_aside_at_rollback_still_wakes_its_reader(self):
        home = self.home("kalam", ASLEEP, last=at(-5 * DAY))
        self.fx.letter(home, "2026-11-10-pace-letter.md", "one question\n", when=at(-5 * DAY))
        self.fx.write(home, "inbox/.seen-2026-11-10-pace-letter.md",
                      "set aside at rollback, not shown\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam").reason, "letter")

    def test_letters_wait_and_awake_do_not_read_letter_times(self):
        for slug, pace in (("lw", LW), ("aw", awake(3))):
            with self.subTest(pace=pace):
                home = self.home(slug, pace, last=at(-DAY), letters=[("a.md", "a\n")])
                with mock.patch.object(due.homes, "letter_time", side_effect=AssertionError("read")):
                    self.assertFalse(self.due(home, slug).due)

    def test_never_due_without_a_soul_with_links_or_mid_merge(self):
        cases = {
            "no-soul": self.home("nosoul", ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), soul=False,
                                 letters=[("a.md", "a\n")]),
            "links": self.home("linked", ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), letters=[("a.md", "a\n")]),
            "mid-merge": self.home("merging", ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), letters=[("a.md", "a\n")]),
        }
        os.remove(cases["links"] / "CADENCE.md")
        self.fx.link(cases["links"], "CADENCE.md", self.fx.secret)
        (cases["mid-merge"] / ".git" / "MERGE_HEAD").write_text("0" * 40 + "\n")
        for reason, home in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(reason=reason):
                slug = home.name[len("citizen-"):]
                self.assertEqual(self.due(home, slug), Due(False, reason))
                self.assertFalse(self.due(home, slug, summoned=True).due)
        self.assertFalse(self.state.exists())

    def test_a_linked_marker_or_seen_marker_is_never_read_or_written_through(self):
        for i, rel in enumerate(("REST", "inbox/.seen-a.md", "beats/2026-11-01.md")):
            with self.subTest(rel=rel):
                slug = f"k{i}"
                home = self.home(slug, ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), letters=[("a.md", "a\n")])
                self.fx.link(home, rel, self.fx.secret)
                before = snapshot(self.fx.root / "outside")
                self.assertEqual(self.due(home, slug).reason, "links")
                self.assertEqual(snapshot(self.fx.root / "outside"), before)

    def test_a_fresh_index_lock_keeps_the_home_out_and_a_stale_one_does_not(self):
        home = self.home("kalam", ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), letters=[("a.md", "a\n")])
        lockfile = home / ".git" / "index.lock"
        lockfile.write_text("")
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam", bound=600).reason, "mid-merge")
        old = time.time() - 1300
        os.utime(lockfile, (old, old))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam", bound=600).reason, "letter")
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam", bound=900).reason, "mid-merge")

    def test_a_home_with_no_clone(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.due(self.fx.home_path("palance"), "palance"), Due(False, "no-home"))

    def test_a_summons_passes_the_gate_for_all_four_paces(self):
        for slug, pace in (("a1", ASLEEP), ("a2", LW), ("a3", LISTENING), ("a4", awake(30))):
            with self.subTest(pace=pace):
                home = self.home(slug, pace, last=at(-HOUR))
                self.assertFalse(self.due(home, slug).due)
                self.assertEqual(self.due(home, slug, summoned=True), Due(True, "summoned", NOW))
        self.assertFalse(self.state.exists())

    def test_a_pace_changed_between_the_ranking_and_the_gate_is_honoured(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        self.assertEqual([s for s, _ in due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["an"], self.state, {}, NOW)], ["an"])
        self.fx.write(home, "CADENCE.md",
                      cad.render_cadence(cadence_of(ASLEEP, last=at(-4 * DAY), name="an")))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an"), Due(False, "no-mail"))

    def test_a_v1_awake_home_that_never_spoke_is_due_through_rank_and_the_gate_alike(self):
        record = record_with(an={"group": "ambient-nine", "recipient": False,
                                 "set_by": AMBIENT.to_json()})
        home = self.fx.make_home("an", cadence=v1("an", "ambient", "2026-10-23 01:31"))
        first = due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["an"], self.state, record, NOW)
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", record=record).next_at, at(3 * DAY))
        tick = at(3 * DAY)
        self.assertEqual(due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["an"], self.state, record, tick),
                         [("an", Due(True, "schedule", tick))])
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", now=tick, record=record), Due(True, "schedule", tick))

    def test_a_decided_v1_home_that_cannot_be_migrated_is_never_due(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("an", cadence=v1("an", "ambient", "2026-10-23 01:31"),
                                 letters=[("a.md", "a\n")])
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", now=at(30 * DAY)), Due(False, "blocked"))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an", summoned=True).reason, "summoned")

    def test_a_show_back_beat_from_the_file(self):
        said = at(-3 * DAY)
        home = self.home("kalam", ASLEEP, last=said, pending_=pending(LISTENING, said))
        with mock.patch.object(due, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT", True):
            self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam"), Due(True, "show-back", NOW))
            self.fx.letter(home, "2026-11-15-hi.md", "hi\n", when=at(-HOUR))
            self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam").reason, "letter")

    def test_a_beat_script_looped_on_a_silent_awake_citizen_keeps_its_pace(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3), last=NOW)
        beats, now = [], NOW
        for i in range(20 * 24):
            if self.due(home, "an", now=now).due:
                beats.append(now)
                attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "an", f"loop-{i}", "silent", now)
            now += HOUR
        self.assertEqual(beats, [at(k * 3 * DAY) for k in range(1, 7)])

    def test_a_home_that_cannot_be_read_is_not_due(self):
        home = self.home("an", awake(3), last=at(-9 * DAY))
        with mock.patch.object(due.cadence, "read_cadence", side_effect=OSError("disk")):
            self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an"), Due(False, "error"))


class TestTheLastPace1VersionDecides(HomeCase):
    """Spec section 2: a CADENCE.md changed in a commit the new code did not make
    is treated as a disagreeing marker is: the last pace/1 version decides, until
    the next commit for that home restores it."""

    def tagged_home(self, slug, pace, last):
        text = cad.render_cadence(cadence_of(pace, last=last, name=slug))
        return self.fx.make_home(slug, cadence=text, when="2026-10-01T00:00Z",
                                 message=f"beat: {slug} reflected (2026-11-12) \u00b7 pace/1")

    def change(self, home, slug, text):
        """An untagged commit (an old waker, a person) that rewrites or deletes CADENCE.md."""
        if text is None:
            (home / "CADENCE.md").unlink()
        else:
            self.fx.write(home, "CADENCE.md", text)
        self.fx.commit(home, f"beat: {slug} reflected (2026-11-14)")

    def test_an_untagged_letters_wait_does_not_stop_an_awake_schedule(self):
        home = self.tagged_home("an", awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY))
        self.change(home, "an", cad.render_cadence(cadence_of(LW, last=at(-3 * DAY), name="an")))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "an"), Due(True, "schedule", NOW))
        self.assertEqual(due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["an"], self.state, {}, NOW),
                         [("an", Due(True, "schedule", NOW))])

    def test_an_untagged_awake_does_not_wake_an_asleep_citizen(self):
        home = self.tagged_home("kalam", ASLEEP, last=at(-10 * DAY))
        self.change(home, "kalam", cad.render_cadence(cadence_of(awake(3), last=at(-10 * DAY))))
        self.assertEqual(self.due(home, "kalam"), Due(False, "no-mail"))

    def test_an_untagged_emptied_deleted_or_v1_file_is_never_blocked(self):
        for slug, text in (("an", ""), ("ud", None), ("zi", v1("zi", "rest-on", "2026-11-14 04:00"))):
            with self.subTest(slug=slug, text=text):
                home = self.tagged_home(slug, awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY))
                self.change(home, slug, text)
                self.assertEqual(self.due(home, slug), Due(True, "schedule", NOW))

class TestRank(HomeCase):
    def test_most_overdue_first(self):
        self.home("a", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        self.home("b", awake(3), last=at(-6 * DAY))
        self.home("c", ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), letters=[("x.md", "x\n")])
        self.home("d", awake(3), last=at(-HOUR))
        got = due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["a", "b", "c", "d"], self.state, {}, NOW)
        self.assertEqual([s for s, _ in got], ["c", "b", "a"])
        self.assertEqual([d.reason for _, d in got], ["letter", "schedule", "schedule"])

    def test_ties_go_by_roster_order_from_the_cursor(self):
        roster = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        for slug in roster:
            self.home(slug, awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY))
        for cursor, want in ((0, "abcd"), (1, "bcda"), (3, "dabc"), (6, "cdab"), (-1, "dabc")):
            with self.subTest(cursor=cursor):
                got = due.rank(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, NOW, cursor=cursor)
                self.assertEqual("".join(s for s, _ in got), want)

    def test_only_roster_homes_that_are_due(self):
        self.home("a", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        self.home("off", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        self.home("nosoul", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY), soul=False)
        self.home("asleep", ASLEEP, last=at(-4 * DAY))
        got = due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["a", "nosoul", "asleep", "missing"], self.state, {}, NOW)
        self.assertEqual([s for s, _ in got], ["a"])

    def test_one_failing_home_does_not_hold_up_the_rest(self):
        self.home("a", awake(3), last=at(-9 * DAY))
        bad = self.home("b", awake(3), last=at(-9 * DAY))
        self.home("c", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "a", "f-1", "home-failed", at(-HOUR))
        os.remove(bad / "CADENCE.md")
        self.fx.link(bad, "CADENCE.md", self.fx.secret)
        got = due.rank(self.fx.citizens, ["a", "b", "c"], self.state, {}, NOW)
        self.assertEqual([s for s, _ in got], ["c"])

    def test_a_stamp_out_of_range_in_one_home_holds_up_no_one(self):
        # an offset that carries a stamp past year 1 or 9999 reads as no stamp, in
        # CADENCE.md and in the attempt record alike; a proposal said at the end of
        # time leaves a home that cannot be read ("error", never due), when the
        # show-back beat reads it (patched on). The others rank.
        patcher = mock.patch.object(due, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT", True)
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        self.home("a", awake(3), last=at(-9 * DAY))
        self.home("c", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        far = Pending(awake(5), "9999-12-31T23:30Z", "pace: every 5 days", False)
        cases = (("cadence", dict(pace=awake(3), last=at(-9 * DAY)), "not-yet"),
                 ("record", dict(pace=awake(3), last=at(-HOUR)), "not-yet"),
                 ("pending", dict(pace=ASLEEP, last=at(-9 * DAY), pending_=far), "error"))
        for slug, kw, reason in cases:
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                home = self.home(slug, **kw)
                if slug == "cadence":
                    text = (home / "CADENCE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                    self.fx.write(home, "CADENCE.md", text.replace(
                        f"- last beat: {st(at(-9 * DAY))}", "- last beat: 0001-01-01T00:00+01:00"))
                if slug == "record":
                    self.state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    (self.state / slug).write_text(json.dumps(
                        {"slug": slug, "last_beat": "9999-12-31T23:59-01:00"}), encoding="utf-8")
                roster = ["a", slug, "c"]
                got = due.rank(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, NOW)
                self.assertEqual([s for s, _ in got], ["a", "c"])
                assessed = dict(due.assess(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, NOW))
                self.assertEqual(assessed[slug].reason, reason)

    def test_rank_takes_a_roster_file(self):
        self.home("a", awake(3), last=at(-4 * DAY))
        roster = self.fx.roster("a")
        self.assertEqual([s for s, _ in due.rank(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, NOW)], ["a"])

    def test_read_roster(self):
        path = self.fx.love / "roster.txt"
        path.write_text("an\n\n# a note\n  kalam  \nan\n../evil\nai-love\r\n", encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(due.read_roster(path), ["an", "kalam", "ai-love"])

    def test_rank_seeds_and_next_never_writes(self):
        self.home("a", awake(3))
        self.home("b", ASLEEP)
        roster = ["a", "b"]
        self.assertEqual(due.next_line(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, NOW),
                         f"next to wake: nobody due; next due a at {st(at(3 * DAY))}")
        self.assertFalse(self.state.exists())
        self.assertEqual(due.rank(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, NOW), [])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(p for p in os.listdir(self.state) if not p.startswith(".")), ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(due.rank(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, at(3 * DAY)),
                         [("a", Due(True, "schedule", at(3 * DAY)))])

    def test_next_line(self):
        self.home("a", awake(3), last=at(-3 * DAY - 5 * HOUR - 59 * MINUTE))
        self.home("b", awake(5), last=at(-DAY))
        self.home("c", ASLEEP, last=at(-DAY))
        lines = lambda roster, now=NOW: due.next_line(self.fx.citizens, roster, self.state, {}, now)
        self.assertEqual(lines(["a", "b", "c"]), "next to wake: a (schedule, overdue 5h)")
        self.assertEqual(lines(["b", "c"]), f"next to wake: nobody due; next due b at {st(at(4 * DAY))}")
        self.assertEqual(lines(["c"]), "next to wake: nobody due")
        self.assertEqual(lines([]), "next to wake: nobody due")

            code = ("import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); "
                    "from citizen_pace_lib import attempts, due, lock; "
                    "print(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, attempts.OUTCOMES[0], lock.DEFAULT_BOUND)")
            r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-c", code, str(h.TOOLS)], cwd=tmp,
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False,
                               env={"PATH": h.SYSTEM_PATH})

                first = (h.TOOLS / "citizen_pace_lib" / name).read_text().splitlines()[0]
                self.assertEqual(first, "from __future__ import annotations")

Create `tools/citizen_pace_lib/attempts.py`:

```python
from __future__ import annotations

# The attempt record (spec section 3, "Keeping the clock honest"): one small JSON
# file per citizen, <state>/<slug>, where <state> is $LOVE/memory/.fleet-last
# (git-ignored, as memory/.fleet-* already is). The fleet and
# citizen-reflect.sh share it. It keeps the last landed beat (spoken or silent),
# the clock start written when no beat was ever recorded, the last attempt and
# its outcome, the run of failures and the back-off it earns, the per-home
# "reported once" flags, notices for the next pace paragraph, and how many fleet
# ticks in a row found the citizen busy. Every change is a read-modify-write
# under a file lock, and every write is atomic.

import contextlib
import datetime as _dt
import fcntl
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Iterator, List, Optional

from . import clock
from .clock import DAY, HOUR
from .homes import LinkRefused, read_regular, write_regular

OUTCOMES = ("spoken", "silent", "not-due", "busy", "home-failed", "host-failed", "halted", "summoned")
LANDED = ("spoken", "silent")
# the child writes every outcome but host-failed; the fleet writes host-failed
# after a failed probe, and home-failed or halted when the child wrote nothing
CHILD_OUTCOMES = tuple(o for o in OUTCOMES if o != "host-failed")
BACKOFF = (12 * HOUR, 24 * HOUR, 7 * DAY)   # after failures 1, 2, and 3 or more
HAND_PREFIX = "hand-"                       # a hand-run's attempt id; the fleet's ids never start so
NOTICE_CAP = 20
SEEDED = "now"
_SLUG = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,99}")
_ID = re.compile(r"\S{1,200}")
_KEY = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,99}")
# what an attempt's outcome may change, kept so a second outcome for the same
# attempt (the fleet's host-failed after the child's home-failed) can undo it
_UNDO = ("last_beat", "seeded", "failures", "retry_after", "busy_ticks")


def valid_slug(slug) -> bool:
    """A citizen's name as it may name a file: letters, digits, '-' and '_'."""
    return isinstance(slug, str) and bool(_SLUG.fullmatch(slug))


def record_path(state, slug: str) -> Path:
    if not valid_slug(slug):
        raise ValueError(f"{slug!r} is not a citizen name")
    return Path(state) / slug


def fresh(slug: str) -> dict:
    """The record of a citizen with no attempt yet."""
    return {"slug": slug, "last_beat": None, "seeded": None, "attempt": None, "failures": 0,
            "retry_after": None, "reported": [], "notices": [], "busy_ticks": 0}


# -- reading and cleaning ------------------------------------------------------------

def _stamp_or_none(v) -> Optional[str]:
    if not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip():
        return None
    try:
        return clock.stamp(clock.parse_stamp(v))
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _when(v) -> Optional[_dt.datetime]:
    s = _stamp_or_none(v)
    return clock.parse_stamp(s) if s else None


def _count(v) -> int:
    return v if type(v) is int and v >= 0 else 0


def _stamp_of(at) -> str:
    """A time given as a datetime or a stamp, as a stamp."""
    if isinstance(at, _dt.datetime):
        return clock.stamp(at)
    s = _stamp_or_none(at)
    if s is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{at!r} is not a time")
    return s


def _undo_part(raw) -> dict:
    raw = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    last = _stamp_or_none(raw.get("last_beat"))
    return {"last_beat": last, "seeded": SEEDED if last and raw.get("seeded") == SEEDED else None,
            "failures": _count(raw.get("failures")), "retry_after": _stamp_or_none(raw.get("retry_after")),
            "busy_ticks": _count(raw.get("busy_ticks"))}


def _attempt(raw) -> Optional[dict]:
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return None
    aid, outcome, at = raw.get("id"), raw.get("outcome"), _stamp_or_none(raw.get("at"))
    if not (isinstance(aid, str) and _ID.fullmatch(aid)) or outcome not in OUTCOMES or not at:
        return None
    before = raw.get("before")
    return {"id": aid, "at": at, "outcome": outcome,
            "before": _undo_part(before) if isinstance(before, dict) else None}


def _clean(slug: str, raw) -> dict:
    rec = fresh(slug)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return rec
    rec.update(_undo_part(raw))
    rec["attempt"] = _attempt(raw.get("attempt"))
    reported = raw.get("reported")
    if isinstance(reported, list):
        for k in reported:
            if isinstance(k, str) and _KEY.fullmatch(k) and k not in rec["reported"]:
                rec["reported"].append(k)
    notices = raw.get("notices")
    if isinstance(notices, list):
        for n in notices:
            if isinstance(n, dict) and isinstance(n.get("key"), str) and _KEY.fullmatch(n["key"]):
                at = _stamp_or_none(n.get("at"))
                if at:
                    rec["notices"].append({"key": n["key"], "at": at})
        rec["notices"] = rec["notices"][-NOTICE_CAP:]
    return rec


def load(state, slug: str) -> dict:
    """The citizen's record; the defaults when it is missing or cannot be read
    (a lost record starts the clock again, once, through seed)."""
    path = record_path(state, slug)
    try:
        text = read_regular(path)
    except (LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError):
        return fresh(slug)
    if text is None:
        return fresh(slug)
    try:
        raw = json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        return fresh(slug)
    return _clean(slug, raw)


def save(state, slug: str, rec: dict) -> None:
    """Write the record atomically, as one JSON line; creates the state folder."""
    path = record_path(state, slug)
    os.makedirs(str(state), exist_ok=True)
    write_regular(path, json.dumps(_clean(slug, rec), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n")


@contextlib.contextmanager
def _locked(state, slug: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    """Hold <state>/.<slug>.rw locked, so two writers never lose a change."""
    os.makedirs(str(state), exist_ok=True)
    fd = os.open(str(Path(state) / f".{slug}.rw"), os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def update(state, slug: str, change: Callable[[dict], None]) -> dict:
    """Load, apply change(rec) in place, and save when anything changed, all
    under the record's lock. Returns the record as saved."""
    record_path(state, slug)
    with _locked(state, slug):
        rec = load(state, slug)
        before = json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True)
        change(rec)
        rec = _clean(slug, rec)
        if json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True) != before:
            save(state, slug, rec)
        return rec


# -- outcomes --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def record_outcome(state, slug: str, attempt_id: str, outcome: str, at) -> dict:
    """Record what one attempt came to.

    spoken / silent: a landed beat; last_beat = at, failures 0, no back-off.
    home-failed: failures + 1, and no new pick until at + BACKOFF[min(failures, 3) - 1].
    not-due, busy, halted, summoned, host-failed: the attempt only; no clock moves.
    The same outcome for the same attempt again changes nothing. A different
    outcome for the same attempt first undoes the earlier one, so the fleet's
    host-failed takes back the back-off of the child's home-failed. Busy outcomes
    of fleet attempts in a row are counted (busy_ticks); any other fleet outcome
    ends the run. A hand-run's attempt (id beginning "hand-") leaves the count."""
    if outcome not in OUTCOMES:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown outcome {outcome!r}")
    if not (isinstance(attempt_id, str) and _ID.fullmatch(attempt_id)):
        raise ValueError(f"{attempt_id!r} is not an attempt id")
    record_path(state, slug)
    when = _stamp_of(at)

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        last = rec["attempt"]
        if last and last["id"] == attempt_id:
            if last["outcome"] == outcome:
                return
            before = last["before"] or {k: rec[k] for k in _UNDO}
            rec.update(before)
        else:
            before = {k: rec[k] for k in _UNDO}
        rec["attempt"] = {"id": attempt_id, "at": when, "outcome": outcome, "before": before}
        if outcome in LANDED:
            rec.update(last_beat=when, seeded=None, failures=0, retry_after=None)
        elif outcome == "home-failed":
            rec["failures"] += 1
            wait = BACKOFF[min(rec["failures"], len(BACKOFF)) - 1]
            rec["retry_after"] = clock.stamp(clock.parse_stamp(when) + wait)
        if not attempt_id.startswith(HAND_PREFIX):
            if outcome == "busy":
                rec["busy_ticks"] += 1
            else:
                rec["busy_ticks"] = 0
                if "busy" in rec["reported"]:
                    rec["reported"].remove("busy")

    return update(state, slug, change)


def outcome_for(state, slug: str, attempt_id: str) -> str:
    """The outcome this attempt recorded, or "missing"."""
    a = load(state, slug)["attempt"]
    return a["outcome"] if a and a["id"] == attempt_id else "missing"


def last_beat_at(rec: dict) -> Optional[_dt.datetime]:
    """The record's last landed beat (or the clock start it was seeded with)."""
    return _when((rec or {}).get("last_beat"))


def retry_after(rec: dict) -> Optional[_dt.datetime]:
    return _when((rec or {}).get("retry_after"))


def backing_off(rec: dict, now: _dt.datetime) -> bool:
    """A failed beat keeps this citizen from being picked until retry_after."""
    r = retry_after(rec)
    return r is not None and now < r


def seed(state, slug: str, now: _dt.datetime) -> dict:
    """Start the clock now when the record holds no last beat (or one later than
    now). Call it only when CADENCE.md holds none either; the fleet's ranking and
    the reflect gate are the only callers that write."""
    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        last = last_beat_at(rec)
        if last is None or last > now:
            rec["last_beat"], rec["seeded"] = clock.stamp(now), SEEDED

    return update(state, slug, change)


# -- reported once, busy, notices ----------------------------------------------------

def _check_key(key: str) -> None:
    if not (isinstance(key, str) and _KEY.fullmatch(key)):
        raise ValueError(f"{key!r} is not a report or notice key")


def mark_reported(state, slug: str, key: str) -> bool:
    """True the first time key is reported for this citizen, False after."""
    _check_key(key)
    first = []

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        if key not in rec["reported"]:
            rec["reported"].append(key)
            first.append(True)

    update(state, slug, change)
    return bool(first)


def clear_reported(state, slug: str, key: str) -> bool:
    """Forget a report, so the next one is made again; True when it was there."""
    _check_key(key)
    had = []

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        if key in rec["reported"]:
            rec["reported"].remove(key)
            had.append(True)

    update(state, slug, change)
    return bool(had)


def report_busy(state, slug: str) -> bool:
    """True once when the citizen was busy on two fleet ticks running; again
    only after a run of busy ticks has ended and a new one has begun."""
    first = []

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        if rec["busy_ticks"] >= 2 and "busy" not in rec["reported"]:
            rec["reported"].append("busy")
            first.append(True)

    update(state, slug, change)
    return bool(first)


def add_notice(state, slug: str, key: str, at) -> dict:
    """Keep a notice (e.g. "restored") for the citizen's next pace paragraph."""
    _check_key(key)
    when = _stamp_of(at)

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        rec["notices"].append({"key": key, "at": when})
        del rec["notices"][:-NOTICE_CAP]

    return update(state, slug, change)


def notice_keys(rec: dict, since=None) -> List[str]:
    """The keys of the notices recorded at or after since (all when None),
    oldest first, each once."""
    start = since if isinstance(since, _dt.datetime) or since is None else _when(since)
    out = []
    for n in sorted((rec or {}).get("notices") or [], key=lambda n: n["at"]):
        if (start is None or clock.parse_stamp(n["at"]) >= start) and n["key"] not in out:
            out.append(n["key"])
    return out


def clear_notices(state, slug: str, upto=None) -> dict:
    """Drop the notices recorded at or before upto (all when None)."""
    end = clock.parse_stamp(_stamp_of(upto)) if upto is not None else None

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        rec["notices"] = [n for n in rec["notices"]
                          if end is not None and clock.parse_stamp(n["at"]) > end]

    return update(state, slug, change)
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the per-citizen lock**

Create `tools/citizen_pace_lib/lock.py`:

```python
from __future__ import annotations

# The per-citizen lock (spec section 3, "Keeping the clock honest"; CONTRACT
# section 14): a folder <state>/<slug>.lock holding `pid` and `started` (a
# stamp). citizen-reflect.sh and citizen-beat.sh take it before their gates, so
# a hand-run beside the fleet can never beat a citizen twice or confirm a
# proposal inside one beat; a second run finds it held and writes `busy`. Tend,
# the bring-up-to-date step and the heard-late step skip a home whose lock is
# held. A lock is stale, and is reclaimed, when its pid is gone or it is older
# than twice the beat bound (FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC, 600 s by default).

import datetime as _dt
import errno
import os
import re
import shutil
import stat
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Tuple

from . import clock
from .attempts import record_path

DEFAULT_BOUND = 600
MIN_BOUND = 30
SUFFIX = ".lock"


def beat_bound(value: Optional[str] = None) -> int:
    """The beat bound in seconds, read as citizen-fleet.sh's num() reads
    FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC, so the lock is judged by the bound the fleet enforces:
    anything but the digits 0-9 (a space included) counts as 0, and under 30 is 600."""
    raw = os.environ.get("FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC", "") if value is None else str(value)
    n = int(raw) if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", raw) else 0
    return DEFAULT_BOUND if n < MIN_BOUND else n


def lock_path(state, slug: str) -> Path:
    """<state>/<slug>.lock (the slug is checked as for the attempt record)."""
    p = record_path(state, slug)
    return p.with_name(p.name + SUFFIX)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Holder:
    pid: Optional[int]          # None when no pid is recorded (yet) or it is not a process number
    started: Optional[str]      # stamp, or None
    age_s: Optional[float]      # seconds since started (or since the folder was made)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Taken:
    got: bool
    reclaimed: str = ""                 # why a stale lock was reclaimed first, "" when none was
    holder: Optional[Holder] = None     # who holds it, when not got


def _read_small(path: Path) -> Optional[str]:
    try:
        fd = os.open(str(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    except OSError:
        return None
    try:
        if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(fd).st_mode):
            return None
        return os.read(fd, 64).decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _ident(d: Path) -> Tuple[Optional[int], Optional[str]]:
    """(pid, started) as recorded in a lock folder; (None, None) for anything else."""
    try:
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(os.lstat(d).st_mode):
            return None, None
    except OSError:
        return None, None
    text = _read_small(d / "pid") or ""
    pid = int(text) if text.isdigit() and int(text) > 0 else None
    started = _read_small(d / "started")
    try:
        started = clock.stamp(clock.parse_stamp(started)) if started else None
    except ValueError:
        started = None
    return pid, started


def holder(state, slug: str, now: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None) -> Optional[Holder]:
    """Who holds the citizen's lock, or None when there is no lock. A path that is
    not a plain folder (a stray file or a link) is a lock with no holder recorded."""
    d = lock_path(state, slug)
    try:
        st = os.lstat(d)
    except OSError:
        return None
    pid, started = _ident(d)
    if started:
        age = ((now or clock.now()) - clock.parse_stamp(started)).total_seconds()
    else:
        age = time.time() - st.st_mtime
    return Holder(pid, started, max(0.0, age))


def _alive(pid: int) -> bool:
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return False
    except OSError:
        return True          # it exists, but is not ours to signal
    return True


def stale_reason(h: Optional[Holder], bound: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
    """Why a lock is stale ("pid N is gone", "older than S s"), or "" when it is held."""
    if h is None:
        return ""
    limit = 2 * (beat_bound() if bound is None else bound)
    if h.pid is not None and not _alive(h.pid):
        return f"pid {h.pid} is gone"
    if h.age_s is not None and h.age_s > limit:
        return f"older than {limit} s"
    return ""


def held(state, slug: str, now: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None, bound: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
    """A live holder that is not stale holds the lock."""
    h = holder(state, slug, now)
    return h is not None and not stale_reason(h, bound)


def _discard(p: Path) -> None:
    try:
        if stat.S_ISDIR(os.lstat(p).st_mode):
            shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
        else:
            os.unlink(p)
    except OSError:
        pass


def _reclaim(d: Path, seen: Holder) -> bool:
    """Move a stale lock aside and remove it. If what was moved is not the lock
    judged stale (another run took the path meanwhile), put it back."""
    grave = d.with_name(f"{d.name}.stale-{os.getpid()}-{time.time_ns()}")
    try:
        os.rename(d, grave)
    except OSError:
        return False
    if _ident(grave) != (seen.pid, seen.started):
        try:
            os.rename(grave, d)
        except OSError:
            _discard(grave)
        return False
    _discard(grave)
    return True


def _write_new(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    fd = os.open(str(path), os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o644)
    try:
        os.write(fd, text.encode("utf-8"))
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def take(state, slug: str, pid: int, now: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None,
         bound: Optional[int] = None) -> Taken:
    """Take the citizen's lock for pid. A stale lock is reclaimed first (the
    reason is returned, for the log); a held one is not taken."""
    if type(pid) is not int or pid <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"{pid!r} is not a process number")
    when = now or clock.now()
    d = lock_path(state, slug)
    os.makedirs(str(state), exist_ok=True)
    reclaimed = ""
    for _ in range(2):
        try:
            os.mkdir(d)
        except FileExistsError:
            h = holder(state, slug, when)
            reason = stale_reason(h, bound)
            if not reason or reclaimed or not _reclaim(d, h):
                return Taken(False, reclaimed, h)
            reclaimed = reason
            continue
        try:
            _write_new(d / "pid", f"{pid}\n")
            _write_new(d / "started", f"{clock.stamp(when)}\n")
        except OSError as e:
            if e.errno != errno.ENOENT:      # the folder is still ours: leave no half-made lock
                _discard(d)
            return Taken(False, reclaimed, holder(state, slug, when))
        return Taken(True, reclaimed)
    return Taken(False, reclaimed, holder(state, slug, when))


def release(state, slug: str, pid: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
    """Remove the lock; with pid, only when that pid holds it. True when removed."""
    d = lock_path(state, slug)
    if not os.path.lexists(d):
        return False
    if pid is not None and _ident(d)[0] != pid:
        return False
    _discard(d)
    return True
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write who is due**

Create `tools/citizen_pace_lib/due.py`:

```python
from __future__ import annotations

# Who is due (spec section 3). The fleet only ever answers a citizen's own
# clock: an awake citizen is due N days after its last beat, and its letters
# wait for that beat; an asleep or listening citizen is due when an unread
# letter waits and 72 hours have passed since its last beat; and a citizen that
# asked for more is owed one show-back beat, 72 hours after the beat that said
# it. Nothing else makes a citizen due. Its last beat is the later of
# CADENCE.md's `last beat` and the attempt record's last landed beat; with
# neither, the clock starts now, and only the fleet's ranking and the reflect
# gate write that start. The record that decides is cadence.read_deciding's: a
# CADENCE.md changed outside pace/1 does not decide over its last pace/1
# version. A person's summons passes any pace, floor and back-off, but never a
# home with no soul, a linked pace path, a merge in progress or a fresh
# index.lock.

import datetime as _dt
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from . import attempts, cadence, clock, homes, lock
from .clock import DAY, FLOOR, HOUR
from .homes import LinkRefused

# Yu's answer to KS-004 section 15 item 16 (spec sections 1 and 9): True gives an
# asleep, asleep-letters-wait or listening citizen that asks for more one
# show-back beat, no sooner than 3 days after the beat that said it. It is set
# in the PR before the merge and nothing else overrides it; the delivery tool
# reads this same value to word the letter.
WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT = True

DUE_REASONS = ("schedule", "letter", "show-back", "summoned")
NOT_DUE_REASONS = ("no-home", "no-soul", "links", "mid-merge", "blocked", "backing-off",
                   "letters-wait", "floor", "not-yet", "no-mail", "unreadable", "error")
SHOW_BACK_KINDS = ("asleep-letters-wait", "asleep", "listening")
# the proposal's stamp (from apply) and the attempt record's stamp for the same
# beat can differ by the time the commit took; a landed beat within this of the
# proposal is that same beat
SAME_BEAT = HOUR


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Due:
    due: bool
    reason: str                              # one of DUE_REASONS or NOT_DUE_REASONS
    since: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None     # due: when it became due
    next_at: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None   # not due: the earliest it may become due, when known

    def overdue_s(self, now: _dt.datetime) -> int:
        """Seconds since it became due; 0 when not due."""
        if not self.due or self.since is None:
            return 0
        return max(0, int((now - self.since).total_seconds()))

    def to_json(self, now: _dt.datetime) -> dict:
        return {"due": self.due, "reason": self.reason, "overdue_s": self.overdue_s(now),
                "since": clock.stamp(self.since) if self.since else None,
                "next_at": clock.stamp(self.next_at) if self.next_at else None}


def _when(v) -> Optional[_dt.datetime]:
    if not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip():
        return None
    try:
        return clock.parse_stamp(v)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def last_beat(c: Optional[cadence.Cadence], rec: dict,
              now: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None) -> Optional[_dt.datetime]:
    """The later of CADENCE.md's last beat and the attempt record's. With now, a
    time later than now is no last beat: unknown state starts the clock from now."""
    found = [_when(c.last_beat) if c is not None else None, attempts.last_beat_at(rec)]
    found = [t for t in found if t is not None and (now is None or t <= now)]
    return max(found) if found else None


def show_back_owed(c: Optional[cadence.Cadence], last: Optional[_dt.datetime],
                   confirm_beat: Optional[bool] = None) -> bool:
    """One show-back beat is owed: the switch is on, an asleep, letters-wait or
    listening citizen has a pending proposal that was not said on a show-back
    beat, and no landed beat came after the beat that said it."""
    confirm = WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT if confirm_beat is None else confirm_beat
    if not confirm or c is None or c.pending is None or c.pending.on_show_back:
        return False
    if c.pace is None or c.pace.kind not in SHOW_BACK_KINDS:
        return False
    said = clock.parse_stamp(c.pending.said)
    return last is None or last <= said + SAME_BEAT


def _by_pace(c: cadence.Cadence, last: _dt.datetime, now: _dt.datetime,
             mail: Sequence[_dt.datetime], confirm: Optional[bool]) -> Due:
    kind = c.pace.kind if c.pace is not None else None
    if kind == "awake":
        at = last + c.pace.n * DAY
        return Due(True, "schedule", at) if now >= at else Due(False, "not-yet", next_at=at)
    back = None
    if show_back_owed(c, last, confirm):
        back = max(clock.parse_stamp(c.pending.said), last) + FLOOR
    if kind == "asleep-letters-wait":
        if back is None:
            return Due(False, "letters-wait")
        return Due(True, "show-back", back) if now >= back else Due(False, "floor", next_at=back)
    floor = last + FLOOR
    if mail and now >= floor:
        return Due(True, "letter", max(min(mail), floor))
    if back is not None and now >= back:
        return Due(True, "show-back", back)
    if mail or back is not None:
        return Due(False, "floor", next_at=floor if mail else back)
    return Due(False, "no-mail" if kind is not None else "unreadable")


def is_due(c: Optional[cadence.Cadence], rec: dict, now: _dt.datetime, mail_times: list,
           soul: bool, links: list, midmerge: bool, summoned: bool = False,
           confirm_beat: Optional[bool] = None) -> Due:
    """Whether one citizen is due now. Checked in order: no soul, links, a merge
    or fresh index.lock (never due, even summoned); a summons (due); a record
    that must not become v2 (blocked); back-off; then its pace. mail_times are
    the arrival times of its unread letters. confirm_beat None reads
    WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT at call time."""
    if not soul:
        return Due(False, "no-soul")
    if links:
        return Due(False, "links")
    if midmerge:
        return Due(False, "mid-merge")
    if summoned:
        return Due(True, "summoned", now)
    if c.blocked:
        return Due(False, "blocked")
    by_pace = _by_pace(c, last_beat(c, rec, now) or now, now, mail_times, confirm_beat)
    if attempts.backing_off(rec, now):
        until = attempts.retry_after(rec)
        if by_pace.due:
            nxt = until
        else:
            nxt = max(by_pace.next_at, until) if by_pace.next_at else None
        return Due(False, "backing-off", next_at=nxt)
    return by_pace


# -- one home on disk ------------------------------------------------------------------

def fresh_index_lock(home, bound: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
    """.git/index.lock exists and is no older than twice the beat bound."""
    age = homes.index_lock_age(home)
    return age is not None and age <= 2 * (lock.beat_bound() if bound is None else bound)


def mail_times(home, now: _dt.datetime) -> List[_dt.datetime]:
    """When each unread letter arrived (homes.letter_time, clamped to now)."""
    return [homes.letter_time(home, rel, now) for rel in homes.unread_letters(home)]


def due_for_home(home, name: str, state, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime, summoned: bool = False,
                 write_seed: bool = True, bound: Optional[int] = None) -> Due:
    """Whether the citizen in this home is due now. With write_seed (the fleet's
    ranking and the reflect gate), a citizen with no last beat anywhere has its
    clock started now in the attempt record; next and plan pass False. A home
    that cannot be read is not due ("error"), a stamp that no date can reach
    (a proposal said at the end of time) included."""
    home = Path(home)
    try:
        if not home.is_dir():
            return Due(False, "no-home")
        soul = homes.has_soul(home, name)
        links = homes.forbidden_links(home) if soul else []
        midmerge = bool(soul and not links and (homes.mid_merge(home) or fresh_index_lock(home, bound)))
        if not soul or links or midmerge or summoned:
            return is_due(None, {}, now, [], soul, links, midmerge, summoned)
        try:
            c = cadence.read_deciding(home, name, record, now)
        except LinkRefused:
            return Due(False, "links")
        rec = attempts.load(state, name)
        if write_seed and last_beat(c, rec, now) is None:
            rec = attempts.seed(state, name, now)
        wants_mail = not c.blocked and (c.pace is None or c.pace.kind in ("asleep", "listening"))
        mail = mail_times(home, now) if wants_mail else []
        return is_due(c, rec, now, mail, soul, links, midmerge)
    except (OSError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        return Due(False, "error")


# -- the roster --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def read_roster(path) -> List[str]:
    """The roster's citizen names in order: blank lines, '#' notes, repeats and
    anything that is not a plain name are skipped."""
    out: List[str] = []
    for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        slug = line.strip()
        if slug and not slug.startswith("#") and attempts.valid_slug(slug) and slug not in out:
            out.append(slug)
    return out


def _slugs(roster) -> List[str]:
    if isinstance(roster, (str, os.PathLike)):
        return read_roster(roster)
    out: List[str] = []
    for s in roster:
        if attempts.valid_slug(s) and s not in out:
            out.append(s)
    return out


def assess(homes_dir, roster, state, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime,
           write_seed: bool = True) -> List[Tuple[str, Due]]:
    """(slug, Due) for every roster citizen, in roster order."""
    return [(slug, due_for_home(Path(homes_dir) / f"citizen-{slug}", slug, state, record, now,
                                write_seed=write_seed))
            for slug in _slugs(roster)]


def _order(slugs: List[str], cursor: int) -> dict:
    n = len(slugs) or 1
    start = cursor % n
    return {slug: (i - start) % n for i, slug in enumerate(slugs)}


def _ranked(assessed: List[Tuple[str, Due]], order: dict) -> List[Tuple[str, Due]]:
    due_now = [(s, d) for s, d in assessed if d.due]
    return sorted(due_now, key=lambda sd: (sd[1].since, order[sd[0]]))


def rank(homes_dir, roster, state, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime, cursor: int = 0,
         write_seed: bool = True) -> List[Tuple[str, Due]]:
    """The due citizens, most overdue first; ties go by roster order from the
    cursor. A home that fails to read is not due and holds up no one."""
    slugs = _slugs(roster)
    return _ranked(assess(homes_dir, slugs, state, record, now, write_seed), _order(slugs, cursor))


def next_line(homes_dir, roster, state, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime, cursor: int = 0) -> str:
    """fleet-status.sh's "next to wake" line. Writes nothing."""
    slugs = _slugs(roster)
    order = _order(slugs, cursor)
    assessed = assess(homes_dir, slugs, state, record, now, write_seed=False)
    ranked = _ranked(assessed, order)
    if ranked:
        slug, d = ranked[0]
        return f"next to wake: {slug} ({d.reason}, overdue {d.overdue_s(now) // 3600}h)"
    upcoming = sorted((d.next_at, order[s], s) for s, d in assessed if d.next_at is not None)
    if upcoming:
        at, _, slug = upcoming[0]
        return f"next to wake: nobody due; next due {slug} at {clock.stamp(at)}"
    return "next to wake: nobody due"
```

### Task 4: The pace paragraph and the pace letter text

What a citizen is told about its own pace (spec section 4, "The pace paragraph") and the one letter
that asks it once (spec section 5, "What it says"). The paragraph ends every beat's user prompt. It
gives the pace and who set it, in the second person. Then come a pending choice for more, without the
line that said it; each notice, once; and the four choices with their meanings, moved one place at
each beat that commits. The letter gives each recipient group its one true sentence, the rotated menu,
and the rule paragraph worded from the committed show-back value. Neither ever offers a sample answer
or says "I rest" (spec section 4, Prompts; principle 6). Both modules are pure text over Tasks 1 to 3.
The caller passes the committed `due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT` in as `confirm_beat`, so the words and the
fleet's behaviour come from the same value (spec sections 1 and 5); from `due.py` the paragraph reads
only `SAME_BEAT`, the hour within which apply's stamp and the attempt record's stamp are one beat.

- Create: `tools/citizen_pace_lib/letter.py`

**Readings this task fixes** (each is covered by a test; later tasks rely on them):
- **The paragraph** is CONTRACT section 9's layout, one item per line: the first line, the pending
  sentence, the notices, the instruction, the four menu lines, then `RULE_SENTENCE`, `LIMIT_SENTENCE`
  and "Without a pace line, your pace stays as it is." on one line. An unreadable pace opens with
  "Your pace could not be read, so you get no set beats; a letter still wakes you." and still offers
  the menu. A beat that shows the pace letter gets only the first line (spec section 4), so the pending
  sentence and the notices wait for the next full paragraph.
- **Times shown to a citizen are days** (`YYYY-MM-DD`), not minute stamps, in every second-person
  sentence. Only the AMBIENT form quotes the citizen's words (spec section 4's example), and only
  words that `quotable` passes. A beat's pace line and the words a prompt offered are never quoted.
- **Notices, each once.** History notices are those stamped at or after the citizen's last beat, the
  later of `CADENCE.md`'s `last beat` and the attempt record's `last_beat` (a silent beat that
  committed nothing still counts). Apply stamps a beat's notices and `CADENCE.md`'s last beat with its
  own minute, and record stamps the attempt record after the commit, so an attempt record less than
  `due.SAME_BEAT` (one hour) after `CADENCE.md`'s last beat is that same beat, and the window starts
  at `CADENCE.md`'s stamp; beats that move the clock are at least 72 h apart, so two beats never
  merge. When that last beat showed the pace letter (its "reached (once)" entry within `SAME_BEAT`
  of it), its paragraph left the notices out, and Task 5's apply recorded each of them again at that
  beat; the window starts at the reached entry and never reaches back past it, so a notice shown
  before the pace letter's beat is not shown again. Lines: `unclear` gives its reason when it is one
  of `REASONS`; `lapsed` gives the pace words when they parse, and says the citizen's line could not
  be read when that is why it lapsed; both "changed by someone other than" texts give one line;
  `pace unreadable` adds none (the first line says it); the attempt record's `restored` key adds the
  restored line. Identical lines are shown once. No notice quotes a line.
- **The paragraph names the pace that decides the beat**: over a `CADENCE.md` changed outside
  `pace/1`, the last `pace/1` version (Task 2's `read_deciding`), as Task 3's `due` reads it.
- **Show-back off.** With `confirm_beat` False, the letters-wait meaning drops its show-back aside, the
  letter's second sentence is `MORE_LATER` for an asleep or listening recipient, and the letter's
  close drops ", or once to show back a choice for more" (principle 7: true words only).
- **The letter's paragraphs are single lines** (the spec's template wraps only because it is a spec).
- **Each sentence must be true of its home**, or `letter_text` raises `ValueError`. The 8 must be
  asleep, set by a prompt; the 16 and the never asked asleep, set by Ai on 10-08; the heard, awake every
  3 days, set by their AMBIENT; hope and ihsanme awake every 3 days, set by the fleet's first word; the
  unheard with no pace read anything but letters-wait. A blocked record, an unreadable pace, another
  citizen's record, a group that is not a recipient group, or a missing dated answer also raises, and
  so do quoted words that would carry "I rest" or a `pace:` line.
- **Dates and words come from the record entry.** The heard quote their two latest dated answers as
  `'<w>'` when the words are the same, or `'<w1>' and '<w2>'` when they differ. The unheard with no pace
  read take the latest answer's date. hope and ihsanme take the latest answer's month and day, and get
  "(In July you chose AMBIENT.)" only when the entry's `july` words say AMBIENT. diplosemy, in the
  sixteen-ambient group, gets the spec's extra sentence.

def unquoted(text, quotes):
    """The text with the record's quoted words taken out."""
    for q in quotes:
        text = text.replace(q, "")
    return text


class PromptChecks:
    """The rules every rendering keeps (spec section 4: no "I rest", no sample answer)."""

    def assert_prompt_rules(self, text, name, quotes=()):
        self.assertIsNone(I_REST.search(text), text)
        low = text.lower()
        for w in SAMPLE_WORDS:
            self.assertNotIn(w, low)
        # the only "pace:" is the quoted instruction, beside the first line's "Your pace:"
        bare = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"pace\s*:", text, re.I)
                if text[max(0, m.start() - 1)] != '"' and not text[:m.start()].endswith("Your ")]
        self.assertEqual(bare, [], text)
        # read back as an answer, nothing in it but the citizen's own quoted words names a pace
        self.assertEqual(answer_lines(text, name, "beat"), [])
        for kind in KINDS:
            self.assertEqual(answer_lines(unquoted(text, quotes), name, kind), [], (kind, text))


class TestRotation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_offset_is_beats_plus_the_first_byte_of_sha256(self):
        pinned = {("kalam", 0): 3, ("kalam", 1): 0, ("soma", 0): 0, ("teotlme", 7): 3,
                  ("hope", 1): 3, ("aseme", 5): 1, ("alohame", 0): 3}
        for (name, beats), want in pinned.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name, beats=beats):
                self.assertEqual(par.rotation(name, beats), want)

    def test_the_same_in_every_process(self):
        names = ["kalam", "soma", "teotlme", "hope", "ihsanme", "aseme", "ai-love", "palance"]
        here = " ".join(str(par.rotation(n, 11)) for n in names)
        code = ("import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); "
                "from citizen_pace_lib import paragraph as p; "
                f"print(' '.join(str(p.rotation(n, 11)) for n in {names!r}))")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            for flags, seed in ((["-I"], None), ([], "0"), ([], "1"), ([], "4242")):
                env = {"PATH": h.SYSTEM_PATH}
                if seed is not None:
                    env["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = seed
                r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *flags, "-c", code, str(h.TOOLS)], cwd=tmp,
                                   env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(r.stdout.strip(), here, (flags, seed))

    def test_the_menu_turns_by_one_at_each_committed_beat(self):
        for beats in range(8):
            k = par.rotation("kalam", beats)
            self.assertEqual(par.rotated_menu("kalam", beats, True), MENU[k:] + MENU[:k])
            nxt = par.rotated_menu("kalam", beats + 1, True)
            self.assertEqual(nxt, par.rotated_menu("kalam", beats, True)[1:]
                             + par.rotated_menu("kalam", beats, True)[:1])
        self.assertEqual(par.menu_lines("kalam", 1, True), [M_ASLEEP, M_LW, M_LISTENING, M_AWAKE])

    def test_a_beat_count_must_be_a_whole_number(self):
        for bad in (-1, 1.0, True, "3", None):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                par.rotation("kalam", bad)

    @staticmethod
    def year(name, n_days, seed):
        """A year of one citizen's beats on 6-hour ticks, each 0-3 ticks late (the
        daily cap): on a schedule every n_days, or woken by letters at the floor
        when n_days is None. Counts the choice shown first at each committed beat.
        A silent beat with no mail commits nothing and is not counted."""
        rnd = random.Random(f"{name}-{n_days}-{seed}")
        commits = rnd.randrange(60)            # beat commits the home already holds
        firsts = collections.Counter({m[0]: 0 for m in MENU})
        last, end, tick = 0, 365 * 24, 6
        while True:
            if n_days is None:
                due = max(last + rnd.randrange(24, 24 * 21), last + 72)   # a letter, at the floor
            else:
                due = last + 24 * n_days
            at = math.ceil(due / tick) * tick + tick * rnd.randrange(4)
            if at > end:
                return firsts
            shown = par.rotated_menu(name, commits, True)[0][0]
            if n_days is None or rnd.random() >= 0.3:    # a letter beat always commits
                firsts[shown] += 1
                commits += 1
            last = at

    def test_each_choice_comes_first_equally_often_within_one(self):
        for name in ("kalam", "soma", "hope", "ud"):
            for n in list(range(3, 31)) + [365, None]:
                for seed in range(3):
                    with self.subTest(name=name, n=n, seed=seed):
                        counts = self.year(name, n, seed).values()
                        self.assertLessEqual(max(counts) - min(counts), 1)
