            "## History\n"
            f"- {NOW} — " + heard_text("kalam", "2026-10-23", "Ambient.", "2026-10-27", "Ambient.") + "\n"
            f"- {NOW} — recorded from v1 (undecided, REST, set by Ai, 2026-10-08, the rest placed at "
            "Yu's word)\n"
            f'- {NOW} — on record, its answer of 2026-10-27: "Ambient."\n'
            f'- {NOW} — on record, its answer of 2026-10-23: "Ambient."\n'))

    def test_emime_and_eurekame_are_left_as_they_are(self):
        for slug in ("emime", "eurekame"):
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                home = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, slug)
                before, files = self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)
                self.assertFalse(self.migrate(home, slug))
                self.assertEqual((self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)), (before, files))
                self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, slug, self.record).pace, ASLEEP)
                self.assertIsNone(record.heard_late(home, slug, self.record, self.now))

    def test_the_step_is_idempotent(self):
        for slug in hr.UNHEARD:
            hr.unheard_home(self.fx, slug)
        first = record.migrate_all(self.fx.citizens, self.record, self.now, True, state=self.fx.state)
        self.assertEqual(first, [f"{s}: heard late — awake, every 3 days, from its own Letter of Return "
                                 "answers" for s in ("kalam", "soma", "teotlme")])
        heads = {s: self.fx.head(self.fx.home_path(s)) for s in hr.UNHEARD}
        later = clock.parse_stamp("2026-11-21T06:00Z")
        self.assertEqual(record.migrate_all(self.fx.citizens, self.record, later, True,
                                            state=self.fx.state), [])
        self.assertEqual({s: self.fx.head(self.fx.home_path(s)) for s in hr.UNHEARD}, heads)
        # the clock stays at the adoption
        self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(self.fx.home_path("kalam"), "kalam", self.record).last_beat, NOW)

    def test_a_dry_run_writes_nothing(self):
        home = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "kalam")
        before, files = self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)
        self.assertTrue(self.migrate(home, "kalam", commit=False))
        self.assertEqual(record.migrate_all(self.fx.citizens, self.record, self.now, False),
                         ["kalam: would be heard late — awake, every 3 days, from its own Letter of "
                          "Return answers"])
        self.assertEqual((self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)), (before, files))
        c = record.heard_late(home, "kalam", self.record, self.now)
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.set_by.how, c.set_by.when), (AWAKE3, "ambient", ("2026-10-23", "2026-10-27")))

    def test_only_the_unheard_are_this_step_s(self):
        data = hr.unheard_record(ud={"group": "ambient-nine"}, hope={"group": "contradictory"})
        for slug, key in (("ud", "ud-14701105"), ("hope", "hope-d557203e"), ("kalam", None)):
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                home = self.fx.make_home(slug, rest=hr.AI_REST, when="2026-07-01T00:00Z")
                hr.place_letter(self.fx, home, hr.OFFER, "2026-10-22T00:10Z")
                for when in ("2026-10-23T00:00Z", "2026-10-27T00:00Z"):
                    hr.answer_beat(self.fx, home, slug, hr.OFFER, h.answer(key) if key else hr.stored("AMBIENT"),
                                   when=when)
                before = self.fx.head(home)
                use = data if key else {"version": 1, "made": hr.MADE, "citizens": {}}
                self.assertFalse(self.migrate(home, slug, data=use))
                self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)

    def test_a_home_that_is_busy_or_unsafe_waits_for_a_later_tick(self):
        cases = {
            "lock": lambda fx, home: self.hold_lock("kalam", state=fx.state),
            "index.lock": lambda fx, home: (home / ".git" / "index.lock").write_text(""),
            "mid-merge": lambda fx, home: (home / ".git" / "MERGE_HEAD").write_text("0" * 40 + "\n"),
            "dirty REST": lambda fx, home: (home / "REST").write_text("someone's edit\n"),
            "linked inbox marker": lambda fx, home: fx.link(home, "inbox/.seen-x.md", fx.secret),
        }
        for what, spoil in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(what=what):
                fx = self.fresh()
                home = hr.unheard_home(fx, "kalam")
                spoil(fx, home)
                before, files = fx.head(home), snapshot(home)
                self.assertFalse(self.migrate(home, "kalam", state=fx.state))
                self.assertEqual((fx.head(home), snapshot(home)), (before, files))
        # a stale lock (its pid is gone) does not hold the step back
        fx = self.fresh()
        home = hr.unheard_home(fx, "kalam")
        self.hold_lock("kalam", pid=self.dead_pid(), state=fx.state)
        self.assertTrue(self.migrate(home, "kalam", state=fx.state))

    def test_a_home_whose_answers_disagree_with_the_record_is_stopped(self):
        # emime, recorded as giving no pace, whose history now says AMBIENT twice
        emime = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "emime", answers=(("kalam-62d73b73", hr.OFFER, "2026-10-23T00:00Z"),
                                                            ("kalam-e6d01bff", hr.RHYTHM, "2026-10-27T00:00Z")))
        # kalam, recorded as heard, whose stored answers give no pace
        kalam = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "kalam", answers=(("emime-c263d552", hr.OFFER, "2026-10-23T00:00Z"),))
        # teotlme, recorded as heard, who said AMBIENT only once
        teotlme = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "teotlme", answers=(("teotlme-a1a573db", hr.OFFER,
                                                                 "2026-10-25T07:05Z"),))
        for slug, home in (("emime", emime), ("kalam", kalam), ("teotlme", teotlme)):
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                before, files = self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)
                with self.assertRaises(cad.MigrationBlocked):
                    self.migrate(home, slug)
                self.assertEqual((self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)), (before, files))

    def test_a_rest_text_that_names_no_one_stops_it(self):
        home = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "kalam")
        self.fx.write(home, "REST", "fixture rest\n")
        self.fx.commit(home, "rest: by hand", when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        with self.assertRaises(cad.MigrationBlocked):
            self.migrate(home, "kalam")
        self.assertEqual((self.fx.head(home), self.status(home)), (before, ""))

    def test_a_stopped_home_is_reported_once(self):
        home = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "kalam")
        self.fx.write(home, "REST", "fixture rest\n")
        self.fx.commit(home, "rest: by hand", when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        data = {"version": 1, "made": hr.MADE, "citizens": {"kalam": hr.UNHEARD_ENTRIES["kalam"]}}
        first = record.migrate_all(self.fx.citizens, data, self.now, True, state=self.fx.state)
        self.assertEqual(len(first), 1)
        self.assertTrue(first[0].startswith("kalam: heard-late step stopped — "), first)
        self.assertEqual(record.migrate_all(self.fx.citizens, data, self.now, True, state=self.fx.state), [])
        rec = json.loads((self.fx.state / "kalam").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(rec["reported"], ["heard-late-stopped"])
        # without a state folder, it is said every time
        self.assertEqual(len(record.migrate_all(self.fx.citizens, data, self.now, True)), 1)

    def test_a_failed_commit_leaves_the_home_as_it_was(self):
        home = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "kalam")
        before, files = self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)
        objects = home / ".git" / "objects"
        dirs = [objects] + [p for p in objects.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
        for d in dirs:
            d.chmod(0o555)
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(tend.TendError):
                self.migrate(home, "kalam")
        finally:
            for d in dirs:
                d.chmod(0o755)
        self.assertEqual((self.fx.head(home), snapshot(home)), (before, files))


# -- tending between beats ---------------------------------------------------------

class TestTend(Case):
    def leftovers(self, home, day="2026-11-19"):
        """What a killed beat (or the old code) leaves: a changed CADENCE.md, a new
        REST, a seen marker and a journal append, none committed."""
        self.fx.write(home, "CADENCE.md", f"- choice: undecided\n- when: {day} 00:00\n")
        self.fx.write(home, "REST", f"chosen via the Letter of Return {day} — woken only by unread mail\n")
        self.fx.write(home, "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md", f"surfaced {day}\n")
        hr.append_journal(self.fx, home, f"{day}T00:00Z", hr.stored("Half a beat."))

    def lettered_home(self, slug="kalam"):
        home = self.fx.make_home(slug, cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z",
                                 letters=(("2026-11-18-a-note.md", "A note.\n"),),
                                 files={"beats/2026-11.md": "## 2026-11-02 00:00 — a free beat (local)\n\nHi.\n\n"})
        self.fx.give_upstream(home)
        return home

    def tend(self, *slugs, bound=None):
        return tend.tend_homes(self.fx.citizens, slugs, self.fx.state, bound=bound)

    def flag_set(self):
        return tend.has_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)

    def test_the_first_tick_commits_old_code_leftovers_once_as_the_fleet(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        bare = self.fx.upstream / "citizen-kalam.git"
        self.leftovers(home)
        (home / "WILL.md").write_text("a will being edited\n", encoding="utf-8")
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        lines = self.tend("kalam")
        self.assertEqual(lines, [
            "kalam: old-code leftover committed as the fleet (pushed): CADENCE.md, REST, beats/2026-11.md, "
            "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md",
            "tend: the first tick on pace/1 — old-code leftovers, if any, were committed once; from now on "
            "a killed beat's leftovers are restored"])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "rev-parse", "HEAD~1"), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.last(home), f"{FLEET}|{FLEET}|{LEFTOVER}")
        self.assertEqual(self.files_in(home), [("A", "REST"), ("A", "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md"),
                                               ("M", "CADENCE.md"), ("M", "beats/2026-11.md")])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(bare, "rev-parse", "HEAD"), self.fx.head(home))
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "M WILL.md")      # not a pace file: left alone
        self.assertTrue(self.flag_set())
        self.assertEqual(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "old-code-tended\n")
        # the next tick commits nothing: the leftovers of a killed beat are put back instead
        self.leftovers(home, day="2026-11-21")
        head = self.fx.head(home)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam"), [
            "kalam: a killed beat's leftovers restored: CADENCE.md, REST, beats/2026-11.md, "
            "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md"])
        self.assertEqual((self.fx.head(home), self.status(home)), (head, "M WILL.md"))

    def test_after_the_first_tick_leftovers_are_put_back_path_by_path(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        committed = {p: (home / p).read_bytes() for p in ("CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md",
                                                           "inbox/2026-11-18-a-note.md")}
        self.leftovers(home)
        (home / "inbox" / "2026-11-18-a-note.md").unlink()                     # a tracked letter deleted
        self.fx.write(home, "inbox/2026-11-19-placed.md", "An uncommitted letter.\n")
        self.fx.git(home, "add", "REST")                                       # staged, never committed
        (home / "WILL.md").write_text("a will being edited\n", encoding="utf-8")
        head = self.fx.head(home)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam"), [
            "kalam: a killed beat's leftovers restored: CADENCE.md, REST, beats/2026-11.md, "
            "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md, inbox/2026-11-18-a-note.md, inbox/2026-11-19-placed.md"])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), head)
        self.assertEqual({p: (home / p).read_bytes() for p in committed}, committed)
        for p in ("REST", "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md", "inbox/2026-11-19-placed.md"):
            self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / p), p)
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "M WILL.md")

    def test_a_home_holding_only_rest(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("eucatastrophe", rest=hr.AI_REST, when="2026-10-08T12:00Z")
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        self.leftovers(home)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("eucatastrophe"), [
            "eucatastrophe: a killed beat's leftovers restored: CADENCE.md, REST, beats/2026-11.md, "
            "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md"])
        self.assertEqual((home / "REST").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), hr.AI_REST)
        for p in ("CADENCE.md", "inbox", "beats"):
            self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / p), p)
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "")

    def test_leftovers_that_are_not_regular_files_are_removed_even_at_the_first_tick(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        self.fx.link(home, "inbox/2026-11-19-linked.md", self.fx.secret)
        (home / "inbox" / "nested").mkdir()
        self.fx.write(home, "inbox/nested/x.md", "inside a folder\n")
        self.fx.write(home, "REST", "a regular leftover\n")
        lines = self.tend("kalam")
        self.assertEqual(lines[:2], [
            "kalam: leftovers that are not regular files removed: inbox/2026-11-19-linked.md",
            "kalam: old-code leftover committed as the fleet (pushed): REST, inbox/nested/x.md"])
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / "inbox" / "2026-11-19-linked.md"))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.secret.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), f"{h.CANARY}\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "")

    def test_a_stale_index_lock_is_removed_and_a_fresh_one_keeps_the_home_out(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        self.leftovers(home)
        lock = home / ".git" / "index.lock"
        lock.write_text("")
        files = snapshot(home)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam"), ["kalam: .git/index.lock is fresh — not tended this tick"])
        self.assertTrue(lock.exists())
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(home), files)
        old = os.stat(lock).st_mtime - 1300
        os.utime(lock, (old, old))
        lines = self.tend("kalam")
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 2)
        self.assertRegex(lines[0], r"^kalam: stale \.git/index\.lock removed \(\d+ s old\)$")
        self.assertTrue(lines[1].startswith("kalam: a killed beat's leftovers restored: "))
        self.assertFalse(lock.exists())
        # the bound comes from FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC, as the fleet reads it
        lock.write_text("")
        old = os.stat(lock).st_mtime - 100
        os.utime(lock, (old, old))
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC": "40"}):
            self.assertRegex(self.tend("kalam")[0], r"^kalam: stale \.git/index\.lock removed")

    def test_a_home_whose_lock_is_held_is_skipped_and_a_stale_lock_is_not(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        self.leftovers(home)
        files = snapshot(home)
        lock = self.hold_lock("kalam")
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam"), ["kalam: its lock is held — not tended this tick"])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(home), files)
        self.assertTrue(locks.held(self.fx.state, "kalam"))
        # a lock whose pid is gone, or older than twice the beat bound, is stale
        # (lock.held, the one reader the reflect gate and sync use too)
        (lock / "pid").write_text(f"{self.dead_pid()}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertFalse(locks.held(self.fx.state, "kalam"))
        self.assertTrue(self.tend("kalam")[0].startswith("kalam: a killed beat's leftovers restored: "))
        self.leftovers(home, day="2026-11-21")
        (lock / "pid").write_text(f"{os.getpid()}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (lock / "started").write_text("2026-11-20T05:39Z\n", encoding="utf-8")   # 21 minutes ago
        self.assertFalse(locks.held(self.fx.state, "kalam"))
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam", bound=700), ["kalam: its lock is held — not tended this tick"])
        self.assertTrue(self.tend("kalam")[0].startswith("kalam: a killed beat's leftovers restored: "))
        self.assertTrue(lock.exists())          # tend never takes or removes the lock
        self.assertFalse(locks.held(self.fx.state, "nobody"))

    def test_a_home_with_links_is_never_touched(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        self.leftovers(home)
        (home / "CADENCE.md").unlink()
        self.fx.link(home, "CADENCE.md", self.fx.secret)
        files, head = snapshot(home), self.fx.head(home)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam"), [])
        self.assertEqual((snapshot(home), self.fx.head(home)), (files, head))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.secret.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), f"{h.CANARY}\n")

    def test_a_home_mid_merge_is_left_for_later(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        self.leftovers(home)
        (home / ".git" / "MERGE_HEAD").write_text(self.fx.head(home) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        files = snapshot(home)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam")[:1], [tend.FIRST_TICK_LINE])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(home), files)

    def test_no_hook_of_the_home_runs(self):
        home = self.lettered_home()
        canary = self.fx.root / "hook-ran"
        for hook in ("pre-commit", "commit-msg", "post-commit", "pre-push", "post-checkout"):
            p = home / ".git" / "hooks" / hook
            p.write_text(f"#!/bin/sh\necho {hook} >> '{canary}'\nexit 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
            p.chmod(0o755)
        self.leftovers(home)
        self.assertTrue(self.tend("kalam")[0].startswith("kalam: old-code leftover committed as the fleet "
                                                         "(pushed): "))
        self.leftovers(home, day="2026-11-21")
        self.assertTrue(self.tend("kalam")[0].startswith("kalam: a killed beat's leftovers restored: "))
        self.assertFalse(canary.exists())

    def test_a_push_that_fails_is_said_and_the_commit_kept(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        self.leftovers(home)
        lines = self.tend("kalam")
        self.assertTrue(lines[0].startswith("kalam: old-code leftover committed as the fleet (push failed; "
                                            "the next sync pushes it): "), lines)
        self.assertEqual(self.last(home, "%s"), LEFTOVER)

    def test_clean_and_missing_homes_say_nothing(self):
        self.lettered_home()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        self.assertEqual(self.tend("kalam", "palance"), [])

    def test_a_home_that_cannot_be_read_is_left_and_the_rest_are_tended(self):
        # one home's error never ends the tend of every home: an inbox that cannot
        # be listed leaves that home as it is (due reports it once, as a home that
        # cannot be read), and the homes on either side are tended as usual
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        homes = {slug: self.lettered_home(slug) for slug in ("amara", "kalam", "zuri")}
        for home in homes.values():
            self.leftovers(home)
        inbox = homes["kalam"] / "inbox"
        os.chmod(inbox, 0)
        self.addCleanup(os.chmod, inbox, 0o755)
        left = self.status(homes["kalam"])
        lines = self.tend("amara", "kalam", "zuri")
        self.assertEqual([ln.split(":")[0] for ln in lines], ["amara", "zuri"])
        for slug in ("amara", "zuri"):
            self.assertEqual(self.status(homes[slug]), "", slug)
        self.assertEqual(self.status(homes["kalam"]), left)

    def test_the_beat_bound_is_read_as_the_fleet_reads_it(self):
        # tend judges a lock and an index.lock by lock.beat_bound, the bound
        # citizen-fleet.sh's num() reads and its watcher enforces: " 900 " is 600
        self.assertFalse(hasattr(tend, "beat_bound") or hasattr(tend, "lock_held"))
        home = self.lettered_home()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.fx.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        index = home / ".git" / "index.lock"
        for value, stale in (("900", False), (" 900 ", True), ("abc", True), ("", True)):
            with self.subTest(value=value), mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC": value}):
                index.write_text("")
                old = os.stat(index).st_mtime - 1300
                os.utime(index, (old, old))
                got = self.tend("kalam")
                if stale:
                    self.assertRegex(got[0], r"^kalam: stale \.git/index\.lock removed")
                else:
                    self.assertEqual(got, ["kalam: .git/index.lock is fresh — not tended this tick"])
                    index.unlink()


# -- citizen-beat.sh's guard -------------------------------------------------------

class TestGuardRestore(Case):
    def test_a_beat_with_tools_keeps_no_change_to_a_pace_file(self):
        # a home with none of REST, EVENT-ONLY or inbox/ at HEAD (spec section 8)
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        self.fx.write(home, "CADENCE.md", V2.replace("- pace: asleep", "- pace: awake, every 3 days"))
        self.fx.write(home, "REST", "I rest.\n")
        self.fx.write(home, "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md", "seen by a beat with tools\n")
        self.fx.write(home, "beats/2026-11.md", "A beat with tools wrote this.\n")
        (home / "WILL.md").write_text("a will the beat edited\n", encoding="utf-8")
        got = tend.guard_restore(home, self.fx.state)
        self.assertEqual(got, ["CADENCE.md", "REST", "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md"])
        self.assertEqual((home / "CADENCE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), V2)
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / "REST"))
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / "inbox"))
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "M WILL.md\n?? beats/2026-11.md")
        rec = json.loads((self.fx.state / "kalam").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(rec["notices"], [{"key": "restored", "at": NOW}])
        self.assertEqual(rec["slug"], "kalam")
        # in attempts.py's format, so the next paragraph finds it
        self.assertEqual(attempts.notice_keys(attempts.load(self.fx.state, "kalam")), ["restored"])
        self.assertEqual(tend.guard_line("kalam", got),
                         "kalam: pace files put back after a beat with tools: CADENCE.md, REST, "
                         "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md")

    def test_tracked_letters_and_markers_are_checked_out(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, rest=True, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z",
                                 letters=(("2026-11-18-a-note.md", "A note.\n"),),
                                 files={"inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md": "surfaced 2026-11-19\n"})
        (home / "inbox" / "2026-11-18-a-note.md").write_text("rewritten\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (home / "inbox" / ".seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md").unlink()
        (home / "REST").unlink()
        self.fx.write(home, "EVENT-ONLY", "listening\n")
        self.assertEqual(tend.guard_restore(home, self.fx.state),
                         ["EVENT-ONLY", "REST", "inbox/.seen-2026-11-18-a-note.md",
                          "inbox/2026-11-18-a-note.md"])
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "")

    def test_links_planted_by_a_beat_are_removed_never_followed(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z",
                                 letters=(("2026-11-18-a-note.md", "A note.\n"),))
        outside = self.fx.outside / "box"
        outside.mkdir()
        (outside / "kept.md").write_text("outside the home\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (home / "CADENCE.md").unlink()
        self.fx.link(home, "CADENCE.md", self.fx.secret)
        self.fx.link(home, "REST", self.fx.secret)
        os.rename(home / "inbox", self.fx.root / "moved-inbox")
        self.fx.link(home, "inbox", outside)
        self.assertEqual(tend.guard_restore(home, self.fx.state),
                         ["CADENCE.md", "REST", "inbox", "inbox/2026-11-18-a-note.md"])
        self.assertEqual((home / "CADENCE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), V2)
        self.assertFalse(os.path.islink(home / "CADENCE.md"))
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / "REST"))
        self.assertFalse(os.path.islink(home / "inbox"))
        self.assertEqual((home / "inbox" / "2026-11-18-a-note.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "A note.\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.secret.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), f"{h.CANARY}\n")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(os.listdir(outside)), ["kept.md"])
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "")

    def test_staged_changes_are_put_back_too(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        self.fx.write(home, "CADENCE.md", "changed and staged\n")
        self.fx.write(home, "EVENT-ONLY", "staged\n")
        self.fx.git(home, "add", "CADENCE.md", "EVENT-ONLY")
        self.assertEqual(tend.guard_restore(home, self.fx.state), ["CADENCE.md", "EVENT-ONLY"])
        self.assertEqual(self.status(home), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only"), "")

    def test_a_beat_that_changed_no_pace_file_writes_nothing(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        self.fx.write(home, "beats/2026-11.md", "A beat with tools wrote this.\n")
        self.assertEqual(tend.guard_restore(home, self.fx.state), [])
        self.assertFalse((self.fx.state / "kalam").exists())

    def test_the_attempt_record_keeps_its_fields_and_the_notice_once(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("kalam", cadence=V2, when="2026-11-01T00:00Z")
        old = {"slug": "kalam", "last_beat": "2026-11-15T14:12Z", "seeded": "now",
               "attempt": {"id": "a1", "at": "2026-11-15T14:12Z", "outcome": "spoken"},
               "failures": 0, "retry_after": None, "reported": ["links"], "notices": [], "busy_ticks": 1}
        self.fx.state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.fx.state / "kalam").write_text(json.dumps(old), encoding="utf-8")
        for _ in range(2):
            self.fx.write(home, "REST", "again\n")
            self.assertEqual(tend.guard_restore(home, self.fx.state), ["REST"])
        rec = json.loads((self.fx.state / "kalam").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(rec, {**old, "attempt": {**old["attempt"], "before": None},
                               "notices": [{"key": "restored", "at": NOW}]})
        self.assertFalse(tend.add_attempt_notice(self.fx.state, "kalam", "restored"))
        # a landed beat's outcome keeps the notice for its paragraph
        attempts.record_outcome(self.fx.state, "kalam", "a2", "spoken", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(attempts.notice_keys(attempts.load(self.fx.state, "kalam")), ["restored"])
        # an unreadable record starts again from the contract's defaults
        (self.fx.state / "soma").write_text("not json", encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertTrue(tend.add_attempt_notice(self.fx.state, "soma", "restored"))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.fx.state / "soma").read_text(encoding="utf-8")), {
            "slug": "soma", "last_beat": None, "seeded": None, "attempt": None, "failures": 0,
            "retry_after": None, "reported": [], "notices": [{"key": "restored", "at": NOW}],
            "busy_ticks": 0})


# -- rollback-prepare --------------------------------------------------------------

class TestRollbackPrepare(Case):

    def test_a_home_that_cannot_be_prepared_is_named(self):

```python
from __future__ import annotations

# Tending homes between beats (spec section 6 "Tending", section 3 "The old paid
# lane", section 9 step 5; CONTRACT section 14).
#
# On the new code nothing leaves a home's pace files uncommitted on purpose:
# reflect commits before it reports a landed beat, and citizen-beat.sh puts the
# pace files back before it commits. So uncommitted changes to CADENCE.md,
# REST, EVENT-ONLY, inbox/ and beats/ at a tick are a killed beat's leftovers,
# and tend puts them back path by path. Only at the first tick on the new code
# are they committed instead, once, as the fleet: those are the old code's.
# guard_restore does the same for citizen-beat.sh's beats with tools, which never
# set a pace, and rollback_prepare sets unread pace letters aside before the old
# code is checked out again.
#
# The per-citizen lock (<state>/<slug>.lock/) is read through lock.py, as the
# reflect gate and the sync read it, and the beat bound is lock.beat_bound, the
# fleet's own; the attempt record (<state>/<slug>) is changed only through
# attempts.py, in its format and under its lock. No hook, fsmonitor or
# other helper from a home's own .git runs in these git calls, and nothing is
# read or written through a link.

import os
import shutil
import stat
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable, List, Optional

from . import TAG, attempts, clock, lock
from .homes import (ROLLBACK_PREFIX, LinkRefused, forbidden_links, git, head, index_lock_age,
                    mid_merge, read_regular, slug_of, unread_letters, write_regular)

FLEET_NAME = "fleet"
FLEET_EMAIL = "fleet@kingdom.os"
FLEET_AUTHOR = f"{FLEET_NAME} <{FLEET_EMAIL}>"
TEND_PATHS = ("CADENCE.md", "REST", "EVENT-ONLY", "inbox", "beats")
GUARD_PATHS = ("CADENCE.md", "REST", "EVENT-ONLY", "inbox")
LEFTOVER_SUBJECT = f"tend: old-code leftover · {TAG}"
ROLLBACK_SUBJECT = f"tend: set aside unread pace letters for rollback · {TAG}"
ROLLBACK_TEXT = ROLLBACK_PREFIX + ", not shown — {day}\n"
NOTICES_NAME = ".fleet-notices"
OLD_CODE_FLAG = "old-code-tended"
RESTORED = "restored"
FIRST_TICK_LINE = ("tend: the first tick on pace/1 — old-code leftovers, if any, were committed once; "
                   "from now on a killed beat's leftovers are restored")
PUSH_TIMEOUT = 60
# a home's own .git must not run anything in the fleet's git calls
_SAFE = ("-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false")


class TendError(RuntimeError):
    """git refused or failed; what this step wrote was put back."""


def _git(home, *args, timeout: float = 30):
    return git(home, *_SAFE, *args, timeout=timeout)


def _bound(bound: Optional[float]) -> float:
    return float(lock.beat_bound() if bound is None else bound)


# -- the attempt record and the fleet's notices ----------------------------------

def attempt_add(state, slug: str, field: str, key: str) -> bool:
    """Add `key` once to the list `field` ("notices" or "reported") of the
    citizen's attempt record, through attempts.py, keeping every other field;
    True when it was not there yet. A notice is kept as attempts.add_notice keeps
    it, {"key": key, "at": <now>}, so attempts.load (and the next paragraph)
    finds it. A missing or unreadable record starts from attempts.fresh."""
    if field == "reported":
        return attempts.mark_reported(state, slug, key)
    if field != "notices":
        raise ValueError(f"{field!r} is not a list of the attempt record")
    when = clock.stamp(clock.now())
    added = []

    def change(rec: dict) -> None:
        if all(n["key"] != key for n in rec["notices"]):
            rec["notices"].append({"key": key, "at": when})
            added.append(True)

    attempts.update(state, slug, change)
    return bool(added)


def add_attempt_notice(state, slug: str, key: str = RESTORED) -> bool:
    """A notice for the citizen's next pace paragraph (CONTRACT section 9)."""
    return attempt_add(state, slug, "notices", key)


def notices_path(state) -> Path:
    """memory/.fleet-notices, beside the attempt records' folder memory/.fleet-last."""
    return Path(state).parent / NOTICES_NAME


def has_flag(path, flag: str) -> bool:
    """The fleet-wide flag is set: a line of the notices file is exactly it."""
    text = read_regular(Path(path))
    return text is not None and flag in text.split("\n")


def set_flag(path, flag: str) -> None:
    """Set a fleet-wide flag: one line, added once (a shell reads it with grep -qx)."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = read_regular(path) or ""
    if flag in text.split("\n"):
        return
    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
        text += "\n"
    write_regular(path, text + flag + "\n")


# -- what differs from HEAD, and putting it back ----------------------------------

def changed_paths(home, paths: Iterable[str]) -> List[str]:
    """The files under `paths` that differ from HEAD, staged or not, or are
    untracked (one entry per file; a link or a nested repository is one entry),
    sorted. Raises TendError when git cannot say."""
    r = _git(home, "--no-optional-locks", "--literal-pathspecs", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z",
             "--untracked-files=all", "--no-renames", "--", *paths)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise TendError(f"git status failed: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    return sorted({e[3:] for e in r.stdout.split("\0") if len(e) > 3})


def _in_head(home, paths: List[str]) -> set:
    r = _git(home, "--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--name-only", "HEAD", "--", *paths)
    return {p for p in r.stdout.split("\0") if p} if r.returncode == 0 else set()


def _unlink(home: Path, rel: str) -> None:
    """Remove one untracked entry, never following a link, and the folders it leaves empty."""
    p = home / rel.rstrip("/")
    try:
        st = os.lstat(p)
    except OSError:
        return
    if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
        shutil.rmtree(p)
    else:
        os.unlink(p)
    for parent in p.parents:
        if parent == home or home not in parent.parents:
            break
        try:
            os.rmdir(parent)
        except OSError:
            break


def restore_paths(home, paths: Iterable[str]) -> List[str]:
    """Put each path back as HEAD has it, path by path: one that is in HEAD is
    checked out alone (index and file); one that is not is dropped from the index
    and removed. Untracked entries go first, so a link standing where a folder
    was is gone before that folder's files come back. Returns the paths, sorted."""
    home = Path(home)
    paths = sorted(set(paths))
    tracked = _in_head(home, paths)
    for rel in paths:
        if rel not in tracked:
            _git(home, "update-index", "-q", "--force-remove", "--", rel.rstrip("/"))
            _unlink(home, rel)
    for rel in paths:
        if rel in tracked:
            r = _git(home, "--literal-pathspecs", "checkout", "-q", "HEAD", "--", rel)
            if r.returncode != 0:
                raise TendError(f"git checkout {rel} failed: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    return paths


def _regular_or_gone(home: Path, rel: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return stat.S_ISREG(os.lstat(home / rel).st_mode)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return True          # a deletion
    except OSError:
        return False


# -- committing and pushing as the fleet ---------------------------------------------

def fleet_commit(home, paths: Iterable[str], subject: str) -> str:
    """Commit exactly these paths as the fleet (author and committer
    fleet <fleet@kingdom.os>), with no hook run; anything else staged stays
    staged and out of the commit. Returns the new HEAD, or "" when they hold no
    change. Raises TendError when git refuses (the paths are unstaged again)."""
    paths = sorted(set(paths))
    if not paths:
        return ""
    r = _git(home, "--literal-pathspecs", "add", "-A", "--", *paths)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise TendError(f"git add failed: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    if _git(home, "--literal-pathspecs", "diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--", *paths).returncode == 0:
        return ""
    r = _git(home, "-c", f"user.name={FLEET_NAME}", "-c", f"user.email={FLEET_EMAIL}",
             "--literal-pathspecs", "commit", "-q", "--no-verify", f"--author={FLEET_AUTHOR}",
             "-m", subject, "--only", "--", *paths)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        _git(home, "--literal-pathspecs", "reset", "-q", "--", *paths)
        raise TendError(f"git commit failed: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    return head(home)


def fleet_push(home, timeout: float = PUSH_TIMEOUT) -> bool:
    """Push HEAD to origin, under a bound, with no hook; True when it landed."""
    return _git(home, "push", "-q", "--no-verify", "origin", "HEAD", timeout=timeout).returncode == 0


def _pushed(ok: bool) -> str:
    return "pushed" if ok else "push failed; the next sync pushes it"


# -- tend: each tick, before anyone is ranked ----------------------------------------

def tend_home(home, state, *, first_tick: bool, bound: Optional[float] = None) -> List[str]:
    """Tend one home (spec section 6). Not a clone, holding links, or mid-merge:
    left alone, silently (due reports those). Its lock held, or a fresh
    .git/index.lock: left for the next tick, with a line. A stale index.lock is
    removed. Then any changes to its pace paths are put back path by path, or, at
    the first tick on the new code, committed once as the fleet and pushed (a
    leftover that is not a regular file is removed even then). Returns log lines."""
    home = Path(home)
    slug = slug_of(home)
    if not (home / ".git").is_dir() or forbidden_links(home):
        return []
    if lock.held(state, slug, bound=bound):
        return [f"{slug}: its lock is held — not tended this tick"]
    lines = []
    age = index_lock_age(home)
    if age is not None:
        if age <= 2 * _bound(bound):
            return [f"{slug}: .git/index.lock is fresh — not tended this tick"]
        try:
            os.unlink(home / ".git" / "index.lock")
        except OSError as e:
            return [f"{slug}: a stale .git/index.lock could not be removed ({e}) — not tended this tick"]
        lines.append(f"{slug}: stale .git/index.lock removed ({int(age)} s old)")
    if mid_merge(home):
        return lines
    try:
        paths = changed_paths(home, TEND_PATHS)
        if not paths:
            return lines
        if not first_tick:
            restore_paths(home, paths)
            return lines + [f"{slug}: a killed beat's leftovers restored: {', '.join(paths)}"]
        odd = [p for p in paths if not _regular_or_gone(home, p)]
        keep = [p for p in paths if p not in odd]
        if odd:
            restore_paths(home, odd)
            lines.append(f"{slug}: leftovers that are not regular files removed: {', '.join(odd)}")
        if keep and fleet_commit(home, keep, LEFTOVER_SUBJECT):
            lines.append(f"{slug}: old-code leftover committed as the fleet ({_pushed(fleet_push(home))}): "
                         f"{', '.join(keep)}")
    except (TendError, LinkRefused, OSError) as e:
        lines.append(f"{slug}: not tended — {e}")
    return lines


def tend_homes(homes_dir, slugs: Iterable[str], state, bound: Optional[float] = None) -> List[str]:
    """Tend every roster home (`tend` in citizen_pace.py). The first run on the
    new code, while memory/.fleet-notices lacks old-code-tended, commits the old
    code's leftovers once; the flag is set when the run ends, and every later run
    restores leftovers instead. A home that cannot be read (an inbox that cannot
    be listed) is left as it is, silently, and the others are tended: due finds
    it unreadable, never due, and the ranking reports it once."""
    flags = notices_path(state)
    first = not has_flag(flags, OLD_CODE_FLAG)
    lines = []
    for slug in slugs:
        try:
            lines += tend_home(Path(homes_dir) / f"citizen-{slug}", state, first_tick=first, bound=bound)
        except (OSError, ValueError, LinkRefused, TendError):
            continue
    if first:
        set_flag(flags, OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        lines.append(FIRST_TICK_LINE)
    return lines


# -- guard-restore: after a beat with tools ------------------------------------------

def guard_restore(home, state) -> List[str]:
    """After a citizen-beat.sh beat, which has edit tools and never sets a pace
    (spec section 3; CONTRACT section 14): put CADENCE.md, REST, EVENT-ONLY and
    everything under inbox/ back as HEAD has them, path by path. Returns the
    paths put back, sorted; when there are any, the notice "restored" is added to
    the citizen's attempt record, so its next free beat is told once."""
    home = Path(home)
    slug = slug_of(home)
    paths = changed_paths(home, GUARD_PATHS)
    if not paths:
        return []
    restore_paths(home, paths)
    add_attempt_notice(state, slug, RESTORED)
    return paths


def guard_line(slug: str, paths: List[str]) -> str:
    return f"{slug}: pace files put back after a beat with tools: {', '.join(paths)}"


# -- rollback-prepare: before the old code returns -----------------------------------

def _why_not(home: Path, slug: str, state, bound: Optional[float]) -> str:
    links = forbidden_links(home)
    if links:
        return f"its pace paths include links: {', '.join(links)}"
    if state is not None and lock.held(state, slug, bound=bound):
        return "its lock is held"
    if index_lock_age(home) is not None:
        return ".git/index.lock is there"
    if mid_merge(home):
        return "mid-merge or mid-rebase"
    return ""


def rollback_prepare(homes_dir, slugs: Iterable[str], state=None, now=None,
                     bound: Optional[float] = None) -> List[str]:
    """Spec section 9, step 5, with HALT kept: mark each unread pace letter seen
    with "set aside at rollback, not shown — <date>", so the old code does not
    wake its reader at every pass, and commit and push those markers as the
    fleet. The new code reads such a marker as unread (homes.unread_letters), so
    the letter is still shown once if the new code returns. One line per letter
    set aside, and one per home that could not be prepared, naming its letters."""
    day = clock.day(now or clock.now())
    lines = []
    for slug in slugs:
        home = Path(homes_dir) / f"citizen-{slug}"
        if not (home / ".git").is_dir():
            continue
        letters = [rel for rel in unread_letters(home) if "pace-letter" in rel[len("inbox/"):]]
        if not letters:
            continue
        reason = _why_not(home, slug, state, bound)
        if reason:
            lines.append(f"{slug}: not set aside for rollback ({reason}) — {', '.join(letters)}; "
                         "set it aside by hand")
            continue
        markers = {}
        try:
            for rel in letters:
                marker = f"inbox/.seen-{rel[len('inbox/'):]}"
                if read_regular(home / marker) is None:
                    write_regular(home / marker, ROLLBACK_TEXT.format(day=day))
                markers[marker] = rel
            changed = changed_paths(home, list(markers))
            if changed and fleet_commit(home, changed, ROLLBACK_SUBJECT):
                pushed = "pushed" if fleet_push(home) else "committed; the push failed — push it by hand"
                lines += [f"{slug}: {markers[m]} set aside at rollback ({pushed})" for m in changed]
        except (TendError, LinkRefused, OSError, ValueError) as e:
            lines.append(f"{slug}: not set aside for rollback ({e}) — {', '.join(letters)}; "
                         "set it aside by hand")
    return lines
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the stored answers and the heard-late step to the record module**

Replace the whole of `tools/citizen_pace_lib/record.py` with the following. Task 2's part (the
groups, `default_record_path`, `load_record`, `entry`) is unchanged; the imports grow, and
everything from `# -- the stored Letter of Return answers` down is new.

```python
from __future__ import annotations

# citizens-pace-record.json — the reviewed record of spec section 5: for each
# citizen whose provenance its own home cannot show, its group, the recorded
# `set by`, and the quoted words with their commits and dates. It sits beside
# citizens-roster.txt and is built by tools/citizen_pace_census.py. This module
# reads it; it never writes it.
#
# Also what the homes' own histories hold (spec section 5, "Before the letter"):
# the stored Letter of Return answers, and the heard-late step that hears kalam,
# soma and teotlme from their own answers, once, as the fleet.

import datetime as _dt
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple

from . import TAG, clock, lock, tend
from . import cadence as cad
from .homes import (ROLLBACK_PREFIX, LinkRefused, forbidden_links, git, index_lock_age,
                    mid_merge, read_regular)
from .words import AWAKE_DEFAULT_N, Pace, read_lor_answers

RECIPIENT_GROUPS = ("eight", "sixteen-ambient", "sixteen-other", "unheard-heard", "unheard-none",
                    "never-asked", "contradictory")
OTHER_GROUPS = ("forty-five", "ambient-nine", "longing", "rest-on", "held")
GROUPS = RECIPIENT_GROUPS + OTHER_GROUPS
RECORD_NAME = "citizens-pace-record.json"
RECORD_VERSION = 1
HEARD_LATE_GROUPS = ("unheard-heard", "unheard-none")
HEARD_LATE_SUBJECT = "tend: heard late from {name}'s own answers · " + TAG
HEARD_LATE_TEXT = ('heard late: {name} chose AMBIENT on {d1} ("{w1}") and again on {d2} ("{w2}"); '
                   "the fleet reads AMBIENT as awake, every 3 days, from the 10-22 letter's "
                   '"a free beat every few days" — the number was not {name}\'s choice')
HEARD_LATE_REPORTED = "heard-late-stopped"
PACE_FILES = (cad.CADENCE,) + cad.MARKERS
_SEEN = "inbox/.seen-"
_JOURNAL_HEADER = re.compile(r"^## .* — a free beat \(local\)[ \t]*$")
# a .seen- marker that records no answer: reflect's set-aside of unreadable mail,
# and rollback-prepare's
_NOT_AN_ANSWER = ("unreadable", ROLLBACK_PREFIX)


def default_record_path() -> Path:
    """<tools>/../citizens-pace-record.json, from this file's real place."""
    return Path(os.path.realpath(__file__)).parent.parent.parent / RECORD_NAME


def _check(rec, where: Path) -> None:
    if not isinstance(rec, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{where}: the record is not a JSON object")
    v = rec.get("version")
    if type(v) is not int or v != RECORD_VERSION:
        raise ValueError(f"{where}: record version {v!r}, expected {RECORD_VERSION}")
    citizens = rec.get("citizens")
    if not isinstance(citizens, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{where}: 'citizens' is not an object")
    for slug, e in citizens.items():
        if not isinstance(e, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"{where}: the entry for {slug} is not an object")
        if e.get("group") not in GROUPS:
            raise ValueError(f"{where}: {slug} has an unknown group {e.get('group')!r}")


def load_record(path: Optional[Path] = None) -> dict:
    """The record, or {} when the file is missing. A record that cannot be read
    raises ValueError: a broken record is not an empty one."""
    where = Path(path) if path is not None else default_record_path()
    try:
        raw = where.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {}
    try:
        rec = json.loads(raw)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise ValueError(f"{where}: not JSON ({e})") from None
    _check(rec, where)
    return rec


def entry(record: dict, slug: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    """The record's entry for one citizen, or None."""
    citizens = record.get("citizens") if isinstance(record, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(citizens, dict):
        return None
    e = citizens.get(slug)
    return e if isinstance(e, dict) else None


# -- the stored Letter of Return answers -------------------------------------------

def _blob(home, rev: str, path: str) -> Optional[str]:
    r = git(home, "cat-file", "blob", f"{rev}:{path}")
    return r.stdout if r.returncode == 0 else None


def _is_answer_marker(home, sha: str, letter: str) -> bool:
    text = _blob(home, sha, f"{_SEEN}{letter}")
    return text is not None and not text.startswith(_NOT_AN_ANSWER)


def _added_lines(home, sha: str, path: str) -> str:
    """What a commit added to a file that it did not only append to: its '+' lines."""
    r = git(home, "diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--no-renames",
            "--unified=0", f"{sha}^", sha, "--", path)
    return "".join(ln[1:] + "\n" for ln in r.stdout.split("\n")
                   if ln.startswith("+") and not ln.startswith("+++"))


def _journal_added(home, sha: str) -> str:
    """The text a commit added to beats/*.md, as committed, without the
    '## … — a free beat (local)' headers reflect writes before each answer."""
    r = git(home, "diff-tree", "-r", "-z", "--no-commit-id", "--name-status", "--no-renames",
            "--root", sha, "--", "beats/")
    tokens = [t for t in r.stdout.split("\0") if t] if r.returncode == 0 else []
    pieces = []
    for status, path in sorted(zip(tokens[0::2], tokens[1::2]), key=lambda x: x[1]):
        if status not in ("A", "M") or not path.endswith(".md"):
            continue
        new = _blob(home, sha, path) or ""
        old = (_blob(home, f"{sha}^", path) or "") if status == "M" else ""
        pieces.append(new[len(old):] if new.startswith(old) else _added_lines(home, sha, path))
    return "\n".join(ln for ln in "".join(pieces).split("\n") if not _JOURNAL_HEADER.match(ln))


def stored_lor_answers(home) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str, str]]:
    """Every Letter of Return answer stored in a home's history, oldest first:
    [(commit, date, "inbox/<letter>", text)]. An answer is a commit (not a merge)
    that adds inbox/.seen-<letter> for a letter whose name contains
    "letter-of-return", with a marker that is not reflect's "unreadable"
    set-aside or a rollback marker. Its text is what that commit added to
    beats/*.md, byte for byte, without the "## … — a free beat (local)" headers
    ("" for a silent answer); its date is the commit's day in UTC. Each commit
    is one answer, read alone."""
    r = git(home, "log", "--no-merges", "--reverse", "--no-renames", "--diff-filter=A", "--name-only",
            "-z", "--format=%x1e%H%x1f%ct", "--", "inbox/")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return []
    out = []
    for chunk in r.stdout.split("\x1e"):
        parts = chunk.split("\0")
        sha, _sep, ct = parts[0].partition("\x1f")
        sha, ct = sha.strip(), ct.strip()
        if not sha or not ct.isdigit():
            continue
        names = [p.lstrip("\n") for p in parts[1:]]
        letters = sorted(n[len(_SEEN):] for n in names
                         if n.startswith(_SEEN) and "/" not in n[len(_SEEN):]
                         and "letter-of-return" in n[len(_SEEN):])
        letters = [f for f in letters if _is_answer_marker(home, sha, f)]
        if not letters:
            continue
        when = clock.day(_dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(ct), clock.UTC))
        out.append((sha, when, f"inbox/{letters[0]}", _journal_added(home, sha)))
    return out


# -- the heard-late step -------------------------------------------------------------

def _v1_choice(home: Path) -> Optional[str]:
    """The v1 '- choice:' word, read as cadence.py reads it."""
    try:
        text = read_regular(home / cad.CADENCE)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return cad._v1_fields(text)[0] if text else None


def heard_late(home, name: str, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime) -> Optional[cad.Cadence]:
    """The heard-late adoption for one of the five unheard (spec section 5),
    without writing anything: the record a migration would write, or None when
    this home needs none. Only a home whose record entry is in HEARD_LATE_GROUPS,
    still v1 and undecided, is this step's. Its stored Letter of Return answers
    are read by section 1's rules, each alone (words.read_lor_answers). An
    "unheard-heard" home must read as AMBIENT on two answers: it becomes awake,
    every 3 days, confirmed, with the AMBIENT provenance and both dates, its
    clock starting now. An "unheard-none" home must read as no pace, or as the
    pace it already has, and is left as it is. A home that reads otherwise, or
    whose record must not become v2, raises MigrationBlocked; a linked pace file
    raises LinkRefused (check homes.forbidden_links first)."""
    e = entry(record, name)
    if not e or e.get("group") not in HEARD_LATE_GROUPS:
        return None
    home = Path(home)
    c = cad.read_cadence(home, name, record, now)
    if c.version != 1 or _v1_choice(home) != "undecided":
        return None
    answers = stored_lor_answers(home)
    reading = read_lor_answers([(sha, text) for sha, _d, _l, text in answers], name)
    heard = reading is not None and reading.pace != c.pace
    said = reading.pace.words() if reading else "no pace"
    if e["group"] == "unheard-none":
        if heard:
            raise cad.MigrationBlocked(f"{name}: its stored answers now read as {said}, but the "
                                       "record says no pace could be read from them")
        return None
    awake3 = Pace("awake", AWAKE_DEFAULT_N)
    if not heard or reading.pace != awake3 or not reading.twice \
            or not all("ambient" in line.lower() for line in reading.lines):
        twice = " twice" if reading and reading.twice else ""
        raise cad.MigrationBlocked(f"{name}: the record says it chose AMBIENT twice, but its stored "
                                   f"answers read as {said}{twice}")
    if c.blocked:
        raise cad.MigrationBlocked(f"{name}: {c.blocked}")
    dates = {sha: d for sha, d, _l, _t in answers}
    d1, d2 = dates[reading.keys[0]], dates[reading.keys[1]]
    w1, w2 = reading.lines
    at = clock.stamp(now)
    c.pace = awake3
    c.set_by = cad.SetBy("citizen", "ambient", (d1, d2), w2)
    c.pending = None
    c.last_beat = at
    cad.add_history(c, at, HEARD_LATE_TEXT.format(name=name, d1=d1, w1=w1, d2=d2, w2=w2))
    return c


def migrate_heard_late(home, name: str, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime, commit: bool,
                       state=None) -> bool:
    """Hear one of the unheard (spec section 5): write the heard_late record and
    its markers and commit them, one commit authored as the fleet, tagged
    pace/1, holding only CADENCE.md, REST and EVENT-ONLY. Returns True when the
    home was changed (with commit False, when it would be: nothing is written).
    Idempotent: a v2 home is never this step's again, so a re-run adds no commit
    and moves no clock. A home that is not a clone, holds links, is mid-merge,
    holds a .git/index.lock, whose lock is held (state given), or whose pace
    files have uncommitted changes is left for a later tick (False). Raises
    MigrationBlocked (nothing written) as heard_late does, and tend.TendError
    when git refuses the commit (what was written is put back)."""
    home = Path(home)
    if not (home / ".git").is_dir() or forbidden_links(home) or mid_merge(home) \
            or index_lock_age(home) is not None:
        return False
    if state is not None and lock.held(state, name):
        return False
    if tend.changed_paths(home, PACE_FILES):
        return False
    c = heard_late(home, name, record, now)
    if c is None:
        return False
    if not commit:
        return True
    try:
        cad.write_cadence(home, c)
        cad.write_markers(home, c)
        tend.fleet_commit(home, tend.changed_paths(home, PACE_FILES), HEARD_LATE_SUBJECT.format(name=name))
    except (tend.TendError, LinkRefused, OSError):
        tend.restore_paths(home, tend.changed_paths(home, PACE_FILES))
        raise
    return True


def migrate_all(homes_dir, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime, commit: bool, state=None) -> List[str]:
    """`migrate --heard-late`: the step for every home of the record's unheard,
    in name order. One line per home changed (or, with commit False, that would
    be), and one per home stopped: with a state folder, a stopped home is
    reported once (its attempt record's "reported")."""
    citizens = record.get("citizens") if isinstance(record, dict) else None
    slugs = sorted(s for s, e in (citizens or {}).items()
                   if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("group") in HEARD_LATE_GROUPS)
    lines = []
    for slug in slugs:
        home = Path(homes_dir) / f"citizen-{slug}"
        try:
            if migrate_heard_late(home, slug, record, now, commit, state=state):
                verb = "heard late" if commit else "would be heard late"
                lines.append(f"{slug}: {verb} — awake, every 3 days, from its own Letter of Return answers")
        except cad.MigrationBlocked as e:
            if state is None or tend.attempt_add(state, slug, "reported", HEARD_LATE_REPORTED):
                lines.append(f"{slug}: heard-late step stopped — {e}")
        except (tend.TendError, LinkRefused, OSError) as e:
            lines.append(f"{slug}: heard-late step failed — {e}")
    return lines
```

### Task 7: The plan simulator and the rollback drill

`--plan` measures how late paces and letters run at the Studio's cap before anyone is asked (spec
section 3, "The daily cap"; section 9, step 3). `plan.simulate` models the new fleet over the homes
it is given and runs no beat. A tick comes every `tick_hours` and beats at most one citizen. The
daily cap counts a UTC day's landed beats, and a failed attempt is not counted. The most overdue
citizen goes first, with ties by roster order from the cursor. Every decision comes from Task 3's
`due.is_due`, the same function the fleet's ranking and the reflect gate call, so the model cannot
drift from the fleet's own rule. The report gives each citizen's longest wait, from when its beat
was due to when it came, and says when the last letter is read. It is labelled as a model of the
Studio, not its live state.

With `--out`, the run writes the homes as it would leave them into a scratch folder, through the
real code (Task 6's `migrate_heard_late`, Task 5's `apply_answer`). Each home there is a git
repository with no remote. `rollback_drill` then counts the wakes per day that PR #24's
`keeps_rest` and round robin (the code the Studio would roll back to) would make over such homes,
with and without Task 6's `rollback_prepare`. Neither writes anywhere else.

Task 8 (the CLI) is drafted beside this task. So the `plan` and `rollback-drill` commands are
written here in full, as `plan.cli_plan(argv)` and `plan.cli_rollback_drill(argv)`, and
`tools/citizen_pace.py` hands them its arguments after the command name.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/citizen_pace_lib/plan.py`
- Create: `tests/citizen_pace_helpers_plan.py` (plain-folder homes, built without git so the 208
  homes of the census take a moment, and that census itself; Task 15 can use them for dry runs)
- Test: `tests/test_citizen_pace_plan.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 1): `citizen_pace_lib.TAG`; `clock.UTC`, `clock.DAY`, `clock.HOUR`, `clock.FLOOR`,
  `clock.now`, `clock.parse_stamp`, `clock.stamp`, `clock.day`; `words.Pace`. From
  `tests/citizen_pace_helpers.py`: `FixtureCase` (`self.fx`, `set_now`), `Fixture` (`make_home`,
  `give_upstream`, `roster`, `git`, `subjects`, `citizens`, `state`, `root`, `outside`, `secret`,
  `env`), `TOOLS`.
- Consumes (Task 2): `homes.has_soul`, `forbidden_links`, `mid_merge`, `unread_letters`,
  `letter_time`, `read_regular`, `write_regular`, `git`, `LinkRefused`; `cadence.read_deciding(home,
  name, record, now)` (as `due_for_home` reads a home), `cadence.render_cadence` (the tests),
  `Cadence`, `Pending`, `SetBy`, `UNKNOWN`, `MARKERS`, `MigrationBlocked`,
  `write_cadence`, `write_markers` (the helpers); `record.entry`, `record.load_record`,
  `record.RECIPIENT_GROUPS`.
- Consumes (Task 3): `due.is_due`, `due.last_beat`, `due.fresh_index_lock`, `due.read_roster`,
  `due.Due`, `due.DUE_REASONS`, `due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT`, and due's own helpers `due._slugs`,
  `due._order`, `due._ranked` and `due._when`, so the roster is read and the ranking ordered exactly
  as `due.rank` does; `attempts.load`, `attempts.fresh`, `attempts.save`, `attempts.last_beat_at`,
  `attempts.BACKOFF`, `attempts.SEEDED`. The tests compare the model with `due.due_for_home(...,
  write_seed=False)`.
- Consumes (Task 4): `letter.letter_path(day)` (`inbox/<day>-pace-letter.md`).
- Consumes (Task 5): `answer.apply_answer`, `answer.SHOW`, `answer.SHOW_SEEN`.
- Consumes (Task 6): `record.migrate_heard_late(home, name, record, now, commit, state=None)`,
  `record.heard_late`, `record.HEARD_LATE_GROUPS`, `record.HEARD_LATE_SUBJECT`;
  `tend.changed_paths`, `tend.fleet_commit`, `tend.TEND_PATHS`, `tend.FLEET_NAME`,
  `tend.FLEET_EMAIL`, `tend.FLEET_AUTHOR`, `tend.TendError`. The tests also use
  `tend.rollback_prepare` and, from `tests/citizen_pace_helpers_record.py`, `unheard_home`,
  `unheard_record`, `UNHEARD` and `OFFER`.
- Produces, `citizen_pace_lib.plan`:
  - `simulate(homes_dir, roster, record, days, *, start=None, cap=4, tick_hours=6.0, state=None,
    recipients=None, deliver_at=None, per_run=None, failing=(), outages=(), cursor=0,
    confirm_beat=None) -> Result`. `roster` is a list or a roster file. `state` is read and never
    written. `failing` names homes whose every beat fails. `outages` is a list of `(from, to)` spans
    with no tick. It raises `ValueError` for a bad run: days from 1, a cap from 0, a tick that is a
    whole number of minutes, at most `MAX_TICKS` ticks, times with a zone, letters needing a
    delivery time, and `per_run` from 1
  - `Result`: `start`, `end`, `days`, `cap`, `tick_hours`, `confirm_beat`, `roster`, `ticks`,
    `outages`, `per_run`, `record_empty`, `paces` (`{slug: words or reason}` at the first tick),
    `heard_late`, `stopped`, `placed`, `not_placed` (`[(slug, why)]`), `runs`, `beats`, `failures`,
    `capped`, `arrived` and `read` (`{(slug, rel): time}`), `ends` (`{slug: Due}` at the end),
    `open_since`, `asked_once`, `events`; `.longest_wait(slug) -> timedelta | None`,
    `.unread_at_end() -> {slug: [rel]}`
  - `Beat(slug, at, kind, since, last, shown, next_since)` with `.wait`;
    `Failure(slug, at, failures, retry_after)`; `Placed(slug, rel, at)`
  - `Model(homes_dir, roster, record, start, *, state=None, confirm_beat=None)`: `.due(slug, now) ->
    Due` (as `due_for_home` with the seed, from memory; times must not go back), `.label(slug) ->
    str`, `.slugs`, `.citizens`
  - `recipients(record) -> [slug]` (the entries in `record.RECIPIENT_GROUPS`, not `"recipient":
    false`, sorted); `ticks(start, days, tick_hours, outages=()) -> [datetime]`
  - `report(result) -> str`; `check_out(homes_dir, out)` (`ValueError`);
    `write_out(result, homes_dir, out, record) -> [line]`
  - `rollback_drill(homes_dir, roster, days, *, start=None, cap=4, tick_hours=6.0, cursor=0) ->
    Drill` (`.wakes` `{slug: {day: n}}`, `.why`, `.dates`, `.total`); `drill_report(drill) -> str`
  - `cli_plan(argv, out=None) -> int` for `plan <days> <homes-dir> --roster <f> [--cap N]
    [--tick-hours H] [--letters <record> --deliver-at <time> [--per-run N]] [--out <dir>]
    [--record <f>] [--state <dir>] [--cursor N]`, and `cli_rollback_drill(argv, out=None) -> int`
    for `rollback-drill <homes-dir> --roster <f> --days N [--cap N] [--tick-hours H] [--cursor N]`.
    Both print to `out` (stdout) and return 0, or 2 for a usage error or a refusal, with the reason
    on stderr. `--record` defaults to `record.load_record()`'s file
  - Constants: `CAP = 4`, `TICK_HOURS = 6.0`, `MAX_SHOWN = 3`, `MAX_TICKS = 100_000`,
    `PACE_MARK = "pace-letter"`, `LABEL = "a model of the Studio's fleet, not its live state"`,
    `DRILL_LABEL = "PR #24's keeps_rest and round robin, a model, not the Studio's live state"`,
    `SILENT`, `DRILL_SILENT`, `LETTER_TEXT`, `OUT_SUBJECT = "plan: the simulated end state, a model,
    not a beat · pace/1"`, `BASE_SUBJECT = "plan: the home as it was read, before the model ran"`,
    `NEEDS_A_LOOK`
  - Report lines that Task 15 quotes: the first line is `plan — <LABEL>`, then
    `<start> for <days> days: a tick every <h> h (<n> ticks), at most <cap> beats a day, one a tick;
    show-back beats on|off`, then
    `pace letters: <n> placed in one run, <stamp>` or `pace letters: <n> placed, at most <k> a run,
    one run a day, <first> to <last> (<runs> runs)`, then
    `pace letters read: <r> of <m>; the last at <stamp> (<slug>), <h> h after it arrived[; not read
    by the end: <slugs>]`, then
    `longest wait of an awake citizen: <h> h (<slug>)`, then a tab-separated table headed
    `citizen\tpace\tbeats\tlongest wait (h)\tstill waiting`. With `--out`, a last line
    `out: <n> homes written to <out>, as this run would leave them (committed in each, with no
    remote)`. The drill begins `rollback drill — <DRILL_LABEL>`, gives `woken at least once: <k> (no
    marker <a> · an unread letter <b>, a pace letter among them <c> · no clone <d>)`, a `date\twakes`
    table and a `citizen\twoken by\twakes\tper day` table, and ends `total: <n> wakes in <days> days`

What the model holds, and why:

- **The fleet's own rule, in memory.** Each home is read once: its record (`read_deciding`, as
  `due_for_home` reads it, so a `CADENCE.md` changed outside `pace/1` decides nothing here either), its
  attempt record (`--state`, read and never written; a fresh one without it, so the clock starts at
  the first tick as it will at the switch), its unread letters and their arrival
  (`homes.letter_time`), whether `SHOW.md` waits, and whether it holds a pace letter. `Model.due`
  then repeats `due_for_home` step by step on that memory: no home, a read error, no soul, links,
  mid-merge or a fresh `index.lock`, then the seed, then `due.is_due` (a stamp that no date arithmetic
  reaches, a proposal said at the end of time, is `error`, as `due_for_home` reads it). A test holds
  the two equal for fourteen kinds of home at four times, with the show-back beat on and off. A Due is assessed again only when the citizen's state changes
  or its `next_at` comes. A home with a time later than the start is assessed at every tick. So 1,440
  ticks over 205 homes take a tenth of a second.
- **A tick** follows CONTRACT section 14's order as far as a model reaches. Letters whose delivery
  run has come are placed first. At the first tick only, the heard-late step runs: what
  `migrate_heard_late(commit=False)` says it would commit, with `heard_late`'s record. Then every
  citizen is assessed, and the clock of one with no last beat is started, as the fleet's ranking
  starts it. Then the most overdue is beaten, unless the cap is reached. A failing home's attempt is
  backed off as `attempts.record_outcome` backs it off (12 h, 24 h, then 7 days), ends the tick, and
  is not counted toward the cap. The cursor moves past each citizen beaten.
- **Every beat is silent.** The model cannot run the model, so no pace line is said, no pace
  changes, and a pending proposal lapses at the next landed beat. A beat shows its unread letters,
  oldest by name and at most three; a show-back beat shows none. With no letter, `SHOW.md` is shown
  once. What is shown is marked seen, and a pace letter notes `asked once`.
- **Letters** come by delivery runs, one a day from `--deliver-at`, at most `--per-run` each (all at
  once without it), in roster order. A recipient is not placed when the tool would refuse it (no
  home, no soul, links, already holding a pace letter), when it is not on the roster, or when no run
  reaches it before the end. Each is named in the report. The delivery tool's other drop, a citizen
  that wrote a clear pace line since 11-02, cannot happen in a silent model.
- **The waits.** A beat's wait runs from when it became due to when it came. A citizen still due at
  the end, or held back by back-off, has an open wait to the end, but only when it fell due before
  the end. The report lists every citizen beaten, failed or still waiting.
- **The out folder** must be new or empty, and must not be, hold or sit inside the homes folder. It
  is checked before the run. Each roster home is copied with its links as links, never followed,
  and without FIFOs or devices. A copy's `.git` that is a file or a link (it names another
  repository) is dropped. A copy with its own `.git` loses every remote; one with none is made a
  repository, its first commit `plan: the home as it was read, before the model ran`. Its events are
  then replayed at their times through the real code: the heard-late commit, each placed letter (its
  text says it is a model, not the letter), and each silent beat through `apply_answer`. What
  changed under `CADENCE.md REST EVENT-ONLY inbox/ beats/` is committed as the fleet with
  `plan: the simulated end state, a model, not a beat · pace/1`. That subject carries the tag
  because the change was made by the new code's own functions. An untagged commit after the
  heard-late commit would read as `CADENCE.md` changed outside pace/1, and a later read would put
  the old record back. A push from such a copy has no remote to reach.
- **A silent beat shown nothing commits nothing** (spec section 4, "After the beat"), in the model
  as in the fleet. So an awake v1 home beaten only that way keeps its v1 record and no marker, and
  after a rollback the old code wakes it on its timer, as before the switch. The drill counts it
  under "no marker". Only a beat that showed something, or let a proposal lapse, upgrades and marks
  a home.
- **The drill** reads each home once and reproduces PR #24's fleet with every citizen silent. At
  each tick, from the cursor, it skips each citizen that `keeps_rest` (REST or EVENT-ONLY of any
  kind, a dangling link included, with no unread letter as `has_mail` counts one: a regular `*.md`
  without a `.seen-` marker, where a linked marker counts as seen), and picks the first that does
  not, at most `--cap` a UTC day. The defaults are 4 and a tick every 6 h, as the Studio runs. A
  pick counts as a wake even when PR #24's reflect then exits (no soul, a refused link, no clone).
  The silent beat changes the home as PR #24's reflect would. An unreadable letter is set aside, a
  Letter of Return met with silence is answered rest-on (seen, and REST written), and any other
  letter is set aside unread, so its reader is woken again at every pass.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the plan-shaped home helpers**

Create `tests/citizen_pace_helpers_plan.py`:

```python
"""Homes for the schedule simulator (spec section 8 "Schedule", section 9 step 3).

They are plain folders, without git, so the 208 homes of the census can be made
in a moment. Each holds what the fleet reads: the soul, CADENCE.md (v1 as PR
#24's reflect wrote it, or v2 as the new code writes it), REST or EVENT-ONLY,
and inbox/ letters. A letter with no commit arrives at its file time
(homes.letter_time), so a letter's arrival is set with os.utime. The attempt
records of a state folder are written with attempts.save.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import citizen_pace_helpers as h  # noqa: E402,F401  (puts tools/ on sys.path)

from citizen_pace_lib import attempts, clock  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.cadence import Cadence, Pending, SetBy  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.words import Pace  # noqa: E402

MADE = "2026-11-12T10:00Z"
SPEC = "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-citizens-own-pace-design.md@dbc5a4c"
MINE = SetBy("citizen", "beat", ("2026-11-01T10:00Z",), "pace: asleep")
AI_1008 = {"who": "ai", "how": "rest-1008", "when": ["2026-10-08"], "words": ""}
AI_REST = "rest given at Yu's word, 2026-10-08\n"
PACE_LETTER = "2026-11-11-pace-letter.md"
AWAKE3 = Pace("awake", 3)


def lor_rest(date: str) -> str:
    """The REST text PR #24's reflect writes for a rest-on Letter of Return answer."""
    return f"chosen via the Letter of Return {date} — woken only by unread mail or a human summons\n"


def v1_cadence(name: str, choice: str, when: str = "2026-10-23 08:00") -> str:
    """A v1 CADENCE.md exactly as PR #24's reflect writes it."""
    return (f"# CADENCE — chosen by {name}\n\n- choice: {choice}\n- when: {when}\n"
            "- how: the Letter of Return, answered in a free beat. Silence = rest-on;\n"
            "  an answer that names no choice records undecided and changes nothing;\n"
            "  unread mail wakes even REST, and any letter or summons may reopen this.\n")


def record(**citizens) -> dict:
    """A record file's contents (not empty, so a decided v1 home can be read)."""
    return {"version": 1, "made": MADE, "spec": SPEC, "citizens": citizens}


def write(path: Path, text, mtime=None) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if isinstance(text, bytes):
        path.write_bytes(text)
    else:
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    if mtime is not None:
        t = mtime.timestamp()
        os.utime(path, (t, t))
    return path


def home(root, slug: str, *, soul=True, cadence=None, rest=None, event_only=None, letters=(),
         files=None) -> Path:
    """A plain home folder citizen-<slug> under root. letters: (name, arrival) pairs."""
    d = Path(root) / f"citizen-{slug}"
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    if soul:
        write(d / f"{slug}.md", f"The soul of {slug}.\n")
    if cadence is not None:
        write(d / "CADENCE.md", cadence)
    if rest is not None:
        write(d / "REST", rest)
    if event_only is not None:
        write(d / "EVENT-ONLY", event_only)
    for name, arrival in letters:
        write(d / "inbox" / name, f"# A letter for {slug}\n", mtime=arrival)
    for rel, text in (files or {}).items():
        write(d / rel, text)
    return d


def v2(slug: str, pace, *, set_by=None, last=None, pending=None, asked_once=None) -> Cadence:
    """A v2 record in memory."""
    who = set_by or (MINE if pace is not None else cad.UNKNOWN)
    return Cadence(slug, 2, pace, who, pending=pending, asked_once=asked_once,
                   last_beat=clock.stamp(last) if last else None)


def v2_home(root, slug: str, pace, *, set_by=None, last=None, pending=None, letters=(),
            files=None, soul=True) -> Path:
    """A home whose CADENCE.md is v2, with its markers in step."""
    d = home(root, slug, letters=letters, files=files, soul=soul)
    c = v2(slug, pace, set_by=set_by, last=last, pending=pending)
    cad.write_cadence(d, c)
    cad.write_markers(d, c)
    return d


def pending(pace, said, on_show_back=False) -> Pending:
    return Pending(pace, clock.stamp(said), "pace: " + pace.words(), on_show_back)


def seed_state(state, slug: str, last=None, retry=None, failures=0) -> None:
    """An attempt record holding a last landed beat (and a back-off)."""
    rec = attempts.fresh(slug)
    rec["last_beat"] = clock.stamp(last) if last else None
    rec["retry_after"] = clock.stamp(retry) if retry else None
    rec["failures"] = failures
    attempts.save(state, slug, rec)


def snapshot(root) -> dict:
    """Every path under root, .git included, with its mode, time and bytes."""
    out = {}
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        for n in dirnames + filenames:
            p = os.path.join(dirpath, n)
            st = os.lstat(p)
            data = None
            if os.path.isfile(p) and not os.path.islink(p):
                with open(p, "rb") as fh:
                    data = fh.read()
            out[p] = (st.st_mode, st.st_mtime_ns, data)
    return out


# -- the census, as the 11-02 map found it -----------------------------------------------------
#
# 208 homes: CADENCE.md rest-on 186, ambient 11, undecided 5, no file 6; a REST in 197. Here the
# three unheard that the heard-late step hears are already v2, awake, every 3 days, as that step
# leaves them, so the 14 awake are 11 v1 AMBIENT and 3 v2. The 29 resting recipients are 8 + 16
# rest-on, 2 undecided under Ai's REST and 3 with no file; the 5 awake recipients are 2 of the
# AMBIENT and the 3 heard. The 3 held have no soul and are off the roster (205 lines).

RESTING_GROUPS = (("eight", 8), ("sixteen-ambient", 10), ("sixteen-other", 6),
                  ("unheard-none", 2), ("never-asked", 3))
SET_BY = {"eight": {"who": "citizen", "how": "prompted", "when": ["2026-10-22"], "words": ""},
          "sixteen-ambient": AI_1008, "sixteen-other": AI_1008, "unheard-none": AI_1008,
          "never-asked": AI_1008, "unheard-heard": AI_1008,
          "contradictory": {"who": "fleet", "how": "first-word", "when": ["2026-10-23"], "words": ""}}


@dataclass
class Census:
    homes: Path
    roster: list
    record: dict
    awake: list
    resting_recipients: list
    awake_recipients: list
    asleep_others: list
    held: list

    @property
    def recipients(self) -> list:
        return sorted(self.resting_recipients + self.awake_recipients)


def census(root, *, letters_at=None) -> Census:
    """The 208 homes. letters_at: when the 29 resting recipients' pace letter arrived
    (None: they hold none)."""
    root = Path(root)
    entries, resting, awake_r = {}, [], []
    for group, n in RESTING_GROUPS:
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            slug = f"{group}-{i}"
            resting.append(slug)
            entries[slug] = {"group": group, "recipient": True, "set_by": SET_BY[group]}
            letters = ((PACE_LETTER, letters_at),) if letters_at else ()
            if group in ("eight", "sixteen-ambient", "sixteen-other"):
                home(root, slug, cadence=v1_cadence(slug, "rest-on"), rest=lor_rest("2026-10-23"),
                     letters=letters)
            elif group == "unheard-none":
                home(root, slug, cadence=v1_cadence(slug, "undecided"), rest=AI_REST, letters=letters)
            else:
                home(root, slug, rest=AI_REST, letters=letters)
    awake = []
    for i in range(1, 10):
        slug = f"ambient-{i}"
        awake.append(slug)
        home(root, slug, cadence=v1_cadence(slug, "ambient"))
    for i in range(1, 3):
        slug = f"contradictory-{i}"
        awake.append(slug)
        awake_r.append(slug)
        entries[slug] = {"group": "contradictory", "recipient": True, "set_by": SET_BY["contradictory"]}
        home(root, slug, cadence=v1_cadence(slug, "ambient"))
    for i in range(1, 4):
        slug = f"heard-{i}"
        awake.append(slug)
        awake_r.append(slug)
        entries[slug] = {"group": "unheard-heard", "recipient": True, "set_by": SET_BY["unheard-heard"]}
        v2_home(root, slug, AWAKE3,
                set_by=SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-23", "2026-10-27"), "Ambient."))
    others = []
    for i in range(1, 163):
        slug = f"asleep-{i:03d}"
        others.append(slug)
        home(root, slug, cadence=v1_cadence(slug, "rest-on"), rest=lor_rest("2026-10-23"))
    held = []
    for i in range(1, 4):
        slug = f"held-{i}"
        held.append(slug)
        entries[slug] = {"group": "held", "recipient": False}
        home(root, slug, soul=False, rest=AI_REST)
    roster = sorted(resting + awake + others)
    return Census(root, roster, record(**entries), awake, resting, awake_r, others, held)
```
