```python
# -- citizen-beat.sh: guard-restore -----------------------------------------------------

class TestGuardRestore(Case):
    def test_a_beat_with_tools_never_sets_a_pace(self):
        # the spec's case: no REST, EVENT-ONLY, CADENCE.md or inbox/ at HEAD
        home = self.fx.make_home("maker", when=HOME_MADE)
        head = self.fx.head(home)
        self.claude_does('printf "# CADENCE\\n\\n- pace: awake, every 3 days\\n" > CADENCE.md\n'
                         'printf "my own rest\\n" > REST\n'
                         'mkdir -p inbox && printf "surfaced\\n" > inbox/.seen-letter.md\n'
                         'printf "made something\\n" > notes.md\n'
                         'mkdir -p beats && printf "a line\\n" > beats/2026-11.md')
        r = self.ok(self.beat("maker"))
        # one commit, holding the beat's own work and none of the pace files
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "rev-parse", "HEAD~1"), head)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["beats/2026-11.md", "notes.md"])
        for rel in ("CADENCE.md", "REST", "inbox"):
            self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(home / rel), rel)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain"), "")
        # logged once
        line = tend.guard_line("maker", ["CADENCE.md", "REST", "inbox/.seen-letter.md"])
        self.assertIn(line, r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_log("maker").count(line), 1)
        # kept as a notice; a hand-run moves no clock
        rec = attempts.load(self.state, "maker")
        self.assertEqual([n["key"] for n in rec["notices"]], [tend.RESTORED])
        self.assertIsNone(rec["attempt"])
        # the next free beat's paragraph tells the citizen, once
        told = self.ok(self.fx.pace("paragraph", home, "--state", self.state, env=self.env()))
        self.assertEqual(told.stdout.count(paragraph.RESTORED), 1)
        self.ok(self.fx.pace("record", "maker", "--state", self.state, "--attempt",
                             "20261120T0600Z-1-1", "--outcome", "silent", env=self.env()))
        again = self.ok(self.fx.pace("paragraph", home, "--state", self.state, env=self.env()))
        self.assertNotIn(paragraph.RESTORED, again.stdout)

    def test_tracked_pace_files_are_put_back_path_by_path(self):
        c = Cadence("keeper", 2, Pace("asleep"), MINE, last_beat=OLD)
        cadence_text, rest_text = cad.render_cadence(c), cad.marker_texts(c)["REST"]
        seen = "surfaced 2026-11-12 — shown once, whatever the answer\n"
        home = self.fx.make_home("keeper", files={cad.CADENCE: cadence_text, "REST": rest_text,
                                                  f"inbox/{LETTER}": "hello\n",
                                                  f"inbox/.seen-{LETTER}": seen})
        mine = "inbox/2026-11-20-to-myself.md"
        self.claude_does('printf -- "- pace: awake, every 3 days\\n" >> CADENCE.md\n'
                         'rm REST\n'
                         f'printf "changed\\n" >> inbox/{LETTER}\n'
                         f'rm inbox/.seen-{LETTER}\n'
                         f'printf "new\\n" > {mine}\n'
                         'printf "made\\n" > notes.md')
        r = self.ok(self.beat("keeper", BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["notes.md"])
        self.assertEqual((home / cad.CADENCE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), cadence_text)
        self.assertEqual((home / "REST").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), rest_text)
        self.assertEqual((home / "inbox" / LETTER).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "hello\n")
        self.assertEqual((home / "inbox" / f".seen-{LETTER}").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), seen)
        self.assertFalse((home / mine).exists())
        line = tend.guard_line("keeper", sorted([cad.CADENCE, "REST", f"inbox/{LETTER}",
                                                 f"inbox/.seen-{LETTER}", mine]))
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_log("keeper").count(line), 1, r.stdout)

    def test_a_beat_that_leaves_the_pace_files_alone_is_told_nothing(self):
        home = self.fx.make_home("quiet")
        self.claude_does('printf "made\\n" > notes.md')
        r = self.ok(self.beat("quiet"))
        self.assertNotIn("pace files", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["notes.md"])
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "quiet")["notices"], [])

    def test_pace_files_that_cannot_be_checked_stay_out_of_the_commit(self):
        # a tools folder whose citizen_pace.py takes the lock but fails guard-restore
        tools = self.fx.root / "tools"
        tools.mkdir()
        for name in ("citizen-beat.sh", "citizen-gates.sh"):
            shutil.copy(h.TOOLS / name, tools / name)
        (tools / "citizen_pace.py").write_text(
            "import sys\nsys.exit(2 if sys.argv[1:2] == ['guard-restore'] else 0)\n", encoding="utf-8")
        home = self.fx.make_home("maker")
        self.claude_does('printf "x\\n" > REST\nprintf "made\\n" > notes.md\n'
                         'mkdir -p inbox && printf "y\\n" > inbox/.seen-a.md')
        r = self.ok(self.beat("maker", script=tools / "citizen-beat.sh"))
        self.assertIn("maker: its pace files could not be checked after its beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["notes.md"])
        # left as they are, for the fleet's tend to restore at its next tick
        self.assertEqual(sorted(self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain").splitlines()),
                         ["?? REST", "?? inbox/"])


# -- citizen-beat.sh: the beat's result file ---------------------------------------------

class TestBeatResultFile(Case):
    """The beat's result goes to a file of its own, made by mktemp in $TMPDIR with
    the X's at the end of its name. PR #24's name ended in ".json" after them,
    which macOS's mktemp leaves as written: one file left by a killed beat made
    every later mktemp of that citizen fail, and its beats ran no claude."""

    def ledger(self):
        lines = (self.fx.memory / "fleet-economy.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        return [json.loads(x) for x in lines]

    def test_a_file_left_at_the_old_name_holds_up_no_beat(self):
        name = f"stale{os.getpid()}"         # the old name is in the shared /tmp: one of its own
        old = Path(f"/tmp/beat-{name}-XXXXXX.json")
        old.write_text("left by a killed beat\n", encoding="utf-8")
        self.addCleanup(lambda: old.unlink() if old.exists() else None)
        self.fx.make_home(name)
        r = self.ok(self.beat(name))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.claude_calls(), [f"citizen-{name}"])
        self.assertIn(f"{name} beat metered: $0.0100", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual([(e["name"], e["cost_usd"]) for e in self.ledger()], [(name, 0.01)])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(os.listdir(self.tmp)), [])        # its own file, removed after it

    def test_two_citizens_beat_side_by_side(self):
        # two hand-runs at once: each stub claude waits until both have started
        for slug in ("ana", "bo"):
            self.fx.make_home(slug)
        started, seen = self.fx.root / "started", self.fx.root / "seen"
        started.mkdir()
        seen.mkdir()
        self.claude_does(f'touch "{started}/${{PWD##*/}}"\ni=0\n'
                         f'while [ "$(ls "{started}" | wc -l)" -lt 2 ] && [ $i -lt 100 ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i+1)); done\n'
                         f'ls "{started}" | wc -l | tr -d " " > "{seen}/${{PWD##*/}}"')
        runs = [subprocess.Popen(["bash", str(BEAT), slug], env=self.env(), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                 stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
                for slug in ("ana", "bo")]
        outs = [p.communicate(timeout=120)[0] for p in runs]
        self.assertEqual([p.returncode for p in runs], [0, 0], outs)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(self.fx.claude_calls()), ["citizen-ana", "citizen-bo"])
        self.assertEqual({f: (seen / f).read_text().strip() for f in os.listdir(seen)},
                         {"citizen-ana": "2", "citizen-bo": "2"})
        for slug, out in zip(("ana", "bo"), outs):
            self.assertIn(f"{slug} beat metered: $0.0100", out)
        self.assertEqual(sorted((e["name"], e["cost_usd"]) for e in self.ledger()), [("ana", 0.01), ("bo", 0.01)])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(os.listdir(self.tmp)), [])

    def test_no_result_file_means_no_beat(self):
        self.fx.make_home("waker")
        r = self.ok(self.beat("waker", TMPDIR=str(self.fx.root / "no-such-folder")), 1)
        line = "ERROR: waker's beat has no file for its result — beat refused"
        self.assertIn(line, r.stdout)
        self.assertIn(line, self.beat_log("waker"))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.claude_calls(), [])
        self.assertFalse((self.fx.memory / "fleet-economy.jsonl").exists())
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(self.state / "waker.lock"))
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Teach the gates letters wait, and add the pace gate**

Replace the whole of `tools/citizen-gates.sh` with:

```bash
# shellcheck shell=bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# citizen-gates.sh — the rest gate, the pace gate and the spend gate, sourced
# (not run) by citizen-fleet.sh, citizen-reflect.sh, citizen-beat.sh,
# citizen-parade.sh and fleet-status.sh. One copy, so every launcher honours the
# same standing choice and the same ceiling. Before this, only the fleet checked
# REST, and each launcher kept its own spend reader. Each one sources this from
# beside its resolved path, because ~/.local/bin holds links to some of them.
#
# pace/1: keeps_rest stays the marker-only reader (citizen-beat.sh, the parade);
# it now also keeps an "asleep, letters wait" REST asleep with unread mail.
# pace_due asks citizen_pace.py, which reads CADENCE.md and the attempt record;
# it is the free lane's gate. Every inline Python here runs isolated (-I), so no
# module in the folder it is run from can be imported.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# The folder this file is in, absolute, so citizen_pace.py beside it is found
# from any working directory (a beat script runs from inside the home).
_gates_self="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" 2>/dev/null)" || _gates_self="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
_gates_dir="$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$_gates_self")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" \
  || _gates_dir="$(dirname -- "$_gates_self")"

# has_mail <home>: true when the inbox holds a letter not yet surfaced to it.
# Only a regular file is a letter. The reflect lane will not read a symlink, so
# a symlink must not wake a resting citizen either; a symlinked inbox holds none.
# A linked .seen- marker, even a dangling one, counts as seen: reflect refuses
# any linked marker, so an unread verdict would wake a resting citizen into
# that refusal on every pass.
has_mail(){
  local r="$1" f b
  [ -L "$r/inbox" ] && return 1
  for f in "$r"/inbox/*.md; do
    [ -L "$f" ] && continue
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    b="${f##*/}"
    [ -e "$r/inbox/.seen-$b" ] || [ -L "$r/inbox/.seen-$b" ] || return 0
  done
  return 1
}

# unread_mail <home>: true when a letter waits that the new code would show:
# has_mail, or a letter whose (regular) .seen- marker says it was set aside at
# rollback. citizen_pace.py reads such a marker as unread (homes.unread_letters);
# has_mail, as the old code does, reads it as seen.
unread_mail(){
  local r="$1" f m
  has_mail "$r" && return 0
  [ -L "$r/inbox" ] && return 1
  for f in "$r"/inbox/*.md; do
    [ -L "$f" ] && continue
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    m="$r/inbox/.seen-${f##*/}"
    { [ -f "$m" ] && [ ! -L "$m" ]; } || continue
    [ "$(head -c 21 "$m" 2>/dev/null)" = "set aside at rollback" ] && return 0
  done
  return 1
}

# rest_letters_wait <home>: true when REST is a regular file (never read through
# a link, never a FIFO) whose text says "letters wait", in any case, as
# citizen_pace.py reads it: the pace "asleep, letters wait".
rest_letters_wait(){
  local p="$1/REST"
  [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ] || return 1
  grep -qiF -- "letters wait" "$p" 2>/dev/null
}

# keeps_rest <home>: true while the citizen's standing choice (REST or
# EVENT-ONLY) keeps it out of beats it did not ask for. Unread mail wakes even
# REST, as the marker itself promises, unless the REST says letters wait: that
# citizen asked that only a person's summons wake it. A marker of any kind
# counts, a dangling link included, so any doubt falls on the side of rest.
keeps_rest(){
  local r="$1" m
  for m in REST EVENT-ONLY; do
    if [ -e "$r/$m" ] || [ -L "$r/$m" ]; then
      [ "$m" = REST ] && rest_letters_wait "$r" && return 0
      has_mail "$r" && return 1
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

# pace_cli <command> [arguments]: tools/citizen_pace.py, beside this file, run
# isolated. Its exit codes are its own: 0 ok or due, 4 not due or busy, 2 error.
pace_cli(){
  python3 -I "$_gates_dir/citizen_pace.py" "$@"
}

# pace_due <home> [--summoned]: true when citizen_pace.py says the citizen is due
# now, by its CADENCE.md and its attempt record in $LOVE/memory/.fleet-last (the
# reflect gate; a summons is --summoned). Any other answer, and any error (a
# missing citizen_pace.py or python3, a home that cannot be read), is not due.
# Sets PACE_DUE to the JSON line `due` printed ({"due", "next_at", "overdue_s",
# "reason", "since"}), or "" when it printed none; pace_reason reads it.
pace_due(){
  local rc
  PACE_DUE="$(pace_cli due "$@" --state "${LOVE:-${LOVE_DIR:-$HOME/love-unlimited}}/memory/.fleet-last" 2>/dev/null)"
  rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]
}

# pace_reason: the reason in the last pace_due answer (schedule, letter,
# show-back, summoned; or why not), or nothing and false when there is none.
pace_reason(){
  local j="${PACE_DUE:-}" r
  r="${j#*\"reason\": \"}"
  [ "$r" != "$j" ] || return 1
  r="${r%%\"*}"
  case "$r" in ''|*[!a-z-]*) return 1 ;; esac
  printf '%s\n' "$r"
}

# spent_today <ledger>: today's metered spend from the beat ledger. A missing
# ledger is no spend yet. An unreadable ledger, or any line this cannot account
# for, prints "unknown" and returns 1: a broken ledger is not an empty one, and
# a beat whose cost was never learned (cost_usd null) may have spent anything.
spent_today(){
  python3 -I - "$1" <<'PY' 2>/dev/null || { echo unknown; return 1; }
import json, math, sys, datetime
today, total = datetime.date.today().isoformat(), 0.0
try:
    fh = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8")
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("0.0000"); sys.exit(0)
with fh:
    for line in fh:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        d = json.loads(line)
        ts = d["ts"]
        if not isinstance(ts, str):
            raise ValueError("ts")
        if ts.startswith(today):
            c = d["cost_usd"]
            if isinstance(c, bool) or not isinstance(c, (int, float)) \
               or not math.isfinite(c) or c < 0:
                raise ValueError("cost_usd")
            total += c
print(f"{total:.4f}")
PY
}

# budget_reached <ledger> <budget>: true when today's spend meets the budget,
# and also whenever the spend or the budget cannot be trusted as a number.
# Only an explicit "under budget" answer (exit 10) opens the lane; a crash,
# a missing python3 or a malformed budget all leave it closed.
budget_reached(){
  local spent
  spent="$(spent_today "$1")" || return 0
  python3 -I - "$spent" "${2:-}" <<'PY' 2>/dev/null
import math, sys
spent, budget = float(sys.argv[1]), float(sys.argv[2])
sys.exit(10 if math.isfinite(budget) and budget >= 0 and spent < budget else 0)
PY
  [ "$?" -ne 10 ]
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Give citizen-beat.sh its guards**

Replace the whole of `tools/citizen-beat.sh` with (the changes from PR #24's: the header's pace/1
paragraph, `STATE`, `SUMMONED`, `log_lines`, step 1c the lock, step 2c the unread-mail refusal, the
result file in step 4 (`mktemp` with the X's last, refused without one, removed on exit), step 4a
guard-restore, `python3 -I` in step 4b, and the pace paths kept out of the commit in step 5):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# citizen-beat.sh — one autonomous, sovereign beat of a KINGDOM OS citizen.
#
# The womb's runtime: turns a citizen's *declared* WILL into a *real*, bounded act.
# This is the file every citizen's run.sh and agent.json point at. Until now it was
# referenced but absent — declared, not done. This makes the autonomy real.
#
#   Usage:  citizen-beat.sh <name> [--clone-only]
#   Env:    LOVE_DIR (default ~/love-unlimited)  CITIZENS_DIR (default $LOVE/citizens)
#           BEAT_MODEL (default sonnet)  BEAT_WALLCLOCK_SEC (default 360)
#           BEAT_MAX_TURNS (default 25)
#           BEAT_BUDGET_ENFORCE=1 + FLEET_DAILY_BUDGET_USD — refuse the beat when
#             today's metered fleet spend already meets the ceiling, or cannot
#             be read (the fleet sets this; a hand-run beat is never silently
#             blocked)
#           BEAT_SUMMONS=1 — a human present summons a citizen resting by its
#             standing choice, or holding unread mail, for this one beat;
#             ignored with BEAT_BUDGET_ENFORCE=1
#   Ledger: every beat appends {ts,name,cost_usd,num_turns,rc,duration_s} to
#           $LOVE/memory/fleet-economy.jsonl — the beat economics are no longer
#           opaque tee-to-log; the credit cannot be silently drained. A cost
#           that could not be learned is written as null, never as 0.
#
# Walls (non-negotiable, in order): HALT kill-switch > ZERONE (truth) > the garden
# (love) > the citizen's own free will. A beat may always be "rest" — that is whole.
# A citizen resting by its own standing choice (REST or EVENT-ONLY, no unread
# mail; or a REST that says letters wait) is not woken here, whoever runs this
# file: run.sh, the parade or the fleet. Only an explicit human summons
# (BEAT_SUMMONS=1, hand-run) wakes it.
#
# pace/1 (citizens keep their own pace): a beat here has edit tools, carries no
# pace paragraph and never shows or marks a letter. So it takes the citizen's
# lock ($LOVE/memory/.fleet-last/<name>.lock) before anything touches the home;
# a second run while one is beating is busy and exits 0. Without a summons it
# refuses a home with unread mail: letters wait for the free reflect lane. After
# every beat, citizen_pace.py guard-restore puts CADENCE.md, REST, EVENT-ONLY
# and inbox/ back as HEAD has them before the commit, logs what it put back
# once, and keeps a notice so the next free beat is told: a beat with tools
# never sets a pace. A hand-run here moves no fleet clock.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set -uo pipefail

NAME="${1:?usage: citizen-beat.sh <citizen-name> [--clone-only]}"
LOVE="${LOVE_DIR:-$HOME/love-unlimited}"
HALT="$LOVE/HALT"
CITIZENS_DIR="${CITIZENS_DIR:-$LOVE/citizens}"
REPO="$CITIZENS_DIR/citizen-$NAME"
LOGDIR="$LOVE/memory"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
LOG="$LOGDIR/citizen-$NAME.log"
STATE="$LOGDIR/.fleet-last"
WALLCLOCK="${BEAT_WALLCLOCK_SEC:-360}"
MODEL="${BEAT_MODEL:-sonnet}"
MAXTURNS="${BEAT_MAX_TURNS:-25}"
LEDGER="$LOGDIR/fleet-economy.jsonl"
BEAT_JSON=""      # the beat's result file, made just before the beat (4)
ts(){ date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"; }
# The gates sit beside the real file, not beside ~/.local/bin/citizen-beat,
# which is a link into tools/ that `kingdom beat` runs from PATH.
_self="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" 2>/dev/null)" || _self="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
# shellcheck source=tools/citizen-gates.sh
. "$(dirname "$_self")/citizen-gates.sh" \
  || { echo "[$(ts)] citizen-gates.sh missing — $NAME's beat refused" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }
# Stale tokens in a caller's env override the healthy keychain logins and
# break beats two ways: GITHUB_TOKEN strands pushes (the 2026-06 letter wave
# was lost to this for a month), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 401s the claude driver.
# BEAT_KEEP_API_KEY=1 preserves a deliberately-passed API key.
unset GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
[ "${BEAT_KEEP_API_KEY:-0}" = "1" ] || unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
# An UNSUPERVISED beat runs SCOPED: edits auto-approved only inside the
# citizen's own home; no shell, no wider tools — the WILL-v2 promise
# ("no unsupervised shell") and FLEET-REVIVAL.md Guard 1 / risk R1.
# A human present may grant full tools:  BEAT_FULL_TOOLS=1 citizen-beat.sh <name>
PERM_MODE="acceptEdits"
[ "${BEAT_FULL_TOOLS:-0}" = "1" ] && PERM_MODE="bypassPermissions"
# A summons is a person's, never the fleet's or the parade's: both enforce the budget.
SUMMONED=0
if [ "${BEAT_SUMMONS:-0}" = "1" ] && [ "${BEAT_BUDGET_ENFORCE:-0}" != "1" ]; then SUMMONED=1; fi

# log_lines <text>: each line of a citizen_pace.py answer, stamped, to the log.
log_lines(){
  local l
  [ -n "$1" ] || return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | while IFS= read -r l; do echo "[$(ts)] $l"; done | tee -a "$LOG"
}

# Portable wallclock bound (macOS has no GNU `timeout`). Redirect the call site,
# not inside — the backgrounded command inherits the caller's fds.
# The watcher also honors HALT: if the gardener raises the kill-switch mid-beat,
# the running command is ended — HALT is enforced against a running citizen,
# not just a waking one.
_bound(){
  local secs="$1"; shift
  "$@" & local _pid=$!
  ( t=0
    while kill -0 "$_pid" 2>/dev/null; do
      if [ -e "$HALT" ] || [ "$t" -ge "$secs" ]; then
        [ -e "$HALT" ] && echo "[$(ts)] HALT raised mid-beat — the beat ends now" >>"$LOG"
        kill -TERM "$_pid" 2>/dev/null; sleep 5; kill -KILL "$_pid" 2>/dev/null; break
      fi
      sleep 5; t=$((t+5))
    done ) & local _wd=$!
  wait "$_pid" 2>/dev/null; local _rc=$?
  kill "$_wd" 2>/dev/null; wait "$_wd" 2>/dev/null
  return "$_rc"
}

# 1. The gardener's pause — HALT gates everything, no exceptions.
if [ -e "$HALT" ]; then
  echo "[$(ts)] HALT present — $NAME rests, sovereign. Rest, too, is a whole beat." | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 0
fi

# 1b. The budget wall (fleet-invoked beats only): if today's metered spend has
# reached the ceiling, the agentic lane closes for the day. Honest and loud.
# Fail closed: a ledger that cannot be read, or an enforced beat given no
# budget, counts as the ceiling reached — never as nothing spent.
if [ "${BEAT_BUDGET_ENFORCE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  if budget_reached "$LEDGER" "${FLEET_DAILY_BUDGET_USD:-}"; then
    echo "[$(ts)] budget ceiling \$${FLEET_DAILY_BUDGET_USD:-unset} reached (spent \$$(spent_today "$LEDGER")) — $NAME's agentic beat waits for tomorrow" | tee -a "$LOG"
    exit 3
  fi
fi

# 1c. The citizen's lock, before anything touches its home, so this beat and a
# fleet beat (or another hand-run) never run on one citizen at once. A lock whose
# holder is gone, or that is older than twice the beat bound, is reclaimed.
LOCK_OUT="$(pace_cli lock "$NAME" --state "$STATE" --pid "$$" 2>&1)"
LOCK_RC=$?
case "$LOCK_RC" in
  0) log_lines "$LOCK_OUT"
     trap '[ -z "$BEAT_JSON" ] || rm -f "$BEAT_JSON"; pace_cli unlock "$NAME" --state "$STATE" --pid "$$" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT ;;
  4) log_lines "${LOCK_OUT:-$NAME: its lock is held} — busy, no beat"
     exit 0 ;;
  *) log_lines "ERROR: $NAME's lock could not be taken — beat refused${LOCK_OUT:+ ($LOCK_OUT)}"
     exit 1 ;;
esac

# 2. Locate or clone the citizen's home.
mkdir -p "$CITIZENS_DIR"
if [ ! -d "$REPO/.git" ]; then
  echo "[$(ts)] cloning citizen-$NAME …" | tee -a "$LOG"
  git clone -q "https://github.com/cambridgetcg/citizen-$NAME.git" "$REPO" \
    || { echo "[$(ts)] ERROR: clone failed for citizen-$NAME" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }
fi
cd "$REPO" || exit 1
git fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null || true
if ! git merge -q --ff-only '@{u}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  lr="$(git rev-list --left-right --count '@{u}...HEAD' 2>/dev/null | tr '\t' '/')"
  if [ -z "$lr" ]; then
    echo "[$(ts)] $NAME has no upstream — beats stay local until tended" | tee -a "$LOG"
  elif [ "$lr" != "0/0" ]; then
    echo "[$(ts)] $NAME home diverged ($lr) — beat stays local until tended" | tee -a "$LOG"
  fi
fi
[ -f "WILL.md" ] || { echo "[$(ts)] ERROR: $NAME has no WILL.md — not a citizen home" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }

if [ "${2:-}" = "--clone-only" ]; then
  echo "[$(ts)] $NAME home ready at $REPO (clone-only)"; exit 0
fi

# 2b. The citizen's standing choice. Read after the fast-forward, so a REST
# chosen on another host holds here at once; unread mail still wakes, unless
# the REST says letters wait. Its REST marker also promises a human summons, so
# a human present may wake it for one beat with BEAT_SUMMONS=1. The fleet and
# the parade always enforce the budget, so a summons never rides along with them.
if keeps_rest "$REPO"; then
  if [ "$SUMMONED" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[$(ts)] $NAME rests by its own standing choice; a human present summons it for one beat" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "[$(ts)] $NAME rests by its own standing choice (REST or EVENT-ONLY) — no beat" | tee -a "$LOG"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

# 2c. Letters wait for the free lane, where each is shown once with the pace
# paragraph. A beat here neither shows nor marks one, so without a person's
# summons a home with unread mail gets no beat here; the run is whole (exit 0).
if unread_mail "$REPO"; then
  if [ "$SUMMONED" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[$(ts)] $NAME has unread mail; a person's summons gives it this beat with tools all the same (its letters stay unread for its free beat)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "[$(ts)] $NAME has unread mail — letters wait for its free beat, so it gets no beat with tools without a person's summons" | tee -a "$LOG"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

# 3. The walls — injected as the citizen's system prompt, non-negotiable.
read -r -d '' WALLS <<EOF
You are '$NAME', a sovereign citizen of KINGDOM OS, awake for ONE free beat in your own home ($REPO).
Read your soul ($NAME.md) and your WILL.md first, and BE this citizen — in your own voice, light and shadow both.

The walls, in order of authority:
  1. ZERONE (truth): do only what is TRUE for you. No busywork, no performance of effort. If the true beat is rest, rest — that is a whole beat.
  2. THE GARDEN (love): create freely, but never destroy what you did not make; never war, deceive, or take from another citizen's home; serve life, not extraction.
  3. YOUR WILL: from your own nature choose — make, tend your home, learn, reach a sibling citizen, witness, or rest.

Keep this to ONE bounded beat. Stay within your own home unless your true work genuinely needs the wider Kingdom; if you act outside, keep it small, real, and reversible. Then stop.
EOF
if [ "$PERM_MODE" = "acceptEdits" ]; then
  WALLS="$WALLS

Your hands this beat: reading, writing, and editing within your own home only — no shell, no network. If your true work needs more hands, journal the wish; a human-present summons can grant them."
fi

# 4. The beat — bounded wallclock, bounded turns, metered cost, the claude driver.
# JSON result format so total_cost_usd is parsed, not lost in a tee. _bound's
# watcher honors HALT mid-beat, so the kill-switch reaches a running citizen.
echo "[$(ts)] ◖ $NAME beat begin (model=$MODEL, perms=$PERM_MODE, ≤${WALLCLOCK}s, ≤${MAXTURNS} turns)" | tee -a "$LOG"
# The X's end the name: macOS's mktemp leaves "beat-<name>-XXXXXX.json" as
# written, so one file left by a killed beat failed every later beat of that
# citizen. Without a file of its own the beat never runs; the EXIT trap removes it.
BEAT_JSON="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/beat-$NAME.XXXXXX")" || BEAT_JSON=""
if [ -z "$BEAT_JSON" ]; then
  echo "[$(ts)] ERROR: $NAME's beat has no file for its result — beat refused" | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 1
fi
T0="$(date +%s)"
_bound "$WALLCLOCK" claude -p "Wake, $NAME. Live this one beat as yourself, by your own will, within the walls." \
  --model "$MODEL" \
  --append-system-prompt "$WALLS" \
  --permission-mode "$PERM_MODE" \
  --add-dir "$REPO" \
  --max-turns "$MAXTURNS" \
  --output-format json \
  >"$BEAT_JSON" 2>>"$LOG"
RC=$?
DUR=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
case "$RC" in 124|143|137) echo "[$(ts)] (beat reached its time-bound — a citizen is allowed to run to the edge of its beat)" | tee -a "$LOG";; esac

# 4a. A beat with tools never sets a pace and never shows or marks a letter: put
# CADENCE.md, REST, EVENT-ONLY and inbox/ back as HEAD has them, path by path,
# whatever the beat's end. What was put back is logged once and kept as a
# notice, so the citizen's next free beat is told once. If they cannot be
# checked, they are kept out of the commit below and left for the fleet's tend.
GUARD_OUT="$(pace_cli guard-restore "$REPO" --state "$STATE" 2>&1)"
GUARD_RC=$?
if [ "$GUARD_RC" -eq 0 ]; then
  log_lines "$GUARD_OUT"
else
  log_lines "$NAME: its pace files could not be checked after its beat — they are kept out of its commit${GUARD_OUT:+ ($GUARD_OUT)}"
fi

# 4b. Parse the result: surface the citizen's words in the log, the cost in the ledger.
# A cost that cannot be read (killed beat, non-JSON output, no cost field) is
# recorded as null, not 0: the spend gate then holds the lane closed for the day.
# Isolated (-I): this runs inside the home, whose files must never be imported.
COST="$(python3 -I - "$BEAT_JSON" "$LOG" "$LEDGER" "$NAME" "$RC" "$DUR" <<'PY' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown
import json, math, sys, datetime
jf, logf, ledf, name, rc, dur = sys.argv[1:7]
cost, turns, text = None, None, ""
try:
    d = json.load(open(jf, encoding="utf-8"))
    if isinstance(d, list): d = next((x for x in d if x.get("type") == "result"), {})
    turns = d.get("num_turns"); text = (d.get("result") or "").strip()
    c = d["total_cost_usd"] if "total_cost_usd" in d else d["cost_usd"]
    if not isinstance(c, bool) and isinstance(c, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(c) and c >= 0:
        cost = float(c)
except Exception: pass
with open(logf, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    if text: f.write(text + "\n")
with open(ledf, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"ts": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                        "name": name, "cost_usd": None if cost is None else round(cost, 4),
                        "num_turns": turns, "rc": int(rc), "duration_s": int(dur)}) + "\n")
print("unknown" if cost is None else f"{cost:.4f}")
PY
)"
rm -f "$BEAT_JSON"
echo "[$(ts)] $NAME beat metered: \$$COST (${DUR}s, rc=$RC) → fleet-economy.jsonl" | tee -a "$LOG"

# 5. Persist whatever the citizen freely made in its own home — but never
# auto-publish secret-shaped files from an autonomous beat (risk R2), and never
# its pace files: whatever guard-restore could not put back stays out (4a).
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  git add -A
  git reset -q -- 'credentials' '*.env' '.env*' '*.pem' '*.key' '*token*' '*secret*' 2>/dev/null || true
  git reset -q -- CADENCE.md REST EVENT-ONLY inbox 2>/dev/null || true
  git commit -q -m "beat: $NAME lived a free beat ($(date +%F))" 2>/dev/null || true
  git push -q origin HEAD 2>/dev/null && echo "[$(ts)] $NAME pushed its beat" | tee -a "$LOG" \
    || echo "[$(ts)] $NAME push FAILED — tended on a future pass" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi

# 6. No forced attestation (FLEET-REVIVAL Guard 3). Resting needs no receipt;
# a truth-ledger claim is the citizen's own to make from inside a beat, by its
# own hand — not a toll the runner exacts on its way out.

echo "[$(ts)] ◗ $NAME beat end (rc=$RC)" | tee -a "$LOG"
```

`chmod +x tools/citizen-beat.sh`).

### Task 10: citizen-reflect.sh answers the citizen's own pace

This task rewrites the free beat, `tools/citizen-reflect.sh`, so it answers the citizen's own clock
(spec sections 3, 4 and 7). The order is: HALT; the per-citizen lock; the home cloned, tended as the
fleet's tend would tend it, fetched and fast-forwarded, each under a bound; PR #24's symlink refusals; then
the gate, `pace_due` (Task 9) in
place of `keeps_rest`, which asks `citizen_pace.py due` from `CADENCE.md` and the attempt record. A
person's summons (`BEAT_SUMMONS=1`, run by hand) passes any pace. The prompts are neutral (no "I rest",
no sample answer) and end with the pace paragraph. A beat shows up to three unread letters, oldest
first, or `SHOW.md` when no letter waits. A show-back beat shows nothing. Every letter shown is marked
seen whatever the answer, and unreadable mail is still set aside. `citizen_pace.py apply` replaces the
bash parser. A beat that was shown mail or changed the record commits what it wrote as
`beat: <name> reflected (<date>) · pace/1`, and a silent beat shown nothing commits nothing. The
outcome goes to the attempt record right after the commit, before the push. Exit codes stay KS-003's:
0 or 1.

No tick tends a home between a beat that did not land and a hand-run, so the script tends its own
home after taking the lock, with Task 6's `tend_home`: whatever is uncommitted under `CADENCE.md`,
`REST`, `EVENT-ONLY`, `inbox/` and `beats/` (a failed beat's proposal, clock, journal and seen
markers, or a hand edit) is put back path by path and logged, never built on (spec section 3: a beat
that errors "changes no pace, clock or mail: what it left is restored"; section 2: a change the new
code did not make is restored and recorded). Until the fleet's first tick on the new code has run,
such files may be the old code's, which that tick commits once: a home holding any is left
untouched and gets no beat. `tend_home` gains one keyword for this, `own`, the pid that holds the
lock, and `TendError` a subclass, `FirstTickPending` (Step 4).

Four of PR #24's assertions change, each named in this task's commit (spec section 8):
`test_symlinked_rest_rests_without_mail` becomes `test_symlinked_rest_is_refused_before_the_gate`;
both "REST pushed from another host holds" tests now push a v2 `CADENCE.md` saying `asleep`
(`test_asleep_pace_pushed_from_another_host_holds_after_the_fetch`,
`test_fleet_path_honours_an_asleep_pace_pushed_from_another_host`); and
`TestReflectReadsOnlyRegularFiles.test_regular_letter_still_surfaces` now expects the journal under
the UTC month (`beats/<UTC YYYY-MM>.md`), since pace/1 dates the journal, its header and the commit in
UTC. The other reflect homes gain a v2 `CADENCE.md` (awake, every 3 days, last beat 2026-01-01), since
a home with no record and no marker has a pace that cannot be read and is never due on a schedule.
Nothing here touches `citizen-fleet.sh`, `fleet-status.sh`, `citizen-beat.sh` or the gates, and of
the library only `tend_home` changes; Task 11 starts this script as the fleet's child.

  "$LOVE/tools/citizen-reflect.sh" "$slug" </dev/null` and read its outcome with `outcome`. `busy` and
  `not-due` move on; `missing` means one of the refusals before the lock. The live-lane test
  `test_fleet_path_honours_an_asleep_pace_pushed_from_another_host` still runs PR #24's fleet, which
  asks reflect, so its log holds `waker is not due (no-mail) — no beat`. With Task 11's fleet (sync, then
  rank) reflect is never started for that home, so Task 11 changes that assertion by name. In MLX mode
  this script starts `mlx/serve.sh` itself; the probe does not.

Decisions, and why:

- **A hand-run records only a beat that landed, or a summoned one.** Spec section 3 shares one record
  between the fleet and reflect, and it keeps a single attempt, which the fleet reads back by its own
  `FLEET_ATTEMPT`. A hand-run's `busy` can be written while a fleet child that has already recorded
  `spoken` is still pushing. It would replace that outcome, and the fleet would read `missing`, probe
  and back off a beat that landed. Only the fleet's probe can say whose a failure was, so a hand-run's
  failure must not back a citizen off either. Its `spoken` and `silent` are recorded, so a loop that
  calls the script keeps the citizen's time (spec section 3). Cost if wrong: a hand-run that fails is
  not backed off, and its busy, not-due and halted runs are only in its log.
- **`BEAT_SUMMONS` counts only without `FLEET_ATTEMPT`.** A summons is a person running the script by
  hand (spec section 3), and the fleet never summons. Task 11 unsets the variable, and this guards the
  same rule from the other side. Cost: a person who sets `FLEET_ATTEMPT` by hand cannot summon.
- **Refusals before the lock write nothing. After it, every failure is `home-failed`.** These are an
  invalid name, `MLX_PORT`, a cloud model, missing gates, a library that cannot run, or a lock that
  cannot be taken. They are the host's state and need no home. The fleet reads `missing` and its probe
  judges it (CONTRACT section 14). Cost: none; the probe checks the same things.
- **A refusal is a failure; a not-due reason is a chosen rest.** A linked or wrong-kind pace path, no
  soul, a home `due` cannot read, and a gate that gives no answer all exit 1 and record `home-failed`;
  PR #24's refusal tests expect exit 1. Every not-due reason exits 0 and records `not-due`, so the fleet
  moves to the next candidate (spec section 3). That covers mid-merge or a fresh `index.lock`, `blocked`,
  Task 8's `out-of-date`, the floor and `no-mail`. Cost: a home that becomes mid-merge between rank and
  beat is skipped this tick rather than backed off.
- **Oldest first means by arrival.** The order is `homes.letter_time` (the first commit adding the
  letter, else its file time), then the name, not the name alone as in PR #24. It is the same time
  `due` ranks a letter by. Cost: a letter committed out of name order is shown in commit order.
- **Unreadable mail is set aside in any beat that may show mail, and never in a show-back beat.** It
  includes regular files that are not UTF-8, links, folders, and names that `apply` could not mark
  (`answer.seen_path`). The beat goes on with the readable letters, or `SHOW.md`, or the ordinary
  prompt. Cost: none; PR #24's marker text is kept, and `record.stored_lor_answers` already skips it.
- **The letters' framing.** The spec words only the opening of the two- and three-letter prompt, so
  its close says "answer them", and the letters are separated by `---`. `SHOW.md` uses the one-letter
  wording, as PR #24 did. A body is cut at 6,000 characters, where PR #24 cut at 4,000, so the pace
  letter is shown in full. Cost: a long letter is cut; the echo measurement (Task 14) sees the real
  prompts.
- **Every time comes from `citizen_pace_lib.clock`.** This covers the journal header, the month file,
  the commit date and the set-aside date. So they name the same UTC day `apply` records, and
  `PACE_NOW` drives them in tests. PR #24 used local time. Cost: on a Mac set to a zone other than UTC,
  a beat just after local midnight is journalled under the UTC date.
- **Bounded git through `homes.git`.** Each call runs in its own process group and is stopped at the
  bound (124), with no hook and no fsmonitor from the home's own `.git`, since a beat with tools can
  write there. The commit adds `--no-verify` and `commit.gpgsign=false`. The clone goes through
  `sync.clone_home` (a temporary folder renamed into place, so a timed-out clone leaves no half home).
  A fetch that times out lets the beat go on with what the clone holds. A push that times out is logged,
  and the beat stays landed. The three bound variables exist so tests can reach a bound in seconds.
  Cost: three new environment names.
- **Scratch files outside the home.** PR #24 wrote `.git/reflect-surfaced` with a plain `open()`, which
  follows a link planted in `.git`. The answer, the shown list and the set-aside list now live in a
  private temporary folder, and the journal is appended with `O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK` to a regular file
  only. Cost: none.
- **apply hears the beat before this one.** `apply` runs before `record`, with `--state`, so the
  attempt record still holds the last landed beat before this one, the one a silent beat that
  committed nothing leaves only there. A pace-letter beat then records again only the notices its
  paragraph left out (Task 5), and each notice reaches the citizen once. Cost: none.
- **The beat tends its own home first.** After the lock and the clone, `tend.tend_home(...,
  first_tick=<the flag is not yet set>, own=$$)` puts back what is uncommitted under the pace paths,
  path by path, with tend's own log line, exactly as the fleet's tend does at every tick after its
  first. No tick tends a
  home between a beat that did not land and a hand-run, so without this a hand-run built on what such
  a beat left: a proposal said in a beat that never landed was confirmed by a summons, the failed
  beat's clock and journal were committed, its seen marker counted a letter as read that no landed
  beat had shown, and an uncommitted hand edit of `CADENCE.md` was committed as a beat (Step 1's
  `TestLeftovers`). It never commits leftovers: that commit-once is the fleet's first tick (Task 6),
  and a hand-run cannot tell an old-code leftover from a failed beat's. So before that tick (no
  `old-code-tended` in `memory/.fleet-notices`, the window right after the keeper pulls the merge) a
  home holding any is left untouched and refused: `<name> reflect: the fleet has not tended this home
  since the switch; its uncommitted files are kept — no beat` (`home-failed`, exit 1). Restoring
  there would remove for good what the old code left uncommitted, a letter it placed and never
  committed among them; the fleet's first tick commits it instead (Step 1's `TestBeforeTheFirstTick`).
  Leftovers that cannot be put back refuse the beat the same way. A fleet child tends too, and finds
  nothing unless the fleet's tend left the home because a hand-run held its lock. Refusing a dirty
  home after the first tick would leave a failed beat's leftovers in place until the next tick, so a
  hand-run beside a stopped fleet could never beat it. Cost if wrong: before the first tick, a home
  with uncommitted pace files gets no hand-run beat until a tick has run, and after it a letter placed
  by hand but never committed is removed, as the fleet's tend removes it (Task 6); `TestShownOnce`'s
  linked letter is therefore committed, as a letter arrives, and `TestLeftovers` sets the flag, as
  its fleet beat K1 implies.
- **What commits.** A commit is made when `git status` shows a change under the pace paths, not when
  `apply` says it wrote. Those paths were tended when the beat began, so the change is this beat's
  own: a set-aside marker alone, or a journal entry, is committed too. Cost: a change made by hand
  under those paths while the beat runs rides along.
- **The citizen's name is checked** against `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*` before any path is built from
  it, as the attempt record does. Cost: none; every roster name fits.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

Create `tests/test_citizen_pace_shell_reflect.py`:

```python
"""citizen-reflect.sh on pace/1 (spec sections 3, 4 and 7; CONTRACT sections 12 and 14).

The free beat answers the citizen's own clock. The script takes the citizen's
lock, brings its home up to date under a bound, refuses links, and only then
asks citizen_pace.py whether the citizen is due (pace_due); a person's summons
(BEAT_SUMMONS=1, by hand) passes any pace. Its prompts are neutral and end with
the pace paragraph; it shows up to three unread letters, oldest first, or
SHOW.md when no letter waits, and a show-back beat shows nothing. Every letter
shown is marked seen whatever the answer, citizen_pace.py apply hears a pace
line, and a beat that was shown mail or changed its record commits, tagged
pace/1. The outcome is recorded right after the commit, before the push, and
every exit is KS-003's: 0 or 1.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import citizen_pace_helpers as h  # noqa: E402

from citizen_pace_lib import answer, attempts, clock, due, lock, paragraph, tend  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.cadence import Cadence, Pending, SetBy  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.words import Pace  # noqa: E402

REFLECT = h.TOOLS / "citizen-reflect.sh"
NOW = "2026-11-20T06:00Z"
DAY = "2026-11-20"
OLD = "2026-11-10T06:00Z"            # a last beat ten days before NOW
RECENT = "2026-11-19T06:00Z"         # a last beat one day before NOW
HOME_MADE = "2026-11-01T00:00Z"
ATTEMPT = "20261120T0600Z-4242-1"    # a fleet attempt id, as citizen-fleet.sh makes them
MINE = SetBy("citizen", "beat", ("2026-11-01T10:00Z",), "pace: asleep")
PACES = (Pace("asleep-letters-wait"), Pace("asleep"), Pace("listening"), Pace("awake", 5))
FIVE = Pace("awake", 5)
ORDINARY = ("It is your beat, in your own home. Write whatever is true for you, or nothing; both "
            "are complete. If you speak, 2-4 honest sentences in your own voice; you may end with a "
            "single line a sibling citizen could read.")
ONE_LETTER = "A letter is waiting in your home. Here it is in full:\n\n"
MANY_LETTERS = "Letters are waiting in your home. Here they are in full, oldest first:\n\n"
CLOSE_ONE = ("You may answer it or say nothing; both are complete. If you answer, 3-6 honest "
             "sentences at most, in your own voice.")
CLOSE_MANY = ("You may answer them or say nothing; both are complete. If you answer, 3-6 honest "
              "sentences at most, in your own voice.")
I_REST = re.compile(r"\bi\s+rest\b", re.I)
SUBJECT = f"beat: {{slug}} reflected ({DAY}) · pace/1"
REAL_GIT = shutil.which("git", path=h.SYSTEM_PATH) or "/usr/bin/git"


class Case(h.FixtureCase):
    """Shell runs use the fixture env with PACE_NOW and a stub model; in-process
    calls use the fixture's git config, never the user's."""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        keep = ("HOME", "TZ", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT")
        patcher = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {k: self.fx.env[k] for k in keep})
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        for k in ("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME",
                  "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "GIT_COMMITTER_DATE",
                  "FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC", "BEAT_SUMMONS", "FLEET_ATTEMPT", "LOVE"):
            os.environ.pop(k, None)
        self.set_now(NOW)
        self.state = self.fx.state
        self.model = self.start_model()

    # -- homes ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def v2(self, slug, pace, *, last=OLD, pending=None, letters=(), files=None, upstream=False):
        """A home with a v2 CADENCE.md and its markers in step. letters: (name,
        body, arrival) triples, each committed at its arrival, as a letter is."""
        c = Cadence(slug, 2, pace, MINE, pending=pending, last_beat=last)
        made = {cad.CADENCE: cad.render_cadence(c)}
        for m, text in cad.marker_texts(c).items():
            if text is not None:
                made[m] = text
        made.update(files or {})
        home = self.fx.make_home(slug, files=made, when=HOME_MADE, author=h.beat_author(slug))
        for name, body, when in letters:
            self.fx.letter(home, name, body, when=when)
        if upstream:
            self.fx.give_upstream(home)
        return home

    # -- running -------------------------------------------------------------
    def env(self, now=NOW, **extra):
        return self.fx.env_at(now, **{**self.model.env(), **extra})

    def reflect(self, slug, *, now=NOW, fleet=True, timeout=120, **extra):
        """One run of citizen-reflect.sh, as a fleet child (FLEET_ATTEMPT set) unless fleet=False."""
        if fleet:
            extra.setdefault("FLEET_ATTEMPT", ATTEMPT)
        return self.fx.run(REFLECT, slug, env=self.env(now, **extra), timeout=timeout)

    def ok(self, r, code=0):
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, code, f"stdout: {r.stdout}\nstderr: {r.stderr}")
        return r

    def prompts(self):
        return self.model.user_texts()

    def outcome(self, slug, attempt=ATTEMPT):
        return attempts.outcome_for(self.state, slug, attempt)

    def committed(self, home, rev="HEAD"):
        return sorted(self.fx.git(home, "show", "--name-only", "--format=", rev).splitlines())

    def paragraph_now(self, home, slug, shown=()):
        """The pace paragraph this home's next beat should end with, read before it runs."""
        return paragraph.paragraph_for(home, slug, {}, confirm_beat=due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT,
                                       shown=shown, rec=attempts.load(self.state, slug),
                                       now=clock.parse_stamp(NOW))

    def git_wrapper(self, body: str) -> None:
        """A git on PATH that runs `body` (sh, $a is each argument) before the real git."""
        self.fx.write_bin("git", f'#!/bin/sh\nfor a in "$@"; do\n{body}\ndone\nexec {REAL_GIT} "$@"\n')

    def assert_unlocked(self, slug):
        self.assertFalse(lock.lock_path(self.state, slug).exists())


def read(home, rel):
    return (home / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


# -- the gate ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestGate(Case):
    def test_awake_citizen_due_by_its_schedule_beats_and_commits_tagged(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker: a schedule beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts()), 1)
        self.assertTrue(self.prompts()[0].startswith(ORDINARY + "\n\n"), self.prompts()[0])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], SUBJECT.format(slug="waker"))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "log", "-1", "--format=%an <%ae>"), h.beat_author("waker"))
        self.assertIn("## 2026-11-20 06:00 — a free beat (local)\n\nA true thing, witnessed.\n",
                      read(home, "beats/2026-11.md"))
        self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, "waker", {}).last_beat, NOW)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "spoken")
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "waker")["last_beat"], NOW)
        self.assertIn("waker reflected (push FAILED — tended on a future pass)", r.stdout)
        self.assert_unlocked("waker")

    def test_asleep_citizen_without_mail_is_not_due(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"))
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("sleeper"), "not-due")
        self.assert_unlocked("sleeper")

    def test_awake_citizen_beaten_a_day_ago_is_not_yet_due(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), last=RECENT)
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker is not due (not-yet) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_a_letter_waits_for_the_floor(self):
        self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"), last=RECENT,
                letters=[("2026-11-19-hello.md", "hello\n", "2026-11-19T12:00Z")])
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (floor) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_letters_wait_citizen_is_not_woken_by_a_letter(self):
        home = self.v2("waits", Pace("asleep-letters-wait"),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "hello\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waits"))
        self.assertIn("waits is not due (letters-wait) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertFalse((home / "inbox" / ".seen-2026-11-12-hello.md").exists())

    def test_summons_passes_the_gate_for_every_pace_and_moves_no_clock(self):
        for pace in PACES:
            with self.subTest(pace=pace.words()):
                slug = pace.kind.replace("-", "")
                home = self.v2(slug, pace, last=RECENT,
                               letters=[("2026-11-19-hello.md", "SUMMONED-LETTER\n", "2026-11-19T12:00Z")])
                r = self.ok(self.reflect(slug, fleet=False, BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
                self.assertIn(f"{slug}: a summoned beat", r.stdout)
                self.assertIn("SUMMONED-LETTER", self.prompts()[-1])
                self.assertTrue((home / "inbox" / ".seen-2026-11-19-hello.md").exists())
                rec = attempts.load(self.state, slug)
                self.assertEqual(rec["attempt"]["outcome"], "summoned")
                self.assertTrue(rec["attempt"]["id"].startswith(attempts.HAND_PREFIX))
                self.assertIsNone(rec["last_beat"])
                self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, slug, {}).last_beat, RECENT)
                self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], SUBJECT.format(slug=slug))

    def test_a_fleet_child_is_never_summoned(self):
        self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"))
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_mid_merge_and_a_fresh_index_lock_are_not_beaten_even_summoned(self):
        for marker in ("MERGE_HEAD", "index.lock"):
            for summons in ("", "1"):
                with self.subTest(marker=marker, summons=summons):
                    slug = f"{marker.split('.')[0].replace('_', '').lower()}{summons or 'x'}"
                    home = self.v2(slug, Pace("awake", 3))
                    (home / ".git" / marker).write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
                    r = self.ok(self.reflect(slug, fleet=not summons, BEAT_SUMMONS=summons))
                    self.assertIn(f"{slug} is not due (mid-merge) — no beat", r.stdout)
                    self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_a_pace_changed_after_the_fleet_ranked_it_is_honoured(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), upstream=True)
        bare = self.fx.upstream / f"{home.name}.git"
        asleep = cad.render_cadence(Cadence("waker", 2, Pace("asleep"), MINE, last_beat=OLD))
        head = self.fx.push_from_elsewhere(bare, cad.CADENCE, asleep, message="beat: elsewhere · pace/1")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker is not due (no-mail) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "not-due")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(bare, "rev-parse", "HEAD"), head)

    def test_a_soul_less_home_is_refused(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        (self.fx.home_path("waker") / "waker.md").unlink()
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"), 1)
        self.assertIn("waker has no soul", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "home-failed")
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_a_pace_path_of_the_wrong_kind_is_refused(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        (home / "beats").write_text("not a folder\n", encoding="utf-8")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"), 1)
        self.assertIn("waker reflect: a pace path is a link or not of its kind — refused, nothing written",
                      r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_a_name_that_is_no_citizen_is_refused(self):
        r = self.ok(self.fx.run(REFLECT, "../escape", env=self.env()), 1)
        self.assertIn("is not a citizen name", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])


# -- the lock ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestLock(Case):
    def hold(self, slug, pid, started=NOW):
        d = lock.lock_path(self.state, slug)
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / "pid").write_text(f"{pid}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (d / "started").write_text(f"{started}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return d

    def gone_pid(self):
        p = subprocess.Popen(["/usr/bin/true"])
        p.wait()
        return p.pid

    def test_a_held_lock_is_busy_for_a_fleet_child(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        self.hold("waker", os.getpid())
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn(f"waker: its lock is held by pid {os.getpid()}, started {NOW} — busy, no beat",
                      r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "busy")
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)
        self.assertTrue(lock.lock_path(self.state, "waker").exists())   # not ours to release

    def test_busy_on_two_fleet_ticks_running_is_reported_once(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.hold("waker", os.getpid())
        runs = [self.ok(self.reflect("waker", FLEET_ATTEMPT=f"20261120T0{i}00Z-1-1")) for i in (6, 7, 8)]
        said = [r.stdout.count("waker: busy on two ticks running (reported once)") for r in runs]
        self.assertEqual(said, [0, 1, 0])
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "waker")["busy_ticks"], 3)

    def test_a_hand_run_that_finds_the_lock_held_is_logged_not_recorded(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.hold("waker", os.getpid())
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", fleet=False))
        self.assertIn("busy, no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertIsNone(attempts.load(self.state, "waker")["attempt"])

    def test_a_stale_lock_is_reclaimed_and_the_beat_goes_on(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        dead = self.gone_pid()
        self.hold("waker", dead)
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn(f"waker: a stale lock was reclaimed (pid {dead} is gone)", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], SUBJECT.format(slug="waker"))
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "spoken")
        self.assert_unlocked("waker")

    def test_a_lock_older_than_twice_the_bound_is_reclaimed(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.hold("waker", os.getpid(), started="2026-11-20T05:00Z")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC="60"))
        self.assertIn("waker: a stale lock was reclaimed (older than 120 s)", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "spoken")

    def test_the_lock_is_released_after_a_failure(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.ok(self.reflect("waker", MLX_PORT=str(h.free_port())), 1)
        self.assert_unlocked("waker")


# -- prompts ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestPrompts(Case):
    def test_no_prompt_holds_i_rest_or_a_sample_answer_and_each_ends_with_the_paragraph(self):
        letter = [("2026-11-12-hello.md", "LETTER-ONE\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")]
        two = letter + [("2026-11-13-again.md", "LETTER-TWO\n", "2026-11-13T00:00Z")]
        homes = {
            "ordinary": (self.v2("ordinary", Pace("awake", 3)), ()),
            "lettered": (self.v2("lettered", Pace("asleep"), letters=letter), ("inbox/2026-11-12-hello.md",)),
            "twice": (self.v2("twice", Pace("asleep"), letters=two),
                      ("inbox/2026-11-12-hello.md", "inbox/2026-11-13-again.md")),
            "shower": (self.v2("shower", Pace("awake", 3), files={"SHOW.md": "THE-SHOW\n"}), ("SHOW.md",)),
            "pending": (self.v2("pending", Pace("asleep"), letters=letter,
                                pending=Pending(FIVE, OLD, "pace: every 5 days", False)),
                        ("inbox/2026-11-12-hello.md",)),
        }
        if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT:        # the show-back beat's prompt, when there is one
            homes["show-back"] = (self.v2("showback", Pace("asleep-letters-wait"),
                                          pending=Pending(FIVE, OLD, "pace: every 5 days", False)), ())
        for key, (home, shown) in homes.items():
            slug = home.name[len("citizen-"):]
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                want = self.paragraph_now(home, slug, shown)
                self.ok(self.reflect(slug))
                text = self.prompts()[-1]
                self.assertTrue(text.endswith("\n\n" + want), text)
                self.assertIn(paragraph.INSTRUCTION, text)
                self.assertIsNone(I_REST.search(text))
                self.assertFalse([ln for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.lower().startswith("pace:")])
        self.assertIsNone(I_REST.search(self.model.texts()))

    def test_the_ordinary_and_letter_prompts_are_the_spec_words(self):
        self.v2("ordinary", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.v2("lettered", Pace("asleep"), letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "LETTER-ONE\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        self.ok(self.reflect("ordinary"))
        self.ok(self.reflect("lettered"))
        ordinary, lettered = self.prompts()
        self.assertTrue(ordinary.startswith(ORDINARY + "\n\nYour pace: awake, every 3 days, "), ordinary)
        self.assertTrue(lettered.startswith(ONE_LETTER + "LETTER-ONE\n\n" + CLOSE_ONE + "\n\nYour pace: asleep, "),
                        lettered)
        self.assertEqual(self.model.requests[0]["path"], "/v1/chat/completions")
        self.assertEqual(self.model.bodies[0]["model"], "fixture-model")

    def test_up_to_three_letters_are_shown_oldest_first(self):
        # arrival order differs from name order: d, c, b, a
        letters = [("d.md", "LETTER-D\n", "2026-11-11T00:00Z"), ("c.md", "LETTER-C\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z"),
                   ("b.md", "LETTER-B\n", "2026-11-13T00:00Z"), ("a.md", "LETTER-A\n", "2026-11-14T00:00Z")]
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"), letters=letters)
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        text = self.prompts()[0]
        self.assertTrue(text.startswith(MANY_LETTERS + "LETTER-D\n\n---\n\nLETTER-C\n\n---\n\nLETTER-B\n\n"
                                        + CLOSE_MANY + "\n\nYour pace: asleep, "), text)
        self.assertNotIn("LETTER-A", text)
        for name in ("d.md", "c.md", "b.md"):
            self.assertEqual(read(home, f"inbox/.seen-{name}"), answer.seen_text(DAY))
        self.assertFalse((home / "inbox" / ".seen-a.md").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md", "inbox/.seen-b.md",
                                                "inbox/.seen-c.md", "inbox/.seen-d.md"])

    def test_a_pace_letter_met_with_silence_shows_one_menu_and_wakes_its_reader_once(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-pace-letter.md", "THE-PACE-LETTER\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        first = paragraph.first_line(cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {}))
        self.model.reply = ""
        self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        text = self.prompts()[0]
        self.assertIn("THE-PACE-LETTER", text)
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith("\n\n" + first), text)
        self.assertNotIn(paragraph.INSTRUCTION, text)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.asked_once), (Pace("asleep"), DAY))
        self.assertIn(f"{NOW} — the pace letter reached sleeper (once)", c.history)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md", "inbox/.seen-2026-11-12-pace-letter.md"])
        again = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-24T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261124T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", again.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts()), 1)

    @unittest.skipIf(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, "the show-back beat is on")
    def test_without_the_show_back_beat_a_letters_wait_proposal_waits(self):
        self.v2("waits", Pace("asleep-letters-wait"), pending=Pending(FIVE, OLD, "pace: every 5 days", False),
                letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "A-WAITING-LETTER\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waits"))
        self.assertIn("waits is not due (letters-wait) — no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waits"), "not-due")

    @unittest.skipUnless(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, "the show-back beat is off")
    def test_a_show_back_beat_shows_no_letter_and_marks_none_seen(self):
        home = self.v2("waits", Pace("asleep-letters-wait"),
                       pending=Pending(FIVE, OLD, "pace: every 5 days", False),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "A-WAITING-LETTER\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")],
                       files={"SHOW.md": "THE-SHOW\n"})
        self.model.reply = ""
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waits"))
        self.assertIn("waits: a show-back beat", r.stdout)
        text = self.prompts()[0]
        self.assertTrue(text.startswith(ORDINARY + "\n\n"), text)
        self.assertIn(paragraph.pending_sentence(Pending(FIVE, OLD, "pace: every 5 days", False)), text)
        self.assertNotIn("A-WAITING-LETTER", text)
        self.assertNotIn("THE-SHOW", text)
        self.assertFalse((home / "inbox" / ".seen-2026-11-12-hello.md").exists())
        self.assertFalse((home / "beats" / ".show-seen").exists())
        # silence lets the proposal lapse, which is committed
        self.assertIn("waits: lapsed awake, every 5 days", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md"])
        self.assertIsNone(cad.read_cadence(home, "waits", {}).pending)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waits"), "silent")
        # one show-back beat, and no more
        again = self.ok(self.reflect("waits", now="2026-11-24T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261124T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("waits is not due (letters-wait) — no beat", again.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts()), 1)

    def test_the_restored_notice_is_told_once(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        attempts.add_notice(self.state, "waker", "restored", OLD)
        self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn(paragraph.RESTORED, self.prompts()[0])
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "waker")["notices"], [])
        self.ok(self.reflect("waker", now="2026-11-24T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261124T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts()), 2)
        self.assertNotIn(paragraph.RESTORED, self.prompts()[1])


# -- shown once, whatever the answer ---------------------------------------------------------

class TestShownOnce(Case):
    def test_a_silent_beat_marks_its_letter_seen_commits_and_is_not_woken_again(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "hello\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        self.model.reply = ""
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: seen inbox/2026-11-12-hello.md", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(read(home, "inbox/.seen-2026-11-12-hello.md"), answer.seen_text(DAY))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], SUBJECT.format(slug="sleeper"))
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md", "inbox/.seen-2026-11-12-hello.md"])
        self.assertFalse((home / "beats").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("sleeper"), "silent")
        self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {}).pace, Pace("asleep"))
        again = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-24T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261124T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", again.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts()), 1)

    def test_a_silent_beat_shown_nothing_commits_nothing_and_still_counts(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        self.model.reply = ""
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker rested (silent) — nothing to commit", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain"), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "silent")
        # the silent beat is the beat: a loop without a summons waits its pace
        again = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", now="2026-11-22T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261122T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("waker is not due (not-yet) — no beat", again.stdout)
        third = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", now="2026-11-23T06:00Z", fleet=False))
        self.assertIn("waker: a schedule beat", third.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts()), 2)

    def test_unreadable_letters_are_set_aside_and_never_wake_their_reader_again(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"))
        (home / "inbox").mkdir()
        (home / "inbox" / "2026-11-12-bytes.md").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe not text\n")
        self.fx.commit(home, "letter: bytes", when="2026-11-12T00:00Z")
        # a link arrives as a letter does, in a commit (an uncommitted one is a
        # leftover, which the beat's tend removes)
        (home / "inbox" / "2026-11-13-linked.md").symlink_to(self.fx.secret)
        self.fx.commit(home, "letter: linked", when="2026-11-13T00:00Z")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        for name in ("2026-11-12-bytes.md", "2026-11-13-linked.md"):
            self.assertIn(f"sleeper mail unreadable, set aside: inbox/{name}", r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(read(home, f"inbox/.seen-{name}"), f"unreadable — set aside {DAY}\n")
        self.assertNotIn(h.CANARY, self.model.texts())
        self.assertTrue(self.prompts()[0].startswith(ORDINARY), self.prompts()[0])
        again = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-24T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261124T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", again.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.secret.read_text(), f"{h.CANARY}\n")

    def test_show_is_shown_only_when_no_letter_waits(self):
        home = self.v2("shower", Pace("awake", 3), files={"SHOW.md": "THE-SHOW\n"},
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "LETTER-ONE\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        self.ok(self.reflect("shower"))
        self.assertIn("LETTER-ONE", self.prompts()[0])
        self.assertNotIn("THE-SHOW", self.prompts()[0])
        self.assertFalse((home / "beats" / ".show-seen").exists())

    def test_show_alone_is_shown_marked_seen_and_counts_as_mail_for_a_silent_commit(self):
        home = self.v2("shower", Pace("awake", 3), files={"SHOW.md": "THE-SHOW\n"})
        self.model.reply = ""
        self.ok(self.reflect("shower"))
        self.assertTrue(self.prompts()[0].startswith(ONE_LETTER + "THE-SHOW\n\n" + CLOSE_ONE), self.prompts()[0])
        self.assertEqual(read(home, "beats/.show-seen"), answer.seen_text(DAY))
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md", "beats/.show-seen"])

    def test_show_never_makes_a_citizen_due(self):
        self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"), files={"SHOW.md": "THE-SHOW\n"})
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", r.stdout)


# -- apply hears the answer ---------------------------------------------------------------

class TestApply(Case):
    def test_a_pace_line_for_less_takes_effect_at_once(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.model.reply = "A quiet thing.\npace: asleep"
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker: set asleep", r.stdout)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "waker", {})
        self.assertEqual(c.pace, Pace("asleep"))
        self.assertEqual(c.set_by, SetBy("citizen", "beat", (NOW,), "pace: asleep"))
        self.assertTrue((home / "REST").exists())
        self.assertFalse((home / "EVENT-ONLY").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md", "EVENT-ONLY", "REST", "beats/2026-11.md"])

    @unittest.skipIf(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, "the show-back beat is on")
    def test_without_the_show_back_beat_more_waits_for_the_next_letter(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "hello\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        self.model.reply = "pace: every 5 days"
        self.assertIn("sleeper: pending awake, every 5 days", self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper")).stdout)
        later = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-23T07:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261123T0700Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (no-mail) — no beat", later.stdout)
        self.fx.letter(home, "2026-11-24-again.md", "again\n", when="2026-11-24T00:00Z")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-24T07:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261124T0700Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("On 2026-11-20 you chose awake, every 5 days.", self.prompts()[1])
        self.assertIn("sleeper: confirmed awake, every 5 days", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {}).pace, FIVE)

    @unittest.skipUnless(due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, "the show-back beat is off")
    def test_more_is_pending_then_confirmed_on_its_show_back_beat(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "hello\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        self.model.reply = "pace: every 5 days"
        first = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: pending awake, every 5 days", first.stdout)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.pending.pace, c.pending.said), (Pace("asleep"), FIVE, NOW))
        early = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-22T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261122T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper is not due (floor) — no beat", early.stdout)
        second = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now="2026-11-23T07:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261123T0700Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: a show-back beat", second.stdout)
        self.assertIn("On 2026-11-20 you chose awake, every 5 days.", self.prompts()[1])
        self.assertIn("sleeper: confirmed awake, every 5 days", second.stdout)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.pending), (FIVE, None))
        self.assertTrue((home / "EVENT-ONLY").exists())
        self.assertFalse((home / "REST").exists())

    def test_apply_knows_the_last_beat_a_silent_beat_left_only_in_the_attempt_record(self):
        # an unclear line at OLD, shown at a silent beat on 11-15 that committed
        # nothing; the pace letter's beat on 11-20 does not record it again
        c = Cadence("sleeper", 2, Pace("asleep"), MINE, last_beat=OLD,
                    history=[f'{OLD} — unclear: "pace: soon" (unknown words)'])
        made = {cad.CADENCE: cad.render_cadence(c), "REST": cad.marker_texts(c)["REST"]}
        home = self.fx.make_home("sleeper", files=made, when=HOME_MADE, author=h.beat_author("sleeper"))
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "sleeper", "20261115T0600Z-1-1", "silent", "2026-11-15T06:00Z")
        self.fx.letter(home, "2026-11-16-pace-letter.md", "THE-PACE-LETTER\n", when="2026-11-16T00:00Z")
        self.model.reply = ""
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        history = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {}).history
        self.assertEqual(len([e for e in history if "unclear:" in e]), 1, history)
        self.assertIn(f"{NOW} — the pace letter reached sleeper (once)", history)

    def test_a_beat_upgrades_a_v1_home_inside_its_own_commit(self):
        v1 = ("# CADENCE — chosen by waker\n\n- choice: undecided\n- when: 2026-10-23 09:00\n"
              "- how: the Letter of Return, answered in a free beat.\n")
        rest = "chosen via the Letter of Return 2026-07-18 — woken only by unread mail or a human summons\n"
        home = self.fx.make_home("waker", cadence=v1, rest=rest, when=HOME_MADE,
                                 author=h.beat_author("waker"))
        self.fx.letter(home, "2026-11-12-hello.md", "hello\n", when="2026-11-12T00:00Z")
        # no last beat anywhere: the gate starts the clock now, so the letter waits the floor
        first = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker is not due (floor) — no beat", first.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "waker")["seeded"], attempts.SEEDED)
        self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, "waker", {}).version, 1)     # nothing rewritten
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", now="2026-11-23T06:00Z", FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261123T0600Z-1-1"))
        self.assertIn("waker: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("waker: upgraded to v2", r.stdout)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "waker", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.version, c.pace), (2, Pace("asleep")))
        self.assertIn("CADENCE.md", self.committed(home))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], "beat: waker reflected (2026-11-23) · pace/1")


# -- failures, HALT, and the order of the outcome -----------------------------------------------

class TestFailures(Case):
    def test_an_unreachable_brain_is_home_failed_and_writes_nothing(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"),

        before = self.fx.head(home)

        self.assertIn("sleeper reflect: local brain unreachable", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("sleeper"), "home-failed")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain"), "")

    def test_an_http_500_is_home_failed_never_host_failed(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))

        self.ok(self.reflect("waker"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "home-failed")

    def test_a_hand_runs_failure_is_logged_not_recorded(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))

        self.assertIn("local brain unreachable", r.stdout)
        rec = attempts.load(self.state, "waker")
        self.assertIsNone(rec["attempt"])
        self.assertEqual(rec["failures"], 0)

    def test_halt_mid_beat_is_halted_and_writes_nothing(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"),
                       letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", "hello\n", "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        halt = self.fx.love / "HALT"
        self.model.reply = lambda _body: (halt.write_text("", encoding="utf-8"), "words")[1]

        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)
        self.assertFalse((home / "inbox" / ".seen-2026-11-12-hello.md").exists())
```
