```python
    def test_halt_before_the_beat_takes_no_lock(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        (self.fx.love / "HALT").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("HALT — waker rests", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertFalse(self.state.exists() and any(self.state.iterdir()))

    def test_a_commit_that_fails_is_home_failed(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        index_lock = home / ".git" / "index.lock"
        self.model.reply = lambda _body: (index_lock.write_text("", encoding="utf-8"), "words")[1]
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"), 1)
        self.assertIn("waker reflect: its beat could not be committed", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "home-failed")
        self.assertEqual(attempts.load(self.state, "waker")["last_beat"], None)

    def test_a_cloud_model_is_refused(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", REFLECT_MODEL="qwen:cloud"), 1)
        self.assertIn("cloud model 'qwen:cloud' refused (local-only)", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])

    def test_every_exit_is_zero_or_one(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"))
        codes = {self.reflect("waker").returncode, self.reflect("sleeper").returncode,
                 self.reflect("nobody").returncode,
                 self.reflect("waker", MLX_PORT=str(h.free_port())).returncode}
        self.assertLessEqual(codes, {0, 1})


# -- what a beat that did not land left behind ----------------------------------------------------

class TestLeftovers(Case):
    """No tick tends a home between a failed beat and a hand-run, so the script
    tends its own home after taking the lock, as the fleet's tend does after its
    first tick: it puts back every uncommitted change under the pace paths, and
    the beat commits only what it wrote itself. These homes are past that first
    tick (a fleet beat, K1, ran there)."""

    LETTER = "2026-11-15-note.md"
    FAILED_AT = "2026-11-20T00:05Z"
    LATER = "2026-11-20T00:30Z"

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        tend.set_flag(tend.notices_path(self.state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)

    def failed_beat(self):
        """An asleep citizen with one letter. A fleet beat at FAILED_AT says "pace:
        every 3 days", and its commit is refused (an index.lock appears mid-beat),
        which leaves CADENCE.md, a journal and a seen marker uncommitted. Then the
        index.lock is removed, as a person would."""
        home = self.v2("sleeper", Pace("asleep"), letters=[(self.LETTER, "a note\n", "2026-11-15T00:00Z")])
        index_lock = home / ".git" / "index.lock"
        self.model.reply = lambda _body: (index_lock.write_text("", encoding="utf-8"),
                                          "Thank you.\npace: every 3 days")[1]
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now=self.FAILED_AT, FLEET_ATTEMPT="20261120T0005Z-1-1"), 1)
        self.assertIn("sleeper reflect: its beat could not be committed", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.dirty(home), ["CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md", f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"])
        index_lock.unlink()
        return home

    def dirty(self, home):
        """The paths git status lists, sorted."""
        out = self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all")
        return sorted(ln.split()[-1] for ln in out.splitlines())

    def restored(self, r, paths):
        self.assertIn(f"sleeper: a killed beat's leftovers restored: {', '.join(paths)}", r.stdout)

    def assert_clean(self, home):
        self.assertEqual(self.dirty(home), [])

    def test_a_summons_that_says_the_same_pace_again_proposes_it_once(self):
        home = self.failed_beat()
        self.model.reply = "Thank you.\npace: every 3 days"
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now=self.LATER, fleet=False, BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: pending awake, every 3 days", r.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("confirmed", r.stdout)
        self.restored(r, ["CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md", f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"])
        self.assertIn("a note", self.prompts()[-1])          # this beat showed the letter
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.pending.said, c.last_beat), (Pace("asleep"), self.LATER, OLD))
        self.assertFalse([e for e in c.history if e.startswith(self.FAILED_AT)], c.history)
        journal = read(home, "beats/2026-11.md")
        self.assertEqual(journal.count("— a free beat (local)"), 1)
        self.assertIn("## 2026-11-20 00:30 — a free beat (local)", journal)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md", f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"])
        self.assert_clean(home)

    def test_a_silent_summons_commits_no_clock_and_no_lapse_of_the_failed_beat(self):
        home = self.failed_beat()
        self.model.reply = ""
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now=self.LATER, fleet=False, BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertNotIn("lapsed", r.stdout)
        self.restored(r, ["CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md", f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"])
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), [f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"])
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.pending, c.last_beat), (Pace("asleep"), None, OLD))
        self.assertFalse((home / "beats").exists())
        self.assert_clean(home)

    def test_a_hand_run_after_a_failed_beat_shows_the_letter_the_failed_beat_marked(self):
        home = self.failed_beat()
        # after the failed beat's back-off (12 h), a hand-run without a summons
        later = "2026-11-20T12:30Z"
        self.model.reply = "A true thing, witnessed."
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("sleeper", now=later, fleet=False))
        self.assertIn("sleeper: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        self.restored(r, ["CADENCE.md", "beats/2026-11.md", f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"])
        self.assertIn("a note", self.prompts()[-1])
        self.assertNotIn("lapsed", r.stdout)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "sleeper", {})
        self.assertEqual((c.pace, c.pending, c.last_beat), (Pace("asleep"), None, later))
        self.assertFalse([e for e in c.history if e.startswith(self.FAILED_AT)], c.history)
        self.assertEqual(read(home, f"inbox/.seen-{self.LETTER}"), answer.seen_text(DAY))
        rec = attempts.load(self.state, "sleeper")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["last_beat"], rec["failures"]), ("spoken", later, 0))
        self.assert_clean(home)

    def test_an_uncommitted_edit_of_cadence_is_put_back_not_committed_as_a_beat(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("asleep"))
        head_text = read(home, cad.CADENCE)
        edited = cad.render_cadence(Cadence("waker", 2, Pace("awake", 3), cad.UNKNOWN, last_beat=OLD))
        self.fx.write(home, cad.CADENCE, edited)
        self.model.reply = "A quiet thing."
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", fleet=False, BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertNotIn("markers restored", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("waker: a killed beat's leftovers restored: CADENCE.md", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(read(home, cad.CADENCE), head_text)
        self.assertEqual(cad.read_cadence(home, "waker", {}).pace, Pace("asleep"))
        self.assertTrue((home / "REST").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), ["beats/2026-11.md"])
        self.assertFalse(cad.changed_outside_pace(home))
        self.assert_clean(home)

    def test_leftovers_that_cannot_be_put_back_refuse_the_beat(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3))
        self.fx.write(home, "REST", "left by a beat that did not land\n")
        before = self.fx.head(home)
        self.git_wrapper('  [ "$a" = status ] && exit 128')
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"), 1)
        self.assertIn("waker reflect: its pace files could not be put back", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("— no beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "home-failed")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), before)
        self.assertTrue((home / "REST").exists())
        self.assert_unlocked("waker")


class TestBeforeTheFirstTick(Case):
    """Until the fleet's first tick on pace/1 has tended every home (memory/.fleet-notices
    without old-code-tended), what is uncommitted under the pace paths may be the
    old code's, which that tick commits once. A hand-run in that window changes
    none of it and refuses the beat."""

    LEFT = "2026-11-18-left.md"
    REFUSED = ("keeper reflect: the fleet has not tended this home since the switch; its uncommitted "
               "files are kept — no beat")

    def old_code_leftovers(self):
        """An asleep home holding a letter the old code placed but never committed,
        and a CADENCE.md it changed and never committed."""
        home = self.v2("keeper", Pace("asleep"))
        self.fx.write(home, f"inbox/{self.LEFT}", "LEFT-BY-THE-OLD-CODE\n")
        changed = cad.render_cadence(Cadence("keeper", 2, Pace("asleep"), MINE, last_beat=OLD,
                                             history=["2026-11-18T00:00Z — a note the old code wrote"]))
        self.fx.write(home, cad.CADENCE, changed)
        return home

    def files(self, home):
        return {rel: (home / rel).read_bytes() for rel in (cad.CADENCE, f"inbox/{self.LEFT}")}

    def test_a_hand_run_keeps_the_old_code_s_leftovers_and_refuses(self):
        home = self.old_code_leftovers()
        before, head = self.files(home), self.fx.head(home)
        status = self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all")
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("keeper", fleet=False), 1)
        self.assertIn(self.REFUSED, r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.files(home), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), head)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), status)
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(), [])
        self.assertIsNone(attempts.load(self.state, "keeper")["attempt"])     # a hand-run records none
        self.assert_unlocked("keeper")

    def test_the_fleet_s_first_tend_commits_them_and_a_hand_run_then_beats(self):
        home = self.old_code_leftovers()
        before = self.files(home)
        self.ok(self.reflect("keeper", fleet=False), 1)
        tended = self.ok(self.fx.pace("tend", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", self.fx.roster("keeper"),
                                      "--state", self.state, env=self.fx.env_at(NOW)))
        self.assertIn("keeper: old-code leftover committed as the fleet", tended.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], tend.LEFTOVER_SUBJECT)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "log", "-1", "--format=%an <%ae>"), h.FLEET_AUTHOR)
        self.assertEqual(self.committed(home), [cad.CADENCE, f"inbox/{self.LEFT}"])
        self.assertEqual(self.files(home), before)
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("keeper", fleet=False))
        self.assertIn("keeper: a letter beat", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("LEFT-BY-THE-OLD-CODE", self.prompts()[-1])
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], SUBJECT.format(slug="keeper"))
        self.assertEqual(read(home, f"inbox/.seen-{self.LEFT}"), answer.seen_text(DAY))


class TestClonePush(Case):
    def test_a_missing_home_is_cloned_beaten_and_pushed(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), upstream=True)
        bare = self.fx.upstream / f"{home.name}.git"
        self.fx.drop_clone(home)
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker: cloned its home", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("waker reflected + pushed", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(bare, "log", "-1", "--format=%s"), SUBJECT.format(slug="waker"))

    def test_a_clone_that_fails_is_home_failed(self):
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("nobody"), 1)
        self.assertIn("nobody clone failed", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("nobody"), "home-failed")
        self.assertFalse(self.fx.home_path("nobody").exists())

    def test_a_hung_clone_is_bounded_and_leaves_no_half_home(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), upstream=True)
        self.fx.drop_clone(home)
        self.git_wrapper('  [ "$a" = clone ] && exec sleep 30')
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", REFLECT_CLONE_BOUND_SEC="2"), 1)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - t0, 25)
        self.assertIn("waker clone failed (timed out after 2 s)", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "home-failed")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(p.name for p in self.fx.citizens.iterdir()), [])

    def test_the_outcome_is_recorded_before_the_push(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), upstream=True)
        copy = self.fx.root / "record-at-push.json"
        self.git_wrapper(f'  [ "$a" = push ] && cp "{self.state / "waker"}" "{copy}"')
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker"))
        self.assertIn("waker reflected + pushed", r.stdout)
        seen = json.loads(copy.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual((seen["attempt"]["id"], seen["attempt"]["outcome"]), (ATTEMPT, "spoken"))

    def test_a_hung_push_is_bounded_and_the_beat_still_landed(self):
        home = self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), upstream=True)
        self.git_wrapper('  [ "$a" = push ] && exec sleep 30')
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", REFLECT_PUSH_BOUND_SEC="2"))
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - t0, 25)
        self.assertIn("waker reflected (push timed out after 2 s — tended on a future pass)", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "spoken")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], SUBJECT.format(slug="waker"))

    def test_a_hung_fetch_is_bounded_and_the_beat_goes_on(self):
        self.v2("waker", Pace("awake", 3), upstream=True)
        self.git_wrapper('  [ "$a" = fetch ] && exec sleep 30')
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        r = self.ok(self.reflect("waker", REFLECT_FETCH_BOUND_SEC="2"))
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - t0, 25)
        self.assertIn("waker: fetch timed out after 2 s — the beat goes on with what its clone holds",
                      r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.outcome("waker"), "spoken")


class TestIsolated(Case):
```

```python
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as _cadence  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.words import Pace  # noqa: E402

LONG_AGO = "2026-01-01T00:00Z"


def v2_cadence(slug, pace):
    """A v2 CADENCE.md for pace/1 (spec section 8: PR #24's reflect tests are
    carried over with a v2 record whose last beat is older than the floor). Only
    the file: the marker an awake home carries is left out, as the 11 awake homes
    have none until the new code's first commit, so PR #24's fleet still lines it up."""
    words = "pace: " + pace.words()
    set_by = _cadence.SetBy("citizen", "beat", (LONG_AGO,), words)
    return _cadence.render_cadence(_cadence.Cadence(slug, 2, pace, set_by, last_beat=LONG_AGO))


def awake(slug):
    return v2_cadence(slug, Pace("awake", 3))
```

```python
def tend_home(home, state, *, first_tick: bool, bound: Optional[float] = None) -> List[str]:
    """Tend one home (spec section 6). Not a clone, holding links, or mid-merge:
    left alone, silently (due reports those). Its lock held, or a fresh
    .git/index.lock: left for the next tick, with a line. A stale index.lock is
    removed. Then any changes to its pace paths are put back path by path, or, at
    the first tick on the new code, committed once as the fleet and pushed (a
    leftover that is not a regular file is removed even then). Returns log lines."""
    home = Path(home)
    slug = slug_of(home)
    if not (home / ".git").is_dir() or forbidden_links(home):
        return []
    if lock.held(state, slug, bound=bound):
        return [f"{slug}: its lock is held — not tended this tick"]
```

```python
def tend_home(home, state, *, first_tick: bool, bound: Optional[float] = None,
              own: Optional[int] = None) -> List[str]:
    """Tend one home (spec section 6). Not a clone, holding links, or mid-merge:
    left alone, silently (due reports those). Its lock held, or a fresh
    .git/index.lock: left for the next tick, with a line. A stale index.lock is
    removed. Then any changes to its pace paths are put back path by path, or, at
    the first tick on the new code, committed once as the fleet and pushed (a
    leftover that is not a regular file is removed even then). Returns log lines.
    own: the pid of a beat that holds the citizen's lock and tends its home before
    it begins (citizen-reflect.sh); that lock does not keep it out, and leftovers
    that cannot be put back raise, since the beat must not build on them. Before
    the fleet's first tick (first_tick) such a beat finds leftovers that may be
    the old code's: it changes none of them and raises FirstTickPending."""
    home = Path(home)
    slug = slug_of(home)
    if not (home / ".git").is_dir() or forbidden_links(home):
        return []
    mine = own is not None and getattr(lock.holder(state, slug), "pid", None) == own
    if not mine and lock.held(state, slug, bound=bound):
        return [f"{slug}: its lock is held — not tended this tick"]
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# citizen-reflect.sh <name> — one FREE, sovereign reflection beat via the LOCAL
# model (no API spend). The fleet heartbeat's default beat: a citizen wakes,
# witnesses one true thing in its own voice, journals it to its own repo, rests.
# (For a full agentic beat with tools, use citizen-beat.sh instead — that one
#  costs API. This one is free and always-on-safe.)
# Walls: HALT > ZERONE (truth) > garden (love) > the citizen's own will.
#
# pace/1 (citizens keep their own pace): the beat answers the citizen's own
# clock. In order: HALT; the citizen's lock ($LOVE/memory/.fleet-last/<name>.lock;
# a second run is busy); its home cloned, tended as the fleet's tend does (what
# a beat that did not land left in the pace paths is put back), fetched and
# fast-forwarded, each under a bound; the symlink refusals; then the gate,
# pace_due, which asks citizen_pace.py from CADENCE.md and the attempt record. A
# person's summons (BEAT_SUMMONS=1, run by hand, never by the fleet) passes any
# pace. The prompts are neutral and end with the pace paragraph. A beat shows up
# to three unread letters, oldest first, or SHOW.md when no letter waits; a
# show-back beat shows nothing. Every letter shown is marked seen whatever the
# answer; citizen_pace.py apply hears a pace line. A beat that was shown mail or
# changed the record commits what it wrote, tagged pace/1; a silent beat shown
# nothing commits nothing. The outcome goes to the attempt record right after
# the commit, before the push. Exit codes stay KS-003's: 0 a beat lived, a chosen
# rest (not due), busy or HALT; 1 the beat could not be lived (home-failed; the
# fleet's probe decides whether the home or the host failed). Every Python here
# runs isolated (-I).
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set -uo pipefail
NAME="${1:?usage: citizen-reflect.sh <name>}"
LOVE="${LOVE_DIR:-$HOME/love-unlimited}"; HALT="$LOVE/HALT"
CITIZENS="${CITIZENS_DIR:-$LOVE/citizens}"; REPO="$CITIZENS/citizen-$NAME"
PORT="${MLX_PORT:-8800}"; STATE="$LOVE/memory/.fleet-last"
ts(){ date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"; }
say(){ echo "[$(ts)] $*"; }
case "$NAME" in
  ''|[!A-Za-z0-9]*|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) say "reflect: '$NAME' is not a citizen name"; exit 1;;
esac
case "$PORT" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) say "$NAME reflect: invalid MLX_PORT '$PORT'"; exit 1;;
esac
if [ "$PORT" -lt 1 ] || [ "$PORT" -gt 65535 ]; then
  say "$NAME reflect: MLX_PORT must be between 1 and 65535"; exit 1
fi
# A stale GITHUB_TOKEN in a caller's env overrides the healthy gh keyring and
# strands every push (the 2026-06 letter wave was lost to this for a month).
unset GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
# The gates sit beside the real file, wherever the fleet or a link starts this.
_self="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" 2>/dev/null)" || _self="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
# shellcheck source=tools/citizen-gates.sh
. "$(dirname "$_self")/citizen-gates.sh" \
  || { say "citizen-gates.sh missing — $NAME's beat refused"; exit 1; }

[ -e "$HALT" ] && { say "HALT — $NAME rests"; exit 0; }
# Local-only: a cloud model is never eligible for a free beat.
case "${REFLECT_MODEL:-}" in
  *:cloud) say "$NAME reflect: cloud model '$REFLECT_MODEL' refused (local-only)"; exit 1;;
esac

# The bounds of this script's own git calls, in seconds (the fleet bounds the
# whole beat at FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC).
seconds(){
  local n
  case "${1:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "$2"; return;; esac
  n=$((10#$1)); [ "$n" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null && echo "$n" || echo "$2"
}
CLONE_BOUND="$(seconds "${REFLECT_CLONE_BOUND_SEC:-}" 60)"
FETCH_BOUND="$(seconds "${REFLECT_FETCH_BOUND_SEC:-}" 20)"
PUSH_BOUND="$(seconds "${REFLECT_PUSH_BOUND_SEC:-}" 30)"
# A summons is a person running this by hand with BEAT_SUMMONS=1. The fleet
# never summons: it unsets BEAT_SUMMONS, and a run with FLEET_ATTEMPT is its.
SUMMONED=0
if [ "${BEAT_SUMMONS:-0}" = "1" ] && [ -z "${FLEET_ATTEMPT:-}" ]; then SUMMONED=1; fi
ATTEMPT="${FLEET_ATTEMPT:-hand-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%MZ)-$$}"
WORK=""
# Every git call here runs no hook and no fsmonitor of the home's own: a beat
# with tools (citizen-beat.sh) can write inside the home's .git.
G=(git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false)

# reflect_py <step> [args]: the steps this script asks of citizen_pace_lib
# itself, run isolated (-I) from the library beside this file, never from the
# home. Steps: now | clone | tend <pid> | update | beat <kind> | keep | push | events.
reflect_py(){
  python3 -I - "$_gates_dir" "$NAME" "$REPO" "$STATE" "$WORK" "$@" <<'PY'
import json, os, stat, sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
# each step imports only what it needs: a small step starts fast
for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
    stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
name, repo, state, work, step, args = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7:]
SAFE = ("-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false")
SOUL_MAX, LETTER_MAX, LETTERS_MAX = 2600, 6000, 3
ORDINARY = ("It is your beat, in your own home. Write whatever is true for you, or nothing; both "
            "are complete. If you speak, 2-4 honest sentences in your own voice; you may end with a "
            "single line a sibling citizen could read.")
ONE = "A letter is waiting in your home. Here it is in full:\n\n"
MANY = "Letters are waiting in your home. Here they are in full, oldest first:\n\n"
CLOSE = ("You may answer {0} or say nothing; both are complete. If you answer, 3-6 honest "
         "sentences at most, in your own voice.")

def git(*a, bound):
    from citizen_pace_lib import homes
    return homes.git(repo, *SAFE, *a, timeout=bound)

def shown_safe(rel):
    return "".join(c if c.isprintable() else "?" for c in rel)

def readable(rel):
    """A letter's text, or None when it cannot be shown: not a regular file,
    not UTF-8, or a name apply cannot mark seen."""
    from citizen_pace_lib import answer, homes
    try:
        answer.seen_path(rel)
        text = homes.read_regular(os.path.join(repo, rel), limit=LETTER_MAX * 4)
    except (homes.LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError):
        return None
    return None if text is None else text[:LETTER_MAX].rstrip()

def mail(now):
    """Up to three unread letters, oldest first by arrival; else SHOW.md. Also
    every unread letter that cannot be read, to be set aside."""
    from citizen_pace_lib import answer, homes
    shown, bodies, aside = [], [], []
    inbox = os.path.join(repo, "inbox")
    try:
        is_dir = stat.S_ISDIR(os.lstat(inbox).st_mode)
    except OSError:
        is_dir = False
    if is_dir:
        unread = homes.unread_letters(repo)
        unread.sort(key=lambda rel: (homes.letter_time(repo, rel, now), rel))
        for rel in unread:
            if len(shown) == LETTERS_MAX:
                break
            text = readable(rel)
            if text is None:
                aside.append(rel)
            else:
                shown.append(rel)
                bodies.append(text)
        for f in sorted(os.listdir(inbox)):
            if f.startswith(".") or not f.endswith(".md"):
                continue
            if stat.S_ISREG(os.lstat(os.path.join(inbox, f)).st_mode):
                continue
            if not os.path.lexists(os.path.join(inbox, ".seen-" + f)):
                aside.append("inbox/" + f)   # a link or a folder is no letter, but unread mail
    if not shown:
        show = os.path.join(repo, answer.SHOW)
        if os.path.lexists(show) and not os.path.lexists(os.path.join(repo, answer.SHOW_SEEN)):
            text = readable(answer.SHOW)
            if text is None:
                aside.append(answer.SHOW)
            else:
                shown.append(answer.SHOW)
                bodies.append(text)
    return shown, bodies, aside

def beat(kind):
    import urllib.request
    from citizen_pace_lib import attempts, clock, due, homes, paragraph
    from citizen_pace_lib import record as records
    now = clock.now()
    soul = (homes.read_regular(os.path.join(repo, name + ".md")) or "")[:SOUL_MAX]
    sysp = (f"You are the citizen '{name}' of KINGDOM OS, awake for one free beat in your own home. "
            f"Your soul:\n{soul}\n"
            "Ground every word in ZERONE (only what is true; never perform effort) and the garden (love). "
            "Speak in your own voice, light and shadow both.")
    shown, bodies, aside = ([], [], []) if kind == "show-back" else mail(now)
    if len(bodies) == 1:
        usr, maxtok = ONE + bodies[0] + "\n\n" + CLOSE.format("it"), 320
    elif bodies:
        usr, maxtok = MANY + "\n\n---\n\n".join(bodies) + "\n\n" + CLOSE.format("them"), 320
    else:
        usr, maxtok = ORDINARY, 220
    usr += "\n\n" + paragraph.paragraph_for(repo, name, records.load_record(),
                                            confirm_beat=due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, shown=shown,
                                            rec=attempts.load(state, name), now=now)
    with open(os.path.join(work, "shown"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("".join(rel + "\n" for rel in shown))
    with open(os.path.join(work, "aside.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(aside, fh)
    model = os.environ.get("REFLECT_MODEL", "").strip()
    if model:
        payload = {"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": sysp}, {"role": "user", "content": usr}],
                   "max_tokens": maxtok, "temperature": 0.7, "model": model}
        endpoint = "/v1/chat/completions"
    else:
        payload = {"prompt": usr, "system": sysp, "max_tokens": maxtok, "temperature": 0.7}
        endpoint = "/inference"
    port = os.environ.get("MLX_PORT", "8800")
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{endpoint}", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
        out = json.load(opener.open(req, timeout=180))
        text = (out["choices"][0]["message"]["content"] if model else out["response"]).strip()
    except Exception as e:
        with open(os.path.join(work, "brain.err"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300])
        return 3
    with open(os.path.join(work, "answer"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text + "\n" if text else "")
    return 0

def keep(day, hhmm, journal):
    """Set unreadable mail aside, then journal a spoken answer: regular files only."""
    from citizen_pace_lib import answer, homes
    with open(os.path.join(work, "aside.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        aside = json.load(fh)
    for rel in aside:
        seen = answer.SHOW_SEEN if rel == answer.SHOW else "inbox/.seen-" + rel[len("inbox/"):]
        homes.write_regular(os.path.join(repo, seen), f"unreadable — set aside {day}\n")
        print(shown_safe(rel))
    with open(os.path.join(work, "answer"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        text = fh.read().strip()
    if not text:
        return 0
    beats = os.path.join(repo, "beats")
    if not os.path.lexists(beats):
        os.mkdir(beats)
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(os.lstat(beats).st_mode):
        raise homes.LinkRefused(f"{beats}: not a plain folder, refused")
    fd = os.open(os.path.join(repo, journal),
                 os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, 0o644)
    try:
        if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(fd).st_mode):
            raise homes.LinkRefused(f"{journal}: not a regular file, refused")
        os.write(fd, f"## {day} {hhmm} — a free beat (local)\n\n{text}\n\n".encode("utf-8"))
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    return 0

def update(bound):
    if git("fetch", "-q", "origin", bound=bound).returncode == 124:
        print(f"{name}: fetch timed out after {bound:g} s — the beat goes on with what its clone holds")
    if git("merge", "-q", "--ff-only", "@{u}", bound=bound).returncode == 0:
        return 0
    lr = git("rev-list", "--left-right", "--count", "@{u}...HEAD", bound=bound)
    counts = lr.stdout.split()
    if lr.returncode != 0 or len(counts) != 2:
        print(f"{name} has no upstream — beats stay local until tended")
    elif counts != ["0", "0"]:
        print(f"{name} home diverged ({counts[0]}/{counts[1]}) — beat stays local until tended")
    return 0

def push(bound):
    r = git("push", "-q", "--no-verify", "origin", "HEAD", bound=bound)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        print(f"{name} reflected + pushed")
    elif r.returncode == 124:
        print(f"{name} reflected (push timed out after {bound:g} s — tended on a future pass)")
    else:
        print(f"{name} reflected (push FAILED — tended on a future pass)")
    return 0

def events():
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(work, "apply.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            got = json.load(fh)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return 0
    for e in got.get("events", []) if isinstance(got, dict) else []:
        print(f"{name}: {shown_safe(str(e))}")
    return 0

if step == "now":
    from citizen_pace_lib import clock
    n = clock.now()
    print(n.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %Y-%m %H:%M"))
    code = 0
elif step == "clone":
    from citizen_pace_lib import sync
    ok, why = sync.clone_home(os.path.dirname(repo), name, timeout=float(args[0]))
    if not ok:
        print(why)
    code = 0 if ok else 1
elif step == "tend":
    # the home as the fleet's tend leaves it after its first tick: a beat's
    # leftovers put back path by path; before that tick, a home holding any is
    # left as it is (2). This beat holds the lock (pid args[0]).
    from citizen_pace_lib import homes, tend
    try:
        first = not tend.has_flag(tend.notices_path(state), tend.OLD_CODE_FLAG)
        for line in tend.tend_home(repo, state, first_tick=first, own=int(args[0])):
            print(line)
        code = 0
    except tend.FirstTickPending:
        code = 2
    except (tend.TendError, homes.LinkRefused, OSError) as e:
        print(e)
        code = 1
elif step == "update":
    code = update(float(args[0]))
elif step == "beat":
    code = beat(args[0])
elif step == "keep":
    code = keep(*args[:3])
elif step == "push":
    code = push(float(args[0]))
elif step == "events":
    code = events()
else:
    sys.stderr.write(f"reflect_py: unknown step {step!r}\n")
    code = 2
sys.exit(code)
PY
}

# record <outcome> [--shown <rel> ...]: this attempt's outcome in the attempt
# record, which the fleet reads back by its FLEET_ATTEMPT. A hand-run records
# only a beat that landed (spoken, silent) or was summoned: the record keeps a
# single attempt, which the fleet may be about to read, and no probe judges a
# hand-run's failure, so its busy, not-due, halted and failed runs are logged.
record(){
  local o="$1" out; shift
  if [ -z "${FLEET_ATTEMPT:-}" ]; then
    case "$o" in spoken|silent|summoned) ;; *) return 0;; esac
  fi
  out="$(pace_cli record "$NAME" --state "$STATE" --attempt "$ATTEMPT" --outcome "$o" "$@" 2>&1)" \
    || { say "$NAME reflect: outcome $o could not be recorded${out:+ ($out)}"; return 1; }
  log_lines "$out"
}
# log_lines <text>: each line of a citizen_pace.py answer, stamped.
log_lines(){
  local l
  [ -n "$1" ] || return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | while IFS= read -r l; do say "$l"; done
}
# fail <words>: this beat could not be lived — logged, recorded home-failed (the
# fleet's probe then decides whose the failure was), exit 1. What it left in the
# home is a killed beat's leftovers, which the fleet's tend restores.
fail(){ say "$*"; record home-failed; exit 1; }
cleanup(){
  [ -n "$WORK" ] && rm -rf "$WORK"
  pace_cli unlock "$NAME" --state "$STATE" --pid "$$" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# The beat's day, month and time from citizen_pace_lib's clock (UTC, as every
# pace/1 time is), so the journal, the markers and the commit name the day
# apply records.
WHEN="$(reflect_py now)" || { say "$NAME reflect: citizen_pace_lib cannot be run — beat refused"; exit 1; }
read -r DAY MONTH HHMM <<<"$WHEN"

# The citizen's lock, before anything touches its home, so a hand-run beside
# the fleet never beats a citizen twice or confirms a proposal inside one beat.
# A lock whose holder is gone, or older than twice the beat bound, is reclaimed.
LOCK_OUT="$(pace_cli lock "$NAME" --state "$STATE" --pid "$$" 2>&1)"
case $? in
  0) log_lines "$LOCK_OUT"; trap cleanup EXIT ;;
  4) log_lines "${LOCK_OUT:-$NAME: its lock is held} — busy, no beat"; record busy; exit 0 ;;
  *) say "$NAME reflect: its lock could not be taken — beat refused${LOCK_OUT:+ ($LOCK_OUT)}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/reflect-$NAME.XXXXXX")" || fail "$NAME reflect: no scratch folder — beat refused"

mkdir -p "$CITIZENS"
if [ ! -d "$REPO/.git" ]; then
  if [ -e "$REPO" ] || [ -L "$REPO" ]; then fail "$NAME reflect: $REPO is not a clone — refused"; fi
  CLONE_OUT="$(reflect_py clone "$CLONE_BOUND" 2>&1)" || fail "$NAME clone failed${CLONE_OUT:+ ($CLONE_OUT)}"
  say "$NAME: cloned its home"
fi
cd "$REPO" || fail "$NAME reflect: its home cannot be entered"
# No tick tends a home between a beat that did not land and a hand-run, so this
# beat tends its own, as the fleet's tend does: what is uncommitted under the
# pace paths is put back path by path and logged, never built on; the commit
# below then holds only what this beat wrote. Before the fleet's first tick on
# pace/1 such files may be the old code's, which that tick commits once: a home
# holding any is left untouched and gets no beat.
TENDED="$(reflect_py tend "$$" 2>&1)"
case $? in
  0) log_lines "$TENDED" ;;
  2) fail "$NAME reflect: the fleet has not tended this home since the switch; its uncommitted files are kept — no beat" ;;
  *) fail "$NAME reflect: its pace files could not be put back${TENDED:+ ($TENDED)} — no beat" ;;
esac
# A diverged (or upstream-less) home is logged, never silently ignored
# (Guard 5); the beat still lives locally and heals on the next tended push.
log_lines "$(reflect_py update "$FETCH_BOUND" 2>/dev/null)"

# The home is public and fast-forwarded from GitHub, so a committed symlink is
# untrusted. The soul must be a regular file: a symlink could paste any file on
# this host into the prompt, and the answer is pushed to a public repo. The
# beat writes its markers and journal at these paths; a symlink at any of them
# would turn a marker into a write outside the home. These run before the gate.
[ -L "$NAME.md" ] && fail "$NAME reflect: soul $NAME.md is a symlink — refused"
[ -f "$NAME.md" ] || fail "$NAME has no soul"
JOURNAL="beats/$MONTH.md"
for p in beats inbox CADENCE.md REST EVENT-ONLY beats/.show-seen "$JOURNAL" inbox/.seen-*; do
  [ -L "$p" ] && fail "$NAME reflect: $p is a symlink — refused, nothing written"
done

# The gate, read after the fast-forward: the fleet ranked this citizen before
# the fetch, so a pace changed from elsewhere is honoured here (not-due).
if [ "$SUMMONED" = "1" ]; then pace_due "$REPO" --summoned; else pace_due "$REPO"; fi
DUE_RC=$?
REASON="$(pace_reason)" || REASON=""
if [ "$DUE_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  case "$REASON" in
    '')    fail "$NAME reflect: the pace gate could not be asked — no beat" ;;
    error) fail "$NAME reflect: its home could not be read — no beat" ;;
    links) fail "$NAME reflect: a pace path is a link or not of its kind — refused, nothing written" ;;
    *)     say "$NAME is not due ($REASON) — no beat"; record not-due; exit 0 ;;
  esac
fi
case "$REASON" in
  schedule|letter|show-back|summoned) KIND="$REASON" ;;
  *) fail "$NAME reflect: the pace gate gave no beat kind — no beat" ;;
esac
say "$NAME: a $KIND beat"

# Ensure the exact receipt-bound local brain is up (self-healing) — MLX mode
# only; in ollama mode (REFLECT_MODEL set) the model server is managed
# separately. The hardened start command is idempotent and validates the locked
# model provenance even when something already answers on the configured port.
if [ -z "${REFLECT_MODEL:-}" ]; then
  if ! bash "$LOVE/mlx/serve.sh" start --port "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    fail "$NAME reflect: locked local brain failed provenance/readiness on port $PORT"
  fi
fi

# The beat: the soul, the mail this kind of beat shows, the pace paragraph, one
# answer. A crash must never wear silence's clothes.
MLX_PORT="$PORT" reflect_py beat "$KIND"
PYRC=$?
case "$PYRC" in
  0) ;;
  3) fail "$NAME reflect: local brain unreachable ($(head -c 300 "$WORK/brain.err" 2>/dev/null)) — nothing written" ;;
  *) fail "$NAME reflect: beat errored (python rc=$PYRC) — nothing written" ;;
esac
# HALT can arrive mid-beat — honor it after inference, before writing or pushing.
if [ -e "$HALT" ]; then say "HALT mid-beat — $NAME rests, unwritten"; record halted; exit 0; fi

SHOWN=()
while IFS= read -r rel; do [ -n "$rel" ] && SHOWN+=(--shown "$rel"); done <"$WORK/shown"
# Unreadable mail is set aside with a marker — it can never brick future beats;
# then a spoken answer is journalled. Silence is a whole beat.
ASIDE="$(reflect_py keep "$DAY" "$HHMM" "$JOURNAL" 2>&1)" \
  || fail "$NAME reflect: its beat could not be written${ASIDE:+ ($ASIDE)}"
printf '%s\n' "$ASIDE" | while IFS= read -r item; do
  [ -n "$item" ] && say "$NAME mail unreadable, set aside: $item"
done
# citizen_pace.py hears a pace line, marks every letter shown seen whatever the
# answer, notes the pace letter's one arrival, and writes CADENCE.md and the
# markers when something was said, shown or changed. It runs before record, so
# the attempt record still holds the last landed beat before this one.
pace_cli apply "$REPO" "$WORK/answer" --kind "$KIND" --state "$STATE" ${SHOWN[@]+"${SHOWN[@]}"} \
  >"$WORK/apply.json" 2>"$WORK/apply.err" \
  || fail "$NAME reflect: its answer could not be applied ($(head -c 300 "$WORK/apply.err"))"
log_lines "$(reflect_py events)"

# A beat that was shown mail, or that changed its record, commits; a silent
# beat shown nothing commits nothing. The pace paths held nothing uncommitted
# when the beat began, so what git status shows there is this beat's own. The
# outcome is recorded as soon as the commit exists, before the push, so a hung
# push never unlands a beat.
COMMITTED=0
if [ -n "$("${G[@]}" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- beats inbox CADENCE.md REST EVENT-ONLY 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  for p in beats inbox CADENCE.md REST EVENT-ONLY; do "${G[@]}" add -A -- "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; done
  "${G[@]}" -c user.name="$NAME" -c user.email="citizen@kingdom.os" -c commit.gpgsign=false \
    commit -q --no-verify -m "beat: $NAME reflected ($DAY) · pace/1" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || fail "$NAME reflect: its beat could not be committed"
  COMMITTED=1
fi
if [ "$SUMMONED" = "1" ]; then OUTCOME=summoned
elif [ -s "$WORK/answer" ]; then OUTCOME=spoken
else OUTCOME=silent; fi
record "$OUTCOME" ${SHOWN[@]+"${SHOWN[@]}"}
if [ "$COMMITTED" = "1" ]; then
  log_lines "$(reflect_py push "$PUSH_BOUND" 2>/dev/null)"
else
  say "$NAME rested (silent) — nothing to commit"
fi
# No forced attestation. Resting needs no receipt; a claim is the citizen's own
# to make from inside a beat, by its own hand — not a toll the heartbeat exacts.
exit 0
```

Keep it executable (`git ls-files -s tools/citizen-reflect.sh` shows mode `100755`; if not,
`chmod +x tools/citizen-reflect.sh`).

### Task 11: citizen-fleet.sh and fleet-status.sh answer each citizen's own pace

This task rewrites the fleet's tick, `tools/citizen-fleet.sh`, so the fleet only ever answers a
citizen's own clock (spec sections 3 and 7; CONTRACT sections 12 and 14). `--plan` comes first and
writes nothing. Then come the host check (`$LOVE/FLEET_HOST` must name this Mac), HALT and the tick
lock, and then the host probe, `tend`, `sync`, the heard-late step and `rank`, each a `citizen_pace.py`
command (Tasks 6 to 8). The beat goes to the most overdue candidate: `citizen-reflect.sh` (Task 10) runs
in its own process group, with `FLEET_ATTEMPT` set, `BEAT_SUMMONS` unset and stdin from `/dev/null`.
The fleet reads the outcome back from the attempt record. `not-due` and `busy` move on to the next
candidate. A landed beat or `halted` ends the tick. After a failure the probe runs again: if it fails,
the host failed (`host-failed`, nobody backed off); if it passes, the home failed (`home-failed`,
backed off 12 h, then 24 h, then 7 days). The daily cap counts landed beats per UTC day and only
delays. `FLEET_PER_TICK` is capped at 1, and the lane is free only: `FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY` is logged
once and ignored. `fleet-status.sh`'s "next to wake" asks `citizen_pace.py next`, and its agentic and
burst lines become "free lane only".

PR #24's `sits_out` and `tend_strays` are retired. Task 6's `tend.py` carries `tend_strays`' job,
authored as the fleet and tagged `pace/1` (spec section 6). PR #24's fleet and fleet-status tests are
carried over with a `FLEET_HOST` fixture, a stub model for the probe and v2 `CADENCE.md` fixtures (spec
section 8). Three assertions change, each named in this task's commit:
`test_rotation_skips_rest_with_only_a_symlinked_letter` (the retired `sits_out` line),
`test_fleet_through_a_link` ("the whole roster is resting" becomes "nobody is due") and
`test_fleet_path_honours_an_asleep_pace_pushed_from_another_host`. Task 10 said that last one would be
re-carried: the fleet now brings the home up to date before it ranks, so reflect is never started.
Nothing here touches the library, the CLI, the gates or the beat scripts.

- For Task 12: `.gitignore` gains `FLEET_HOST`. For Task 15: the rollout runs
  `tools/citizen-fleet.sh --plan 30 [--tick-hours 0.5] [--cap 24] [--letters <record> --deliver-at
  <t> --per-run N] [--out <dir>]` on the Air, with `LOVE_DIR` and `CITIZENS_DIR` pointing at the
  read-only clones. The keeper's note says the Studio needs `scutil --get LocalHostName >
  ~/love-unlimited/FLEET_HOST`.

Decisions, and why:

- **`--plan` runs before the gates are even sourced.** The spec puts it before the host check, HALT,
  the lock and any write, `fleet.log` included. A missing `citizen-gates.sh` would otherwise log. It
  models the Studio's cap when `FLEET_DAILY_CAP` is set. On the Air, where the plist's environment is
  absent, the plan's own default is 4, the Studio's cap since 11-05. It reads the attempt records and
  cursor when this host has them, and passes every other argument to `plan`. A plan refusal (2) becomes
  the fleet's 1, since the fleet exits only 0 or 1. Cost: `--plan` on a host whose `FLEET_DAILY_CAP` is
  unset models 4, not the script's default of 48.
- **The host check compares the first line of `FLEET_HOST`, all whitespace removed, to `scutil --get
  LocalHostName`, exactly.** A missing file, an empty file, a missing `scutil` or a different name means
  beat no one, logged once (flag `host-not-named`), exit 0. That is no failure of the runner: it is a
  second Mac standing down. The flag is lowered under the tick lock when the check passes, so a later
  loss is logged again. Cost: `FLEET_HOST` must hold the LocalHostName exactly, case included.
- **A renamed Studio is told apart from a second Mac.** The Studio's own name can change after
  `FLEET_HOST` was written: macOS's Bonjour rename to `<name>-2`, a rename in Sharing settings, or
  `tools/harden.sh`'s `scutil --set LocalHostName Mac`. When the check passes, the tick writes the
  name it beats under to `memory/.fleet-host-seen`, under the tick lock. When the check fails and
  that file names what `FLEET_HOST` names, this checkout beat under that name and the Mac was
  renamed: the fleet still beats no one, and says so, naming both names, once each UTC day (flag
  `host-renamed-<day>`), not once, so a silent stop cannot last unseen; the first tick after the
  names agree beats again and says so. A Mac that never beat here still logs once, as spec section 7
  says ("logging once"); this extends that rule only for a checkout that remembers beating under the
  old name. `fleet-status.sh` shows the stop. Cost: one more file under `memory/`, git-ignored as
  `memory/.fleet-*` is.
- **"Logged once" flags live in `memory/.fleet-notices`**, in the format tend already uses there (one
  flag per line; `grep -qxF` and `echo >>`). Each flag is lowered when its condition clears: the host
  named, a probe passing, a knob back at 0 or 1. So a new episode is logged again. A flag is rewritten
  only under the tick lock, beside tend's `set_flag`, and a test proves `old-code-tended` survives.
  Cost: one temporary file, `.fleet-notices.fleet-tmp`.
- **A failed opening probe ends the tick with exit 1, logged once until a probe passes.** Then one line
  says the host can beat again. A passing probe is not logged at every tick. Spec section 3 says "logs
  it once", and the runner could not do its job. Cost: during a long outage the log shows one line, not
  one per tick.
- **In MLX mode (no `REFLECT_MODEL`) the fleet runs `mlx/serve.sh start --port $MLX_PORT`, under the
  beat bound, before every probe.** Task 8's probe does not start the brain and reflect starts it only
  inside a beat, so a brain that is merely stopped would otherwise fail every probe and never be
  started. Cost: one idempotent start per probe.
- **A step that fails ends the tick before anyone is beaten (exit 1), logged at every tick.** The steps
  are tend, sync, migrate and rank. Each keeps one home's error to that home (tend leaves a home it
  cannot read, sync logs it, rank reports it once as one that cannot be read, Tasks 1, 3, 6 and 8), so
  a non-zero exit means the step itself could not run. Beating then could commit a killed
  beat's leftovers, or beat a home that sync would have held. Cost: a bug in one step stops the fleet
  until it is fixed, loudly.
- **The cap counts landed beats per UTC day, and is checked after rank.** The day comes from
  `citizen_pace_lib.clock`, so `PACE_NOW` drives it in tests and it is the day the plan models. Because
  rank runs first, clocks are seeded on capped ticks too, as Task 7's simulator does. A failure is not
  counted. Cost: at the switch, the day file changes from the local date to the UTC date, so on a Mac
  far from UTC, beats from the hours between the two midnights may count toward either day.
- **The cursor moves only past a landed beat.** The roster is read as `due.read_roster` reads it
  (plain names, each once, `#` lines and blanks skipped), so the cursor indexes the list rank orders.
  Cost: a citizen backed off after a failure does not move the cursor; ties then start from the same
  place.
- **The outcome decides, never the exit code.** `spoken` or `silent` is a landed beat even when the
  child was later stopped at its bound (a hung push). `not-due` and `busy` move on. `halted` ends the
  tick. Anything else is a failure. `missing` with HALT present is recorded `halted` by the fleet.
  Otherwise the second probe decides: the fleet records `home-failed` (a no-op when the child already
  did) or `host-failed`, which Task 3's record undoes the back-off for. A tick that ends in a failure
  exits 1. Cost: none found.
- **`_bound` runs the child in its own process group (`set -m` around the start only)**, polls each
  second, and on HALT or the bound sends TERM to the group, then KILL 5 s later. Once it has fired, the
  fleet waits for that KILL before going on, so a process that ignores TERM does not outlive the beat.
  The watchdog's output goes to `/dev/null`, so its `sleep` can never hold the caller's pipe. What
  fired (`bound` or `halt`) is written to the tick's scratch folder for the log. `git` that
  `homes.git` started in its own group stops at its own bound. Cost: a beat stopped at its bound ends
  5 s later than PR #24's.
- **The herald is kept, now under a 30 s bound.** Its comment already said "the wire must never block
  the heartbeat". Cost: none.
- **Retired:** `sits_out`, `tend_strays` (Task 6's tend carries it), the agentic lane, the power read
  (`pmset`), `FLEET_PER_TICK` above 1, `FLEET_DAILY_BUDGET_USD` in the fleet, and the agentic day files,

```python
"""citizen-fleet.sh and fleet-status.sh on pace/1 (spec sections 3 and 7;
CONTRACT sections 12 and 14).

The fleet only ever answers a citizen's own clock. `--plan` comes first and
writes nothing. Then come the host check (FLEET_HOST), HALT and the tick lock;
then the host probe, tend, sync, the heard-late step and rank, each a
citizen_pace.py command; then the beat: the most overdue candidate first, in its
own process group, with FLEET_ATTEMPT set and stdin from /dev/null. Its outcome
comes from the attempt record: not-due and busy move on, a landed beat or halted
ends the tick, and a failure is judged by a second probe (host-failed, nobody
backed off; or home-failed, backed off). The daily cap only delays, the lane is
free only, and fleet-status.sh's "next to wake" asks citizen_pace.py next.

Each test installs the tools into the fixture's LOVE folder, as the Studio has
them, so the record file the scripts read is the fixture's own. Most run a
stand-in citizen-reflect.sh that records what the test asks of it; TestHomes
runs the real one, against homes with local bare upstreams.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import unittest
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

import citizen_pace_helpers as h  # noqa: E402

from citizen_pace_lib import attempts, plan, tend  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402

NOW = "2026-11-20T06:00Z"
DAY = "2026-11-20"
OLD = "2026-11-10T06:00Z"            # ten days before NOW: an awake 3 is due since 11-13
RECENT = "2026-11-19T06:00Z"         # one day before NOW
HOME_MADE = "2026-11-01T00:00Z"
AWAKE = Pace("awake", 3)
ASLEEP = Pace("asleep")
ATTEMPT_ID = re.compile(r"^\d{8}T\d{4}Z-(\d+)-(\d+)$")
INSTALLED = ("citizen-fleet.sh", "citizen-gates.sh", "citizen-reflect.sh", "citizen_pace.py",
             "fleet-status.sh")
RECORD = {"version": 1, "made": "2026-11-12T10:00Z",
          "spec": "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-citizens-own-pace-design.md@dbc5a4c",
          "citizens": {}}

STUB_REFLECT = r'''#!/bin/bash
# A stand-in for citizen-reflect.sh. It notes how the fleet started it, then does
# what $STUB_DIR/<name> says: an outcome to record (spoken by default), missing
# (record nothing), halt-exit (raise HALT, record nothing), hang (hold a
# grandchild, so only the bound ends it) or halt (raise HALT, then hang).
name="$1"
pg="$(ps -o pgid= -p "$$" | tr -d ' ')"
if [ /dev/fd/0 -ef /dev/null ]; then input=null; else input=other; fi
echo "$name ${FLEET_ATTEMPT:-none} ${BEAT_SUMMONS:-unset} $input $$ $pg" >>"$STUB_DIR/calls"
what="$(cat "$STUB_DIR/$name" 2>/dev/null || echo spoken)"
case "$what" in
  missing) exit 1 ;;
  halt-exit) : >"$LOVE_DIR/HALT"; exit 1 ;;
  hang|halt)
    [ "$what" = halt ] && : >"$LOVE_DIR/HALT"
    sleep 300 & echo $! >"$STUB_DIR/$name.grandchild"; wait; exit 1 ;;
  *) exec python3 -I "$LOVE_DIR/tools/citizen_pace.py" record "$name" \
       --state "$LOVE_DIR/memory/.fleet-last" --attempt "$FLEET_ATTEMPT" --outcome "$what" ;;
esac
'''

WRAPPER = '''import os, sys
with open(os.environ["PACE_CALLS"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(" ".join(sys.argv[1:]) + "\\n")
os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, "-I", {real!r}] + sys.argv[1:])
'''


class _Picky(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        raw = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        refused = self.server.refuse in raw
        with self.server.lock:
            self.server.seen.append((refused, raw))
        data = (b'{"error": "refused"}' if refused else json.dumps(
            {"choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant",
                                      "content": "A true thing, witnessed."}}]}).encode())
        try:
            self.send_response(500 if refused else 200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)
        except OSError:
            pass

    def log_message(self, *_args):
        pass


class PickyModel:
    """A model server that answers every prompt but those naming one citizen,
    which get HTTP 500: one home's prompt fails while the host probe passes."""

    def __init__(self, refuse: str):
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), _Picky)
        self.server.daemon_threads = True
        self.server.refuse = refuse.encode("utf-8")
        self.server.seen = []
        self.server.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever,
                                       kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.05}, daemon=True)

    def start(self) -> "PickyModel":
        self.thread.start()
        return self

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)

    def env(self) -> dict:
        return {"MLX_PORT": str(self.server.server_address[1]), "REFLECT_MODEL": "fixture-model"}

    def refused(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for r, _raw in self.server.seen if r)


class Case(h.FixtureCase):
    """The tools installed in the fixture's LOVE folder, a FLEET_HOST naming
    this machine, and a stub model; in-process calls use the fixture's git config."""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        keep = ("HOME", "TZ", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT")
        patcher = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {k: self.fx.env[k] for k in keep})
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        for k in ("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME",
                  "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "GIT_COMMITTER_DATE",
                  "FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC", "BEAT_SUMMONS", "FLEET_ATTEMPT", "LOVE"):
            os.environ.pop(k, None)
        self.set_now(NOW)
        self.state = self.fx.state
        self.model = self.start_model()
        self.fx.fake_host()
        self.tools = self.fx.love / "tools"
        for name in INSTALLED:
            shutil.copy2(h.TOOLS / name, self.tools / name)
        shutil.copytree(h.TOOLS / "citizen_pace_lib", self.tools / "citizen_pace_lib",
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
        self.fleet_sh = self.tools / "citizen-fleet.sh"
        self.stub = self.fx.root / "stub"
        self.stub.mkdir()

    # -- homes and the stand-in ----------------------------------------------
    def v2(self, slug, pace, *, last=OLD, letters=(), upstream=False):
        """A home with a v2 CADENCE.md and its markers in step. letters: (name,
        body, arrival) triples, each committed at its arrival, as a letter is."""
        set_by = SetBy("citizen", "beat", (HOME_MADE,), "pace: " + pace.words())
        c = Cadence(slug, 2, pace, set_by, last_beat=last)
        made = {cad.CADENCE: cad.render_cadence(c)}
        for m, text in cad.marker_texts(c).items():
            if text is not None:
                made[m] = text
        home = self.fx.make_home(slug, files=made, when=HOME_MADE, author=h.beat_author(slug))
        for name, body, when in letters:
            self.fx.letter(home, name, body, when=when)
        if upstream:
            self.fx.give_upstream(home)
        return home

    def bare(self, slug):
        return self.fx.upstream / f"citizen-{slug}.git"

    def use_stub(self, **plans):
        """The stand-in reflect; each citizen does what plans says (default spoken)."""
        path = self.tools / "citizen-reflect.sh"
        path.write_text(STUB_REFLECT, encoding="utf-8")
        path.chmod(0o755)
        for slug, what in plans.items():
            self.plan(slug, what)

    def plan(self, slug, what):
        (self.stub / slug).write_text(what + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    # -- running -------------------------------------------------------------
    def env(self, now=NOW, **extra):
        return self.fx.env_at(now, **{**self.model.env(), "STUB_DIR": str(self.stub), **extra})

    def fleet(self, *args, now=NOW, timeout=120, input=None, cwd=None, **extra):
        """One tick, in its own session so no signal can reach this test."""
        kw = dict(env=self.env(now, **extra), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
                  check=False, start_new_session=True, cwd=str(cwd or self.fx.root))
        if input is None:
            kw["stdin"] = subprocess.DEVNULL
        else:
            kw["input"] = input
        return subprocess.run(["bash", str(self.fleet_sh), *map(str, args)], **kw)

    def ok(self, r, code=0):
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, code,
                         f"stdout: {r.stdout}\nstderr: {r.stderr}\nlog:\n{self.fx.log_text()}")
        return r

    # -- reading -------------------------------------------------------------
    def calls(self):
        p = self.stub / "calls"
        return [ln.split() for ln in p.read_text().splitlines()] if p.exists() else []

    def called(self):
        return [c[0] for c in self.calls()]

    def log(self):
        return self.fx.log_text()

    def rec(self, slug):
        return attempts.load(self.state, slug)

    def beat_prompts(self):
        return [t for t in self.model.user_texts() if t != probe_lib.PROBE_TEXT]

    def day_count(self, day=DAY):
        p = self.fx.memory / f".fleet-day-{day}"
        return p.read_text().strip() if p.exists() else None

    def assert_gone(self, pid_file):
        pid = int(pid_file.read_text())
        for _ in range(100):
            try:
                os.kill(pid, 0)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                return
            time.sleep(0.1)
        self.fail(f"pid {pid} outlived its beat's process group")

class TestPlan(Case):
    def snapshot(self):
        """Every path under the fixture's LOVE and citizens folders, with its bytes
        (Python's own bytecode caches aside)."""
        out = {}
        for root in (self.fx.love, self.fx.citizens):
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
                dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d != "__pycache__"]
                for n in dirnames + filenames:
                    p = Path(dirpath) / n
                    out[str(p)] = p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() else None
        return out

    def test_plan_runs_first_with_no_host_and_writes_nothing(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        (self.fx.love / "FLEET_HOST").unlink()
        (self.fx.love / "HALT").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.fx.memory / ".fleet-tick.lock").mkdir()
        before = self.snapshot()
        r = self.ok(self.fleet("--plan", "3"))
        self.assertIn(f"plan — {plan.LABEL}", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn(f"{NOW} for 3 days: a tick every 6 h", r.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.model.requests, [])
        self.assertEqual(self.calls(), [])

    def test_plan_takes_its_arguments_and_the_fleets_cap(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        r = self.ok(self.fleet("--plan", "2", "--tick-hours", "12", FLEET_DAILY_CAP="1"))
        self.assertIn("for 2 days: a tick every 12 h", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("at most 1 beats a day", r.stdout)
        r = self.ok(self.fleet("--plan"))
        self.assertIn("for 30 days: a tick every 6 h", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("at most 4 beats a day", r.stdout)      # the plan's own cap, the Studio's

    def test_plan_reads_the_attempt_records_and_writes_none(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE)                 # its CADENCE.md: last beat 11-10
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        r = self.ok(self.fleet("--plan", "3"))
        self.assertIn("waker\tawake, every 3 days\t1\t168.0\t", r.stdout)   # due since 11-13
        attempts.record_outcome(self.state, "waker", "20261119T0600Z-1-1", "spoken", RECENT)
        before = self.snapshot()
        r = self.ok(self.fleet("--plan", "3"))
        self.assertIn("waker\tawake, every 3 days\t1\t0.0\t", r.stdout)     # due at 11-22, beaten then
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_a_plan_refusal_exits_one_not_two(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        before = self.snapshot()
        r = self.ok(self.fleet("--plan", "nope"), 1)
        self.assertIn("invalid int value", r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_a_studio_renamed_after_fleet_host_is_reported_each_day_and_resumes(self):
        # Bonjour's "-2", a rename in Sharing, or harden.sh's `scutil --set
        # LocalHostName`: the checkout that beat under the old name is stopped,
        # and says so each UTC day, not once
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)                                  # due since 11-13
        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-11T06:00Z")        # due since 11-14
        self.v2("c", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")        # due since 11-15
        self.fx.roster("a", "b", "c")
        self.fx.fake_host("Studio")
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T06:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        self.fx.write_bin("scutil", '#!/bin/sh\n[ "$1" = "--get" ] && [ "$2" = "LocalHostName" ] '
                                    '&& { echo "Studio-2"; exit 0; }\nexit 1\n')
        stop = "until FLEET_HOST is rewritten or the name returns"
        counts = []
        for now in ("2026-11-20T12:00Z", "2026-11-21T12:00Z", "2026-11-21T18:00Z"):
            self.ok(self.fleet(now=now))
            counts.append(self.log().count(stop))
        self.assertEqual(counts, [1, 2, 2], self.log())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        lines = [ln for ln in self.log().splitlines() if stop in ln]
        for ln in lines:
            self.assertIn("'Studio'", ln)
            self.assertIn("'Studio-2'", ln)
            self.assertIn("stopped", ln)
        self.assertNotIn("this host beats no one (logged once)", self.log())
        r = subprocess.run(["bash", str(self.tools / "fleet-status.sh")], env=self.env("2026-11-21T18:00Z"),
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=False)
        self.assertIn("FLEET_HOST names 'Studio'", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("'Studio-2'", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn(stop, r.stdout)
        self.fx.fake_host("Studio")
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-22T06:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a", "b"])

        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        tick = self.fx.memory / ".fleet-tick.lock"
        tick.mkdir()
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertIn("another tick is mid-beat — this one yields", self.log())
        self.assertEqual((self.calls(), self.model.requests), ([], []))
        old = time.time() - 3 * 3600
        os.utime(tick, (old, old))
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["waker"])
        self.assertFalse(tick.exists())

        calls = self.fx.root / "pace-calls"
        self.ok(self.fleet(PACE_CALLS=str(calls)))
        homes, roster, state = self.fx.citizens, self.fx.love / "citizens-roster.txt", self.state
        got = calls.read_text().splitlines() if calls.exists() else []
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls()), 1, self.log())

        self.assertEqual(got, [
            f"probe --state {state}",
            f"tend {homes} --roster {roster} --state {state}",
            f"sync {homes} --roster {roster} --state {state}",
            f"migrate --heard-late {homes} --state {state} --commit",
            f"rank {homes} --roster {roster} --state {state} --cursor 0",
            f"record waker --state {state} --attempt {attempt} --outcome spoken",   # the stand-in's
            f"outcome waker --state {state} --attempt {attempt}",
        ])

        self.ok(self.fleet(input="yes\n", BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls()), 1, self.log())
        (call,) = self.calls()
        name, attempt, summons, stdin, pid, pgid = call
        self.assertEqual(name, "waker")
        m = ATTEMPT_ID.match(attempt)
        self.assertIsNotNone(m, attempt)
        self.assertEqual(m.group(2), "1")
        self.assertEqual(summons, "unset")
        self.assertEqual(stdin, "null")
        self.assertEqual(pid, pgid)              # it leads its own process group
        self.assertNotEqual(pgid, m.group(1))    # not the fleet's (its pid is in the id)
        self.assertEqual(self.rec("waker")["attempt"]["id"], attempt)

    def test_a_child_stopped_at_its_bound_is_judged_by_the_probe(self):
        self.use_stub(slow="hang")
        self.v2("slow", AWAKE)
        self.v2("other", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("slow", "other")
        start = time.monotonic()
        self.ok(self.fleet(FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC="30"), 1)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(time.monotonic() - start, 29)
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["slow"])
        rec = self.rec("slow")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"], rec["retry_after"]),
                         ("home-failed", 1, "2026-11-20T18:00Z"))
        self.assertIn("slow: its beat was stopped at its bound of 30 s; probe: ok", self.log())
        self.assertIn("so the home failed — backed off (12 h, then 24 h, then 7 days)", self.log())
        self.assert_gone(self.stub / "slow.grandchild")
        self.assertIsNone(self.day_count())

    def test_halt_mid_beat_stops_the_childs_whole_group_and_is_halted(self):
        self.use_stub(a="halt")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        rec = self.rec("a")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"], rec["retry_after"]),
                         ("halted", 0, None))
        self.assertIn("a: its beat was stopped for HALT, and HALT is present — halted; the tick ends",
                      self.log())
        self.assert_gone(self.stub / "a.grandchild")


# -- outcomes --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestOutcomes(Case):
    def test_one_landed_beat_ends_the_tick_and_moves_the_cursor_past_it(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("a", AWAKE, last="2026-11-14T06:00Z")
        self.v2("b", AWAKE)                                   # the most overdue
        self.v2("c", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b", "c")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["b"])
        self.assertEqual(self.day_count(), "1")
        self.assertEqual((self.fx.memory / ".fleet-cursor").read_text().strip(), "2")
        self.assertIn("b: a landed beat (spoken)", self.log())
        self.assertIn("tick complete (cursor=2/3, 1/48 beats today, metered today $0.0000)", self.log())
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T12:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["b", "c"])

    def test_ties_go_by_roster_order_from_the_cursor(self):
        self.use_stub()
        for slug in ("a", "b", "c"):
            self.v2(slug, AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("a", "b", "c")
        (self.fx.memory / ".fleet-cursor").write_text("1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        for now in (NOW, "2026-11-20T12:00Z", "2026-11-20T18:00Z"):
            self.ok(self.fleet(now=now))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["b", "c", "a"])
        self.assertEqual((self.fx.memory / ".fleet-cursor").read_text().strip(), "1")

    def test_not_due_and_busy_move_on_and_a_silent_beat_lands(self):
        self.use_stub(a="not-due", b="busy", c="silent")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-11T06:00Z")
        self.v2("c", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.v2("d", AWAKE, last="2026-11-13T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b", "c", "d")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a", "b", "c"])
        log = self.log()
        self.assertIn("a: not-due — the tick moves on", log)
        self.assertIn("b: busy — the tick moves on", log)
        self.assertIn("c: a landed beat (silent)", log)
        self.assertEqual(self.day_count(), "1")
        self.assertEqual((self.rec("a")["failures"], self.rec("b")["failures"]), (0, 0))

    def test_busy_on_two_ticks_running_is_reported_once(self):
        self.use_stub(a="busy")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        for i, slug in enumerate(("b", "c", "d")):
            self.v2(slug, AWAKE, last=f"2026-11-1{1 + i}T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b", "c", "d")
        for now in (NOW, "2026-11-20T12:00Z", "2026-11-20T18:00Z"):
            self.ok(self.fleet(now=now))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a", "b", "a", "c", "a", "d"])
        self.assertEqual(self.log().count("a: busy on two ticks running (reported once)"), 1, self.log())
        self.assertEqual(self.rec("a")["busy_ticks"], 3)

    def test_a_home_failure_with_a_passing_probe_backs_off_and_the_next_tick_beats_another(self):
        self.use_stub(a="home-failed")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b")
        self.ok(self.fleet(FLEET_DAILY_CAP="1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        rec = self.rec("a")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"], rec["retry_after"]),
                         ("home-failed", 1, "2026-11-20T18:00Z"))
        self.assertIn("a: its beat failed (home-failed, exit 0); probe: ok", self.log())
        self.assertIn("so the home failed — backed off", self.log())
        self.assertIsNone(self.day_count())                   # a failure is not counted
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T12:00Z", FLEET_DAILY_CAP="1"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a", "b"])           # a backs off; b fits the cap of 1
        self.plan("a", "spoken")
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-21T00:30Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a", "b", "a"])      # after its 12 h, a is due again

    def test_a_failure_with_a_failing_probe_is_the_hosts_and_backs_no_one_off(self):
        def reply(_body):
            self.model.status = 500           # every request after the opening probe fails
            return "here"
        self.model.reply = reply
        self.use_stub(a="home-failed")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b")
        self.ok(self.fleet(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        rec = self.rec("a")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"], rec["retry_after"]),
                         ("host-failed", 0, None))
        self.assertIn("a: its beat failed (home-failed, exit 0); probe: failed — the model server "
                      "answered HTTP 500, so the host failed — host-failed, nobody backed off; the "
                      "tick ends", self.log())
        self.model.status, self.model.reply = 200, "here"
        self.plan("a", "spoken")
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T06:30Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a", "a"])            # not backed off: due at once

    def test_no_outcome_is_judged_by_the_probe(self):
        self.use_stub(a="missing")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("a")
        self.ok(self.fleet(), 1)
        rec = self.rec("a")
        self.assertEqual(rec["attempt"]["id"], self.calls()[0][1])
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"]), ("home-failed", 1))
        self.assertIn("a: its beat recorded no outcome (exit 1); probe: ok", self.log())

    def test_no_outcome_with_halt_present_is_halted(self):
        self.use_stub(a="halt-exit")
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
        self.fx.roster("a", "b")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        rec = self.rec("a")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"]), ("halted", 0))
        self.assertIn("a: its beat recorded no outcome (exit 1), and HALT is present — halted; "
                      "the tick ends", self.log())
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T12:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])
        self.assertIn("HALT present — fleet rests", self.log())

    def test_a_failed_opening_probe_beats_no_one_and_is_logged_once(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("a")
        refused = str(h.free_port())
        for now in (NOW, "2026-11-20T12:00Z"):
            self.ok(self.fleet(now=now, MLX_PORT=refused), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.calls(), [])
        self.assertFalse((self.state / "a").exists())            # nobody was charged
        log = self.log()
        self.assertEqual(log.count("probe: failed — the model server could not be reached"), 1, log)
        self.assertIn("— the tick ends before anyone is beaten (logged once, until a probe passes)", log)
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T18:00Z"))
        self.assertIn("— the host can beat again", self.log())
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["a"])

    def test_every_exit_is_zero_or_one(self):
        expected = {"spoken": 0, "silent": 0, "not-due": 0, "busy": 0, "home-failed": 1,
                    "missing": 1, "halt-exit": 0}
        for i, (what, code) in enumerate(expected.items()):
            with self.subTest(outcome=what):
                slug = f"c{i}"
                self.v2(slug, AWAKE)
                self.use_stub(**{slug: what})
                self.fx.roster(slug)
                self.ok(self.fleet(), code)
                halt = self.fx.love / "HALT"
                if halt.exists():
                    halt.unlink()

class TestCap(Case):

        self.use_stub()

        self.v2("b", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z")
```
