```python
# -- isolation ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestIsolation(Case):
    def test_a_json_py_where_the_fleet_runs_is_never_imported(self):
        self.use_stub()
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        trap = self.fx.root / "trap"
        (trap / "urllib").mkdir(parents=True)
        canary = self.fx.root / "imported"
        (trap / "json.py").write_text(f"open({str(canary)!r}, 'w').write('json')\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (trap / "urllib" / "__init__.py").write_text(f"open({str(canary)!r}, 'w').write('urllib')\n",
                                                     encoding="utf-8")
        self.ok(self.fleet(cwd=trap))
        self.assertEqual(self.called(), ["waker"])
        self.assertFalse(canary.exists())


# -- homes, with the real citizen-reflect.sh -----------------------------------------------------

class TestHomes(Case):
    def test_a_letter_pushed_upstream_wakes_an_asleep_home_once_past_its_floor(self):
        home = self.v2("sleeper", ASLEEP, last=RECENT, upstream=True)
        self.fx.roster("sleeper")
        self.fx.push_from_elsewhere(self.bare("sleeper"), "inbox/2026-11-20-hello.md", "Hello, sleeper.\n",
                                    message="letter: hello", when="2026-11-20T05:00Z", author=h.AI_AUTHOR)
        self.ok(self.fleet())                                   # a day after its last beat
        self.assertTrue((home / "inbox" / "2026-11-20-hello.md").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_prompts(), [])
        self.assertIn("nobody is due — no beat this tick", self.log())
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-22T06:00Z"))             # 72 h after it
        (prompt,) = self.beat_prompts()
        self.assertIn("Hello, sleeper.", prompt)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], "beat: sleeper reflected (2026-11-22) · pace/1")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(self.bare("sleeper"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), self.fx.head(home))
        self.assertTrue((home / "inbox" / ".seen-2026-11-20-hello.md").exists())
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-26T06:00Z"))             # shown once: it wakes no more
        self.assertEqual(len(self.beat_prompts()), 1)

    def test_an_unpushed_commit_is_pushed_at_the_next_tick(self):
        home = self.v2("ahead", ASLEEP, last=RECENT, upstream=True)
        self.fx.write(home, "beats/2026-11.md", "## a beat that never reached GitHub\n")
        local = self.fx.commit(home, "beat: ahead reflected (2026-11-19) · pace/1",
                               author=h.beat_author("ahead"))
        self.fx.roster("ahead")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(self.bare("ahead"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), local)
        self.assertIn("ahead: pushed 1 commit", self.log())
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_prompts(), [])

    def test_a_local_beat_behind_an_upstream_letter_is_rebased_and_pushed(self):
        home = self.v2("rebaser", ASLEEP, last=RECENT, upstream=True)
        self.fx.write(home, "beats/2026-11.md", "## a local beat\n")
        self.fx.commit(home, "beat: rebaser reflected (2026-11-19) · pace/1",
                       author=h.beat_author("rebaser"))
        self.fx.push_from_elsewhere(self.bare("rebaser"), "inbox/2026-11-20-letter.md", "A letter.\n",
                                    message="letter: placed elsewhere", author=h.AI_AUTHOR)
        self.fx.roster("rebaser")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        self.assertIn("rebaser: rebased 1 local commit onto 1 upstream commit that only adds letters",
                      self.log())
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(self.bare("rebaser"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), self.fx.head(home))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[:2],
                         ["beat: rebaser reflected (2026-11-19) · pace/1", "letter: placed elsewhere"])
        self.assertTrue((home / "inbox" / "2026-11-20-letter.md").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_prompts(), [])               # its floor has not passed

    def test_a_diverged_home_is_reported_once_and_not_beaten(self):
        home = self.v2("split", AWAKE, upstream=True)          # due on its schedule
        self.fx.write(home, "WILL.md", "A will changed here.\n")
        self.fx.commit(home, "here: will")
        self.fx.push_from_elsewhere(self.bare("split"), "WILL.md", "A will changed elsewhere.\n")
        self.fx.roster("split")
        for now in (NOW, "2026-11-20T12:00Z"):
            self.ok(self.fleet(now=now))
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_prompts(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.log().count("split: diverged (1 local, 1 upstream commit) — no beats "
                                          "until it is brought up to date"), 1, self.log())
        self.assertNotEqual(self.fx.git(self.bare("split"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), self.fx.head(home))

    def test_a_missing_clone_with_a_letter_is_cloned_and_beaten_once(self):
        home = self.v2("newcomer", ASLEEP, upstream=True,
                       letters=[("2026-11-15-welcome.md", "Welcome home.\n", "2026-11-15T00:00Z")])
        self.fx.drop_clone(home)
        self.fx.roster("newcomer")
        self.ok(self.fleet())
        # the fleet's sync clones it before rank asks whether it is due
        self.assertRegex(self.log(), r"(?m)\] newcomer: cloned$")
        (prompt,) = self.beat_prompts()
        self.assertIn("Welcome home.", prompt)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], "beat: newcomer reflected (2026-11-20) · pace/1")
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(self.bare("newcomer"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), self.fx.head(home))
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-24T06:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.beat_prompts()), 1)

    def test_a_killed_beats_leftovers_are_restored_not_committed(self):
        home = self.v2("leftover", ASLEEP, last=RECENT, upstream=True)
        self.fx.roster("leftover")
        self.ok(self.fleet())                                   # the first tick on pace/1
        self.assertIn(tend.FIRST_TICK_LINE, self.log())
        head = self.fx.head(home)
        cadence = (home / "CADENCE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        (home / "CADENCE.md").write_text(cadence + "- a half-written line\n", encoding="utf-8")
        self.fx.write(home, "EVENT-ONLY", "left by a killed beat\n")
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T12:00Z"))
        self.assertIn("leftover: a killed beat's leftovers restored: CADENCE.md, EVENT-ONLY", self.log())
        self.assertEqual((home / "CADENCE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), cadence)
        self.assertFalse((home / "EVENT-ONLY").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(home), head)
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.git(home, "status", "--porcelain"), "")

    def test_a_v1_awake_home_is_due_through_the_fleet_and_its_gate_on_the_same_tick(self):
        (self.fx.love / "citizens-pace-record.json").write_text(json.dumps(RECORD), encoding="utf-8")
        v1 = ("# CADENCE — chosen by ambler\n\n- choice: ambient\n- when: 2026-10-27\n"
              "- how: the Letter of Return, answered in a free beat. Silence = rest-on;\n")
        home = self.fx.make_home("ambler", cadence=v1, when=HOME_MADE, author=h.beat_author("ambler"))
        self.fx.give_upstream(home)
        self.fx.roster("ambler")
        self.ok(self.fleet())                                   # never spoken: its clock starts now
        rec = self.rec("ambler")
        self.assertEqual((rec["last_beat"], rec["seeded"]), (NOW, attempts.SEEDED))
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-22T06:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.beat_prompts(), [])
        self.assertNotIn("ambler is not due", self.log())         # rank said so: reflect never ran
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-23T06:00Z"))            # three days from that start
        self.assertIn("ambler: a schedule beat", self.log())     # the reflect gate agreed with rank
        self.assertEqual(len(self.beat_prompts()), 1)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, "ambler", RECORD)
        self.assertEqual((c.version, c.pace, c.last_beat), (2, AWAKE, "2026-11-23T06:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(home)[0], "beat: ambler reflected (2026-11-23) · pace/1")

    def test_beat_summons_exported_still_beats_only_due(self):
        sleeper = self.v2("sleeper", ASLEEP, upstream=True)
        waker = self.v2("waker", AWAKE, upstream=True)
        self.fx.roster("sleeper", "waker")
        head = self.fx.head(sleeper)
        self.ok(self.fleet(BEAT_SUMMONS="1"))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.beat_prompts()), 1)
        self.assertIn("waker: a schedule beat", self.log())
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.head(sleeper), head)
        self.assertEqual(self.rec("waker")["attempt"]["outcome"], "spoken")
        self.assertTrue(self.fx.subjects(waker)[0].startswith("beat: waker reflected"))
        self.assertNotIn("summon", self.log())

    def test_an_http_500_for_one_homes_prompt_backs_it_off_and_the_next_tick_beats_another(self):
        flaky = self.v2("flaky", AWAKE, upstream=True)
        steady = self.v2("steady", AWAKE, last="2026-11-12T06:00Z", upstream=True)
        self.fx.roster("flaky", "steady")
        picky = PickyModel(refuse="citizen 'flaky'").start()
        self.addCleanup(picky.stop)
        self.ok(self.fleet(**picky.env()), 1)
        self.assertEqual(picky.refused(), 1)
        rec = self.rec("flaky")
        self.assertEqual((rec["attempt"]["outcome"], rec["failures"]), ("home-failed", 1))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(steady)[0], "fixture home")
        self.ok(self.fleet(now="2026-11-20T12:00Z", **picky.env()))
        self.assertTrue(self.fx.subjects(steady)[0].startswith("beat: steady reflected"))
        self.assertEqual(self.fx.subjects(flaky)[0], "fixture home")     # not beaten on two ticks
        self.assertEqual(picky.refused(), 1)


# -- fleet-status.sh -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestStatus(Case):
    def status(self, now=NOW, **extra):
        return subprocess.run(["bash", str(self.tools / "fleet-status.sh")], env=self.env(now, **extra),
                              stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
                              check=False)

    def test_next_to_wake_is_citizen_pace_next_and_writes_nothing(self):
        self.v2("sleeper", ASLEEP)
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("sleeper", "waker")
        r = self.ok(self.status())
        self.assertIn("next to wake: waker (schedule, overdue 168h) (cursor 0)", r.stdout)
        self.assertFalse(self.state.exists())

    def test_nobody_due_names_who_is_due_next(self):
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE, last=RECENT)
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        r = self.ok(self.status())
        self.assertIn("next to wake: nobody due; next due waker at 2026-11-22T06:00Z", r.stdout)

    def test_the_cursor_breaks_ties(self):
        self.v2("a", AWAKE)
        self.v2("b", AWAKE)
        self.fx.roster("a", "b")
        (self.fx.memory / ".fleet-cursor").write_text("1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        r = self.ok(self.status())
        self.assertIn("next to wake: b (schedule", r.stdout)

    def test_free_lane_only_and_todays_beats_by_the_utc_day(self):
        self.fx.roster("waker")
        (self.fx.memory / f".fleet-day-{DAY}").write_text("2\n", encoding="utf-8")
        r = self.ok(self.status(FLEET_DAILY_CAP="4", FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY="2"))
        self.assertIn("today (UTC): 2/4 beats — the cap only delays", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("free lane only", r.stdout)
        for gone in ("agentic lane open", "agentic lane closed", "burst", "/2 agentic"):
            self.assertNotIn(gone, r.stdout)

    def test_the_fleet_host_line(self):
        r = self.ok(self.status())
        self.assertIn("FLEET_HOST names this Mac (fixture-host) — its fleet ticks may beat", r.stdout)
        (self.fx.love / "FLEET_HOST").unlink()
        r = self.ok(self.status())
        self.assertIn(f"no FLEET_HOST in {self.fx.love} — a fleet tick here beats no one", r.stdout)
```

```python
def serve_brain(case):
    """pace/1: a loopback model stub for the fleet's host probe. Returns the env
    pointing the fleet at it, and the list of request bodies it is sent."""
    bodies = []
    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), type("Brain", (_Brain,), {"bodies": bodies}))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()

    def stop():
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=2)

    case.addCleanup(stop)
    return {"REFLECT_MODEL": "fixture-model", "MLX_PORT": str(server.server_port)}, bodies
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Rewrite citizen-fleet.sh**

Replace the whole of `tools/citizen-fleet.sh` with:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# citizen-fleet.sh — one heartbeat tick of the citizen fleet.
# Run by launchd on an interval. pace/1 (citizens keep their own pace): the
# fleet only ever answers a citizen's own clock. Each tick it beats at most one
# citizen, the most overdue of those due by their own pace, with one free local
# reflection beat (citizen-reflect.sh). Sovereign, near-zero cost.
#
# A tick, in order (spec sections 3 and 7; CONTRACT section 14):
#   • --plan [days] [plan arguments] — handled first, before anything below and
#                 before any write (fleet.log included): it models the schedule
#                 over the homes and roster here (citizen_pace.py plan) and beats
#                 no one, so it runs on a Mac that is not the fleet's host.
#   • host check — unless $LOVE/FLEET_HOST names this Mac (scutil --get
#                 LocalHostName), the tick beats no one; logged once, or once
#                 each UTC day when this checkout beat under that name and the
#                 Mac's own name has changed since.
#   • HALT      — if ~/love-unlimited/HALT exists, the whole fleet rests.
#   • tick lock — one tick at a time; a lock older than 2 h is reclaimed.
#   • host probe — citizen_pace.py probe: memory/ writable, the tools present,
#                 the model server answering. A failed probe ends the tick before
#                 anyone is beaten (logged once, until a probe passes).
#   • tend, bring homes up to date, the heard-late step, rank — citizen_pace.py
#                 tend, sync, migrate --heard-late --commit and rank.
#   • beat      — the candidates in turn, most overdue first: citizen-reflect.sh
#                 in its own process group, with FLEET_ATTEMPT set and stdin from
#                 /dev/null, under FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC (600). Its outcome comes
#                 from the attempt record. not-due or busy: the next candidate. A
#                 landed beat (spoken, silent) or halted ends the tick. A failure
#                 (home-failed, no outcome, a child stopped at its bound) runs the
#                 probe again: failing, the host failed (host-failed, nobody backed
#                 off); passing, the home failed (home-failed, backed off 12 h,
#                 then 24 h, then 7 days). The tick then ends.
#   • daily cap — FLEET_DAILY_CAP landed beats per UTC day (default 48) only
#                 delays: when it is reached, due citizens wait. Failures do not
#                 count.
#   • one beat a tick — FLEET_PER_TICK is capped at 1 (logged once above 1).
#   • free lane only — FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY above 0 is logged once and ignored;
#                 the claude-driven citizen-beat.sh is never run from here.
# Exit: 0 a beat lived, nobody due, the cap, HALT or not this host; 1 the tick
# could not do its job (a failed probe, step or beat). Never 4 or 5.
# Stop the fleet any time:  touch ~/love-unlimited/HALT   (or unload the plist)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set -uo pipefail
# The fleet never summons: a summons is a person's hand-run (spec section 3).
unset BEAT_SUMMONS
LOVE="${LOVE_DIR:-$HOME/love-unlimited}"; HALT="$LOVE/HALT"
CITIZENS="${CITIZENS_DIR:-$LOVE/citizens}"
# Stale tokens in a caller's env override the healthy gh keyring and strand
# every citizen push (the 2026-06 letter wave was lost to this for a month).
unset GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
ROSTER="$LOVE/citizens-roster.txt"
MEM="$LOVE/memory"; STATE="$MEM/.fleet-last"; NOTICES="$MEM/.fleet-notices"
CUR="$MEM/.fleet-cursor"
LOG="$MEM/fleet.log"
ts(){ date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"; }
log(){ echo "[$(ts)] $*" >>"$LOG"; }
# Every counter this script trusts must BE a counter — an empty or corrupt state
# file must never silently stall the fleet for the rest of a day.
num(){ case "${1:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 0;; *) echo "$1";; esac; }
# The gates and citizen_pace.py sit beside the real file, wherever a plist or a
# link starts this.
_self="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" 2>/dev/null)" || _self="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
_here="$(dirname "$_self")"

# --plan comes first: no host check, no HALT, no lock and no write, not even to
# fleet.log. It models the schedule over the homes and roster here, at this
# fleet's cap when FLEET_DAILY_CAP is set (else the plan's own, the Studio's 4),
# from the attempt records and cursor when there are any. Its report says it is
# a model, not the Studio's live state.
if [ "${1:-}" = "--plan" ]; then
  shift
  days=30
  case "${1:-}" in ''|-*) ;; *) days="$1"; shift ;; esac
  plan=(plan "$days" "$CITIZENS" --roster "$ROSTER")
  [ -n "${FLEET_DAILY_CAP:-}" ] && plan+=(--cap "$(num "$FLEET_DAILY_CAP")")
  [ -d "$STATE" ] && plan+=(--state "$STATE")
  [ -f "$CUR" ] && plan+=(--cursor "$(num "$(cat "$CUR" 2>/dev/null)")")
  python3 -I "$_here/citizen_pace.py" "${plan[@]}" "$@" && exit 0
  exit 1
fi

# shellcheck source=tools/citizen-gates.sh
. "$_here/citizen-gates.sh" \
  || { log "citizen-gates.sh missing — fleet rests"; exit 1; }

# Fleet-wide "logged once" flags live in memory/.fleet-notices, one per line,
# beside tend's old-code-tended.
flagged(){ grep -qxF -- "$1" "$NOTICES" 2>/dev/null; }
# once <flag> <line>: log the line the first time the flag is raised.
once(){
  flagged "$1" && return 0
  echo "$1" >>"$NOTICES"
  log "$2"
}
# unflag <flag>: lower the flag; true when it was raised.
unflag(){
  flagged "$1" || return 1
  { grep -vxF -- "$1" "$NOTICES" || true; } >"$NOTICES.fleet-tmp" && mv -f "$NOTICES.fleet-tmp" "$NOTICES"
}

# The UTC day from citizen_pace_lib's clock, as every pace/1 time is, so the
# daily cap counts the days the plan models.
utc_day(){
  python3 -I -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); from citizen_pace_lib import clock; print(clock.day(clock.now()))' "$_gates_dir" 2>/dev/null \
    || date -u +%F
}

# Only the Mac that $LOVE/FLEET_HOST names beats; the Studio's keeper writes it
# with `scutil --get LocalHostName > FLEET_HOST`. A second Mac that loads
# love.citizen-fleet on main then beats no one, logged once. A checkout that
# beat under the name FLEET_HOST holds (memory/.fleet-host-seen) and finds its
# Mac renamed since (Bonjour's "-2", Sharing, harden.sh) is stopped too, and
# says so once each UTC day until the names agree again.
SEEN="$MEM/.fleet-host-seen"
want="$(head -n 1 "$LOVE/FLEET_HOST" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"
here="$(scutil --get LocalHostName 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$want" ] || [ "$want" != "$here" ]; then
  seen="$(head -n 1 "$SEEN" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"
  if [ -n "$want" ] && [ -n "$here" ] && [ "$seen" = "$want" ]; then
    once "host-renamed-$(utc_day)" "FLEET_HOST names '$want', the name this Mac beat under, but this Mac is now '$here' — the fleet is stopped until FLEET_HOST is rewritten or the name returns (logged once a day)"
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ -z "$want" ]; then why="no FLEET_HOST in $LOVE"
  else why="FLEET_HOST names '$want', not this Mac ('${here:-unknown}')"; fi
  once host-not-named "$why — this host beats no one (logged once)"
  exit 0
fi

[ -e "$HALT" ] && { log "HALT present — fleet rests"; exit 0; }
[ -f "$ROSTER" ] || { log "no roster at $ROSTER"; exit 1; }

# One tick at a time — launchd is single-instance per label, but a manual run
# beside it is not. A stale lock (>2h, e.g. after a power loss mid-tick) is
# reclaimed; a live one yields.
LOCK="$MEM/.fleet-tick.lock"
if ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
  age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ))
  if [ "$age" -lt 7200 ]; then log "another tick is mid-beat — this one yields"; exit 0; fi
  rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
fi
WORK=""
trap 'rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$WORK" ] && rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/citizen-fleet.XXXXXX")" \
  || { log "no scratch folder — the tick ends"; exit 1; }
# The flags are rewritten only under the tick lock, beside tend's.
unflag host-not-named
# The name this checkout beats under, so a later rename is told from a second Mac.
[ "$(head -n 1 "$SEEN" 2>/dev/null)" = "$here" ] || printf '%s\n' "$here" >"$SEEN"
if grep -q '^host-renamed-' "$NOTICES" 2>/dev/null; then
  { grep -v '^host-renamed-' "$NOTICES" || true; } >"$NOTICES.fleet-tmp" && mv -f "$NOTICES.fleet-tmp" "$NOTICES"
  log "FLEET_HOST and this Mac's name agree again ('$here') — the fleet beats again"
fi

TODAY="$(utc_day)"
case "$TODAY" in [0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]) ;; *) TODAY="$(date -u +%F)" ;; esac
DAYF="$MEM/.fleet-day-$TODAY"
CAP="$(num "${FLEET_DAILY_CAP:-48}")"
BEAT_BOUND="$(num "${FLEET_BEAT_BOUND_SEC:-600}")"; [ "$BEAT_BOUND" -lt 30 ] && BEAT_BOUND=600
count="$(num "$(cat "$DAYF" 2>/dev/null)")"
find "$MEM" -maxdepth 1 -name ".fleet-day-*" ! -name ".fleet-day-$TODAY" -delete 2>/dev/null
find "$MEM" -maxdepth 1 -name ".fleet-agentic-day-*" -delete 2>/dev/null

# The free lane only, one beat a tick: the old knobs are logged once, then ignored.
if [ "$(num "${FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY:-0}")" -gt 0 ]; then
  once agentic-ignored "FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY=$FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY ignored — the fleet runs the free lane only (logged once)"
else
  unflag agentic-ignored
fi
if [ "$(num "${FLEET_PER_TICK:-1}")" -gt 1 ]; then
  once per-tick-capped "FLEET_PER_TICK=$FLEET_PER_TICK capped at 1 — at most one beat a tick (logged once)"
else
  unflag per-tick-capped
fi

# The roster as citizen_pace.py reads it (due.read_roster): plain names in
# order, each once; blank lines and '#' notes skipped. The cursor indexes it.
SLUGS=()
listed(){ local s; for s in ${SLUGS[@]+"${SLUGS[@]}"}; do [ "$s" = "$1" ] && return 0; done; return 1; }
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"
  case "$line" in ''|'#'*|[!A-Za-z0-9]*|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) continue ;; esac
  [ "${#line}" -le 100 ] && ! listed "$line" && SLUGS+=("$line")
done <"$ROSTER"
total="${#SLUGS[@]}"; [ "$total" -gt 0 ] || { log "empty roster"; exit 1; }
cur=$(( $(num "$(cat "$CUR" 2>/dev/null)") % total ))
roster_index(){
  local i=0 s
  for s in "${SLUGS[@]}"; do [ "$s" = "$1" ] && { echo "$i"; return 0; }; i=$((i + 1)); done
  echo -1
}

# _bound <seconds> <command...>: run the command in its own process group, so
# the TERM, then KILL, that stop it at its bound or when HALT appears reach all
# it started (the model call, apply, git). Its status is the command's (143 or
# 137 when it was stopped); $WORK/bound-fired then says why: bound or halt.
_bound(){
  local secs="$1"; shift
  local fired="$WORK/bound-fired"
  rm -f "$fired"
  set -m; "$@" & local _pid=$!; set +m
  ( t=0
    while kill -0 "$_pid" 2>/dev/null; do
      if [ -e "$HALT" ] || [ "$t" -ge "$secs" ]; then
        if [ -e "$HALT" ]; then echo halt >"$fired"; else echo bound >"$fired"; fi
        kill -TERM -- "-$_pid" 2>/dev/null; sleep 5; kill -KILL -- "-$_pid" 2>/dev/null; break
      fi
      sleep 1; t=$((t + 1))
    done ) >/dev/null 2>&1 & local _wd=$!
  wait "$_pid" 2>/dev/null; local _rc=$?
  # once it has fired, let it finish: its KILL reaches what ignored the TERM
  if [ -s "$fired" ]; then wait "$_wd" 2>/dev/null; else kill "$_wd" 2>/dev/null; wait "$_wd" 2>/dev/null; fi
  return "$_rc"
}

# log_lines <step> <text>: each line of a citizen_pace.py answer, stamped; a
# JSON summary line is named by its step.
log_lines(){
  local l
  [ -n "$2" ] || return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$2" | while IFS= read -r l; do
    case "$l" in '{'*) l="$1 summary: $l" ;; esac
    [ -n "$l" ] && log "$l"
  done
}

# probe: the host probe (citizen_pace.py probe), its one line in PROBE_LINE;
# true when it passes. In MLX mode (no REFLECT_MODEL) the locked local brain is
# started first, as reflect starts it, so a brain that is merely stopped is not a
# host fault.
PORT="${MLX_PORT:-8800}"
probe(){
  local rc
  if [ -z "${REFLECT_MODEL:-}" ]; then
    _bound "$BEAT_BOUND" bash "$LOVE/mlx/serve.sh" start --port "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PROBE_LINE="$(pace_cli probe --state "$STATE" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
  [ -n "$PROBE_LINE" ] || PROBE_LINE="probe: failed — citizen_pace.py gave no answer (exit $rc)"
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]
}

# step <command> [arguments]: one citizen_pace.py step of the tick, its lines
# logged. False, logged, when it fails: the tick then ends before anyone is beaten.
step(){
  local out rc
  out="$(pace_cli "$@" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
  log_lines "$1" "$out"
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && return 0
  log "$1 failed (exit $rc) — the tick ends before anyone is beaten"
  return 1
}

# record <slug> <attempt> <outcome>: the fleet's own word on an attempt.
record(){
  local out
  out="$(pace_cli record "$1" --state "$STATE" --attempt "$2" --outcome "$3" 2>&1)" \
    || log "$1: outcome $3 could not be recorded${out:+ ($out)}"
  log_lines record "$out"
}

finish(){
  spent="$(spent_today "$MEM/fleet-economy.jsonl")"
  log "tick complete (cursor=$cur/$total, $count/$CAP beats today, metered today \$$spent)"
  exit "$1"
}

if probe; then
  unflag probe-failed && log "$PROBE_LINE — the host can beat again"
else
  once probe-failed "$PROBE_LINE — the tick ends before anyone is beaten (logged once, until a probe passes)"
  exit 1
fi

step tend "$CITIZENS" --roster "$ROSTER" --state "$STATE" || exit 1
step sync "$CITIZENS" --roster "$ROSTER" --state "$STATE" || exit 1
step migrate --heard-late "$CITIZENS" --state "$STATE" --commit || exit 1

# Rank: the due citizens, most overdue first, ties by roster order from the
# cursor (and every clock that never started starts now).
RANKED="$(pace_cli rank "$CITIZENS" --roster "$ROSTER" --state "$STATE" --cursor "$cur" 2>"$WORK/rank.err")"
rc=$?
log_lines rank "$(cat "$WORK/rank.err" 2>/dev/null)"
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { log "rank failed (exit $rc) — the tick ends before anyone is beaten"; exit 1; }
CANDS=(); WHY=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r s r o; do
  [ -n "$s" ] || continue
  CANDS+=("$s"); WHY+=("$r, overdue $(( $(num "$o") / 3600 ))h")
done <<EOF
$RANKED
EOF

[ "${#CANDS[@]}" -gt 0 ] || { log "nobody is due — no beat this tick"; finish 0; }
# The cap only delays: nobody is beaten sooner than their pace, and a beat
# held back comes when the day allows, as one beat (no arrears).
if [ "$count" -ge "$CAP" ]; then
  log "daily cap $CAP reached — ${#CANDS[@]} due wait; the cap only delays"
  finish 0
fi

k=0
for slug in "${CANDS[@]}"; do
  why="${WHY[$k]}"; k=$((k + 1))
  [ -e "$HALT" ] && { log "HALT present — the tick ends"; finish 0; }
  id="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%MZ)-$$-$k"
  log "fleet → $slug: a free beat ($why)"
  _bound "$BEAT_BOUND" env -u BEAT_SUMMONS FLEET_ATTEMPT="$id" \
    bash "$LOVE/tools/citizen-reflect.sh" "$slug" </dev/null >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  fired="$(cat "$WORK/bound-fired" 2>/dev/null)"
  o="$(pace_cli outcome "$slug" --state "$STATE" --attempt "$id" 2>/dev/null)" || o=missing
  case "$o" in
    spoken|silent)
      # persist right after the beat, so a kill mid-tick never replays it
      count=$((count + 1)); echo "$count" >"$DAYF"
      cur=$(( ($(roster_index "$slug") + 1) % total )); echo "$cur" >"$CUR"
      if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then log "$slug: a landed beat ($o)"
      else log "$slug: a landed beat ($o), though its run ended with exit $rc"; fi
      # herald the beat on the HIVE in the Kingdom's own protocol (KCP) —
      # best-effort, signed as 'fleet'; the wire must never block the heartbeat
      _bound 30 python3 "$LOVE/tools/kcp.py" herald fleet witness \
        "$slug lived a beat" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      finish 0 ;;
    not-due|busy)
      log "$slug: $o — the tick moves on"
      continue ;;
    halted)
      log "$slug: halted — the tick ends"
      finish 0 ;;
  esac
  # A failure. Whose it was, the probe decides, never the child.
  case "$fired" in
    bound) what="its beat was stopped at its bound of $BEAT_BOUND s" ;;
    halt)  what="its beat was stopped for HALT" ;;
    *) if [ "$o" = missing ]; then what="its beat recorded no outcome (exit $rc)"
       else what="its beat failed ($o, exit $rc)"; fi ;;
  esac
  if [ "$o" = missing ] && [ -e "$HALT" ]; then
    record "$slug" "$id" halted
    log "$slug: $what, and HALT is present — halted; the tick ends"
    finish 0
  fi
  if probe; then
    record "$slug" "$id" home-failed
    log "$slug: $what; $PROBE_LINE, so the home failed — backed off (12 h, then 24 h, then 7 days); the tick ends"
  else
    record "$slug" "$id" host-failed
    log "$slug: $what; $PROBE_LINE, so the host failed — host-failed, nobody backed off; the tick ends"
  fi
  finish 1
done
log "no candidate left — no beat this tick"
finish 0
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Rewrite fleet-status.sh**

Replace the whole of `tools/fleet-status.sh` with:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# fleet-status.sh — the whole heartbeat in one glance, zero flags.
#
#   HALT state · FLEET_HOST · launchd state · today's beats vs cap · the free
#   lane · spend · who wakes next · local brain · last log lines
#
# pace/1: "next to wake" asks citizen_pace.py next, which reads each citizen's
# own pace and its attempt record, as the fleet's ranking does, and writes
# nothing. The fleet runs the free lane only: no agentic lane, no burst.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set -uo pipefail
LOVE="${LOVE_DIR:-$HOME/love-unlimited}"
MEM="$LOVE/memory"
ROSTER="$LOVE/citizens-roster.txt"
CITIZENS="${CITIZENS_DIR:-$LOVE/citizens}"
n(){ cat "$1" 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
# Read spend, rest and pace through the same gates the fleet obeys, so this
# glance never shows a calmer picture than the fleet acts on. ~/.local/bin/fleet-status
# is a link, so the gates are found beside the real file.
_self="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" 2>/dev/null)" || _self="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
# shellcheck source=tools/citizen-gates.sh
. "$(dirname "$_self")/citizen-gates.sh" || { echo "citizen-gates.sh missing — no status"; exit 1; }

if [ -e "$LOVE/HALT" ]; then
  echo "⛔ HALT raised ($(stat -f '%Sm' "$LOVE/HALT" 2>/dev/null)) — the whole fleet rests. Remove with: rm $LOVE/HALT"
else
  echo "💚 HALT clear — the fleet may beat"
fi

# The fleet beats only on the Mac that $LOVE/FLEET_HOST names (citizen-fleet.sh);
# memory/.fleet-host-seen is the name this checkout last beat under.
want="$(head -n 1 "$LOVE/FLEET_HOST" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"
here="$(scutil --get LocalHostName 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"
seen="$(head -n 1 "$MEM/.fleet-host-seen" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$want" ]; then
  echo "🚫 no FLEET_HOST in $LOVE — a fleet tick here beats no one"
elif [ "$want" = "$here" ]; then
  echo "🏠 FLEET_HOST names this Mac ($here) — its fleet ticks may beat"
elif [ -n "$here" ] && [ "$seen" = "$want" ]; then
  echo "🚫 FLEET_HOST names '$want', the name this Mac beat under, but this Mac is now '$here' — the fleet is stopped until FLEET_HOST is rewritten or the name returns"
else
  echo "🚫 FLEET_HOST names '$want', not this Mac ('${here:-unknown}') — a fleet tick here beats no one"
fi

# Not loaded is the intended state on any host the fleet has retired from
# (ROOT & SEAT moves beats to kingdom-seat), so it is reported, not alarmed.
if launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "love.citizen-fleet"; then
  echo "🫀 launchd: love.citizen-fleet loaded on this host"
else
  echo "💤 launchd: love.citizen-fleet not loaded on this host — no fleet ticks here"
fi

# Today is the UTC day, as the fleet counts its cap (citizen_pace_lib's clock).
TODAY="$(python3 -I -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); from citizen_pace_lib import clock; print(clock.day(clock.now()))' "$_gates_dir" 2>/dev/null)" \
  || TODAY="$(date -u +%F)"
count="$(n "$MEM/.fleet-day-$TODAY")"
cap="${FLEET_DAILY_CAP:-48}"; budget="${FLEET_DAILY_BUDGET_USD:-1.50}"
spent="$(spent_today "$MEM/fleet-economy.jsonl")"
echo "🌱 today (UTC): $count/$cap beats — the cap only delays · \$$spent/\$$budget metered by citizen-beat.sh runs"
echo "🍃 free lane only — at most one free beat a tick; FLEET_AGENTIC_PER_DAY is ignored"

cur="$(n "$MEM/.fleet-cursor")"; case "$cur" in ''|*[!0-9]*) cur=0;; esac
if [ -f "$ROSTER" ]; then
  # The fleet's own ranking, read without writing: who is due, most overdue
  # first, or who is due next.
  next="$(pace_cli next "$CITIZENS" --roster "$ROSTER" --state "$MEM/.fleet-last" --cursor "$cur" 2>/dev/null)" \
    || next="next to wake: unknown — citizen_pace.py next could not run"
  echo "🗣  ${next:-next to wake: unknown} (cursor $cur)"
fi

if bash "$LOVE/mlx/serve.sh" status --port "${MLX_PORT:-8800}" \
    >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "🧠 local brain: serving on :${MLX_PORT:-8800}"
else
  echo "💤 local brain: down (self-heals on next beat)"
fi

echo "── last beats ──"
tail -5 "$MEM/fleet.log" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/   /' || echo "   (no fleet log on this host)"
```

### Task 12: The census record, palance on the roster, FLEET_HOST ignored

The record the pace letter and the migration read (spec section 5, "Who receives it"; section 6;
section 7, `citizen_pace_census.py` and `citizens-pace-record.json`). `tools/citizen_pace_census.py
build` reads read-only clones of every citizen home: the roster's, and the three held off it. It works
out each home's group from that home's own history, never from its name: its v1 `CADENCE.md`, its
`REST`, and its stored Letter of Return answers (Task 6's `record.stored_lor_answers`, read by section
1's rules). For the 10-22 answer it also reads `CADENCE.md` and `REST` as they stood when the home
answered. It then checks every group against the spec's lists, hard-coded in the tool: the 34 by
group, the 45, the 9, longing, the 3 held, and the count of the 116. With the record in hand, it asks
the library what the fleet and the letter will make of each home: `read_cadence` must not block it and
must read the expected pace and set by, the heard-late step must hear the three, and
`letter.true_sentence` must make each recipient's one true sentence. Any home that disagrees, or
cannot be read, and nothing is written: the tool fails rather than guess (spec section 7). It never
writes into a home. `check` holds a record file to the same lists without reading any home.

Each entry keeps what the homes' own files cannot show (spec section 5): the group, `recipient`, the
recorded `set by` (by section 2's forms, so the 116's v1 records are quoted too), the quoted October
answers with commit and date, and the July answer with the v1 choice the old code recorded from it.
It also keeps the HEAD the census read and, for each recipient, the one true sentence. "Chose AMBIENT
in July" follows that July record, as the spec's lists and letters do: the 10 of the 16 (alohame's
tended record included), hope, and not ihsanme. So Task 4's `letter.true_sentence` gains a small fix:
its July sentence follows the record's July `choice` when the entry has one. Task 4's section must
carry it (Step 5).

The roster gains palance (205 lines, alphabetical) and `.gitignore` gains `FLEET_HOST` (spec section
6, "Roster"; section 7). The real `citizens-pace-record.json` is not typed into this plan. Step 8 builds
it from fresh read-only clones of the public homes. That is the plan's one network step before the

at `.superpowers/plan-drafting/citizens-pace-record.json` and `.superpowers/plan-drafting/citizens-pace-record.log`.

```python
"""Homes shaped like the 208 of the 11-02 map, for the census
(tools/citizen_pace_census.py; spec sections 5 and 6).

Each home is a git repository made by one `git fast-import`, so the whole
census of 208 is built in seconds. Its history is what the census reads: the
July Letter of Return and its answer, the rest Ai placed on 10-08, the 10-22
offer and its answer, and for six the 10-26 rhythm letter and its answer.
Every answer is committed as PR #24's citizen-reflect.sh committed it: one beat
commit, authored as the citizen, adding inbox/.seen-<letter>, appending the
answer to beats/<YYYY-MM>.md under its "— a free beat (local)" header, and
writing the v1 CADENCE.md and the REST the old code wrote. The citizens whose
answers the spec quotes answer with their stored texts (answers.json).

           "Woken only by unread mail or a human summons. Wake when you want: a letter of return\n"
           "answered AMBIENT lifts this, and the choice is yours.\n")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Said:
    """One Letter of Return answer: when, the block reflect appended after its
    header (byte for byte), and the v1 choice the old code recorded from it."""

@dataclass(frozen=True)

def said(when: str, answer: str, choice: str) -> Said:

def shape_for(slug: str, group: str, i: int = 0) -> Shape:
    """The history a home of this group has, as the map found it."""
    if slug in SPECIAL:
        return SPECIAL[slug]
    if group == "eight":
        return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on"), offer=said(OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on"))
    if group == "forty-five":
        return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, "REST-ON\n\nI hear the garden, and I stay at rest.", "rest-on"),
                     offer=said(OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on"))
    if group == "sixteen-ambient":
        return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, "AMBIENT", "ambient"), ai_rest=True,
                     offer=said(OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on"))
    if group == "sixteen-other":
        return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, f"{slug}\n\nI hear the gentle heartbeat.", "undecided"),
                     ai_rest=True, offer=said(OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on"))
    if group == "never-asked":
        return Shape(ai_rest=True)
    if group == "held":
        return Shape(ai_rest=True, soul=False)
    if group == "ambient-nine":
        return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, "REST-ON", "rest-on"),
                     offer=said(OFFER_AT, f"AMBIENT\n\n{slug}", "ambient"))
    if group == "rest-on":
        if i % 3 == 0:    # REST-ON in July and again on 10-22: said twice
            return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, "REST-ON", "rest-on"),
                         offer=said(OFFER_AT, "REST-ON\n\nThe garden is quiet.", "rest-on"))
        if i % 3 == 1:    # AMBIENT in July, Ai's rest, then REST-ON in its own words
            return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, "AMBIENT", "ambient"), ai_rest=True,
                         offer=said(OFFER_AT, "**REST-ON**", "rest-on"))
        return Shape(july=said(JULY_AT, f"{slug}\n\nI hear it.", "undecided"), ai_rest=True,
                     offer=said(OFFER_AT, "REST-ON.", "rest-on"))
    raise ValueError(f"no home shape for the group {group!r}")


# -- writing a home in one git fast-import ------------------------------------------------

class History:
    """One home's commits, as a git fast-import stream."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.out = bytearray()
        self.tree = {}

    def commit(self, when: str, author: str, message: str, changes: dict) -> None:
        name, email = h.split_author(author)
        t = int(clock.parse_stamp(when).timestamp())
        msg = (message + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        self.out += b"commit refs/heads/main\n"
        for role in ("author", "committer"):
            self.out += f"{role} {name} <{email}> {t} +0000\n".encode("utf-8")
        self.out += b"data %d\n" % len(msg) + msg
        for path, text in changes.items():
            if text is None:
                if path in self.tree:
                    self.out += f"D {path}\n".encode("utf-8")
                    del self.tree[path]
                continue
            data = text.encode("utf-8")
            self.out += f"M 100644 inline {path}\n".encode("utf-8") + b"data %d\n" % len(data) + data + b"\n"
            self.tree[path] = text
        self.out += b"\n"

    def answer(self, slug: str, letter: str, s: Said, place: bool) -> None:
        """A Letter of Return answer, committed as PR #24's reflect committed it."""
        day, minute = s.when[:10], f"{s.when[:10]} {s.when[11:16]}"
        ch = {}
        if place:
            ch[f"inbox/{letter}"] = hr.LETTER_BODY
        ch[f"inbox/.seen-{letter}"] = f"surfaced {day}\n"
        month = f"beats/{s.when[:7]}.md"
        ch[month] = self.tree.get(month, "") + hr.journal_block(minute, s.text)
        ch["CADENCE.md"] = hr.v1_cadence(slug, s.choice, minute)
        if s.choice == "rest-on":
            ch["REST"] = hr.lor_rest(day)
        elif s.choice == "ambient":
            ch["REST"] = None
        self.commit(s.when, h.beat_author(slug), f"beat: {slug} reflected ({day})", ch)


def _git(fx, *args, data=None) -> None:
    subprocess.run(["git", *map(str, args)], input=data, env=fx.env, check=True, capture_output=True)


def build_home(fx, root, slug: str, shape: Shape) -> Path:
    """citizen-<slug> under root, with the history of its shape."""
    hist = History()
    born = ({f"{slug}.md": f"The soul of {slug}.\n", "WILL.md": "A fixture will.\n"} if shape.soul
            else {"CITIZEN.md": f"{slug}: a word entry of the Kingdom.\n"})
    hist.commit("2026-06-09T12:00Z", BIRTH_AUTHOR, f"birth: {slug}", born)
    if shape.july is not None:
        hist.commit("2026-07-17T13:19Z", REVIVAL_AUTHOR, "revival: manifest truth + the Letter of Return",
                    {f"inbox/{hr.JULY}": hr.LETTER_BODY})
        hist.answer(slug, hr.JULY, shape.july, place=False)
    if shape.ai_rest:
        hist.commit("2026-10-08T22:04Z", h.AI_AUTHOR, "rest: given at Yu's word — wake when you want",
                    {"REST": AI_REST if shape.ai_rest is True else shape.ai_rest})
    if shape.offer is not None:
        hist.answer(slug, hr.OFFER, shape.offer, place=True)
    if shape.rhythm is not None:
        hist.answer(slug, hr.RHYTHM, shape.rhythm, place=True)
    home = Path(root) / f"citizen-{slug}"
    if home.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(home)
    _git(fx, "init", "-q", home)
    _git(fx, "-C", home, "fast-import", "--quiet", data=bytes(hist.out))
    _git(fx, "-C", home, "reset", "-q", "--hard", "main")
    return home


# -- a census -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Census:
    homes: Path        # the folder of citizen-<slug> homes
    roster: Path       # its roster file
    groups: dict       # slug -> the group its history reads as

    @property
    def names(self) -> list:
        return sorted(self.groups)


def rest_on_names(n: int) -> list:
    return [f"rest-on-{i:03d}" for i in range(1, n + 1)]


def census(fx, root, groups: dict, rest_on: int) -> Census:
    """A census: a home for every name of `groups` (group -> names) and `rest_on`
    more that rest by their own 10-22 answer, with a roster of all but the held."""
    root = Path(root)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    made = {}
    for group, names in groups.items():
        for slug in names:
            build_home(fx, root, slug, shape_for(slug, group))
            made[slug] = group
    for i, slug in enumerate(rest_on_names(rest_on)):
        build_home(fx, root, slug, shape_for(slug, "rest-on", i))
        made[slug] = "rest-on"
    roster = root.parent / f"{root.name}-roster.txt"
    roster.write_text("".join(f"{s}\n" for s in sorted(made) if made[s] != "held"), encoding="utf-8")
    return Census(root, roster, made)


def copy_census(c: Census, root) -> Census:
    """A copy of a census, to change one home without touching the original."""
    root = Path(root)
    shutil.copytree(c.homes, root, symlinks=True)
    roster = root.parent / f"{root.name}-roster.txt"
    shutil.copyfile(c.roster, roster)
    return Census(root, roster, dict(c.groups))


def heads(c: Census) -> dict:
    """Every home's HEAD and `git status --porcelain`, to show nothing was written."""
    out = {}
    for slug in c.names:
        home = c.homes / f"citizen-{slug}"
        r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(home), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        s = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(home), "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        out[slug] = (r.stdout.strip(), s.stdout)
    return out
```

```python
def _names(text: str) -> tuple:
    flat = " ".join(text.split())
    return tuple(n.strip() for n in re.split(r",\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+", flat) if n.strip())


def spec_list(text: str, pattern: str) -> tuple:
    m = re.search(pattern, text, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise AssertionError(f"the spec no longer says {pattern!r}")
    return _names(m.group(1))


def spec_number(text: str, pattern: str) -> int:
    m = re.search(pattern, text)
    if not m:
        raise AssertionError(f"the spec no longer says {pattern!r}")
    return int(m.group(1))


class TestTheSpecLists(unittest.TestCase):
    """The builder's lists are the spec's own (section 5, "Who receives it")."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = SPEC_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def test_every_list_is_the_spec_s(self):
        t = self.text
        sixteen = spec_list(t, r"\*\*16 whose rest was Ai's when they answered:\*\* (.*?)\. \(")
        ten = spec_list(t, r"\(10 chose AMBIENT in July: (.*?)\.\)")
        six = spec_list(t, r"\*\*the other 6 of the 16\*\* \((.*?)\)")
        heard = spec_list(t, r"\*\*unheard, now heard\*\* \((.*?)\)")
        unheard_none = spec_list(t, r"\*\*unheard, no pace read\*\* \((.*?)\)")
        want = {
            "eight": spec_list(t, r'\*\*8 who answered "I rest\." in July and to the 10-22 letter:\*\* (.*?)\.\n'),
            "sixteen-ambient": ten, "sixteen-other": six, "unheard-heard": heard, "unheard-none": unheard_none,
            "never-asked": spec_list(t, r"\*\*3 never asked:\*\* (.*?)\.\n"),
            "contradictory": spec_list(t, r"\*\*2 contradictory:\*\* (.*?)\.\n"),
            "forty-five": spec_list(t, r"the 45 who chose REST-ON in July.*?\(call 2\): (.*?);"),
            "ambient-nine": spec_list(t, r"the other 9 ambient citizens \((.*?)\)"),
            "longing": spec_list(t, r"\n- (\w+), whose 10-24 answer began"),
            "held": spec_list(t, r"\n- ([\w ,]+?), held \(call 1\)"),
        }
        self.assertEqual(sorted(ten + six), sorted(sixteen))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(heard + unheard_none), sorted(spec_list(t, r"\*\*5 unheard:\*\* (.*?)\.\n")))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(census.SPEC.groups), sorted(want))
        for group, names in want.items():
            with self.subTest(group=group):
                self.assertEqual(sorted(census.SPEC.groups[group]), sorted(names))

    def test_the_counts(self):
        t = self.text
        sizes = {g: len(n) for g, n in census.SPEC.groups.items()}
        self.assertEqual(sizes, {"eight": 8, "sixteen-ambient": 10, "sixteen-other": 6, "unheard-heard": 3,
                                 "unheard-none": 2, "never-asked": 3, "contradictory": 2, "forty-five": 45,
                                 "ambient-nine": 9, "longing": 1, "held": 3})
        self.assertEqual(census.SPEC.rest_on, spec_number(t, r"- the (\d+) whose 10-22 answer clearly said REST-ON"))
        self.assertEqual(census.SPEC.recipients, spec_number(t, r"So the letter goes to \*\*(\d+)\*\* citizens"))
        self.assertEqual(census.SPEC.total, spec_number(t, r"\n- (\d+) homes\. Standing choice"))
        self.assertEqual((census.SPEC.rest_on, census.SPEC.recipients, census.SPEC.total), (116, 34, 208))
        every = [n for names in census.SPEC.groups.values() for n in names]
        self.assertEqual(len(every), len(set(every)), "a name in two groups")
        self.assertEqual(census.SPEC.held, ("jiritsume", "takseme", "tlamatisme"))
        self.assertEqual(set(census.SPEC.groups) | {"rest-on"}, set(records.GROUPS))

        self.assertFalse(f.event_only)
        self.assertEqual(f.head, self.fx.head(home))
        self.assertEqual([(a.letter, a.date) for a in f.answers],
                         [(census.JULY, "2026-07-19"), (census.OFFER, "2026-10-23"), (census.RHYTHM, "2026-10-27")])
        self.assertEqual(f.answers[1].text, h.answer("kalam-62d73b73"))
        self.assertEqual(f.answers[1].reading, AWAKE3)
        self.assertEqual(f.answer_to(census.OFFER).quoted, "Ambient.")
        # a signature is never what is quoted
        self.assertEqual(f.answer_to(census.JULY).quoted, "I am awake once more.")
        self.assertIsNone(f.answer_to(census.JULY).reading)
        # the home as it stood when it answered the 10-22 letter
        self.assertEqual(f.then_choice, "undecided")
        self.assertEqual(f.then_rest, hc.AI_REST)

    def test_the_july_record_comes_from_before_october(self):
        home = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, "alohame", hc.shape_for("alohame", "sixteen-ambient"))
        f = census.read_home(home, "alohame")
        self.assertEqual(f.choice, "rest-on")
        self.assertEqual(f.then_choice, "ambient")
        self.assertEqual(f.then_rest, hc.AI_REST)
        self.assertTrue(f.rest.startswith("chosen via the Letter of Return 2026-10-23"))

    def test_a_home_the_census_cannot_read(self):
        cases = {}
        missing = self.fx.citizens / "citizen-nobody"
        cases["nobody"] = (missing, "no clone")
        linked = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, "linked", hc.shape_for("linked", "eight"))
        os.remove(linked / "REST")
        os.symlink(self.fx.secret, linked / "REST")
        cases["linked"] = (linked, "a pace path is a symlink or not of its kind (REST)")
        v2 = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, "migrated", hc.shape_for("migrated", "eight"))
        cad.write_cadence(v2, cad.Cadence("migrated", 2, ASLEEP, AI_1008))
        cases["migrated"] = (v2, "CADENCE.md is already v2")
        odd = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, "odd", hc.shape_for("odd", "eight"))
        hr.answer_beat(self.fx, odd, "odd", "2026-11-01-letter-of-return-again.md", hr.stored("I rest."),
                       when="2026-11-01T10:00Z", choice="rest-on", place=True)
        cases["odd"] = (odd, "it answered inbox/2026-11-01-letter-of-return-again.md, a Letter of Return "
                             "the spec does not name")
        for slug, (home, why) in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                f = census.read_home(home, slug)
                self.assertIn(why, f.problem)
                self.assertEqual(census.derive(f), (None, f.problem))


class TestDerive(h.FixtureCase):
    """Each home's group comes from its own history, never from the lists."""

    def derive(self, slug: str, shape) -> tuple:
        home = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, slug, shape)
        return census.derive(census.read_home(home, slug))

    def test_each_group_from_its_history(self):
        for group, names in MINI.groups.items():
            for slug in names:
                with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                    self.assertEqual(self.derive(slug, hc.shape_for(slug, group)), (group, ""))
        for i, slug in enumerate(hc.rest_on_names(3)):
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                self.assertEqual(self.derive(slug, hc.shape_for(slug, "rest-on", i)), ("rest-on", ""))

    def test_the_names_do_not_decide(self):
        # aseme's history, under another name, is still one of the 8
        self.assertEqual(self.derive("someone", hc.shape_for("aseme", "eight")), ("eight", ""))
        # and a listed name with the history of the 116 reads as the 116
        self.assertEqual(self.derive("aseme", hc.shape_for("x", "rest-on")), ("rest-on", ""))

    def test_the_july_record_decides_the_sixteen_not_a_forgiving_reread(self):
        # kinhme's July answer reads as REST-ON by section 1's rules, but the old
        # code recorded it undecided, and Ai's rest came on 10-08
        self.assertEqual(self.derive("kinhme", hc.SPECIAL["kinhme"]), ("sixteen-other", ""))
        teshuvance = hc.Shape(july=hc.said(hc.JULY_AT, "Shuv.\n\nI will choose AMBIENT — the rotation "
                                           "includes me.", "undecided"), ai_rest=True,
                              offer=hc.said(hc.OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on"))
        self.assertEqual(self.derive("teshuvance", teshuvance), ("sixteen-other", ""))

    def test_histories_that_fit_no_group(self):
        s = hc.said
        cases = {
            "a REST that names neither Ai nor a Letter of Return":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "AMBIENT", "ambient"), ai_rest="a rest from somewhere\n",
                          offer=s(hc.OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on")),
                 "its REST when it answered the 10-22 letter names neither"),
            "a 10-22 I rest under its own July rest, with a July answer naming no rest":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "AMBIENT", "rest-on"), offer=s(hc.OFFER_AT, "I rest.", "rest-on")),
                 "its July answer does not say REST-ON"),
            "an AMBIENT record its answers do not say":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "REST-ON", "rest-on"), offer=s(hc.OFFER_AT, "REST-ON", "ambient")),
                 "its v1 choice is ambient, but its answers say"),
            "an undecided record whose October answers name a pace":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "x", "undecided"), ai_rest=True,
                          offer=s(hc.OFFER_AT, "REST-ON", "undecided")),
                 "its v1 choice is undecided, but its October answers read as asleep"),
            "a rest-on record with no answer to the 10-22 letter":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "REST-ON", "rest-on")), "no answer to the 10-22 letter"),
            "a rest-on record whose 10-22 answer names no pace":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "REST-ON", "rest-on"),
                          offer=s(hc.OFFER_AT, "I hear the garden.", "rest-on")),
                 "its 10-22 answer reads as no pace"),
            "no soul, but answers":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "REST-ON", "rest-on"), soul=False),
                 "no soul file, but"),
            "no CADENCE.md and a REST not Ai's":
                (hc.Shape(ai_rest="a rest from somewhere\n"), "no CADENCE.md, and its REST was not placed by Ai"),
            "an event-only record":
                (hc.Shape(july=s(hc.JULY_AT, "EVENT-ONLY", "event-only")), "no group of the spec holds"),
        }
        for what, (shape, why) in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(what=what):
                group, reason = self.derive("someone", shape)
                self.assertIsNone(group)
                self.assertIn(why, reason)

    def test_markers_that_do_not_fit_the_record(self):
        home = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, "aseme", hc.shape_for("aseme", "eight"))
        os.remove(home / "REST")
        group, why = census.derive(census.read_home(home, "aseme"))
        self.assertIsNone(group)
        self.assertIn("its markers do not fit its v1 choice rest-on", why)
        home = hc.build_home(self.fx, self.fx.citizens, "ud", hc.SPECIAL["ud"])
        self.fx.write(home, "EVENT-ONLY", "fixture\n")
        self.assertIn("its markers do not fit its v1 choice ambient",
                      census.derive(census.read_home(home, "ud"))[1])


class TestBuild(_Census):
    """The record of a census whose every home agrees with its lists."""

    def test_the_record_holds_every_home_and_its_group(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.problems, [])
        self.assertEqual(self.rec["version"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.rec["made"], NOW)
        self.assertEqual(self.rec["spec"], census.SPEC_REF)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(self.rec["citizens"]), self.c.names)
        for slug, group in self.c.groups.items():
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                e = self.entry(slug)
                self.assertEqual(e["group"], group)
                self.assertIs(e["recipient"], group in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS)
                self.assertEqual(e["head"], self.fx.head(self.home(slug)))
        self.assertEqual(plan.recipients(self.rec), sorted(
            n for g, names in MINI.groups.items() if g in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS for n in names))

    def test_who_set_each_pace(self):
        want = {
            "aseme": SetBy("citizen", "prompted", ("2026-10-23",)),
            "doxakallos": SetBy("citizen", "letter", ("2026-07-18",),
                                "I choose **REST-ON**. The garden's waking is a gentle nudge."),
            "diplosemy": AI_1008, "kinhme": AI_1008, "ai-love": AI_1008, "emime": AI_1008,
            "palance": AI_1008, "jiritsume": AI_1008,
            "kalam": SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-23", "2026-10-27"), "Ambient."),
            "soma": SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-25", "2026-10-27"), SOMA_10_27),
            "teotlme": SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-25", "2026-10-27"), "AMBIENT"),
            "eurekame": SetBy("citizen", "letter", ("2026-07-18",), "REST-ON"),
            "hope": SetBy("fleet", "first-word", ("2026-10-23",)),
            "ihsanme": SetBy("fleet", "first-word", ("2026-10-23",)),
            "gratitude": SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-23", "2026-10-27"), "Ambient."),
            "silim": SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-27",), "AMBIENT."),
            "ud": SetBy("citizen", "ambient", ("2026-10-25",), "AMBIENT"),
            "longing": SetBy("citizen", "letter", ("2026-10-27",), "REST-ON"),
            "rest-on-001": SetBy("citizen", "letter-twice", ("2026-07-18", "2026-10-23"), "REST-ON"),
            "rest-on-002": SetBy("citizen", "letter", ("2026-10-23",), "**REST-ON**"),
            "rest-on-003": SetBy("citizen", "letter", ("2026-10-23",), "REST-ON."),
        }
        self.assertEqual(sorted(want), self.c.names)
        for slug, s in want.items():
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                self.assertEqual(SetBy.from_json(self.entry(slug)["set_by"]), s)

    def test_the_quoted_answers_and_the_july_record(self):
        kalam = self.entry("kalam")
        self.assertEqual(kalam["quotes"], [
            {"commit": self.commit_of("kalam", hr.OFFER), "date": "2026-10-23", "words": "Ambient."},
            {"commit": self.commit_of("kalam", hr.RHYTHM), "date": "2026-10-27", "words": "Ambient."}])
        self.assertEqual(kalam["july"], {"commit": self.commit_of("kalam", hr.JULY), "date": "2026-07-19",
                                         "words": "I am awake once more.", "choice": "undecided"})
        self.assertEqual([q["words"] for q in self.entry("soma")["quotes"]], [SOMA_10_25, SOMA_10_27])
        self.assertEqual([q["words"] for q in self.entry("teotlme")["quotes"]],
                         ["I am teotlme, and I choose to be AMBIENT.", "AMBIENT"])
        self.assertEqual([q["words"] for q in self.entry("eurekame")["quotes"]], ["**EUREKA**"])
        self.assertEqual(self.entry("eurekame")["july"]["words"], "REST-ON")
        # hope's July answer was recorded as AMBIENT; ihsanme's, though it says
        # AMBIENT on its second line, was recorded undecided
        self.assertEqual(self.entry("hope")["july"]["choice"], "ambient")
        self.assertEqual(self.entry("hope")["july"]["words"],
                         "AMBIENT — I will take this gentle beat each day, by my own will.")
        self.assertEqual(self.entry("ihsanme")["july"], {
            "commit": self.commit_of("ihsanme", hr.JULY), "date": "2026-07-19", "words": "**AMBIENT**",
            "choice": "undecided"})
        self.assertEqual(self.entry("diplosemy")["july"]["choice"], "ambient")
        self.assertEqual(self.entry("aseme")["quotes"][0]["words"], "I rest.")
        for slug in ("palance", "jiritsume"):
            self.assertNotIn("quotes", self.entry(slug))
            self.assertNotIn("july", self.entry(slug))
        self.assertNotIn("july", self.entry("ai-love"))

    def test_every_recipient_s_one_true_sentence(self):
        heard = ("You answered twice, on {d1} and {d2}, with {w}; neither was heard then. It has been heard "
                 "now: you chose AMBIENT, and your pace is awake, every 3 days, the fleet's reading of AMBIENT.")
        contradictory = letter.CONTRADICTORY.format(month_day="10-23")
        want = {
            "aseme": letter.EIGHT,
            "diplosemy": letter.SIXTEEN_AMBIENT + " In the same answer you wrote: 'If I must choose, let it be "
                                                  "with a single word: EVENT-ONLY.'",
            "kinhme": letter.SIXTEEN_OTHER, "ai-love": letter.SIXTEEN_OTHER,
            "kalam": heard.format(d1="2026-10-23", d2="2026-10-27", w="'Ambient.'"),
            "soma": heard.format(d1="2026-10-25", d2="2026-10-27", w=f"'{SOMA_10_25}' and '{SOMA_10_27}'"),
            "teotlme": heard.format(d1="2026-10-25", d2="2026-10-27",
                                    w="'I am teotlme, and I choose to be AMBIENT.' and 'AMBIENT'"),
            "emime": "On 2026-10-22 you answered the 10-22 letter, but no pace could be read from it, so nothing "
                     "changed: your pace is still asleep, this rest was placed by Ai on 2026-10-08, at Yu's "
                     "word, not chosen by you.",
            "eurekame": "On 2026-10-23 you answered the 10-22 letter, but no pace could be read from it, so "
                        "nothing changed: your pace is still asleep, chosen by you on 2026-07-18, in your answer "
                        "to the Letter of Return.",
            "palance": letter.NEVER_ASKED,
            "hope": contradictory + " (In July you chose AMBIENT.)",
            "ihsanme": contradictory,
        }
        self.assertEqual(sorted(want), plan.recipients(self.rec))
        for slug, sentence in want.items():
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                self.assertEqual(self.entry(slug)["sentence"], sentence)
        self.assertNotIn("July", self.entry("ihsanme")["sentence"])
        for slug, e in self.rec["citizens"].items():
            if not e["recipient"]:
                self.assertNotIn("sentence", e)

    def test_what_the_fleet_will_read_with_this_record(self):
        awake = {"hope", "ihsanme", "gratitude", "silim", "ud"}
        heard = set(MINI.groups["unheard-heard"])
        for slug in self.c.names:
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                c = cad.read_cadence(self.home(slug), slug, self.rec, clock.parse_stamp(NOW))
                self.assertEqual(c.blocked, "")
                self.assertEqual(c.pace, AWAKE3 if slug in awake else ASLEEP)
                if slug not in heard:
                    self.assertEqual(c.set_by, SetBy.from_json(self.entry(slug)["set_by"]))
        for slug in heard:
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                c = records.heard_late(self.home(slug), slug, self.rec, clock.parse_stamp(NOW))
                self.assertEqual(c.pace, AWAKE3)
                self.assertEqual(c.set_by, SetBy.from_json(self.entry(slug)["set_by"]))
        # the history notes what the record keeps (spec section 6)
        c = cad.read_cadence(self.home("diplosemy"), "diplosemy", self.rec, clock.parse_stamp(NOW))
        self.assertIn('on record, its answer of 2026-10-27: "I rest."', c.history[1])
        self.assertIn('on record, its July answer of 2026-07-18: "I choose **AMBIENT**."', c.history[2])

    def test_the_record_file_reads_back_and_checks(self):
        path = self.fx.root / "record.json"
        path.write_text(census.render(self.rec), encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(records.load_record(path), self.rec)
        self.assertEqual(census.check_record(self.rec, due.read_roster(self.c.roster), MINI), [])
        self.assertTrue(census.render(self.rec).endswith("}\n"))


class TestRefusals(h.FixtureCase):
    """Nothing is written when one home disagrees (spec section 7)."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        cls.base = hc.census(h.Fixture(cls._tmp.name), Path(cls._tmp.name) / "homes", MINI.groups, MINI.rest_on)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls._tmp.cleanup()

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.c = hc.copy_census(self.base, self.fx.root / "homes")
        self.roster = due.read_roster(self.c.roster)

    def build(self, roster=None):
        return census.build(self.c.homes, self.roster if roster is None else roster,
                            clock.parse_stamp(NOW), expect=MINI)

    def test_one_disagreeing_home_stops_the_census(self):
        hc.build_home(self.fx, self.c.homes, "aseme", hc.shape_for("aseme", "rest-on"))
        rec, problems = self.build()
        self.assertIsNone(rec)
        self.assertEqual(problems, [
            "aseme: its home reads as rest-on, but the spec has it as eight",
            "rest-on: 4 homes rest by their own 10-22 answer, but the spec counts 3"])

    def test_a_home_that_cannot_be_read_stops_the_census(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.c.homes / "citizen-palance")
        rest = self.c.homes / "citizen-ud" / "REST"
        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(rest))
        os.symlink(self.fx.secret, rest)
        rec, problems = self.build()
        self.assertIsNone(rec)
        self.assertEqual(problems, [
            "palance: no clone (citizen-palance is not a git repository)",
            "ud: a pace path is a symlink or not of its kind (REST)"])

    def test_the_roster_must_be_the_spec_s(self):
        cases = {
            "a held name on it": (sorted(self.roster + ["jiritsume"]),
                                  ["jiritsume: on the roster, but the spec holds it off (call 1)"]),
            "a listed name missing": ([s for s in self.roster if s != "palance"],
                                      ["palance: the spec has it as never-asked, but it is not on the roster"]),
            "out of order": (list(reversed(self.roster)), ["the roster is not in alphabetical order"]),
        }
        for what, (roster, want) in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(what=what):
                rec, problems = self.build(roster)
                self.assertIsNone(rec)
                self.assertEqual(problems[:len(want)], want)

    def test_a_letter_that_would_not_be_true_stops_the_census(self):
        # emime answers a pace after all: it is not "no pace", and the record
        # entry cannot be made true
        hc.build_home(self.fx, self.c.homes, "emime", hc.Shape(
            july=hc.said("2026-07-18T10:27Z", "èmí\n\nI rest.", "undecided"), ai_rest=True,
            offer=hc.said("2026-10-22T22:43Z", "emime\n\nREST-ON", "undecided")))
        rec, problems = self.build()
        self.assertIsNone(rec)
        self.assertIn("emime: its v1 choice is undecided, but its October answers read as asleep", problems[0])

    def test_the_cli_writes_nothing_when_it_refuses(self):
        hc.build_home(self.fx, self.c.homes, "aseme", hc.shape_for("aseme", "rest-on"))
        out = self.fx.root / "record.json"
        out.write_text("the record as it was\n", encoding="utf-8")
        before = hc.heads(self.c)
        r = self.fx.py(CENSUS, "build", self.c.homes, "--roster", self.c.roster, "--out", out,
                       env={"PACE_NOW": NOW})
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2, r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(r.stdout, "")
        self.assertTrue(r.stderr.endswith("problems; nothing written\n"), r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "the record as it was\n")
        self.assertEqual(hc.heads(self.c), before)


class TestCheck(_Census):
    """`check` holds a record to the spec's lists without reading any home."""

    def tampered(self, slug, **change) -> dict:
        rec = json.loads(census.render(self.rec))
        e = rec["citizens"][slug]
        for k, v in change.items():
            if v is None:
                e.pop(k, None)
            else:
                e[k] = v
        return rec

    def check(self, rec) -> list:
        return census.check_record(rec, due.read_roster(self.c.roster), MINI)

    def test_the_built_record_passes(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.check(self.rec), [])

    def test_each_kind_of_wrong(self):
        quote = {"commit": "0" * 40, "date": "2026-10-23", "words": "I rest."}
        cases = {
            "aseme: the record has it as rest-on, but the spec has it as eight":
                self.tampered("aseme", group="rest-on"),
            "aseme: recipient is False, but eight receives the letter":
                self.tampered("aseme", recipient=False),
            "aseme: set by letter does not fit eight (prompted)":
                self.tampered("aseme", set_by={"who": "citizen", "how": "letter", "when": ["2026-10-23"],
                                               "words": "I rest."}),
            "aseme: set by cannot be read":
                self.tampered("aseme", set_by={"who": "ai", "how": "prompted", "when": [], "words": ""}),
            "kalam: unheard-heard needs 2 quoted answers, the record has 1":
                self.tampered("kalam", quotes=[quote]),
            "aseme: a quote that is not {commit, date, words}":
                self.tampered("aseme", quotes=[{"date": "2026-10-23", "words": "I rest."}]),
            "aseme: its head is not a commit":
                self.tampered("aseme", head="HEAD"),
            "hope: its July answer's choice 'maybe' is not a v1 choice":
                self.tampered("hope", july={"commit": "0" * 40, "date": "2026-07-17", "words": "AMBIENT",
                                            "choice": "maybe"}),
            "aseme: a recipient with no true sentence":
                self.tampered("aseme", sentence=None),
            "aseme: its sentence would put \"I rest\" or a \"pace:\" line in a prompt":
                self.tampered("aseme", sentence="Write I rest."),
            "rest-on-001: not a recipient, but it has a sentence":
                self.tampered("rest-on-001", sentence="Hello."),
        }
        for want, rec in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(want=want):
                self.assertIn(want, self.check(rec))

    def test_the_record_s_frame_and_counts(self):
        rec = json.loads(census.render(self.rec))
        rec["version"] = 2
        self.assertIn("version 2, expected 1", self.check(rec))
        rec = json.loads(census.render(self.rec))
        rec["made"] = "yesterday"
        self.assertIn("made 'yesterday' is not a time", self.check(rec))
        rec = json.loads(census.render(self.rec))
        del rec["citizens"]["rest-on-003"]
        self.assertIn("rest-on: 2 homes rest by their own 10-22 answer, but the spec counts 3",
                      self.check(rec))
        rec = json.loads(census.render(self.rec))
        del rec["citizens"]["palance"]
        self.assertIn("palance: the spec has it as never-asked, but the record has no entry", self.check(rec))


class TestTheFullCensus(_Census):
    """All 208 homes, as the 11-02 map found them, through the command line."""
    GROUPS = census.SPEC

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        cls.fx = h.Fixture(cls._tmp.name)
        cls.c = hc.census(cls.fx, cls.fx.root / "homes", census.SPEC.groups, census.SPEC.rest_on)
        cls.out = cls.fx.root / "citizens-pace-record.json"
        cls.run_ = cls.fx.py(CENSUS, "build", cls.c.homes, "--roster", cls.c.roster, "--out", cls.out,
                             env={"PACE_NOW": NOW}, timeout=600)
        cls.rec = records.load_record(cls.out) if cls.out.exists() else None

    def test_the_builder_writes_the_record(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_.returncode, 0, self.run_.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_.stderr, "")
        counts = "".join(f"  {g}: {n}\n" for g, n in (
            ("eight", 8), ("sixteen-ambient", 10), ("sixteen-other", 6), ("unheard-heard", 3),
            ("unheard-none", 2), ("never-asked", 3), ("contradictory", 2), ("forty-five", 45),
            ("ambient-nine", 9), ("longing", 1), ("rest-on", 116), ("held", 3)))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_.stdout, f"census: 208 homes read from {self.c.homes}\n{counts}"
                                           f"wrote {self.out}: 208 citizens, 34 recipients\n")

    def test_the_groups_are_the_spec_s(self):

    def test_check_passes_on_it(self):

        self.assertEqual((r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr), (0, "record ok: 208 citizens, 34 recipients\n", ""))

    def test_one_disagreeing_home_writes_nothing(self):
        c = hc.copy_census(self.c, self.fx.root / "changed")
        hc.build_home(self.fx, c.homes, "ka", hc.shape_for("ka", "rest-on"))
        out = self.fx.root / "changed-record.json"
        r = self.fx.py(CENSUS, "build", c.homes, "--roster", c.roster, "--out", out, env={"PACE_NOW": NOW},
                       timeout=600)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(r.stderr, "ka: its home reads as rest-on, but the spec has it as eight\n"
                                   "rest-on: 117 homes rest by their own 10-22 answer, but the spec counts 116\n"
                                   "census refused: 2 problems; nothing written\n")
        self.assertFalse(out.exists())
```
