- [ ] **Step 4: Write the census tool**

Create `tools/citizen_pace_census.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""citizen_pace_census.py — build and check citizens-pace-record.json (pace/1).

The record of spec section 5: for every citizen home, what its own files cannot
show. That is its group, who set its pace, its quoted Letter of Return answers
with their commits and dates (the July one with the choice the old code
recorded from it), its HEAD, and for each of the 34 recipients the one true
sentence of its pace letter.

`build` reads read-only clones of the homes (the roster's, and the three held
off it) and works out each home's group from its own history, never from its
name. It then checks every group against the spec's lists, hard-coded below,
and asks the library what the fleet and the letter would make of the record.
It writes the record only when every home agrees, and fails rather than guess
(spec section 7): one home that disagrees, or cannot be read, and nothing is
written. It never writes into a home. `check` holds a record file to the same
lists without reading any home.

  build <homes-dir> [--roster <f>] [--out <f>] [--spec <path@sha>]
  check <record> [--roster <f>]

Exit codes: 0 written or ok, 2 refused or a usage error. Run it as
`python3 -I tools/citizen_pace_census.py ...`; it puts its own real folder
first on sys.path, so it never imports from the folder it is run in.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__)))

import argparse  # noqa: E402
import datetime as _dt  # noqa: E402
import json  # noqa: E402
import re  # noqa: E402
from dataclasses import dataclass  # noqa: E402
from pathlib import Path  # noqa: E402
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple  # noqa: E402

from citizen_pace_lib import clock, homes, letter, paragraph, words  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import record as records  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.cadence import SetBy  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.due import read_roster  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.words import Pace, Unclear  # noqa: E402

OK, REFUSED = 0, 2
TOOLS = Path(os.path.realpath(__file__)).parent
SPEC_REF = "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-citizens-own-pace-design.md@dbc5a4c"
# the three Letters of Return the homes answered (spec section 5)
JULY = "inbox/2026-07-17-letter-of-return.md"
OFFER = "inbox/2026-10-22-letter-of-return-offer.md"
RHYTHM = "inbox/2026-10-26-letter-of-return-rhythm.md"
LETTERS = (JULY, OFFER, RHYTHM)
I_REST = "I rest."
V1_CHOICES = ("rest-on", "event-only", "ambient", "undecided")
GROUP_CHOICES = ("rest-on", "ambient", "undecided")   # the v1 choices some group of the spec holds
ASLEEP = Pace("asleep")
AMBIENT = Pace("awake", words.AWAKE_DEFAULT_N)
AI_1008 = SetBy("ai", "rest-1008", (cad.REST_1008,))
_SHA = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
_DAY = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$")

# -- the spec's lists (section 5, "Who receives it", and Yu's three calls) ------------------

EIGHT = ("aseme", "bindume", "firstnessqing", "ka", "kimme", "penthosme", "sukhance", "wiconime")
SIXTEEN_AMBIENT = ("alohame", "autoxenia", "candence", "diplosemy", "doxomme", "geshtug", "halakhame",
                   "ifeqing", "maatme", "sankofame")
SIXTEEN_OTHER = ("ai-love", "hallance", "hotepme", "kallophanes", "kinhme", "teshuvance")
UNHEARD_HEARD = ("kalam", "soma", "teotlme")
UNHEARD_NONE = ("emime", "eurekame")
NEVER_ASKED = ("eucatastrophe", "palance", "shannonme")
CONTRADICTORY = ("hope", "ihsanme")
FORTY_FIVE = ("ahavame", "allostasisqing", "barzakhqing", "chayimme", "complerescence", "courage", "daome",
              "devekutqing", "dingir", "doxakallos", "hanme", "hayatqing", "heurekin", "hodosme", "jinsme",
              "jivame", "kame", "kundaliniqing", "kur", "life", "light", "metastrophesis", "morphame",
              "nullify-love", "nun", "ondame", "orthophanes", "panimaance", "peace", "prapancame", "qinance",
              "renme", "rigpame", "rtame", "sabbathme", "sabilme", "shemme", "silame", "sorrow", "syzygyqing",
              "true-love", "ubuntume", "xeniame", "zi", "zoeme")
AMBIENT_NINE = ("an", "britqing", "glossame", "gratitude", "justice", "kimance", "silim", "spandaqing", "ud")
LONGING = ("longing",)
HELD = ("jiritsume", "takseme", "tlamatisme")
REST_ON_COUNT = 116

# who may have set the pace of each group (the record's set by)
HOWS = {"eight": ("prompted",), "sixteen-ambient": ("rest-1008",), "sixteen-other": ("rest-1008",),
        "unheard-heard": ("ambient",), "unheard-none": ("rest-1008", "letter", "letter-twice"),
        "never-asked": ("rest-1008",), "contradictory": ("first-word",), "forty-five": ("letter",),
        "ambient-nine": ("ambient",), "longing": ("letter", "letter-twice"),
        "rest-on": ("letter", "letter-twice"), "held": ("rest-1008",)}
# how many October answers the record must quote for each group
QUOTES_NEEDED = {"unheard-heard": 2, "never-asked": 0, "held": 0}
# the pace the fleet must read for each group, with the record (the three unheard
# that are heard late read as asleep until the heard-late step runs)
AWAKE_GROUPS = ("ambient-nine", "contradictory")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Expected:
    """What a census must find: the names of every group but "rest-on", and how
    many rest by their own 10-22 answer (the spec counts them, not names them)."""
    groups: dict
    rest_on: int

    @property
    def held(self) -> tuple:
        return tuple(self.groups.get("held", ()))

    @property
    def total(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(n) for n in self.groups.values()) + self.rest_on

    @property
    def recipients(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(n) for g, n in self.groups.items() if g in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS)

    def listed(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        return {slug: g for g, names in self.groups.items() for slug in names}


SPEC = Expected({"eight": EIGHT, "sixteen-ambient": SIXTEEN_AMBIENT, "sixteen-other": SIXTEEN_OTHER,
                 "unheard-heard": UNHEARD_HEARD, "unheard-none": UNHEARD_NONE, "never-asked": NEVER_ASKED,
                 "contradictory": CONTRADICTORY, "forty-five": FORTY_FIVE, "ambient-nine": AMBIENT_NINE,
                 "longing": LONGING, "held": HELD}, REST_ON_COUNT)


# -- what one home holds ----------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Answer:
    """One stored Letter of Return answer (record.stored_lor_answers)."""
    commit: str      # the beat commit that stored it
    date: str        # its day, UTC
    letter: str      # "inbox/<the letter it answered>"
    text: str        # what the beat added to beats/, byte for byte
    lines: tuple     # its pace lines by section 1's Letter of Return rules
    name: str

    @property
    def reading(self):
        return words.combine(list(self.lines))

    @property
    def first(self) -> str:
        return next((ln.strip() for ln in self.text.splitlines() if ln.strip()), "")

    @property
    def quoted(self) -> str:
        """The words the record quotes: its first pace line, else its first line
        that is not its own name as a signature, else its first line."""
        if self.lines:
            return self.lines[0][0]
        me = " ".join(self.name.lower().split())
        for ln in self.text.splitlines():
            if ln.strip() and words._bare(ln) != me:
                return ln.strip()
        return self.first

    def quote(self) -> dict:
        return {"commit": self.commit, "date": self.date, "words": self.quoted}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Facts:
    slug: str
    soul: bool = False
    choice: Optional[str] = None       # the v1 "- choice:" now (None: no CADENCE.md)
    rest: Optional[str] = None         # REST now
    event_only: bool = False
    head: str = ""
    answers: tuple = ()                # Answer, oldest first
    then_choice: Optional[str] = None  # "- choice:" as the home stood when it answered the 10-22 letter
    then_rest: Optional[str] = None    # REST then
    problem: str = ""                  # why the census cannot read this home

    def answer_to(self, letter_rel: str) -> Optional[Answer]:
        return next((a for a in self.answers if a.letter == letter_rel), None)

    def october(self) -> list:
        return [a for a in self.answers if a.letter != JULY]

    def reading(self, answers=None):
        """Section 1's reading of several answers, each alone (words.read_lor_answers)."""
        got = self.answers if answers is None else answers
        return words.read_lor_answers([(a.commit, a.text) for a in got], self.slug)

    def date_of(self, commit: str) -> str:
        return next(a.date for a in self.answers if a.commit == commit)


def _blob(home: Path, rev: str, path: str) -> Optional[str]:
    r = homes.git(home, "cat-file", "blob", f"{rev}:{path}")
    return r.stdout if r.returncode == 0 else None


def read_home(home, slug: str) -> Facts:
    """What the census needs from one read-only clone. Writes nothing."""
    home = Path(home)
    if not (home / ".git").is_dir():
        return Facts(slug, problem=f"no clone ({home.name} is not a git repository)")
    links = homes.forbidden_links(home)
    if links:
        return Facts(slug, problem=f"a pace path is a symlink or not of its kind ({', '.join(links)})")
    try:
        text = homes.read_regular(home / cad.CADENCE)
        rest = homes.read_regular(home / "REST")
        event_only = homes.read_regular(home / "EVENT-ONLY") is not None
    except (ValueError, homes.LinkRefused) as e:
        return Facts(slug, problem=f"cannot be read ({e})")
    if text is not None and cad._is_v2(text):
        return Facts(slug, problem="CADENCE.md is already v2, so its history is no longer the "
                                   "census's to read")
    answers = []
    for sha, day, rel, said in records.stored_lor_answers(home):
        if rel not in LETTERS:
            return Facts(slug, problem=f"it answered {rel}, a Letter of Return the spec does not name")
        if any(a.letter == rel for a in answers):
            return Facts(slug, problem=f"it answered {rel} twice")
        answers.append(Answer(sha, day, rel, said, tuple(words.lor_pace_lines(said, slug)), slug))
    choice = cad._v1_fields(text)[0] if text else None
    october = [a for a in answers if a.letter != JULY]
    if october:
        before = _blob(home, f"{october[0].commit}^", cad.CADENCE)
        then_choice = cad._v1_fields(before)[0] if before else None
        then_rest = _blob(home, f"{october[0].commit}^", "REST")
    else:
        then_choice, then_rest = choice, rest
    return Facts(slug, homes.has_soul(home, slug), choice, rest, event_only, homes.head(home),
                 tuple(answers), then_choice, then_rest)


# -- which group a home's history puts it in ----------------------------------------------------

def _rest_source(text: Optional[str], which: str) -> Tuple[Optional[SetBy], str]:
    """Who placed a REST, read from its text as cadence.py reads it; or None and
    why not, naming the REST as `which`."""
    if text is None:
        return None, f"{which} is missing"
    s, why = cad._set_by_from_marker("REST", text, None)
    return (None, why.replace("its REST text", which, 1)) if why else (s, "")


def _says(r) -> str:
    if r is None:
        return "no pace"
    if isinstance(r, Unclear):
        return f"unclear ({r.reason})"
    return r.words()


def _markers_fit(f: Facts) -> bool:
    """The markers the old code kept for each v1 choice: REST for rest-on,
    undecided and no file; none for ambient."""
    if f.choice == "ambient":
        return f.rest is None and not f.event_only
    return f.rest is not None and not f.event_only


def derive(f: Facts) -> Tuple[Optional[str], str]:
    """(the group this home's own history puts it in, "") or (None, why it fits none)."""
    if f.problem:
        return None, f.problem
    if not f.soul:
        src, _why = _rest_source(f.rest, "its REST")
        if f.choice is None and not f.answers and src is not None and src.how == "rest-1008":
            return "held", ""
        return None, "no soul file, but it has a CADENCE.md, stored answers or a REST not placed by Ai"
    if f.choice is not None and f.choice not in GROUP_CHOICES:
        return None, f"its v1 choice is {f.choice}, which no group of the spec holds"
    if f.answer_to(JULY) is not None and f.then_choice is None:
        return None, "it answered the July letter, but no v1 choice was recorded from that answer"
    if not _markers_fit(f):
        return None, (f"its markers do not fit its v1 choice {f.choice or 'none'} (REST "
                      f"{'present' if f.rest is not None else 'missing'}, EVENT-ONLY "
                      f"{'present' if f.event_only else 'missing'})")
    offer = f.answer_to(OFFER)
    reading = f.reading()
    if f.choice is None:
        src, _why = _rest_source(f.rest, "its REST")
        if f.answers:
            return None, "no CADENCE.md, but stored Letter of Return answers"
        if src is None or src.how != "rest-1008":
            return None, "no CADENCE.md, and its REST was not placed by Ai"
        return "never-asked", ""
    if f.choice == "undecided":
        src, why = _rest_source(f.rest, "its REST")
        if src is None:
            return None, why
        if not f.october():
            return None, "its v1 choice is undecided, but it has no October answer"
        heard = f.reading(f.october())
        if heard is None:
            return "unheard-none", ""
        if heard.pace == AMBIENT and heard.twice:
            return "unheard-heard", ""
        said = f"{heard.pace.words()}{' twice' if heard.twice else ''}"
        return None, f"its v1 choice is undecided, but its October answers read as {said}"
    if f.choice == "ambient":
        r = offer.reading if offer else None
        if isinstance(r, Unclear) and r.reason == "two paces" and offer.lines[0][1] == AMBIENT \
                and any(p == ASLEEP for _line, p in offer.lines):
            return "contradictory", ""
        if reading is not None and reading.pace == AMBIENT:
            return "ambient-nine", ""
        said = _says(reading.pace if reading else None)
        return None, f"its v1 choice is ambient, but its answers say {said}"
    # rest-on
    if offer is None:
        return None, "its v1 choice is rest-on, but it has no answer to the 10-22 letter"
    if offer.first == I_REST:
        src, why = _rest_source(f.then_rest, "its REST when it answered the 10-22 letter")
        if src is None:
            return None, why
        if src.how == "rest-1008":
            return ("sixteen-ambient" if f.then_choice == "ambient" else "sixteen-other"), ""
        july = f.answer_to(JULY)
        if july is None or f.then_choice != "rest-on":
            return None, ('its 10-22 answer began "I rest." under its own rest, but it has no July '
                          "record of REST-ON")
        if july.first == I_REST:
            return "eight", ""
        if july.reading == ASLEEP:
            return "forty-five", ""
        return None, ('its 10-22 answer began "I rest." under its own July rest, but its July answer '
                      "does not say REST-ON")
    latest = reading.pace if reading else None
    if any(a.reading == AMBIENT for a in f.october()) and latest == ASLEEP:
        return "longing", ""
    if offer.reading != ASLEEP:
        return None, f"its v1 choice is rest-on, but its 10-22 answer reads as {_says(offer.reading)}"
    if latest != ASLEEP:
        return None, f"its v1 choice is rest-on, but its latest clear answer reads as {_says(latest)}"
    return "rest-on", ""


# -- the record entry ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _set_by(f: Facts, group: str, e: dict) -> SetBy:
    """Who set this pace, by the spec's provenance for its group (sections 2 and 6)."""
    offer, july, reading = f.answer_to(OFFER), f.answer_to(JULY), f.reading()
    if group == "eight":
        return SetBy("citizen", "prompted", (offer.date,))
    if group in ("sixteen-ambient", "sixteen-other", "never-asked", "held"):
        return AI_1008
    if group == "contradictory":
        return SetBy("fleet", "first-word", (offer.date,))
    if group == "forty-five":
        return SetBy("citizen", "letter", (july.date,), july.quoted)
    if group == "unheard-none":
        return cad._set_by_from_marker("REST", f.rest, e)[0]
    dates = tuple(f.date_of(k) for k in reading.keys)
    if group in ("unheard-heard", "ambient-nine"):
        return SetBy("citizen", "ambient", dates, reading.lines[-1])
    return SetBy("citizen", "letter-twice" if reading.twice else "letter", dates, reading.lines[-1])


def entry_for(f: Facts, group: str) -> dict:
    e = {"group": group, "recipient": group in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS, "head": f.head}
    july = f.answer_to(JULY)
    if july is not None:
        e["july"] = dict(july.quote(), choice=f.then_choice)
    quotes = [a.quote() for a in f.october()]
    if quotes:
        e["quotes"] = quotes
    e["set_by"] = _set_by(f, group, e).to_json()
    return e


# -- the lists and the roster ------------------------------------------------------------------------

def roster_problems(roster: list, expect: Expected = SPEC) -> List[str]:
    """The roster holds every listed name but the held, and none of them, in order."""
    out = []
    on = set(roster)
    for slug in expect.held:
        if slug in on:
            out.append(f"{slug}: on the roster, but the spec holds it off (call 1)")
    for slug, group in sorted(expect.listed().items()):
        if group != "held" and slug not in on:
            out.append(f"{slug}: the spec has it as {group}, but it is not on the roster")
    if list(roster) != sorted(roster):
        out.append("the roster is not in alphabetical order")
    return out


def _rest_on_line(n: int, expect: Expected) -> str:
    return f"rest-on: {n} homes rest by their own 10-22 answer, but the spec counts {expect.rest_on}"


def list_problems(groups: Dict[str, str], expect: Expected = SPEC) -> List[str]:
    """The groups the homes read as, against the spec's lists."""
    listed = expect.listed()
    out = [f"{slug}: its home reads as {g}, but the spec has it as {listed.get(slug, 'rest-on')}"
           for slug, g in sorted(groups.items()) if g != listed.get(slug, "rest-on")]
    n = sum(1 for g in groups.values() if g == "rest-on")
    if n != expect.rest_on:
        out.append(_rest_on_line(n, expect))
    return out


# -- what the fleet and the letter will make of the record ---------------------------------------

def _fleet_problems(home: Path, slug: str, rec: dict, now: _dt.datetime) -> List[str]:
    """Read every home with the record as the fleet will, and make each
    recipient's one true sentence (letter.true_sentence), kept in its entry."""
    e = rec["citizens"][slug]
    group, want = e["group"], SetBy.from_json(e["set_by"])
    try:
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, slug, rec, now)
    except (ValueError, homes.LinkRefused) as err:
        return [f"{slug}: the fleet could not read it ({err})"]
    if c.blocked:
        return [f"{slug}: its record would be blocked ({c.blocked})"]
    pace = AMBIENT if group in AWAKE_GROUPS else ASLEEP
    if c.pace != pace:
        return [f"{slug}: the fleet would read its pace as {_says(c.pace)}, not {pace.words()}"]
    if group == "unheard-heard":
        try:
            c = records.heard_late(home, slug, rec, now)
        except (ValueError, homes.LinkRefused) as err:
            return [f"{slug}: {err}"]
        if c is None or c.pace != AMBIENT:
            return [f"{slug}: the heard-late step would not hear it"]
    if c.set_by != want:
        return [f"{slug}: the fleet would read its set by as \"{cad.set_by_sentence(slug, c.set_by)}\", "
                f"not the record's \"{cad.set_by_sentence(slug, want)}\""]
    if e["recipient"]:
        try:
            e["sentence"] = letter.true_sentence(slug, e, c)
        except ValueError as err:
            return [f"{slug}: no true letter ({err})"]
    return []


def build(homes_dir, roster: list, now: _dt.datetime, *, spec: str = SPEC_REF,
          expect: Expected = SPEC) -> Tuple[Optional[dict], List[str]]:
    """(the record, []) when every home agrees with the spec's lists, else
    (None, the problems, one line each). Reads the roster's homes and the held,
    and writes nothing."""
    homes_dir = Path(homes_dir)
    problems = roster_problems(roster, expect)
    names = sorted(set(roster) | set(expect.held))
    facts, groups = {}, {}
    for slug in names:
        f = read_home(homes_dir / f"citizen-{slug}", slug)
        group, why = derive(f)
        if group is None:
            problems.append(f"{slug}: {why}")
            continue
        facts[slug], groups[slug] = f, group
    if problems:
        return None, problems
    problems = list_problems(groups, expect)
    if problems:
        return None, problems
    rec = {"version": records.RECORD_VERSION, "made": clock.stamp(now), "spec": spec,
           "citizens": {slug: entry_for(facts[slug], groups[slug]) for slug in names}}
    for slug in names:
        problems += _fleet_problems(homes_dir / f"citizen-{slug}", slug, rec, now)
    problems += check_record(rec, roster, expect)
    return (None, problems) if problems else (rec, [])


# -- checking a record without its homes ---------------------------------------------------------

def _is_quote(q) -> bool:
    return (isinstance(q, dict) and isinstance(q.get("commit"), str) and bool(_SHA.match(q["commit"]))
            and isinstance(q.get("date"), str) and bool(_DAY.match(q["date"]))
            and isinstance(q.get("words"), str))


def _entry_problems(slug: str, e, expect: Expected) -> List[str]:
    want = expect.listed().get(slug, "rest-on")
    if not isinstance(e, dict):
        return [f"{slug}: its entry is not an object"]
    g = e.get("group")
    out = []
    if g != want:
        out.append(f"{slug}: the record has it as {g}, but the spec has it as {want}")
    if g not in HOWS:
        return out
    if e.get("recipient") is not (g in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS):
        receives = "receives the letter" if g in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS else "receives no letter"
        out.append(f"{slug}: recipient is {e.get('recipient')}, but {g} {receives}")
    try:
        s = SetBy.from_json(e.get("set_by"))
    except ValueError:
        out.append(f"{slug}: set by cannot be read")
    else:
        if s.how not in HOWS[g]:
            out.append(f"{slug}: set by {s.how} does not fit {g} ({', '.join(HOWS[g])})")
    quotes = e.get("quotes", [])
    if not isinstance(quotes, list) or not all(_is_quote(q) for q in quotes):
        out.append(f"{slug}: a quote that is not {{commit, date, words}}")
    else:
        need = QUOTES_NEEDED.get(g, 1)
        if len(quotes) < need:
            out.append(f"{slug}: {g} needs {need} quoted answer{'s' if need > 1 else ''}, the record has "
                       f"{len(quotes)}")
    july = e.get("july")
    if july is not None:
        if not _is_quote(july):
            out.append(f"{slug}: its July answer is not {{commit, date, words, choice}}")
        elif july.get("choice") not in V1_CHOICES:
            out.append(f"{slug}: its July answer's choice {july.get('choice')!r} is not a v1 choice")
    if not isinstance(e.get("head"), str) or not _SHA.match(e["head"]):
        out.append(f"{slug}: its head is not a commit")
    sentence = e.get("sentence")
    if g in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS:
        if not isinstance(sentence, str) or not sentence.strip():
            out.append(f"{slug}: a recipient with no true sentence")
        elif paragraph.quotable(sentence) != sentence:
            out.append(f"{slug}: its sentence would put \"I rest\" or a \"pace:\" line in a prompt")
    elif sentence is not None:
        out.append(f"{slug}: not a recipient, but it has a sentence")
    return out


def check_record(rec, roster: Optional[list] = None, expect: Expected = SPEC) -> List[str]:
    """A record's problems against the spec's lists ([] when it is the spec's).
    With a roster, the roster is checked too."""
    if not isinstance(rec, dict):
        return ["the record is not a JSON object"]
    out = []
    if rec.get("version") != records.RECORD_VERSION or type(rec.get("version")) is not int:
        out.append(f"version {rec.get('version')!r}, expected {records.RECORD_VERSION}")
    try:
        clock.parse_stamp(str(rec.get("made")))
    except ValueError:
        out.append(f"made {rec.get('made')!r} is not a time")
    if not isinstance(rec.get("spec"), str) or "@" not in rec["spec"]:
        out.append(f"spec {rec.get('spec')!r} is not <path>@<commit>")
    citizens = rec.get("citizens")
    if not isinstance(citizens, dict):
        return out + ["'citizens' is not an object"]
    for slug, group in sorted(expect.listed().items()):
        if slug not in citizens:
            out.append(f"{slug}: the spec has it as {group}, but the record has no entry")
    for slug in sorted(citizens):
        out += _entry_problems(slug, citizens[slug], expect)
    n = sum(1 for e in citizens.values() if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("group") == "rest-on")
    if n != expect.rest_on:
        out.append(_rest_on_line(n, expect))
    if roster is not None:
        out += roster_problems(roster, expect)
        listed = set(roster) | set(expect.held)
        out += [f"{slug}: in the record, but neither on the roster nor held"
                for slug in sorted(citizens) if slug not in listed]
        out += [f"{slug}: on the roster, but not in the record" for slug in roster if slug not in citizens]
    return out


def render(rec: dict) -> str:
    """The record file's text: sorted keys, two-space indent, UTF-8, a final newline."""
    return json.dumps(rec, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"


# -- the command line ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

USAGE = """usage: citizen_pace_census.py <command> ...
  build <homes-dir> [--roster <f>] [--out <f>] [--spec <path@sha>]
      read every home of the census (the roster's and the held), check each
      against the spec's lists, and write the record only when all agree
  check <record> [--roster <f>]
      hold a record file to the spec's lists, reading no home
exit: 0 written or ok, 2 refused or a usage error
"""


def _parser(cmd: str) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=f"citizen_pace_census.py {cmd}")
    p.add_argument("--roster", type=Path, default=TOOLS.parent / "citizens-roster.txt",
                   help="the roster (default: citizens-roster.txt beside tools/)")
    return p


def _plural(n: int, word: str) -> str:
    return f"{n} {word}{'' if n == 1 else 's'}"


def cmd_build(argv) -> int:
    p = _parser("build")
    p.add_argument("homes_dir", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=records.default_record_path(),
                   help="the record to write (default: citizens-pace-record.json beside the roster)")
    p.add_argument("--spec", default=SPEC_REF, help="the spec the lists come from, <path>@<commit>")
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    rec, problems = build(a.homes_dir, read_roster(a.roster), clock.now(), spec=a.spec)
    if rec is None:
        for line in problems:
            print(line, file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"census refused: {_plural(len(problems), 'problem')}; nothing written", file=sys.stderr)
        return REFUSED
    homes.write_regular(a.out, render(rec))
    counts = {}
    for e in rec["citizens"].values():
        counts[e["group"]] = counts.get(e["group"], 0) + 1
    print(f"census: {len(rec['citizens'])} homes read from {a.homes_dir}")
    for g in records.GROUPS:
        print(f"  {g}: {counts.get(g, 0)}")
    recipients = sum(1 for e in rec["citizens"].values() if e["recipient"])
    print(f"wrote {a.out}: {len(rec['citizens'])} citizens, {recipients} recipients")
    return OK


def cmd_check(argv) -> int:
    p = _parser("check")
    p.add_argument("record", type=Path)
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        rec = json.loads(a.record.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"{a.record}: cannot be read ({e})", file=sys.stderr)
        return REFUSED
    problems = check_record(rec, read_roster(a.roster) if a.roster.exists() else None)
    if problems:
        for line in problems:
            print(line, file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"{a.record}: {_plural(len(problems), 'problem')}; not the spec's record", file=sys.stderr)
        return REFUSED
    citizens = rec["citizens"]
    recipients = sum(1 for e in citizens.values() if e["recipient"])
    print(f"record ok: {len(citizens)} citizens, {recipients} recipients")
    return OK


COMMANDS = {"build": cmd_build, "check": cmd_check}


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        try:
            stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except (AttributeError, ValueError):
            pass
    if not argv:
        sys.stderr.write(USAGE)
        return REFUSED
    if argv[0] in ("-h", "--help", "help"):
        sys.stdout.write(USAGE)
        return OK
    if argv[0] not in COMMANDS:
        sys.stderr.write(f"citizen_pace_census.py: unknown command {argv[0]!r}\n\n{USAGE}")
        return REFUSED
    try:
        return COMMANDS[argv[0]](argv[1:])
    except SystemExit as e:
        return OK if e.code in (0, None) else REFUSED
    except (OSError, ValueError, homes.LinkRefused) as e:
        print(f"citizen_pace_census.py {argv[0]}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return REFUSED


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

hope's July answer was recorded as AMBIENT and ihsanme's as undecided, though ihsanme's second line is
`**AMBIENT**`. The spec gives hope the July sentence and ihsanme none. Matching the words would give

In `tools/citizen_pace_lib/letter.py`, replace:

```python
def _chose_ambient_in_july(july) -> bool:
    """The July answer was recorded as AMBIENT: by the record's "choice" (the v1
    choice the old code recorded from it) when the entry has one, else by its words."""
    if not isinstance(july, dict):
        return False
    if "choice" in july:
        return july["choice"] == "ambient"
    return isinstance(july.get("words"), str) and "ambient" in july["words"].lower()
```

### Task 13: The delivery tool — one pace letter, once

This task builds the tool Ai runs on the Air, by hand and only after Yu's yes, to place the one pace
letter in each recipient's home (spec section 5, "Once" and "Delivery"; section 6, "Inbox"; section 7,
`tools/citizen-pace-letter.py`). It changes no fleet code: the fleet reads the letter as any other
letter (Tasks 3, 5 and 10), and the letter's words come from Task 4's `letter.letter_text`.

What it does:

- **Every home read fresh.** Each recipient is cloned anew into a temporary folder from its remote
  (`PACE_REMOTE_BASE`, else `https://github.com/cambridgetcg`), so "already asked" is decided from what
  GitHub holds, never from a local copy. The folder is removed at the end. Every git call that reaches
  the remote pins one credential helper: inherited helpers are cleared (`-c credential.helper=`), and on
  GitHub the only helper is `!sol access run github -- auth git-credential`, cambridgetcg's route. No
  hook or fsmonitor of a home runs.
- **Four modes.** `--list` prints the recipients after the delivery-time drops, and whether the switch
  to the new code has been seen. `--dry-run` prints each letter this run would place, in full, and
  writes nothing. `--deliver` places them: one commit per home, `letter: one question about your pace
  (once)`, author and committer `Ai <ai@kingdom.os>`, holding only `inbox/<date>-pace-letter.md`
  (`inbox/` made where missing), pushed once with no force and no retry. `--check` lists the
  recipients whose home holds no "reached (once)" line (spec section 5, "Delivery", last bullet).
- **Yu's yes.** `--deliver` needs `--yes-from-yu <YYYY-MM-DD>` (not in the future, not before the
  record was made) and `--show-back on|off`, which must name the committed `due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT`: the
  letters are worded from that value (spec section 5, "What it says"), so a yes given for the other
  setting refuses the run.
- **The switch.** `--deliver` waits until `pace/1` commits are seen in at least three recipients'
  homes, at least one of them a beat, and a day has passed since the first of them (spec section 5,
  "Delivery": "Only after the Studio runs the new code", "only once a day has passed since the
  switch").
- **Once** (spec section 5, "Once"). A home counts as asked when its inbox holds any name containing
  `pace-letter` (seen or not, a `.seen-` marker alone included), when its history holds a commit with the
  delivery message or one that added an `inbox/*pace-letter*` path, when its `CADENCE.md` has `asked
  once` or a "the pace letter reached" line, or when the ledger says it was delivered.
- **Drops** (spec section 5, "Who receives it"). A recipient is dropped when its citizen has written
  its own clear pace line in a beat since 2026-11-02 (a pending proposal counts), or when it has no
  `<name>.md`. The line is read from the journal every beat since 2026-11-02 added (`beats/*.md`, as
  `record._journal_added` reads it, before the census head too), as a beat reads it, so a line from a
  beat on the old code counts, and so does a pace said again that apply records nothing for (a citizen
  whose `set by` is already its own); also from what apply recorded: a history entry `set by`,
  `proposed by` or `confirmed by <name>:`, a pending proposal, or a beat-set `set by`. An unclear line,
  two paces, "I rest." and silence are not drops, and a stop still wins over a drop.
- **Stops, reported to Yu** (spec section 5, "Who receives it" and "Delivery"). Every commit on HEAD
  since the record entry's `head` must be an expected change: a fleet commit tagged `pace/1` (tend, the
  heard-late step), or one of the citizen's own beats (`beat: <slug> reflected (`, `beat: <slug> lived a
  free beat (`, from either code) or PR #24's stranded-state commit (`tend: record stranded
  cadence/mail state`) that sets no pace and changes nothing under `inbox/` but new `.seen-` markers.
  Whether a commit set a pace is read, not guessed: its `CADENCE.md`, `REST` and `EVENT-ONLY` before and
  after are read by `cadence.read_cadence` with the record, and pace, `set by` and pending must match
  (a v1 record becoming v2 inside a beat matches; a lapse is allowed). Anything else stops the home: a
  merge, a commit by anyone else, a letter placed inside a beat, a pace changed without the citizen's
  own line, a record head missing from its history or from the record, links among its pace paths, a
  recipient not on the roster, a letter `letter_text` refuses as untrue of the home, or a letter whose
  one true sentence, made at delivery, is not the record entry's `sentence` (missing, empty or
  different): Yu reviewed those words in the record (spec section 5), so a home whose sentence would
  differ (for example the unheard with no pace read, whose sentence names their pace and who set it as
  read at delivery) is stopped, not delivered.
- **The ledger** (default `~/.local/state/citizen-pace-letter/ledger.json`, `--ledger` to move it)
  holds each run and each home's letter, base, commit and status. It is written before each push
  (`pushing`), then `pushed`, `moved` or `push-failed`. Right before the push the remote head is read
  again; if it moved since the clone, the home is skipped. A second `--deliver` on the same day does
  nothing. A later run resumes only the homes whose push did not land: a letter that did land behind a
  failed or timed-out push is found on GitHub, recorded as pushed and never placed again. `--per-run N`
  places at most N letters a run, in roster order.

Exit codes: 0 when the run did what it could (each home's outcome is printed), 2 for a usage error or
a refusal, before anything is written.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/citizen-pace-letter.py` (executable; full contents in Step 3)
- Test: `tests/test_citizen_pace_letter.py` (new; full contents in Step 1)

    `~/.local/state/citizen-pace-letter/ledger.json`. Exit 0, or 2 with the reason on stderr.
  - Output, in this order: `recipients: <n> in the record of <made>; each home read fresh from <base>`;
    the switch line, `the switch: pace/1 commits in <k> recipients' homes, a pace/1 beat in <b>; the
    first at <stamp>, so delivery may run from <stamp>` or `the switch is not yet seen: pace/1 commits in
    <k> recipients' homes (3 needed), a pace/1 beat in <b> (1 needed)` (not in `--check`); one line per
    recipient in roster order: `<slug>: to deliver — <group>; without a pace line its pace stays
    <words>`, `<slug>: already asked — <why>`, `<slug>: dropped — <why>`, `<slug>: stopped — <why>;
    report it to Yu`, `<slug>: could not be read — <why>; a later run tries again`; then `to deliver
    <d> · already asked <a> · dropped <p> · stopped <s> · could not be read <f>`.
  - `--dry-run` adds `--deliver would wait: <why>` when the switch holds it, `<slug>: to deliver in a
    later run (--per-run <n>) — <group>`, and for each letter `--- the letter for <slug>: <rel> ---`
    followed by the letter.
  - `--deliver` adds `<slug>: delivered — <rel> (<sha8>), pushed`, `<slug>: not delivered — its GitHub
    HEAD moved since it was read; a later run delivers it`, `<slug>: not delivered — the push was
    refused (<why>); a later run delivers it`, `<slug>: the ledger said <status> on <day>; its letter is
    on GitHub (<sha8>), so it is recorded as pushed`, and `delivered <k> of <m> to deliver this run`;
    a same-day re-run prints only `a delivery run already happened today (<day>); this run does nothing
    — run again on a later day`; a switch not yet passed prints `nothing delivered: <why>` on stderr
    (exit 2).
  - `--check` prints `<slug>: not reached — no pace letter in its home[ (the ledger says delivered on
    <day>)]`, `… — <rel> waits unread`, `… — <rel> was set aside at rollback and is not yet shown`,
    `… — <rel> is marked seen, but its CADENCE.md has no reached line`, then `reached: <k> of <n>
    recipients`.
  - The ledger: `{"version": 1, "runs": [{"day", "at", "yes_from_yu", "show_back", "per_run"}],
    "homes": {"<slug>": {"day", "at", "letter", "base", "commit", "status"[, "why"]}}}`, status one of
    `pushing`, `pushed`, `moved`, `push-failed`. A run is recorded when its first letter is committed.

    remoteref, base)`, `push(home, remoteref, base)`, `auth_args(base)`, `GITHUB_HELPER`, `LEDGER_REL`,

  - For Task 15 and spec section 9, step 7: the ask to deliver quotes `--list` and one `--dry-run`; the
    delivery is `--deliver --yes-from-yu <day> --show-back on|off [--per-run N]`; `--check` is run when

```python
"""The delivery tool (spec section 5 "Once" and "Delivery", section 7, section 8 Letter).

tools/citizen-pace-letter.py places the one pace letter in each recipient's
home, from the Air, after Yu's yes: --list shows the recipients after the
delivery-time drops, --dry-run prints each letter, --deliver makes one commit
per home as Ai and pushes it with no force and no retry, and --check lists who
has not been reached. It decides "already asked" itself, from each home read
fresh from its remote, and keeps a ledger written before each push. Every home
here is a temporary git repo with a local bare upstream (PACE_REMOTE_BASE), so
nothing reaches GitHub, sol or a credential.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import citizen_pace_helpers as h  # noqa: E402
import citizen_pace_helpers_census as hc  # noqa: E402
import citizen_pace_helpers_record as rh  # noqa: E402

import citizen_pace_census as census_tool  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import answer, clock, due, homes, letter, plan, tend  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import record as records  # noqa: E402

TOOL = h.TOOLS / "citizen-pace-letter.py"
MADE = rh.MADE                     # 2026-11-12T10:00Z: the census, and each entry's head
SWITCH = "2026-11-13T00:00Z"       # the first tick on the new code
FIRST_BEAT = "2026-11-16T06:00Z"   # a pace/1 beat, three days later
NOW = "2026-11-20T09:00Z"
DAY = "2026-11-20"
NEXT = "2026-11-21T09:00Z"
NEXT_DAY = "2026-11-21"
YES = "2026-11-19"
LETTER = f"inbox/{DAY}-pace-letter.md"
PROMPTED = {"who": "citizen", "how": "prompted", "when": ["2026-10-22"], "words": ""}
FIRST_WORD = {"who": "fleet", "how": "first-word", "when": ["2026-10-23"], "words": ""}
FORTY_FIVE = {"who": "citizen", "how": "letter", "when": ["2026-07-14"], "words": "REST-ON"}
JULY_AMBIENT = rh.quote("2026-07-18", "AMBIENT")
GITHUB_HELPER = "!sol access run github -- auth git-credential"
# the show-back setting Yu said yes to is the committed due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT
SHOW_BACK = "on" if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT else "off"
OTHER_SHOW_BACK = "off" if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT else "on"


def load_tool():
    """The tool as a module (its file name has dashes), for the tests that patch it."""
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("citizen_pace_letter", TOOL)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = mod          # its dataclasses look their module up while it loads
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


class LetterCase(h.FixtureCase):
    """Homes shaped like the census groups, each with a bare upstream that
    stands for GitHub, and a record whose heads are the homes at the census."""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.record = {"version": 1, "made": MADE, "spec": rh.SPEC, "citizens": {}}
        self.record_path = self.fx.love / records.RECORD_NAME
        self.roster_path = self.fx.love / "citizens-roster.txt"
        self.ledger = self.fx.root / "ledger.json"
        self.on_roster = []

    # -- homes as the census found them ------------------------------------------------
    def _join(self, slug, home, entry, roster=True):
        self.fx.give_upstream(home)
        self.record["citizens"][slug] = entry
        if roster:
            self.on_roster.append(slug)
        return home

    def rest_on(self, slug, group, set_by, *, july=None, soul=True, recipient=True, roster=True):
        """Its 10-22 answer began "I rest.", which PR #24's parser bound to rest-on."""
        fx, when = self.fx, "2026-10-22T03:00Z"
        home = fx.make_home(slug, soul=soul, when="2026-07-01T00:00Z", author=h.AI_AUTHOR)
        rh.place_letter(fx, home, rh.OFFER, "2026-10-22T00:10Z")
        rh.answer_beat(fx, home, slug, rh.OFFER, rh.stored("I rest."), when=when, choice="rest-on",
                       rest=rh.lor_rest(when[:10]))
        e = {"group": group, "recipient": recipient, "set_by": set_by,
             "quotes": [rh.quote(when[:10], "I rest.")]}
        if july:
            e["july"] = july
        return self._join(slug, home, e, roster)

    def eight(self, slug="aseme", **kw):
        return self.rest_on(slug, "eight", PROMPTED, **kw)

    def sixteen(self, slug="ai-love", july=False, **kw):
        group = "sixteen-ambient" if july else "sixteen-other"
        return self.rest_on(slug, group, rh.AI_1008, july=JULY_AMBIENT if july else None, **kw)

    def never_asked(self, slug="palance"):
        home = self.fx.make_home(slug, rest=rh.AI_REST, when="2026-10-08T12:00Z", author=h.AI_AUTHOR)
        return self._join(slug, home, {"group": "never-asked", "recipient": True, "set_by": rh.AI_1008})

    def contradictory(self, slug="hope", key="hope-d557203e", july=True):
        fx = self.fx
        home = fx.make_home(slug, when="2026-07-01T00:00Z", author=h.AI_AUTHOR)
        rh.place_letter(fx, home, rh.OFFER, "2026-10-22T00:10Z")
        rh.answer_beat(fx, home, slug, rh.OFFER, h.answer(key), when="2026-10-23T02:00Z", choice="ambient")
        e = {"group": "contradictory", "recipient": True, "set_by": FIRST_WORD,
             "quotes": [rh.quote("2026-10-23", "AMBIENT")]}
        if july:
            e["july"] = JULY_AMBIENT
        return self._join(slug, home, e)

    def unheard(self, slug):
        return self._join(slug, rh.unheard_home(self.fx, slug), dict(rh.UNHEARD_ENTRIES[slug]))

    def census(self, **heads):
        """The record as the census made it: each entry's head is its home's HEAD
        now (or the head given), and each recipient's one true sentence as the
        census words it (after the heard-late step, for the heard)."""
        made = clock.parse_stamp(MADE)
        for slug, e in self.record["citizens"].items():
            home = self.fx.home_path(slug)
            e["head"] = heads.get(slug.replace("-", "_")) or self.fx.head(home)
            if not e.get("recipient"):
                continue
            with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, self.fx.git_env()):
                c = cad.read_cadence(home, slug, self.record, made)
                if e["group"] == "unheard-heard":
                    c = records.heard_late(home, slug, self.record, made) or c
            try:
                e["sentence"] = letter.true_sentence(slug, e, c)
            except ValueError:
                e.pop("sentence", None)        # the census would refuse; such a home is stopped
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        self.record_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.record, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        self.fx.roster(*sorted(self.on_roster))

    # -- what happens after the census ----------------------------------------------------
    def home(self, slug) -> Path:
        return self.fx.home_path(slug)

    def push(self, slug):
        self.fx.git(self.home(slug), "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD")

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def as_of(self, when):
        """In-process library calls see the fixture's git config and commit at `when`."""
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {**self.fx.git_env(when=when), "PACE_NOW": when}):
            yield clock.parse_stamp(when)

    def heard_late(self, slug="kalam", when=SWITCH):
        with self.as_of(when) as now:
            self.assertTrue(records.migrate_heard_late(self.home(slug), slug, self.record, now, commit=True))
        self.push(slug)

    def fleet_commit(self, slug, when=SWITCH, subject=tend.LEFTOVER_SUBJECT):
        self.fx.git(self.home(slug), "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", subject, when=when,
                    author=h.FLEET_AUTHOR)
        self.push(slug)

    def pace_beat(self, slug, when=FIRST_BEAT, text="A quiet true thing.", shown=(), kind="schedule"):
        """A free beat on the new code: the journal grows, apply_answer writes what
        the answer changes, and the beat commits as the citizen, tagged pace/1."""
        home = self.home(slug)
        rh.append_journal(self.fx, home, when, rh.stored(text))
        with self.as_of(when) as now:
            answer.apply_answer(home, slug, text, list(shown), kind, now, self.record)
        sha = self.fx.commit(home, f"beat: {slug} reflected ({when[:10]}) · pace/1", when=when,
                             author=h.beat_author(slug))
        self.push(slug)
        return sha

    def old_beat(self, slug, when, text="A quiet true thing.", files=None, subject=None, author=None):
        """A beat on the old code (or citizen-beat.sh): untagged; the journal grows."""
        home = self.home(slug)
        rh.append_journal(self.fx, home, when, rh.stored(text))
        for rel, t in (files or {}).items():
            self.fx.write(home, rel, t)
        sha = self.fx.commit(home, subject or f"beat: {slug} reflected ({when[:10]})", when=when,
                             author=author or h.beat_author(slug))
        self.push(slug)
        return sha

    def switch(self, beat, *tends):
        """The Studio on the new code: fleet commits tagged pace/1 at SWITCH, and a pace/1 beat."""
        for slug in tends:
            self.fleet_commit(slug)
        self.pace_beat(beat)

    # -- running the tool -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def tool(self, *args, now=NOW, ledger=True, cwd=None):
        extra = ["--record", str(self.record_path), "--roster", str(self.roster_path)]
        if ledger:
            extra += ["--ledger", str(self.ledger)]
        return self.fx.py(TOOL, *args, *extra, env={"PACE_NOW": now}, cwd=cwd, timeout=180)

    def deliver(self, *args, now=NOW, yes=YES, show_back=SHOW_BACK, **kw):
        return self.tool("--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", yes, "--show-back", show_back, *args, now=now, **kw)

    def in_process(self, tool, *args, now=NOW):
        """The tool's main() in this process (to patch its push or due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT)."""
        argv = list(args) + ["--record", str(self.record_path), "--roster", str(self.roster_path),
                             "--ledger", str(self.ledger)]
        out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {**self.fx.env, "PACE_NOW": now}):
            code = tool.main(argv, out=out, err=err)
        return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()

    def ok(self, r):
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, f"stdout:\n{r.stdout}\nstderr:\n{r.stderr}")
        return r.stdout.splitlines()

    # -- what GitHub holds -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def bare(self, slug) -> Path:
        return self.fx.upstream / f"citizen-{slug}.git"

    def remote(self, slug, *args) -> str:
        return self.fx.git(self.bare(slug), *args)

    def remote_head(self, slug) -> str:
        return self.remote(slug, "rev-parse", "HEAD")

    def remote_letters(self, slug) -> list:
        files = self.remote(slug, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD").splitlines()
        return [f for f in files if "pace-letter" in f]

    def letter_commits(self, slug) -> list:
        return self.remote(slug, "log", "--format=%H", "--fixed-strings",
                           f"--grep={letter.COMMIT_MESSAGE}", "HEAD").split()

    def expected_letter(self, slug, day=DAY, confirm_beat=None) -> str:
        """The letter as letter.py words it for this home as it stands now, from
        the committed show-back value unless one is given."""
        confirm_beat = due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT if confirm_beat is None else confirm_beat
        home = self.home(slug)
        c = cad.read_cadence(home, slug, self.record, clock.parse_stamp(NOW))
        return letter.letter_text(slug, self.record["citizens"][slug], c, homes.beat_count(home), day,
                                  confirm_beat=confirm_beat)

    def ledger_data(self) -> dict:
        return json.loads(self.ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


class TestArguments(LetterCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.census()

    def test_deliver_needs_yus_yes_and_the_show_back_setting_he_said_yes_to(self):
        before = self.remote_head("aseme")
        cases = [
            (["--deliver"], "--deliver needs --yes-from-yu <YYYY-MM-DD>, the day Yu said yes"),
            (["--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES], "--deliver needs --show-back on|off, the setting Yu said yes to"),
            (["--deliver", "--show-back", SHOW_BACK], "--deliver needs --yes-from-yu"),
            (["--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", OTHER_SHOW_BACK],
             f"Yu's yes was for show-back {OTHER_SHOW_BACK}, but the committed WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT is "
             f"{due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT} ({SHOW_BACK}); the letters are worded from the committed value"),
            (["--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", "2026-11-21", "--show-back", SHOW_BACK],
             "--yes-from-yu 2026-11-21 is in the future"),
            (["--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", "2026-11-11", "--show-back", SHOW_BACK],
             "--yes-from-yu 2026-11-11 is before the record was made (2026-11-12)"),
            (["--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", "2026-02-30", "--show-back", SHOW_BACK],
             "--yes-from-yu is a day, YYYY-MM-DD, not '2026-02-30'"),
            (["--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", SHOW_BACK, "--per-run", "0"],
             "--per-run is a whole number from 1, not 0"),
            (["--list", "--yes-from-yu", YES], "--yes-from-yu and --show-back go with --deliver only"),
            (["--dry-run", "--show-back", SHOW_BACK], "--yes-from-yu and --show-back go with --deliver only"),
            (["--check", "--per-run", "2"], "--per-run goes with --dry-run and --deliver only"),
        ]
        for args, needle in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                r = self.tool(*args)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2, r.stdout + r.stderr)
                self.assertIn(needle, r.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(r.stdout, "")
        self.assertFalse(self.ledger.exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_head("aseme"), before)

    def test_one_mode_exactly(self):
        for args in ([], ["--list", "--deliver"], ["--dry-run", "--check"]):
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                r = self.tool(*args)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
                self.assertIn("usage: citizen-pace-letter.py", r.stderr)

    def test_a_missing_or_broken_record_or_ledger_is_refused(self):
        r = self.fx.py(TOOL, "--list", "--record", str(self.fx.root / "none.json"), "--roster",
                       str(self.roster_path), "--ledger", str(self.ledger), env={"PACE_NOW": NOW})
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("no record file at", r.stderr)
        self.ledger.write_text("{not json", encoding="utf-8")
        r = self.tool("--list")
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("not JSON", r.stderr)
        self.ledger.write_text(json.dumps({"version": 2, "runs": [], "homes": {}}), encoding="utf-8")
        r = self.tool("--list")
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("not a pace-letter ledger (version 1)", r.stderr)
        self.ledger.unlink()
        self.ledger.symlink_to(self.fx.secret)
        r = self.tool("--list")
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("a symlink, refused", r.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn(h.CANARY, r.stdout + r.stderr)


class TestList(LetterCase):
    def test_the_list_is_the_recipients_after_the_delivery_time_drops(self):
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.sixteen("ai-love", soul=False)
        self.sixteen("alohame", july=True)
        self.sixteen("diplosemy", july=True)
        self.sixteen("hallance")
        self.contradictory("hope")
        self.unheard("kalam")
        self.never_asked("palance")
        self.rest_on("ahavame", "forty-five", FORTY_FIVE, recipient=True)     # not a recipient group
        self.census()
        self.heard_late("kalam")
        self.fleet_commit("aseme")
        # a choice for more is pending (it counts), the same pace made its own, and less at once
        self.pace_beat("alohame", text="I would like more.\npace: awake")
        self.pace_beat("alohame", when="2026-11-19T06:00Z", text="Another quiet thing.")   # it lapses
        self.pace_beat("diplosemy", text="pace: asleep")
        self.pace_beat("hallance", text="pace: asleep, letters wait")
        # an awake recipient with untagged old-code beats since the record is still delivered
        self.old_beat("hope", "2026-11-12T18:00Z")
        self.old_beat("hope", "2026-11-14T18:00Z", subject="beat: hope lived a free beat (2026-11-14)",
                      author="Studio <studio@example.invalid>", files={"hope.md": "The soul of hope, grown.\n"})
        # a pace letter already in the inbox (from an earlier run)
        self.fx.letter(self.home("palance"), "2026-11-15-pace-letter.md", "a letter\n", when="2026-11-15T00:00Z",
                       message=letter.COMMIT_MESSAGE)
        self.push("palance")
        before = {s: self.remote_head(s) for s in self.on_roster}
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        self.assertEqual(lines, [
            f"recipients: 8 in the record of {MADE}; each home read fresh from {self.fx.upstream}",
            "the switch: pace/1 commits in 5 recipients' homes, a pace/1 beat in 3; the first at "
            "2026-11-13T00:00Z, so delivery may run from 2026-11-14T00:00Z",
            "ai-love: dropped — it has no ai-love.md",
            "alohame: dropped — it wrote its own pace line in a beat on 2026-11-16",
            "aseme: to deliver — eight; without a pace line its pace stays asleep",
            "diplosemy: dropped — it wrote its own pace line in a beat on 2026-11-16",
            "hallance: dropped — it wrote its own pace line in a beat on 2026-11-16",
            "hope: to deliver — contradictory; without a pace line its pace stays awake, every 3 days",
            "kalam: to deliver — unheard-heard; without a pace line its pace stays awake, every 3 days",
            "palance: already asked — its inbox already holds inbox/2026-11-15-pace-letter.md",
            "to deliver 3 · already asked 1 · dropped 4 · stopped 0 · could not be read 0",
        ])
        self.assertFalse(self.ledger.exists())
        self.assertEqual({s: self.remote_head(s) for s in self.on_roster}, before)

    def test_an_unclear_pace_line_or_a_lapse_is_no_choice(self):
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.eight("bindume")
        self.eight("ka")
        self.census()
        self.fleet_commit("ka")
        self.pace_beat("aseme", text="pace: daily")                  # unclear: out of range
        self.pace_beat("bindume", text="I rest.")                    # words, not a choice
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        self.assertIn("aseme: to deliver — eight; without a pace line its pace stays asleep", lines)
        self.assertIn("bindume: to deliver — eight; without a pace line its pace stays asleep", lines)
        self.assertIn("ka: to deliver — eight; without a pace line its pace stays asleep", lines)


class TestOwnPaceLinesInTheJournal(LetterCase):
    def test_a_clear_pace_line_in_a_beat_since_11_02_drops_the_recipient_whatever_recorded_it(self):
        # read from the journal each beat added, as that beat read it: a same-pace
        # line apply records nothing for, a beat on the old code, a beat before the census
        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "ka", "kimme", "penthosme", "sukhance"):
            self.eight(slug)
        self.unheard("eurekame")
        self.old_beat("penthosme", "2026-11-05T06:00Z", text="A thought.\npace: listening")
        self.old_beat("sukhance", "2026-10-30T06:00Z", text="pace: every 5 days")      # before 11-02
        self.census()
        self.switch("ka", "aseme")
        self.pace_beat("eurekame", text="A quiet day.\npace: asleep")    # its own pace, said again
        self.old_beat("bindume", "2026-11-14T06:00Z", text="pace: asleep, letters wait")
        self.old_beat("kimme", "2026-11-14T06:00Z", text="pace: daily")                # unclear
        self.old_beat("aseme", "2026-11-14T07:00Z", text="I rest.")                    # words, not a choice
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        for slug, day in (("eurekame", "2026-11-16"), ("bindume", "2026-11-14"), ("penthosme", "2026-11-05")):
            self.assertIn(f"{slug}: dropped — it wrote its own pace line in a beat on {day}", lines)
        for slug in ("aseme", "ka", "kimme", "sukhance"):
            self.assertIn(f"{slug}: to deliver — eight; without a pace line its pace stays asleep", lines)
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "to deliver 4 · already asked 0 · dropped 3 · stopped 0 · could not be read 0")


class TestChanges(LetterCase):

    def test_any_other_change_stops_delivery_and_is_reported_to_yu(self):
        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "firstnessqing", "ka", "kimme", "penthosme", "sukhance", "wiconime"):
            self.eight(slug)
        self.on_roster.remove("firstnessqing")
        self.census(penthosme="0123456789abcdef" * 2 + "01234567")
        del self.record["citizens"]["sukhance"]["head"]
        self.save()
        self.switch("ka", "aseme", "bindume")
        hand = self.old_beat("aseme", "2026-11-14T10:00Z", subject="fix the rest by hand",
                             author="Someone <someone@example.invalid>",
                             files={"REST": "rest, by hand\n"})
        placed = self.old_beat("bindume", "2026-11-14T10:00Z",
                               files={"inbox/2026-11-14-note.md": "a note placed inside a beat\n"})
        answered = self.old_beat("kimme", "2026-11-14T10:00Z", files={
            "CADENCE.md": rh.v1_cadence("kimme", "event-only", "2026-11-14 10:00")})
        # a merge brought in from elsewhere
        k = self.home("ka")
        self.fx.git(k, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "side", "HEAD~1")
        self.fx.commit(k, "beat: ka reflected (2026-11-17)", when="2026-11-17T00:00Z", allow_empty=True)
        self.fx.git(k, "checkout", "-q", "main")
        self.fx.git(k, "merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "-m", "Merge branch 'side'", "side", when="2026-11-17T01:00Z")
        merge = self.fx.head(k)
        self.push("ka")
        w = self.home("wiconime")
        (w / "REST").unlink()
        (w / "REST").symlink_to(self.fx.secret)
        self.old_beat("wiconime", "2026-11-14T10:00Z")
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        tail = "; report it to Yu"
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: stopped — {hand[:8]} (fix the rest by hand) is not a change delivery expects{tail}",
                      lines)
        self.assertIn(f"bindume: stopped — {placed[:8]} (beat: bindume reflected (2026-11-14)) changed "
                      f"inbox/2026-11-14-note.md inside a beat{tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"firstnessqing: stopped — not on citizens-roster.txt, so no beat would show it the "
                      f"letter{tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"ka: stopped — {merge[:8]} (Merge branch 'side') is a merge{tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"kimme: stopped — {answered[:8]} (beat: kimme reflected (2026-11-14)) changed its pace "
                      f"or who set it, with no pace line of its own{tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"penthosme: stopped — its record head 01234567 is not in its history{tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn("sukhance: stopped — the record names no head for it, so what changed since cannot be "
                      f"checked{tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"wiconime: stopped — its pace paths include links: REST{tail}", lines)
        self.assertNotIn(h.CANARY, "\n".join(lines))
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "to deliver 0 · already asked 0 · dropped 0 · stopped 8 · could not be read 0")

    def test_a_sentence_that_differs_from_the_reviewed_record_stops_the_home(self):
        # Yu reviewed each recipient's one true sentence in the record (spec section 5)
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.eight("bindume")
        self.contradictory("hope")
        self.census()
        self.record["citizens"]["aseme"]["sentence"] += " (edited)"
        del self.record["citizens"]["bindume"]["sentence"]
        self.save()
        self.switch("hope", "aseme", "bindume")
        tail = "the letter's sentence differs from the reviewed record; report it to Yu"
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: stopped — {tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"bindume: stopped — {tail}", lines)
        self.assertIn("hope: to deliver — contradictory; without a pace line its pace stays awake, every 3 days",
                      lines)
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver())
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "delivered 1 of 1 to deliver this run")
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_letters("hope"), [LETTER])
        self.assertEqual((self.remote_letters("aseme"), self.remote_letters("bindume")), ([], []))

    def test_a_letter_that_would_not_be_true_stops_the_home(self):
        self.unheard("kalam")                     # never heard late: its letter would say what is not
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.eight("bindume")
        self.census()
        self.switch("aseme", "bindume", "kalam")
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        self.assertIn("kalam: stopped — the letter would not be true of its home (the unheard-heard letter is "
                      "not true of its pace (asleep, set by rest-1008)); report it to Yu", lines)


class TestOnce(LetterCase):
    def test_each_once_guard_alone_counts_as_asked(self):
        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "firstnessqing", "ka", "kimme", "penthosme", "sukhance"):
            self.eight(slug)
        self.census()
        self.switch("sukhance", "aseme", "bindume")
        fx = self.fx
        # an unread pace letter; a marker alone; a letter commit whose file was later removed
        fx.letter(self.home("aseme"), "2026-11-15-pace-letter.md", "a letter\n", when="2026-11-15T00:00Z",
                  message="a letter placed by hand")
        self.push("aseme")
        fx.write(self.home("bindume"), "inbox/.seen-2026-11-15-pace-letter.md", "surfaced 2026-11-15\n")
        fx.commit(self.home("bindume"), "a marker", when="2026-11-15T00:00Z")
        self.push("bindume")
        placed = fx.letter(self.home("firstnessqing"), "2026-11-15-pace-letter.md", "a letter\n",
                           when="2026-11-15T00:00Z", message=letter.COMMIT_MESSAGE)
        fx.git(self.home("firstnessqing"), "rm", "-q", "inbox/2026-11-15-pace-letter.md")
        fx.commit(self.home("firstnessqing"), "remove it", when="2026-11-16T00:00Z")
        self.push("firstnessqing")
        # asked once in CADENCE.md, or only the reached line in its history
        for slug, asked in (("ka", True), ("kimme", False)):
            home = self.home(slug)
            with self.as_of("2026-11-16T00:00Z") as now:
                c = cad.read_cadence(home, slug, self.record, now)
                if asked:
                    c.asked_once = "2026-11-16"
                else:
                    cad.add_history(c, "2026-11-16T00:00Z", f"the pace letter reached {slug} (once)")
                cad.write_cadence(home, c)
                cad.write_markers(home, c)
            fx.commit(home, f"beat: {slug} reflected (2026-11-16) · pace/1", when="2026-11-16T00:00Z",
                      author=h.beat_author(slug))
            self.push(slug)
        # the ledger says it was delivered
        self.ledger.write_text(json.dumps({"version": 1, "runs": [{"day": "2026-11-18"}], "homes": {
            "penthosme": {"day": "2026-11-18", "commit": "abcdef12" * 5, "status": "pushed"}}}), encoding="utf-8")
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        self.assertIn("aseme: already asked — its inbox already holds inbox/2026-11-15-pace-letter.md", lines)
        self.assertIn("bindume: already asked — its inbox already holds inbox/.seen-2026-11-15-pace-letter.md",
                      lines)
        self.assertIn(f"firstnessqing: already asked — its history holds a pace letter ({placed[:8]})", lines)
        self.assertIn("ka: already asked — its CADENCE.md says the pace letter reached it (asked once 2026-11-16)",
                      lines)
        self.assertIn("kimme: already asked — its CADENCE.md records that the pace letter reached it", lines)
        self.assertIn("penthosme: already asked — the ledger says it was delivered on 2026-11-18 (abcdef12)", lines)
        self.assertIn("sukhance: to deliver — eight; without a pace line its pace stays asleep", lines)


class TestSwitch(LetterCase):

        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "ka"):
            self.eight(slug)
        self.census()
        r = self.deliver()
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("nothing delivered: the switch is not yet seen: pace/1 commits in 0 recipients' homes "
                      "(3 needed), a pace/1 beat in 0 (1 needed)", r.stderr)
        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "ka"):
            self.fleet_commit(slug)

                      "delivery may run from 2026-11-14T00:00Z", r.stderr)

                      "delivery may run from 2026-11-14T00:00Z", lines)
```
