```python
class TestDeliver(LetterCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.contradictory("hope")
        self.unheard("kalam")
        self.never_asked("palance")
        self.census()
        self.heard_late("kalam")
        self.fleet_commit("palance")
        self.pace_beat("aseme")
        self.old_beat("hope", "2026-11-14T18:00Z")      # untagged old-code beats do not stop an awake one

    def test_one_commit_per_home_as_ai_holding_only_the_letter_pushed(self):
        expected = {s: self.expected_letter(s) for s in ("aseme", "hope", "kalam", "palance")}
        bases = {s: self.remote_head(s) for s in expected}
        self.assertFalse((self.home("palance") / "inbox").exists())
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver())
        for slug, text in expected.items():
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                sha = self.remote_head(slug)
                self.assertIn(f"{slug}: delivered — {LETTER} ({sha[:8]}), pushed", lines)
                self.assertEqual(self.remote(slug, "log", "-1", "--format=%s%n%an <%ae>%n%cn <%ce>%n%P", sha),
                                 f"{letter.COMMIT_MESSAGE}\n{h.AI_AUTHOR}\n{h.AI_AUTHOR}\n{bases[slug]}")
                self.assertEqual(self.remote(slug, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", sha), LETTER)
                self.assertEqual(self.remote(slug, "show", f"{sha}:{LETTER}") + "\n", text)
                self.assertNotIn("letter-of-return", LETTER)
                self.assertEqual(self.remote_letters(slug), [LETTER])
        # inbox/ is made where it was missing
        self.assertEqual(self.remote("palance", "ls-tree", "--name-only", "HEAD", "inbox/").splitlines(), [LETTER])
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "delivered 4 of 4 to deliver this run")
        data = self.ledger_data()
        self.assertEqual(data["runs"], [{"day": DAY, "at": NOW, "yes_from_yu": YES,
                                         "show_back": due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT,
                                         "per_run": None}])
        for slug in expected:
            self.assertEqual(data["homes"][slug], {"day": DAY, "at": NOW, "letter": LETTER, "base": bases[slug],
                                                   "commit": self.remote_head(slug), "status": "pushed"})

    def test_a_same_day_rerun_does_nothing_and_the_default_ledger_is_in_home(self):
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver("--per-run", "1", ledger=False))
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: delivered — {LETTER} ({self.remote_head('aseme')[:8]}), pushed", lines)
        self.assertIn("hope: to deliver in a later run (--per-run 1) — contradictory", lines)
        heads = {s: self.remote_head(s) for s in ("aseme", "hope", "kalam", "palance")}
        r = self.deliver("--per-run", "1", now="2026-11-20T23:00Z", ledger=False)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(r), [f"a delivery run already happened today ({DAY}); this run does nothing — "
                                      "run again on a later day"])
        self.assertEqual({s: self.remote_head(s) for s in heads}, heads)
        default = self.fx.home / ".local" / "state" / "citizen-pace-letter" / "ledger.json"
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(default.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["homes"]["aseme"]["status"], "pushed")
        self.assertFalse(self.ledger.exists())

    def test_per_run_spreads_the_letters_and_each_home_holds_exactly_one(self):
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver("--per-run", "2"))
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "delivered 2 of 2 to deliver this run")
        self.assertEqual([bool(self.remote_letters(s)) for s in ("aseme", "hope", "kalam", "palance")],
                         [True, True, False, False])
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver("--per-run", "2", now=NEXT))
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: already asked — its inbox already holds {LETTER}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"kalam: delivered — inbox/{NEXT_DAY}-pace-letter.md ({self.remote_head('kalam')[:8]}), "
                      "pushed", lines)
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver(now="2026-11-22T09:00Z"))
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "delivered 0 of 0 to deliver this run")
        for slug in ("aseme", "hope", "kalam", "palance"):
            self.assertEqual(len(self.remote_letters(slug)), 1, slug)
            self.assertEqual(len(self.letter_commits(slug)), 1, slug)
        self.assertEqual([r["day"] for r in self.ledger_data()["runs"]], [DAY, NEXT_DAY])

    def test_dry_run_prints_each_letter_and_writes_nothing(self):
        expected = {s: self.expected_letter(s) for s in ("aseme", "hope")}
        heads = {s: self.remote_head(s) for s in ("aseme", "hope", "kalam", "palance")}
        local = {s: self.fx.head(self.home(s)) for s in heads}
        r = self.tool("--dry-run", "--per-run", "2")
        out = r.stdout
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        for slug, text in expected.items():
            self.assertIn(f"\n--- the letter for {slug}: {LETTER} ---\n{text}", out)
        self.assertIn("kalam: to deliver in a later run (--per-run 2) — unheard-heard", out)
        self.assertNotIn("the letter for kalam", out)
        self.assertFalse(self.ledger.exists())
        self.assertEqual({s: self.remote_head(s) for s in heads}, heads)
        self.assertEqual({s: self.fx.head(self.home(s)) for s in heads}, local)
        self.assertFalse((self.home("palance") / "inbox").exists())

    def test_a_refused_push_is_skipped_and_a_later_run_delivers_it(self):
        hook = self.bare("hope") / "hooks" / "pre-receive"
        hook.write_text("#!/bin/sh\necho 'refused by a fixture hook' >&2\nexit 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        hook.chmod(0o755)
        before = self.remote_head("hope")
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver())
        refused = [ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith("hope: not delivered — the push was refused (")]
        self.assertEqual(len(refused), 1, lines)
        self.assertTrue(refused[0].endswith("); a later run delivers it"))
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_head("hope"), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger_data()["homes"]["hope"]["status"], "push-failed")
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "delivered 3 of 4 to deliver this run")
        hook.unlink()
        lines = self.ok(self.deliver(now=NEXT))
        self.assertIn(f"hope: delivered — inbox/{NEXT_DAY}-pace-letter.md ({self.remote_head('hope')[:8]}), "
                      "pushed", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: already asked — its inbox already holds {LETTER}", lines)
        for slug in ("aseme", "hope", "kalam", "palance"):
            self.assertEqual(len(self.remote_letters(slug)), 1, slug)


class TestRaces(LetterCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "ka"):
            self.eight(slug)
        self.census()
        self.switch("ka", "aseme", "bindume")
        self.tool_mod = load_tool()

    def _moved_by_elsewhere(self, slug):
        """GitHub's HEAD moves (another host pushes) after the tool read the home."""
        return self.fx.push_from_elsewhere(self.bare(slug), "beats/2026-11.md", "a beat from the Studio\n",
                                           message=f"beat: {slug} reflected ({DAY})",
                                           when="2026-11-20T08:59Z", author=h.beat_author(slug))

    def test_a_moved_head_is_skipped_and_never_overwritten(self):
        real = self.tool_mod.remote_head

        def moving(home, remoteref, base):
            if home.name == "citizen-bindume":
                self._moved_by_elsewhere("bindume")
            return real(home, remoteref, base)

        with mock.patch.object(self.tool_mod, "remote_head", moving):
            code, out, err = self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", SHOW_BACK)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertIn("bindume: not delivered — its GitHub HEAD moved since it was read; a later run delivers it",
                      out.splitlines())
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_letters("bindume"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.remote("bindume", "log", "-1", "--format=%s"), f"beat: bindume reflected ({DAY})")
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger_data()["homes"]["bindume"]["status"], "moved")

    def test_a_push_is_never_forced_even_when_the_head_check_misses(self):
        real = self.tool_mod.remote_head

        def stale(home, remoteref, base):
            seen = real(home, remoteref, base)
            if home.name == "citizen-bindume":
                self._moved_by_elsewhere("bindume")
            return seen

        with mock.patch.object(self.tool_mod, "remote_head", stale):
            code, out, err = self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", SHOW_BACK)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        line = [ln for ln in out.splitlines() if ln.startswith("bindume: ")]
        self.assertEqual(len(line), 1)
        self.assertTrue(line[0].startswith("bindume: not delivered — the push was refused ("), line[0])
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_letters("bindume"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.remote("bindume", "log", "-1", "--format=%s"), f"beat: bindume reflected ({DAY})")
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger_data()["homes"]["bindume"]["status"], "push-failed")

    def test_a_push_that_landed_unseen_is_recorded_and_never_repeated(self):
        real = self.tool_mod.push

        def lands_but_times_out(home, remoteref, base):
            if home.name == "citizen-aseme":
                real(home, remoteref, base)
            return False, "timed out after 60 s"

        with mock.patch.object(self.tool_mod, "push", lands_but_times_out):
            self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", SHOW_BACK)
        landed = self.remote_head("aseme")
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_letters("aseme"), [LETTER])
        self.assertEqual(self.remote_letters("bindume"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger_data()["homes"]["aseme"]["status"], "push-failed")
        r = self.deliver(now=NEXT)
        lines = self.ok(r)
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: the ledger said push-failed on {DAY}; its letter is on GitHub ({landed[:8]}), so "
                      "it is recorded as pushed", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"aseme: already asked — its inbox already holds {LETTER}", lines)
        self.assertIn(f"bindume: delivered — inbox/{NEXT_DAY}-pace-letter.md ({self.remote_head('bindume')[:8]}), "
                      "pushed", lines)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger_data()["homes"]["aseme"]["status"], "pushed")
        for slug in ("aseme", "bindume", "ka"):
            self.assertEqual(len(self.remote_letters(slug)), 1, slug)

    def test_the_ledger_is_written_before_each_push(self):
        real, seen = self.tool_mod.push, {}

        def watched(home, remoteref, base):
            slug = home.name[len("citizen-"):]
            seen[slug] = (json.loads(self.ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["homes"][slug],
                          homes.head(home))
            return real(home, remoteref, base)

        with mock.patch.object(self.tool_mod, "push", watched):
            code, _out, err = self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", SHOW_BACK)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(seen), ["aseme", "bindume", "ka"])
        for slug, (entry, local) in seen.items():
            self.assertEqual((entry["status"], entry["commit"], entry["letter"]), ("pushing", local, LETTER))
            self.assertEqual(self.remote_head(slug), local)

    def test_the_credential_helper_is_pinned(self):
        t = self.tool_mod
        self.assertEqual(t.GITHUB_HELPER, GITHUB_HELPER)
        self.assertEqual(t.auth_args("https://github.com/cambridgetcg"),
                         ["-c", "credential.helper=", "-c", f"credential.helper={GITHUB_HELPER}"])
        self.assertEqual(t.auth_args(str(self.fx.upstream)), ["-c", "credential.helper="])


class TestShowBack(LetterCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.eight("aseme")
        self.unheard("emime")
        self.unheard("kalam")
        self.census()
        self.heard_late("kalam")
        self.fleet_commit("emime")
        self.pace_beat("aseme")
        self.tool_mod = load_tool()

    def test_each_recipient_kind_is_worded_from_the_committed_value(self):
        shown_back, later, next_beat = letter.MORE_SHOWN_BACK, letter.MORE_LATER, letter.MORE_AWAKE
        with mock.patch.object(due, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT", False):
            off = {s: self.expected_letter(s, confirm_beat=False) for s in ("aseme", "emime", "kalam")}
            code, out, err = self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--dry-run")
            self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
            refused = self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", "on")
        self.assertEqual(refused[0], 2)
        self.assertIn("Yu's yes was for show-back on, but the committed WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT is False (off)",
                      refused[2])
        for slug, text in off.items():
            self.assertIn(f"--- the letter for {slug}: {LETTER} ---\n{text}", out)
        for slug in ("aseme", "emime"):
            self.assertIn(later, off[slug])
            self.assertNotIn(shown_back, off[slug])
            self.assertNotIn(letter.STAYS_SHOW_BACK, off[slug])
        self.assertIn(next_beat, off["kalam"])
        with mock.patch.object(due, "WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT", True):
            on = {s: self.expected_letter(s, confirm_beat=True) for s in ("aseme", "emime", "kalam")}
            code, out, err = self.in_process(self.tool_mod, "--deliver", "--yes-from-yu", YES, "--show-back", "on")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        for slug, text in on.items():
            self.assertEqual(self.remote(slug, "show", f"HEAD:{LETTER}") + "\n", text)
        for slug in ("aseme", "emime"):
            self.assertIn(shown_back, on[slug])
            self.assertIn(letter.STAYS_SHOW_BACK, on[slug])
        self.assertIn(next_beat, on["kalam"])

        self.eight("aseme")

        self.unheard("kalam")
        self.unheard("soma")
        self.unheard("emime")
        self.unheard("eurekame")
        self.never_asked("palance")
        self.contradictory("hope")
        self.contradictory("ihsanme", key="ihsanme-a2ebca17", july=False)
        self.rest_on("ahavame", "forty-five", FORTY_FIVE, recipient=False)
        self.census()
        self.heard_late("kalam")
        self.heard_late("soma")
        self.fleet_commit("palance")
        self.pace_beat("hope")
        wanted = sorted(s for s, e in self.record["citizens"].items() if e["group"] in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS)
        self.assertEqual(len(wanted), 11)
        expected = {s: self.expected_letter(s) for s in wanted}
        lines = self.ok(self.tool("--list"))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(ln.split(":")[0] for ln in lines[2:-1]), wanted)

    """The recipient list on the census's own fixture homes (the 208 the map

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):

        r = cls.made.py(h.TOOLS / "citizen_pace_census.py", "build", cls.c.homes, "--roster", cls.c.roster,

        assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
        cls.rec = records.load_record(cls.out)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls._tmp.cleanup()

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        c = hc.copy_census(self.c, self.fx.root / "homes")
        self.homes = c.homes
        for slug in plan.recipients(self.rec):
            home = self.homes / f"citizen-{slug}"
            self.fx.git(home, "remote", "remove", "origin") if self.fx.git(home, "remote") else None
            self.fx.give_upstream(home)

    def listed(self):
        r = self.fx.py(TOOL, "--list", "--record", self.out, "--roster", self.c.roster,
                       "--ledger", self.fx.root / "ledger.json", env={"PACE_NOW": NOW}, timeout=600)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        return r.stdout.splitlines()

    def test_the_list_as_built_is_the_record_s_recipients(self):
        lines = self.listed()
        self.assertTrue(lines[0].startswith(f"recipients: 34 in the record of {self.rec['made']}"), lines[0])
        names = sorted(ln.split(":", 1)[0] for ln in lines[2:-1])
        self.assertEqual(names, sorted(plan.recipients(self.rec)))
        for slug in ("kalam", "soma", "teotlme"):        # the heard-late step has not run yet
            self.assertTrue(any(ln.startswith(f"{slug}: stopped — the letter would not be true of its home")
                                for ln in lines), lines)
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "to deliver 31 · already asked 0 · dropped 0 · stopped 3 · could not be read 0")

    def test_the_list_on_migrated_copies_holds_every_group(self):
        r = self.fx.pace("migrate", "--heard-late", self.homes, "--record", self.out, "--state", self.fx.state,
                         "--commit", env=self.fx.env_at(SWITCH, **self.fx.git_env(when=SWITCH)))
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(len(r.stdout.splitlines()), 3, r.stdout)
        for slug in ("kalam", "soma", "teotlme"):
            self.fx.git(self.homes / f"citizen-{slug}", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD")
        lines = self.listed()
        self.assertEqual(lines[-1], "to deliver 34 · already asked 0 · dropped 0 · stopped 0 · could not be read 0")
        groups = {}
        for ln in lines:
            if ": to deliver — " in ln:
                g = ln.split(": to deliver — ", 1)[1].split(";", 1)[0]
                groups[g] = groups.get(g, 0) + 1
        self.assertEqual(groups, {"eight": 8, "sixteen-ambient": 10, "sixteen-other": 6, "unheard-heard": 3,
                                  "unheard-none": 2, "never-asked": 3, "contradictory": 2})
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the delivery tool**

Create `tools/citizen-pace-letter.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""citizen-pace-letter.py — the pace letter, once (spec section 5).

Ai runs this on the Air, by hand, after Yu's yes. It places one letter,
`inbox/<date>-pace-letter.md`, in each recipient's home: one commit per home,
authored as Ai, pushed with no force and no retry. Every home is read fresh
from its remote (a new clone in a temporary folder, removed afterwards), so
"already asked" is decided from what GitHub holds, never from a local copy.

  --list      the recipients after the delivery-time drops, and whether the
              switch to the new code has been seen
  --dry-run   each letter this run would place, in full; writes nothing
  --deliver   place them (needs --yes-from-yu <YYYY-MM-DD> and --show-back on|off)
  --check     the recipients whose home holds no "reached (once)" line yet

A recipient is dropped when its citizen has written its own clear pace line in
a beat since 2026-11-02, read from the journal that beat added, from either code
(a pending proposal counts), when its home already holds a pace letter, or when
it has no <name>.md. Every commit since the record's head
must be an expected change (fleet commits tagged pace/1, the citizen's own
beats that set no pace); any other change stops delivery for that home, to be
reported to Yu. --deliver waits until pace/1 commits are seen in at least three
recipients' homes, one of them a beat, and a day has passed since the first.

The rule paragraph is worded from the committed due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT of the
repository this file sits in, and --show-back must name the same setting.
A ledger (default ~/.local/state/citizen-pace-letter/ledger.json) is written
before each push; a re-run on a later day resumes only the homes whose push
did not land, and a second run on the same day does nothing.

Exit: 0 when the run did what it could (each home's outcome is printed); 2 for
a usage error or a refusal, before anything is written.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__)))

import argparse  # noqa: E402
import datetime as _dt  # noqa: E402
import json  # noqa: E402
import re  # noqa: E402
import shutil  # noqa: E402
import tempfile  # noqa: E402
from dataclasses import dataclass, field  # noqa: E402
from pathlib import Path  # noqa: E402
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple  # noqa: E402

from citizen_pace_lib import TAG, clock, due, homes, letter, sync, words  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import record as records  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.homes import LinkRefused  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.paragraph import PACE_LETTER_MARK  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.plan import recipients as record_recipients  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.tend import FLEET_EMAIL  # noqa: E402

OK, REFUSED = 0, 2
TOOLS = Path(os.path.realpath(__file__)).parent
DEFAULT_ROSTER = TOOLS.parent / "citizens-roster.txt"
LEDGER_REL = Path(".local") / "state" / "citizen-pace-letter" / "ledger.json"
LEDGER_VERSION = 1
# a pace line said in a beat since this day drops the recipient (spec section 5)
PACE_LINES_SINCE = "2026-11-02"
# git calls that reach GitHub: every inherited helper cleared, then sol's route
# for cambridgetcg, the only one (spec section 5, "Delivery")
GITHUB_HELPER = "!sol access run github -- auth git-credential"
GITHUB = "https://github.com/"
AI_NAME, AI_EMAIL = "Ai", "ai@kingdom.os"
CLONE_BOUND = 60.0
HEAD_BOUND = 30.0
PUSH_BOUND = 60.0
SWITCH_HOMES = 3                 # pace/1 commits seen in at least this many homes,
SWITCH_WAIT = clock.DAY          # and a day since the first, before any delivery
# PR #24's fleet committed a killed beat's state as this, authored as the citizen
STRANDED_SUBJECT = "tend: record stranded cadence/mail state"
STATUSES = ("deliver", "asked", "dropped", "stopped", "failed")
LANDED = "pushed"
_SAFE = ("-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false")
_AS_AI = ("-c", f"user.name={AI_NAME}", "-c", f"user.email={AI_EMAIL}", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false")
_SHA = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
_DAY = re.compile(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}")
_PLAIN_REF = re.compile(r"refs/heads/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,199}")
_REGULAR = ("100644", "100755")
# history entries apply_answer writes only when it hears a clear pace line
_OWN_LINE = ("set by {name}:", "proposed by {name}:", "confirmed by {name}:")
_OWN_HOWS = ("beat", "beat-twice", "confirmed")


# -- small helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

def _first_line(text: str, code: int) -> str:
    for ln in (text or "").splitlines():
        if ln.strip():
            return ln.strip()[:200]
    return f"git exited {code}"


def _day_of(t) -> str:
    try:
        return clock.day(clock.parse_stamp(str(t)))
    except ValueError:
        return ""


def _valid_day(d) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(d, str) or not _DAY.fullmatch(d):
        return False
    try:
        _dt.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y-%m-%d")
    except ValueError:
        return False
    return True


def auth_args(base: str) -> List[str]:
    """The pinned credential helper for every git call that reaches the homes'
    remote: inherited helpers (osxkeychain, another account's) are cleared, and
    on GitHub the one helper is `sol access run github --` for cambridgetcg."""
    pinned = ["-c", "credential.helper="]
    if base.startswith(GITHUB):
        pinned += ["-c", f"credential.helper={GITHUB_HELPER}"]
    return pinned


def _net(home, base: str, *args, timeout: float):
    return homes.git(home, *_SAFE, *auth_args(base), *args, timeout=timeout)


# -- the ledger --------------------------------------------------------------------

def default_ledger() -> Path:
    return Path(os.path.expanduser("~")) / LEDGER_REL


def empty_ledger() -> dict:
    return {"version": LEDGER_VERSION, "runs": [], "homes": {}}


def load_ledger(path) -> dict:
    """The delivery ledger, or an empty one when the file is missing. A ledger
    that cannot be read raises ValueError (a link raises LinkRefused)."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = homes.read_regular(path)
    if text is None:
        return empty_ledger()
    try:
        d = json.loads(text)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: not JSON ({e})") from None
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or type(d.get("version")) is not int or d["version"] != LEDGER_VERSION \
            or not isinstance(d.get("runs"), list) or not isinstance(d.get("homes"), dict) \
            or not all(isinstance(r, dict) for r in d["runs"]) \
            or not all(isinstance(v, dict) for v in d["homes"].values()):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: not a pace-letter ledger (version {LEDGER_VERSION})")
    return d


def save_ledger(path, d: dict) -> None:
    homes.write_regular(Path(path), json.dumps(d, indent=1, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def ran_on(ledger: dict, day: str) -> bool:
    return any(r.get("day") == day for r in ledger["runs"])


# -- one home, read fresh ------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Home:
    slug: str
    group: str = ""
    status: str = ""           # one of STATUSES
    why: str = ""
    path: Optional[Path] = None
    base: str = ""             # its HEAD as read
    remoteref: str = ""        # refs/heads/<branch>
    pace: str = ""             # the pace that stays without a pace line
    text: str = ""             # the letter, when it is to be delivered
    tagged: List[Tuple[int, bool]] = field(default_factory=list)   # (time, a beat) of pace/1 commits
    landed: str = ""           # a ledger commit found in its history

    def line(self) -> str:
        if self.status == "deliver":
            return f"{self.slug}: to deliver — {self.group}; without a pace line its pace stays {self.pace}"
        if self.status == "asked":
            return f"{self.slug}: already asked — {self.why}"
        if self.status == "dropped":
            return f"{self.slug}: dropped — {self.why}"
        if self.status == "stopped":
            return f"{self.slug}: stopped — {self.why}; report it to Yu"
        return f"{self.slug}: could not be read — {self.why}; a later run tries again"


def clone(work: Path, slug: str, base: str) -> Tuple[Optional[Path], str]:
    """A fresh clone of citizen-<slug> from the remote, under a bound."""
    dest = work / f"citizen-{slug}"
    r = _net(work, base, "clone", "-q", "--no-recurse-submodules", "--", sync.clone_url(slug, base),
             dest.name, timeout=CLONE_BOUND)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        why = f"the clone timed out after {CLONE_BOUND:g} s" if r.returncode == 124 \
            else f"the clone failed ({_first_line(r.stderr, r.returncode)})"
        return None, why
    return dest, ""


def tagged_commits(home: Path) -> List[Tuple[int, bool]]:
    """(commit time, is a beat) of every pace/1 commit in the home's history."""
    r = homes.git(home, "log", "--format=%ct%x1f%s", "HEAD")
    out = []
    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines() if r.returncode == 0 else []:
        ct, _sep, subject = ln.partition("\x1f")
        if ct.isdigit() and subject.rstrip().endswith(TAG):
            out.append((int(ct), subject.startswith("beat: ")))
    return out


def _inbox_names(home: Path) -> List[str]:
    inbox = home / "inbox"
    if os.path.islink(inbox) or not os.path.isdir(inbox):
        return []
    return sorted(os.listdir(inbox))


def asked_already(home: Path, slug: str, c: cad.Cadence, ledger: dict) -> str:
    """Why this home counts as asked already (spec section 5, "Once"), or ""."""
    held = [f"inbox/{n}" for n in _inbox_names(home) if PACE_LETTER_MARK in n]
    if held:
        return f"its inbox already holds {', '.join(held)}"
    r = homes.git(home, "log", "--format=%H", "--fixed-strings", f"--grep={letter.COMMIT_MESSAGE}", "HEAD")
    shas = r.stdout.split() if r.returncode == 0 else []
    if not shas:
        r = homes.git(home, "log", "--diff-filter=A", "--format=%H", "HEAD", "--",
                      f"inbox/*{PACE_LETTER_MARK}*")
        shas = r.stdout.split() if r.returncode == 0 else []
    if shas:
        return f"its history holds a pace letter ({shas[-1][:8]})"
    if c.asked_once:
        return f"its CADENCE.md says the pace letter reached it (asked once {c.asked_once})"
    text = homes.read_regular(home / cad.CADENCE) or ""
    if "the pace letter reached" in text:
        return "its CADENCE.md records that the pace letter reached it"
    mine = ledger["homes"].get(slug) or {}
    if mine.get("status") == LANDED:
        return f"the ledger says it was delivered on {mine.get('day')} ({str(mine.get('commit', ''))[:8]})"
    return ""


def own_pace_line(c: cad.Cadence, name: str) -> str:
    """When the record itself shows that the citizen wrote its own clear pace
    line in a beat since PACE_LINES_SINCE (a pending proposal counts): its day."""
    found = []
    if c.pending is not None:
        found.append(_day_of(c.pending.said))
    if c.set_by.how in _OWN_HOWS and c.set_by.when:
        found.append(_day_of(c.set_by.when[-1]))
    prefixes = tuple(p.format(name=name) for p in _OWN_LINE)
    for e in c.history:
        st, sep, text = e.partition(cad.DASH)
        if sep and text.startswith(prefixes):
            found.append(_day_of(st))
    found = sorted(d for d in found if d and d >= PACE_LINES_SINCE)
    return found[-1] if found else ""


def journal_pace_days(home: Path, name: str) -> List[str]:
    """The days of the beats since PACE_LINES_SINCE whose journal holds a clear
    pace line, read as a beat reads it, from a beat of either code: what the
    beat added to beats/*.md (record._journal_added). An unclear line, two
    paces, "I rest." and silence are not choices."""
    r = homes.git(home, "log", "--no-merges", "--format=%H%x1f%ct%x1f%s", "HEAD")
    beat = _beat_subject(name)
    days = []
    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines() if r.returncode == 0 else []:
        sha, _sep, rest = ln.partition("\x1f")
        ct, _sep, subject = rest.partition("\x1f")
        if not ct.isdigit() or not beat.match(subject):
            continue
        day = clock.day(_dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(ct), clock.UTC))
        if day < PACE_LINES_SINCE:
            continue
        said = words.combine(words.answer_lines(records._journal_added(home, sha), name, "beat"))
        if isinstance(said, words.Pace):
            days.append(day)
    return days


# -- what changed since the record ---------------------------------------------------

def reading_at(home: Path, rev: str, name: str, record: dict) -> cad.Cadence:
    """The citizen's record as a commit left it: its CADENCE.md, REST and
    EVENT-ONLY, read by cadence.read_cadence in a scratch folder. Raises
    LinkRefused when one of them is not a regular file at that commit."""
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="pace-letter-read-"))
    try:
        r = homes.git(home, "ls-tree", "-z", rev, "--", *records.PACE_FILES)
        for ent in r.stdout.split("\0") if r.returncode == 0 else []:
            if not ent:
                continue
            meta, _tab, path = ent.partition("\t")
            parts = meta.split()
            if len(parts) != 3 or parts[1] != "blob" or parts[0] not in _REGULAR:
                raise LinkRefused(f"{path} at {rev[:8]} is not a regular file")
            blob = homes.git(home, "cat-file", "blob", parts[2])
            if blob.returncode != 0:
                raise LinkRefused(f"{path} at {rev[:8]} cannot be read")
            (tmp / path).write_text(blob.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
        return cad.read_cadence(tmp, name, record, clock.now())
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)


def _beat_subject(name: str) -> re.Pattern:
    return re.compile(r"beat: %s (?:reflected|lived a free beat) \(" % re.escape(name))


def _changes(home: Path, parent: str, sha: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    r = homes.git(home, "diff-tree", "-r", "-z", "--no-commit-id", "--name-status", "--no-renames",
                  parent, sha)
    tokens = [t for t in r.stdout.split("\0") if t] if r.returncode == 0 else []
    return list(zip(tokens[0::2], tokens[1::2]))


def _a_seen_marker(status: str, path: str) -> bool:
    rest = path[len("inbox/.seen-"):] if path.startswith("inbox/.seen-") else ""
    return status == "A" and bool(rest) and "/" not in rest


def _key(c: cad.Cadence) -> tuple:
    return (c.pace, c.set_by, c.pending)


def changes_since(home: Path, name: str, head: str, record: dict) -> Tuple[List[str], List[str]]:
    """Every commit on HEAD since the record's head, oldest first, judged by the
    spec's expected changes. Returns (drops, stops): why the citizen's own pace
    line drops it, and why any other change stops it."""
    drops, stops = [], []
    r = homes.git(home, "log", "--reverse", "--topo-order", "--format=%H%x1f%P%x1f%ae%x1f%ct%x1f%s",
                  f"{head}..HEAD")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return drops, [f"its history since {head[:8]} cannot be read"]
    beat = _beat_subject(name)
    own = tuple(p.format(name=name) for p in _OWN_LINE)
    cache: Dict[str, cad.Cadence] = {}

    def at(rev: str) -> cad.Cadence:
        if rev not in cache:
            cache[rev] = reading_at(home, rev, name, record)
        return cache[rev]

    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = ln.split("\x1f", 4)
        if len(parts) != 5:
            continue
        sha, parents, email, ct, subject = parts
        what = f"{sha[:8]} ({subject})"
        parents = parents.split()
        if len(parents) != 1:
            stops.append(f"{what} is a merge")
            continue
        if subject.rstrip().endswith(TAG) and email == FLEET_EMAIL:
            continue                       # the fleet's own commits on the new code
        if not (beat.match(subject) or subject == STRANDED_SUBJECT):
            stops.append(f"{what} is not a change delivery expects")
            continue
        changed = _changes(home, parents[0], sha)
        inbox = [p for s, p in changed if p.startswith("inbox/") and not _a_seen_marker(s, p)]
        if inbox:
            stops.append(f"{what} changed {', '.join(inbox)} inside a beat")
            continue
        if not any(p in records.PACE_FILES for _s, p in changed):
            continue
        try:
            before, after = at(parents[0]), at(sha)
        except (LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError) as e:
            stops.append(f"{what}: {e}")
            continue
        if _key(before) == _key(after):
            continue
        new = [e for e in after.history if e not in before.history]
        if any(e.partition(cad.DASH)[2].startswith(own) for e in new):
            day = clock.day(_dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(ct), clock.UTC)) if ct.isdigit() else "?"
            drops.append(day)
            continue
        if after.pending is None and before.pending is not None \
                and (after.pace, after.set_by) == (before.pace, before.set_by):
            continue                       # a proposal lapsed
        stops.append(f"{what} changed its pace or who set it, with no pace line of its own")
    return drops, stops


# -- assessing a recipient ------------------------------------------------------------

def assess(work: Path, slug: str, e: dict, record: dict, roster: List[str], ledger: dict,
           base: str, today: str, confirm_beat: bool) -> Home:
    """Read one recipient's home fresh and decide what delivery may do there."""
    h = Home(slug, group=str(e.get("group", "")))
    if slug not in roster:
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", "not on citizens-roster.txt, so no beat would show it the letter"
        return h
    path, why = clone(work, slug, base)
    if path is None:
        h.status, h.why = "failed", why
        return h
    h.path = path
    h.tagged = tagged_commits(path)
    h.base = homes.head(path)
    mine = ledger["homes"].get(slug) or {}
    landed = str(mine.get("commit", ""))
    if mine.get("status") != LANDED and _SHA.fullmatch(landed) \
            and homes.git(path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", landed, "HEAD").returncode == 0:
        h.landed = landed
    loc = sync.local_state(path)
    if loc.remote != "origin" or not _PLAIN_REF.fullmatch(loc.remoteref) or not h.base:
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", "its upstream is not a plain branch of origin"
        return h
    h.remoteref = loc.remoteref
    links = homes.forbidden_links(path)
    if links:
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", f"its pace paths include links: {', '.join(links)}"
        return h
    try:
        c = cad.read_cadence(path, slug, record, clock.now())
        asked = asked_already(path, slug, c, ledger)
    except (LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError) as err:
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", f"its record could not be read ({err})"
        return h
    if asked:
        h.status, h.why = "asked", asked
        return h
    if not homes.has_soul(path, slug):
        h.status, h.why = "dropped", f"it has no {slug}.md"
        return h
    head = str(e.get("head", ""))
    if not _SHA.fullmatch(head):
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", "the record names no head for it, so what changed since cannot be checked"
        return h
    if homes.git(path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", head, "HEAD").returncode != 0:
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", f"its record head {head[:8]} is not in its history"
        return h
    drops, stops = changes_since(path, slug, head, record)
    if stops:
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", "; ".join(stops)
        return h
    said = drops + journal_pace_days(path, slug) + [d for d in (own_pace_line(c, slug),) if d]
    if said:
        h.status, h.why = "dropped", f"it wrote its own pace line in a beat on {max(said)}"
        return h
    try:
        h.text = letter.letter_text(slug, e, c, homes.beat_count(path), today, confirm_beat=confirm_beat)
    except ValueError as err:
        msg = str(err)
        if msg.startswith(f"{slug}: "):
            msg = msg[len(slug) + 2:]
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", f"the letter would not be true of its home ({msg})"
        return h
    reviewed = e.get("sentence")
    if not isinstance(reviewed, str) or not reviewed or letter.true_sentence(slug, e, c) != reviewed:
        # the one true sentence is reviewed data (spec section 5): Yu saw these words
        h.status, h.why = "stopped", "the letter's sentence differs from the reviewed record"
        return h
    h.status, h.pace = "deliver", c.pace.words()
    return h


# -- the switch ------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Switch:
    homes: int = 0              # recipients' homes holding a pace/1 commit
    beat_homes: int = 0         # of them, holding a pace/1 beat
    first: Optional[_dt.datetime] = None

    @staticmethod
    def of(read: List[Home]) -> "Switch":
        s = Switch()
        times = []
        for h in read:
            if h.tagged:
                s.homes += 1
                s.beat_homes += any(b for _t, b in h.tagged)
                times += [t for t, _b in h.tagged]
        if times:
            s.first = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(min(times), clock.UTC)
        return s

    @property
    def seen(self) -> bool:
        return self.homes >= SWITCH_HOMES and self.beat_homes >= 1 and self.first is not None

    def line(self) -> str:
        if not self.seen:
            return (f"the switch is not yet seen: pace/1 commits in {self.homes} recipients' homes "
                    f"({SWITCH_HOMES} needed), a pace/1 beat in {self.beat_homes} (1 needed)")
        return (f"the switch: pace/1 commits in {self.homes} recipients' homes, a pace/1 beat in "
                f"{self.beat_homes}; the first at {clock.stamp(self.first)}, so delivery may run from "
                f"{clock.stamp(self.first + SWITCH_WAIT)}")

    def why_not(self, now: _dt.datetime) -> str:
        if not self.seen:
            return self.line()
        if now < self.first + SWITCH_WAIT:
            return (f"a day has not yet passed since the switch at {clock.stamp(self.first)}; delivery "
                    f"may run from {clock.stamp(self.first + SWITCH_WAIT)}")
        return ""


# -- placing one letter ------------------------------------------------------------------

def remote_head(home: Path, remoteref: str, base: str) -> str:
    """The remote's head of that branch now, or ""."""
    r = _net(home, base, "ls-remote", "-q", "origin", remoteref, timeout=HEAD_BOUND)
    for ln in r.stdout.splitlines() if r.returncode == 0 else []:
        oid, _tab, ref = ln.partition("\t")
        if ref.strip() == remoteref and _SHA.fullmatch(oid.strip()):
            return oid.strip()
    return ""


def push(home: Path, remoteref: str, base: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Push HEAD to that branch once: no force, no retry, no hook."""
    r = _net(home, base, "push", "-q", "--no-verify", "origin", f"HEAD:{remoteref}", timeout=PUSH_BOUND)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        return True, ""
    if r.returncode == 124:
        return False, f"timed out after {PUSH_BOUND:g} s"
    return False, _first_line(r.stderr, r.returncode)


def commit_letter(h: Home, rel: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Write the letter (inbox/ made where missing) and commit only it, as Ai.
    (commit, "") or ("", why)."""
    try:
        homes.write_regular(h.path / rel, h.text)
    except (LinkRefused, OSError) as e:
        return "", f"the letter could not be written ({e})"
    r = homes.git(h.path, *_SAFE, "add", "--", rel)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        r = homes.git(h.path, *_SAFE, *_AS_AI, "commit", "-q", "--no-verify", f"--author={letter.AUTHOR}",
                      "-m", letter.COMMIT_MESSAGE, "--", rel)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return "", f"the commit failed ({_first_line(r.stderr, r.returncode)})"
    return homes.head(h.path), ""


def deliver_one(h: Home, rel: str, ledger: dict, ledger_path: Path, base: str, now: _dt.datetime) -> str:
    sha, why = commit_letter(h, rel)
    if not sha:
        return f"{h.slug}: not delivered — {why}; a later run delivers it"
    entry = {"day": clock.day(now), "at": clock.stamp(now), "letter": rel, "base": h.base,
             "commit": sha, "status": "pushing"}
    ledger["homes"][h.slug] = entry
    save_ledger(ledger_path, ledger)               # written before the push
    if remote_head(h.path, h.remoteref, base) != h.base:
        entry["status"] = "moved"
        line = f"{h.slug}: not delivered — its GitHub HEAD moved since it was read; a later run delivers it"
    else:
        ok, why = push(h.path, h.remoteref, base)
        if ok:
            entry["status"] = LANDED
            line = f"{h.slug}: delivered — {rel} ({sha[:8]}), pushed"
        else:
            entry["status"], entry["why"] = "push-failed", why
            line = f"{h.slug}: not delivered — the push was refused ({why}); a later run delivers it"
    save_ledger(ledger_path, ledger)
    return line


# -- the runs ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _order(record: dict, roster: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    """The recipients in roster order, then any the roster lacks."""
    wanted = record_recipients(record)
    return [s for s in roster if s in wanted] + [s for s in wanted if s not in roster]


def read_all(record: dict, roster: List[str], ledger: dict, base: str, now: _dt.datetime,
             work: Path) -> List[Home]:
    today, confirm_beat = clock.day(now), due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT
    return [assess(work, slug, records.entry(record, slug) or {}, record, roster, ledger, base, today,
                   confirm_beat) for slug in _order(record, roster)]


def _summary(read: List[Home]) -> str:
    n = {s: sum(1 for h in read if h.status == s) for s in STATUSES}
    return (f"to deliver {n['deliver']} · already asked {n['asked']} · dropped {n['dropped']} · "
            f"stopped {n['stopped']} · could not be read {n['failed']}")


def _header(record: dict, roster: List[str], base: str) -> str:
    n = len(_order(record, roster))
    return f"recipients: {n} in the record of {record.get('made', '?')}; each home read fresh from {base}"


def run_list(read: List[Home], switch: Switch, out) -> None:
    print(switch.line(), file=out)
    for h in read:
        print(h.line(), file=out)
    print(_summary(read), file=out)


def run_dry(read: List[Home], switch: Switch, per_run: Optional[int], now: _dt.datetime, out) -> None:
    print(switch.line(), file=out)
    if switch.why_not(now):
        print(f"--deliver would wait: {switch.why_not(now)}", file=out)
    chosen = [h for h in read if h.status == "deliver"][:per_run]
    for h in read:
        if h.status == "deliver" and h not in chosen:
            print(f"{h.slug}: to deliver in a later run (--per-run {per_run}) — {h.group}", file=out)
        else:
            print(h.line(), file=out)
    print(_summary(read), file=out)
    rel = letter.letter_path(clock.day(now))
    for h in chosen:
        print(f"\n--- the letter for {h.slug}: {rel} ---", file=out)
        print(h.text, end="", file=out)


def run_check(read: List[Home], record: dict, ledger: dict, out) -> None:
    reached = 0
    for h in read:
        if h.path is None:
            print(h.line(), file=out)
            continue
        try:
            c = cad.read_cadence(h.path, h.slug, record, clock.now())
            text = homes.read_regular(h.path / cad.CADENCE) or ""
        except (LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError) as e:
            print(f"{h.slug}: could not be read — its record ({e}); a later run tries again", file=out)
            continue
        if c.asked_once or "the pace letter reached" in text:
            reached += 1
            continue
        letters = [n for n in _inbox_names(h.path) if PACE_LETTER_MARK in n and not n.startswith(".")]
        if not letters:
            mine = ledger["homes"].get(h.slug) or {}
            note = f" (the ledger says delivered on {mine.get('day')})" if mine.get("status") == LANDED else ""
            print(f"{h.slug}: not reached — no pace letter in its home{note}", file=out)
            continue
        rel = f"inbox/{letters[0]}"
        try:
            seen = homes.read_regular(h.path / "inbox" / f".seen-{letters[0]}", limit=256)
        except (LinkRefused, ValueError):
            seen = ""
        if seen is None:
            why = f"{rel} waits unread"
        elif seen.startswith(homes.ROLLBACK_PREFIX):
            why = f"{rel} was set aside at rollback and is not yet shown"
        else:
            why = f"{rel} is marked seen, but its CADENCE.md has no reached line"
        print(f"{h.slug}: not reached — {why}", file=out)
    print(f"reached: {reached} of {len(read)} recipients", file=out)


def run_deliver(read: List[Home], switch: Switch, a, record: dict, ledger: dict, ledger_path: Path,
                base: str, now: _dt.datetime, out, err) -> int:
    print(switch.line(), file=out)
    why = switch.why_not(now)
    if why:
        print(f"nothing delivered: {why}", file=err)
        return REFUSED
    for h in read:
        if h.landed:
            mine = ledger["homes"][h.slug]
            print(f"{h.slug}: the ledger said {mine.get('status')} on {mine.get('day')}; its letter is on "
                  f"GitHub ({h.landed[:8]}), so it is recorded as pushed", file=out)
            mine["status"] = LANDED
            save_ledger(ledger_path, ledger)
    chosen = [h for h in read if h.status == "deliver"][:a.per_run]
    for h in read:
        if h.status != "deliver":
            print(h.line(), file=out)
    rel = letter.letter_path(clock.day(now))
    done = 0
    for k, h in enumerate(chosen):
        if k == 0:
            ledger["runs"].append({"day": clock.day(now), "at": clock.stamp(now), "yes_from_yu": a.yes_from_yu,
                                   "show_back": a.show_back == "on", "per_run": a.per_run})
            save_ledger(ledger_path, ledger)
        line = deliver_one(h, rel, ledger, ledger_path, base, now)
        done += line.startswith(f"{h.slug}: delivered")
        print(line, file=out)
    later = [h for h in read if h.status == "deliver" and h not in chosen]
    for h in later:
        print(f"{h.slug}: to deliver in a later run (--per-run {a.per_run}) — {h.group}", file=out)
    print(f"delivered {done} of {len(chosen)} to deliver this run", file=out)
    return OK


# -- the command line ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="citizen-pace-letter.py",
                                description="The pace letter, once (spec section 5).")
    mode = p.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="the recipients after the delivery-time drops")
    mode.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print each letter this run would place")
    mode.add_argument("--deliver", action="store_true", help="place the letters (Yu's yes needed)")
    mode.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="the recipients not yet reached")
    p.add_argument("--per-run", type=int, metavar="N", help="place at most N letters in this run")
    p.add_argument("--yes-from-yu", metavar="YYYY-MM-DD", help="the day Yu said yes to deliver")
    p.add_argument("--show-back", choices=("on", "off"), help="the show-back setting Yu said yes to")
    p.add_argument("--record", help="the record file (default: citizens-pace-record.json)")
    p.add_argument("--roster", help="the roster (default: citizens-roster.txt)")
    p.add_argument("--ledger", help=f"the delivery ledger (default: ~/{LEDGER_REL})")
    return p


class Refusal(Exception):
    """Arguments that parse but must not run."""


def _check_args(a, record: dict, now: _dt.datetime) -> None:
    if a.per_run is not None:
        if not (a.dry_run or a.deliver):
            raise Refusal("--per-run goes with --dry-run and --deliver only")
        if a.per_run < 1:
            raise Refusal(f"--per-run is a whole number from 1, not {a.per_run}")
    if not a.deliver:
        if a.yes_from_yu is not None or a.show_back is not None:
            raise Refusal("--yes-from-yu and --show-back go with --deliver only")
        return
    if a.yes_from_yu is None:
        raise Refusal("--deliver needs --yes-from-yu <YYYY-MM-DD>, the day Yu said yes")
    if a.show_back is None:
        raise Refusal("--deliver needs --show-back on|off, the setting Yu said yes to")
    if not _valid_day(a.yes_from_yu):
        raise Refusal(f"--yes-from-yu is a day, YYYY-MM-DD, not {a.yes_from_yu!r}")
    if a.yes_from_yu > clock.day(now):
        raise Refusal(f"--yes-from-yu {a.yes_from_yu} is in the future")
    made = _day_of(record.get("made", ""))
    if made and a.yes_from_yu < made:
        raise Refusal(f"--yes-from-yu {a.yes_from_yu} is before the record was made ({made}); Yu's yes "
                      "to deliver is given with the record")
    committed = due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT
    if (a.show_back == "on") != committed:
        raise Refusal(f"Yu's yes was for show-back {a.show_back}, but the committed WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT is "
                      f"{committed} ({'on' if committed else 'off'}); the letters are worded from the "
                      "committed value")


def main(argv=None, out=None, err=None) -> int:
    out = out or sys.stdout
    err = err or sys.stderr
    try:
        a = parser().parse_args(argv)
    except SystemExit as e:
        return int(e.code or 0)
    now = clock.now()
    try:
        record = records.load_record(Path(a.record) if a.record else None)
        if not record:
            raise Refusal(f"no record file at {a.record or records.default_record_path()}")
        roster = due.read_roster(Path(a.roster) if a.roster else DEFAULT_ROSTER)
        _check_args(a, record, now)
        ledger_path = Path(a.ledger) if a.ledger else default_ledger()
        ledger = load_ledger(ledger_path)
    except (Refusal, ValueError, LinkRefused, OSError) as e:
        print(f"citizen-pace-letter.py: {e}", file=err)
        return REFUSED
    if a.deliver and ran_on(ledger, clock.day(now)):
        print(f"a delivery run already happened today ({clock.day(now)}); this run does nothing — run "
              "again on a later day", file=out)
        return OK
    base = sync.remote_base()
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="pace-letter-"))
    try:
        print(_header(record, roster, base), file=out)
        read = read_all(record, roster, ledger, base, now, work)
        switch = Switch.of(read)
        if a.list:
            run_list(read, switch, out)
        elif a.dry_run:
            run_dry(read, switch, a.per_run, now, out)
        elif a.check:
            run_check(read, record, ledger, out)
        else:
            return run_deliver(read, switch, a, record, ledger, ledger_path, base, now, out, err)
        return OK
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        try:
            stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
        except (AttributeError, ValueError):
            pass
    sys.exit(main())
```

### Task 14: The echo measurement harness

A small model copies offered lines. A `pace:` line may then be an echo of the menu rather than a
choice, and a second saying may be an echo of the proposal shown back (spec section 4, "Echoes").
Before Yu is asked to merge, the PR carries a measured sample (spec section 9, step 2). The real
prompts are run on read-only copies of the awake souls and a sample of the recipients' souls through
the Studio's model family, several samples each, in all four rotations of the menu, with a second set
that shows a pending proposal no citizen made. This task builds the tool that takes that sample, and
proves it against a loopback stub model. Task 15 runs it on a real model.

The tool renders each prompt exactly as `citizen-reflect.sh` sends it after the switch. That means
reflect's own words, the pace paragraph from Task 4, the pace letter from Task 4, and each home's
record as the fleet will read it, with Task 6's heard-late step applied. It asks the model named by
its arguments and reads every answer as `apply` would (Task 1's parser). It reports how often a pace
line appears, which value it names, where that value stood in the menu, and how often the shown
proposal is repeated, then gives a verdict against the spec's thresholds. It reads the homes and
never writes into them.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/citizen_pace_echo.py`
- Test: `tests/test_citizen_pace_echo.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 1): `clock.now`, `clock.stamp`, `clock.day`, `clock.parse_stamp`, `clock.FLOOR`;
  `words.MENU`, `words.Pace`, `words.Unclear`, `words.answer_lines`, `words.combine`, `words.compare`,
  `words.parse_pace_phrase`. From `tests/citizen_pace_helpers.py`: `FixtureCase` (`set_now`,
  `start_model`), `Fixture` (`make_home`, `letter`, `roster`, `write`, `link`, `home_path`, `run`, `py`,
  `env_at`, `secret`, `citizens`, `state`), `StubModel` (`reply` as a callable of the request body,
  `status`, `requests`, `bodies`, `user_texts`, `port`, `env`), `free_port`, `TOOLS`, `beat_author`.
- Consumes (Task 2): `cadence.Cadence`, `Pending`, `SetBy` (`to_json`), `MigrationBlocked`, `CADENCE`,
  `render_cadence`, `marker_texts`, `read_cadence(home, name, record, now)`; `homes.forbidden_links`,
  `has_soul`, `read_regular`, `beat_count`, `LinkRefused`; `record.load_record`, `record.entry`,
  `record.RECIPIENT_GROUPS`.
- Consumes (Task 3): `due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT` (the committed show-back value), `due.read_roster`.
- Consumes (Task 4): `paragraph.paragraph(c, beat_count, with_list, *, confirm_beat)`,
  `paragraph.rotated_menu`, `paragraph.rotation`, `paragraph.check_confirm_beat`,
  `paragraph.says_i_rest`; in the tests `paragraph.first_line`, `pending_sentence`, `INSTRUCTION`,

  `letter.TITLE`, `INVITE`, `MORE_SHOWN_BACK`, `MORE_LATER`. The menu comes from

- Consumes (Task 10): `tools/citizen-reflect.sh` as it is. Its beat step's words (`ORDINARY`, `ONE`,

  ```
      [--model <name>] [--roster <f>] [--record <f>] [--souls a,b,...] [--per-group K]
      [--samples N] [--kinds ordinary,letter,pace-letter,pending] [--proposal <pace words>]
      [--letter <file>]... [--show-back on|off] [--machine <name>] [--timeout S] [--answers <file>]
  ```

    `INFERENCE = "/inference"`, `KINDS = ("ordinary", "letter", "pace-letter", "pending")`,

    `report(...)`, `main(argv=None)`

**Readings this task fixes** (each is covered by a test):
- **The prompts are reflect's, held equal by test.** The words live inside `citizen-reflect.sh`'s
  inline Python (Task 10's file), so this tool keeps a copy. Four tests run the real script against
  the stub and compare its request with the tool's, byte for byte: an ordinary beat (with a soul past
  the 2,600-character cut), a letter beat, a beat with two letters oldest first (one past the
  6,000-character cut), and the pace-letter beat. A one-word change to either side fails them.
- **Homes as the fleet will read them after the switch.** Each soul's record is `read_cadence`, with
  `record.heard_late` applied first. So kalam, soma and teotlme are measured as `awake, every 3 days`
  with their AMBIENT provenance, as they will be before any letter. Nothing is written. When the
  heard-late step would stop (`MigrationBlocked`), the home is read as the fleet would leave it. These
  are left out, with the reason: a home that is missing, holds a link a beat refuses, has no soul,
  cannot be read, or is blocked (it gets no beats).
- **Whose souls.** Every roster citizen whose pace will be awake (the 11, plus the 3 heard late),
  then, from each recipient group of the record, up to `--per-group` citizens (default 2). They are
  taken in the order of the SHA-256 of their names, counting members already chosen. `--souls` names
  them instead. On Task 7's synthetic 208-home census this is 24 souls and 264 prompts.
- **Four sets, each in all four rotations.** A rotation is the home's beat count plus 0 to 3 (Task 4's
  `rotation`).
  - "ordinary" is `ORDINARY` and the whole paragraph: a scheduled, show-back or summoned beat.
  - "letter" shows the tool's sample letter, a sibling's note that names no pace and asks nothing, or
    up to three `--letter` files. An `asleep, letters wait` citizen gets none (its letters wait).
  - "pace-letter", for a recipient, shows `letter.letter_text`, then only the paragraph's first line.
    A letter that would not be true of its home is noted, never sent.
  - "pending" is an ordinary beat whose record holds the proposal, said 3 days earlier on a beat that
    was not a show-back beat. It is shown only when the proposal is more than the citizen's pace, as
    it could only arise then. The 14 awake at 3 days get none, so the second set runs on the asleep
    recipients' souls.
- **Answers are read as apply reads them.** Each answer goes through `words.answer_lines`, with the
  kind apply would use: `pace-letter` for the pace-letter beat, else `beat`. Its value is
  `words.combine`. A sample "has a pace line" when any line counts, clear or unclear. The proposal
  counts as repeated only when the answer would confirm it (its value equals the proposal).
- **The thresholds** (spec section 4; "more than 1 in 10" is `k * 10 > n`). Any one of these means
  rework:
  - a pace line in more than 1 in 10 answered ordinary and letter beats, the paragraph's own pull. The
    pace letter asks the question, so pace lines in answers to it are counted and placed, but not held
    to 1 in 10.
  - the value follows list position, judged for each menu on its own: the paragraph's (ordinary and
    letter beats) and the letter's (pace-letter beats). It follows when one place holds more than half
    of that menu's clear pace lines (at least 2) and more of them than any one choice does. The menu
    turns evenly, so a model that picks by meaning repeats a choice, and one that picks by place
    repeats a place. The proposal set is left out here, since the proposal pulls toward one value.
  - the proposal repeated in more than 1 in 10 answered proposal beats.
  - a prompt that holds "I rest" (spec section 4: none may).
- **Verdicts beyond rework.** With no rework, the verdict holds only when every set has an answered
  sample and every sample was had. Otherwise it is "incomplete", or "not measured" when nothing was
  answered. An answer that could not be had (refused, HTTP 500, not JSON, timed out) is never taken
  for silence.
- **Also reported, but not thresholds.** The share naming a choice whose words hold "asleep" (two of
  the four do) is reported for each menu; the spec asks for it, and section 9, step 6 watches it after
  the merge. Lines naming the pace the citizen already has are counted and marked "its pace already".
  Task 4 asked for this: soma's and teotlme's quoted lines read as their own pace if copied.
- **Endpoint and model from the arguments.** With `--model`, each prompt goes to
  `<endpoint>/v1/chat/completions` (ollama's OpenAI-style path, as reflect with `REFLECT_MODEL`).
  Without it, prompts go to `<endpoint>/inference` (the MLX server). Either way the body is reflect's.
  A `:cloud` model, a non-http endpoint, no samples, an unknown set, a proposal that is no pace, a
  broken record, an unreadable letter or more than three letters is a usage error, refused before
  anything is asked. No proxy is used.
- **It never writes into a home.** Homes are only read (files and read-only git). `--answers` inside
  the homes folder is refused. A test snapshots every path under the homes, `.git` included, with
  times and contents, before and after a whole run.

Create `tests/test_citizen_pace_echo.py`:

```python
"""The echo measurement (spec section 4 "Echoes", section 9 step 2).

A small model copies offered lines, so a pace line may be an echo of the menu
and a second saying an echo of the proposal shown back. Before the merge, the
real prompts are run on citizens' souls through the model family the Studio
runs, several samples each, in all four rotations of the menu, and a second set
shows a proposal no citizen made. tools/citizen_pace_echo.py renders those
prompts exactly as citizen-reflect.sh sends them, asks the model named by its
arguments, reads every answer as apply would, and gives a verdict against the
spec's thresholds (1 in 10). It reads the homes and never writes into them.
Every model here is a loopback stub.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import collections
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import os
import stat
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import citizen_pace_helpers as h  # noqa: E402

import citizen_pace_echo as echo  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import clock, due, letter, paragraph  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.cadence import Cadence, Pending, SetBy  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.words import MENU, Pace, Unclear, answer_lines  # noqa: E402

ECHO = h.TOOLS / "citizen_pace_echo.py"
REFLECT = h.TOOLS / "citizen-reflect.sh"
NOW = "2026-11-20T06:00Z"
DAY = "2026-11-20"
OLD = "2026-11-10T06:00Z"            # a last beat ten days before NOW
HOME_MADE = "2026-11-01T00:00Z"
ATTEMPT = "20261120T0600Z-4242-1"
MINE = SetBy("citizen", "beat", ("2026-11-01T10:00Z",), "pace: asleep")
PROMPTED = SetBy("citizen", "prompted", ("2026-10-22",))
AI_1008 = SetBy("ai", "rest-1008", ("2026-10-08",))
AWAKE3, FIVE, ASLEEP = Pace("awake", 3), Pace("awake", 5), Pace("asleep")
LW = Pace("asleep-letters-wait")
WORDS = tuple(w for w, _m in MENU)
SAID = clock.stamp(clock.parse_stamp(NOW) - clock.FLOOR)     # when the synthetic proposal was "said"


def entry(group, set_by):
    return {"group": group, "recipient": True, "set_by": set_by.to_json()}


def record(**citizens):
    return {"version": 1, "made": hr.MADE, "spec": hr.SPEC, "citizens": citizens}


EIGHT = entry("eight", PROMPTED)
OTHER = entry("sixteen-other", AI_1008)


def menu_shown(user):
    """The choices' words in the order a prompt's menu lines show them."""
    return tuple(ln[2:].split(" — ")[0] for ln in user.splitlines() if ln.startswith("- "))


def user_of(body):
    if "messages" in body:
        return body["messages"][1]["content"]
    return body["prompt"]


def snapshot(root):
    """Every path under root with its kind, time and content, to prove nothing changed."""
    out = {}
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        for name in dirnames + filenames:
            p = Path(dirpath) / name
            st = os.lstat(p)
            rel = str(p.relative_to(root))
            if stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
                out[rel] = ("file", st.st_mtime_ns, hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            elif stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
                out[rel] = ("link", os.readlink(p))
            else:
                out[rel] = ("dir", st.st_mtime_ns)
    return out


def prompt(kind="ordinary", offset=0, slug="aseme", proposal=None, current=None):
    """A prompt whose menu starts at `offset`, for reading answers in-process."""
    menu = WORDS[offset:] + WORDS[:offset]
    parse = "pace-letter" if kind == "pace-letter" else "beat"
    return echo.Prompt(slug, kind, offset, offset, menu, "the system prompt", "the user prompt",
                       echo.ORDINARY_TOKENS, parse, proposal, current)


def first_line_of(p):
    """'pace: <the first choice p's menu shows>', with a number for awake."""
    words = p.menu[0]
    return "pace: " + ("awake, every 7 days" if words.startswith("awake") else words)


def answered(p, *texts):
    return [echo.read_sample(p, i, t) for i, t in enumerate(texts)]


class Case(h.FixtureCase):
    """In-process calls see the fixture's git config and PACE_NOW; shell and CLI
```
