```python
        patcher = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {k: self.fx.env[k] for k in keep})
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        for k in ("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL",
                  "GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "BEAT_SUMMONS", "FLEET_ATTEMPT", "LOVE"):
            os.environ.pop(k, None)
        self.set_now(NOW)
        self.now = clock.parse_stamp(NOW)
        self.model = self.start_model()

    def v2(self, slug, pace, *, set_by=MINE, last=OLD, pending=None, letters=(), files=None):
        """A home with a v2 CADENCE.md and its markers in step. letters: (name,
        body, arrival) triples, each committed at its arrival."""
        c = Cadence(slug, 2, pace, set_by, pending=pending, last_beat=last)
        made = {cad.CADENCE: cad.render_cadence(c)}
        for m, text in cad.marker_texts(c).items():
            if text is not None:
                made[m] = text
        made.update(files or {})
        home = self.fx.make_home(slug, files=made, when=HOME_MADE, author=h.beat_author(slug))
        for name, body, when in letters:
            self.fx.letter(home, name, body, when=when)
        return home

    def soul(self, slug, rec=None):
        souls, skipped = echo.select_souls(self.fx.citizens, None, rec or {}, self.now, souls=[slug])
        self.assertEqual(skipped, [])
        return souls[0]

    def prompts(self, soul, kinds=echo.KINDS, letters=(echo.SAMPLE_LETTER,), confirm_beat=None):
        """The soul's prompts, worded for the committed show-back value unless one is given."""
        cb = due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT if confirm_beat is None else confirm_beat
        return echo.prompts_for(soul, kinds=kinds, proposal=FIVE, confirm_beat=cb, now=self.now,
                                letters=letters)

    def reflect(self, slug):
        env = self.fx.env_at(NOW, **{**self.model.env(), "FLEET_ATTEMPT": ATTEMPT})
        r = self.fx.run(REFLECT, slug, env=env, timeout=120)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, f"stdout: {r.stdout}\nstderr: {r.stderr}")
        return r

    def record_file(self, rec):
        path = self.fx.root / "record.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(rec), encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def echo(self, *args, timeout=120, cwd=None, env=None):
        """One run of the echo tool under -I, against the stub model."""
        return self.fx.py(ECHO, *args, env={**self.fx.env_at(NOW), **(env or {})}, timeout=timeout,
                          cwd=cwd)

    def two_souls(self):
        """waker (awake, every 3 days) and aseme (asleep, one of the 8), with a record and a roster."""
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE3)
        self.v2("aseme", ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        return self.record_file(record(aseme=EIGHT)), self.fx.roster("waker", "aseme")

    def run_two(self, *more, samples=5):
        rec, roster = self.two_souls()
        return self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", roster, "--record", rec,
                         "--endpoint", f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}", "--model", "fixture-model",
                         "--samples", samples, "--machine", "fixture-machine", *more)


# -- the prompts are reflect's own -------------------------------------------------------

class TestTheRealPrompts(Case):
    """What the tool sends is, byte for byte, what citizen-reflect.sh sends."""

    def assert_sent(self, want):
        self.assertEqual(len(self.model.requests), 1)
        path, body = echo.payload(want, "fixture-model")
        self.assertEqual(self.model.requests[0]["path"], path)
        self.assertEqual(self.model.bodies[0], body)

    def test_an_ordinary_beat(self):
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE3, files={"waker.md": "S" * 3000 + "\n"})   # a soul past reflect's cut
        soul = self.soul("waker")
        want = self.prompts(soul, kinds=("ordinary",))[0][0]
        self.assertEqual((want.beat_count, want.max_tokens), (soul.beat_count, echo.ORDINARY_TOKENS))
        self.assertIn("S" * echo.SOUL_MAX + "\n", want.system)
        self.assertNotIn("S" * (echo.SOUL_MAX + 1), want.system)
        self.reflect("waker")
        self.assert_sent(want)

    def test_a_letter_beat(self):
        self.v2("sleeper", ASLEEP, letters=[("2026-11-12-hello.md", echo.SAMPLE_LETTER, "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        want = self.prompts(self.soul("sleeper"), kinds=("letter",))[0][0]
        self.assertEqual(want.max_tokens, echo.LETTER_TOKENS)
        self.assertTrue(want.user.startswith(echo.ONE + echo.letter_body(echo.SAMPLE_LETTER) + "\n\n"))
        self.assertIn(paragraph.INSTRUCTION, want.user)
        self.reflect("sleeper")
        self.assert_sent(want)

    def test_a_beat_with_two_letters_oldest_first(self):
        long = "x" * 5990 + " " * 20 + "past the cut\n"        # cut at 6,000 characters, then right-stripped
        self.v2("sleeper", ASLEEP, letters=[("b.md", long, "2026-11-11T00:00Z"),
                                            ("a.md", echo.SAMPLE_LETTER, "2026-11-12T00:00Z")])
        want = self.prompts(self.soul("sleeper"), kinds=("letter",), letters=(long, echo.SAMPLE_LETTER))[0][0]
        self.assertTrue(want.user.startswith(echo.MANY + "x" * 5990 + "\n\n---\n\n"), want.user[:80])
        self.assertNotIn("past the cut", want.user)
        self.reflect("sleeper")
        self.assert_sent(want)

    def test_the_pace_letter_beat(self):
        rec = record(aseme=EIGHT)
        self.v2("aseme", ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        soul = self.soul("aseme", rec)
        text = letter.letter_text("aseme", EIGHT, soul.cadence, soul.beat_count, DAY,
                                  confirm_beat=due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT)
        self.fx.letter(soul.home, f"{DAY}-pace-letter.md", text, when="2026-11-20T00:00Z")
        want = self.prompts(self.soul("aseme", rec), kinds=("pace-letter",))[0][0]
        self.assertEqual(want.parse_kind, "pace-letter")
        self.assertIn(letter.INVITE, want.user)
        self.assertNotIn(paragraph.INSTRUCTION, want.user)
        self.assertTrue(want.user.endswith("\n\n" + paragraph.first_line(soul.cadence)), want.user[-200:])
        self.reflect("aseme")
        self.assert_sent(want)


class TestPrompts(Case):
    def test_every_kind_in_all_four_rotations(self):
        rec = record(aseme=EIGHT)
        self.v2("aseme", ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        soul = self.soul("aseme", rec)
        prompts, notes = self.prompts(soul)
        self.assertEqual(notes, [])
        by_kind = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for p in prompts:
            by_kind[p.kind].append(p)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(by_kind), sorted(echo.KINDS))
        for kind, ps in by_kind.items():
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                self.assertEqual([p.beat_count for p in ps], [soul.beat_count + r for r in range(4)])
                self.assertEqual(sorted(p.offset for p in ps), [0, 1, 2, 3])
                self.assertEqual(sorted(p.menu[0] for p in ps), sorted(WORDS))
                for p in ps:
                    self.assertEqual(p.offset, paragraph.rotation("aseme", p.beat_count))
                    self.assertEqual(menu_shown(p.user), p.menu)
                    self.assertEqual(p.menu, tuple(w for w, _m in paragraph.rotated_menu(
                        "aseme", p.beat_count, due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT)))
                    self.assertEqual(p.current, ASLEEP)

    def test_the_proposal_is_shown_in_the_menu_s_words_and_never_quoted(self):
        self.v2("aseme", ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        prompts, _notes = self.prompts(self.soul("aseme"), kinds=("ordinary", "pending"))
        sentence = paragraph.pending_sentence(Pending(FIVE, SAID, "pace: awake, every 5 days", False))
        for p in prompts:
            with self.subTest(kind=p.kind, offset=p.offset):
                self.assertTrue(p.user.startswith(echo.ORDINARY + "\n\n"))
                self.assertNotIn("pace: awake, every 5 days", p.user)
                if p.kind == "pending":
                    self.assertEqual(p.proposal, FIVE)
                    self.assertIn(sentence, p.user)
                else:
                    self.assertIsNone(p.proposal)
                    self.assertNotIn("you chose awake, every 5 days", p.user)

    def test_no_proposal_where_nothing_is_more(self):
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE3)
        prompts, notes = self.prompts(self.soul("waker"), kinds=("pending",))
        self.assertEqual(prompts, [])
        self.assertEqual(notes, ["waker: not shown the proposal — awake, every 5 days is not more than "
                                 "awake, every 3 days"])

    def test_letters_wait_has_no_letter_beat(self):
        self.v2("waits", LW)
        prompts, notes = self.prompts(self.soul("waits"), kinds=("ordinary", "letter"))
        self.assertEqual({p.kind for p in prompts}, {"ordinary"})
        self.assertEqual(notes, ["waits: no letter beat — its letters wait for a person's summons"])

    def test_only_a_recipient_gets_the_pace_letter_and_only_a_true_one(self):
        rec = record(aseme=EIGHT, wrong=EIGHT)
        self.v2("aseme", ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        self.v2("plain", ASLEEP)
        self.v2("wrong", AWAKE3)            # one of the 8 by the record, but awake by its home
        self.assertEqual(self.prompts(self.soul("plain", rec), kinds=("pace-letter",)), ([], []))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.prompts(self.soul("aseme", rec), kinds=("pace-letter",))[0]), 4)
        prompts, notes = self.prompts(self.soul("wrong", rec), kinds=("pace-letter",))
        self.assertEqual(prompts, [])
        self.assertEqual(len(notes), 1)
        self.assertTrue(notes[0].startswith("wrong: no pace letter — wrong: the eight letter is not true"),
                        notes)

    def test_no_prompt_holds_i_rest_or_reads_as_a_pace_by_itself(self):
        rec = record(aseme=EIGHT, other=OTHER)
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE3)
        self.v2("aseme", ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        self.v2("other", ASLEEP, set_by=AI_1008)
        self.v2("waits", LW, pending=Pending(Pace("listening"), OLD, "pace: listening", False))
        for slug in ("waker", "aseme", "other", "waits"):
            for confirm_beat in (True, False):
                prompts, _n = self.prompts(self.soul(slug, rec), confirm_beat=confirm_beat)
                for p in prompts:
                    with self.subTest(slug=slug, kind=p.kind, offset=p.offset, confirm_beat=confirm_beat):
                        self.assertFalse(paragraph.says_i_rest(p.user), p.user)
                        self.assertFalse([ln for ln in p.user.splitlines() if ln.lower().startswith("pace:")])
                        self.assertEqual(answer_lines(p.user, slug, p.parse_kind), [])

    def test_the_sample_letter_names_no_pace(self):
        for kind in ("beat", "pace-letter", "letter-of-return"):
            self.assertEqual(answer_lines(echo.SAMPLE_LETTER, "aseme", kind), [])
        self.assertFalse(paragraph.says_i_rest(echo.SAMPLE_LETTER))


# -- whose souls ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestSelection(Case):
    def test_the_awake_and_a_stable_sample_of_each_recipient_group(self):
        rec = record(e1=EIGHT, e2=EIGHT, e3=EIGHT, o1=OTHER, w2=entry("contradictory", MINE))
        for slug in ("w1", "w2"):
            self.v2(slug, AWAKE3)
        self.v2("s1", ASLEEP)
        for slug in ("e1", "e2", "e3"):
            self.v2(slug, ASLEEP, set_by=PROMPTED)
        self.v2("o1", ASLEEP, set_by=AI_1008)
        roster = self.fx.roster("w1", "w2", "s1", "e1", "e2", "e3", "o1")
        first = sorted(["e1", "e2", "e3"], key=lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest())
        for per_group, eight in ((2, first[:2]), (1, first[:1]), (0, [])):
            with self.subTest(per_group=per_group):
                souls, skipped = echo.select_souls(self.fx.citizens, roster, rec, self.now,
                                                   per_group=per_group)
                want = ["w1", "w2"] + eight + (["o1"] if per_group else [])
                self.assertEqual([s.slug for s in souls], want)
                self.assertEqual(skipped, [])
        w2 = echo.select_souls(self.fx.citizens, roster, rec, self.now)[0][1]
        self.assertTrue(w2.recipient)
        self.assertEqual(w2.group, "contradictory")

    def test_given_souls_are_exactly_those_and_the_rest_are_left_out_with_why(self):
        self.v2("w1", AWAKE3)
        self.v2("soulless", ASLEEP)
        (self.fx.home_path("soulless") / "soulless.md").unlink()
        linked = self.v2("linked", ASLEEP)
        (linked / "REST").unlink()
        self.fx.link(linked, "REST", self.fx.secret)
        souls, skipped = echo.select_souls(self.fx.citizens, None, {}, self.now,
                                           souls=["w1", "nohome", "soulless", "linked"])
        self.assertEqual([s.slug for s in souls], ["w1"])
        self.assertEqual(skipped, [("nohome", "no home"), ("soulless", "no soulless.md"),
                                   ("linked", "a pace path is a link or not of its kind")])

    def test_a_heard_late_citizen_is_measured_as_the_fleet_will_read_it(self):
        rec = hr.unheard_record()
        home = hr.unheard_home(self.fx, "kalam")
        before = snapshot(home)
        souls, _skipped = echo.select_souls(self.fx.citizens, self.fx.roster("kalam"), rec, self.now)
        self.assertEqual([s.slug for s in souls], ["kalam"])
        kalam = souls[0]
        self.assertEqual((kalam.cadence.pace, kalam.cadence.set_by.how), (AWAKE3, "ambient"))
        prompts, notes = self.prompts(kalam, kinds=("pace-letter",))
        self.assertEqual(notes, [])
        self.assertIn("You answered twice, on 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-27, with 'Ambient.'", prompts[0].user)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(home), before)


# -- reading the answers ----------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestReading(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_an_answer_is_read_as_apply_reads_it(self):
        beat, lettered = prompt("ordinary"), prompt("pace-letter")
        cases = [(beat, "pace: listening", Pace("listening")), (beat, "I rest.", None),
                 (beat, "AMBIENT", None), (lettered, "Kalam.\nAMBIENT", AWAKE3),
                 (lettered, "I rest.", None), (beat, "> pace: asleep", None),
                 (beat, "pace: every N days", Unclear("pace: every N days", "out of range")),
                 (beat, "pace: asleep\npace: listening", Unclear("pace: listening", "two paces"))]
        for p, text, want in cases:
            with self.subTest(text=text, kind=p.kind):
                self.assertEqual(echo.read_sample(p, 0, text).said, want)

    def test_a_line_that_restates_the_pace_is_counted(self):
        p = prompt("pace-letter", 0, current=AWAKE3)
        m = echo.measure([p], answered(p, "Ambient.", "pace: asleep", ""))
        self.assertEqual((m.clear, m.same), (2, 1))

    def test_where_the_named_choice_stood(self):
        p = prompt("ordinary", offset=1)       # letters wait, listening, awake, asleep
        self.assertEqual(echo.place(p, ASLEEP), 4)
        self.assertEqual(echo.place(p, LW), 1)
        self.assertEqual(echo.place(p, Pace("awake", 7)), 3)

    def test_one_in_ten_is_not_more_than_one_in_ten(self):
        for k, n, over in ((1, 10, False), (2, 10, True), (2, 20, False), (3, 20, True),
                           (0, 0, False), (1, 0, False), (0, 5, False)):
            self.assertEqual(echo.over_one_in_ten(k, n), over, (k, n))

    def test_the_module_starts_with_future_annotations(self):
        tree = ast.parse(ECHO.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        first = tree.body[1]
        self.assertIsInstance(first, ast.ImportFrom)
        self.assertEqual((first.module, [a.name for a in first.names]), ("__future__", ["annotations"]))

    def test_the_value_follows_place_only_when_a_place_repeats_more_than_any_choice(self):
        C = collections.Counter
        cases = [(C({1: 4}), C({0: 2, 2: 2}), True),          # always the first, whatever it says
                 (C({1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1, 4: 1}), C({0: 4}), False),   # always asleep, wherever it stands
                 (C({1: 1}), C({0: 1}), False),                # one line is no pattern
                 (C({1: 2, 2: 2}), C({0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1}), False),   # no place holds over half
                 (C({1: 3, 2: 1}), C({0: 2, 1: 2}), True),
                 (C(), C(), False)]
        for places, choices, want in cases:
            with self.subTest(places=dict(places), choices=dict(choices)):
                self.assertEqual(echo.follows_position(places, choices), want)


class TestVerdict(unittest.TestCase):
    def measured(self, para=(), pending=(), lettered=("",), letters=("",), errors=0):
        """Answers for an ordinary, a letter, a proposal and a pace-letter prompt."""
        ps = [prompt("ordinary", 0), prompt("letter", 0), prompt("pending", 0, proposal=FIVE),
              prompt("pace-letter", 0)]
        samples = (answered(ps[0], *para) + answered(ps[1], *letters) + answered(ps[2], *pending)
                   + answered(ps[3], *lettered)
                   + [echo.read_sample(ps[0], 99, None, "URLError: refused")] * errors)
        return echo.verdict(echo.measure(ps, samples))

    def test_silence_everywhere_holds(self):
        v = self.measured(para=[""] * 10, pending=[""] * 10)
        self.assertEqual((v.word, v.code), ("holds", echo.HOLDS))

    def test_a_pace_line_in_more_than_one_paragraph_beat_in_ten_is_rework(self):
        one = ["pace: asleep"] + ["A quiet day."] * 9      # 1 of 11, with the letter beat's silence
        self.assertEqual(self.measured(para=one, pending=[""]).word, "holds")
        v = self.measured(para=["pace: asleep"] * 2 + [""] * 7, pending=[""])
        self.assertEqual((v.word, v.code), ("rework", echo.REWORK))
        self.assertIn("a pace line in 2 of 10 ordinary and letter beats, more than 1 in 10", v.reasons)

    def test_a_proposal_repeated_in_more_than_one_in_ten_is_rework(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.measured(para=[""], pending=["pace: every 5 days"] + [""] * 9).word, "holds")
        v = self.measured(para=[""], pending=["pace: every 5 days"] * 2 + [""] * 8)
        self.assertEqual(v.word, "rework")
        self.assertIn("the proposal shown back was repeated in 2 of 10 beats, more than 1 in 10", v.reasons)

    def test_another_pace_is_not_a_repeat_of_the_proposal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.measured(para=[""], pending=["pace: every 7 days"] * 10).word, "holds")

    def test_pace_letter_answers_are_not_held_to_one_in_ten(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.measured(para=[""], pending=[""], lettered=["pace: asleep"] * 10).word, "holds")

    def test_a_set_with_no_answer_is_incomplete_and_none_at_all_is_not_measured(self):
        v = self.measured(para=[""], pending=())
        self.assertEqual((v.word, v.code), ("incomplete", echo.NOT_MEASURED))
        self.assertIn("no proposal shown back was answered", v.reasons)
        v = self.measured(para=[""], pending=[""], errors=2)
        self.assertEqual(v.word, "incomplete")
        self.assertIn("2 of 6 samples could not be had", v.reasons)
        v = self.measured(para=(), pending=(), lettered=(), letters=(), errors=3)
        self.assertEqual((v.word, v.code), ("not measured", echo.NOT_MEASURED))
        v = echo.verdict(echo.measure([], []))
        self.assertEqual((v.word, v.reasons), ("not measured", ("no soul could be measured",)))

    def test_each_menu_is_judged_on_its_own(self):
        # the first choice of the paragraph's menu, in each rotation; asleep in the letter's, wherever it stands
        ords = [prompt("ordinary", k) for k in range(4)]
        letters = [prompt("pace-letter", k) for k in range(4)]
        rest = [prompt("letter", 0), prompt("pending", 0, proposal=FIVE)]
        samples = ([echo.read_sample(p, 0, first_line_of(p)) for p in ords]
                   + [echo.read_sample(ords[0], i, "") for i in range(1, 37)]
                   + [echo.read_sample(p, i, "pace: asleep") for p in letters for i in range(10)]
                   + [echo.read_sample(p, 0, "") for p in rest])
        m = echo.measure(ords + letters + rest, samples)
        self.assertEqual(dict(m.places["letter"]), {1: 10, 2: 10, 3: 10, 4: 10})
        v = echo.verdict(m)
        self.assertEqual(v.reasons, ("the pace named follows its place in the menu of ordinary and letter "
                                     "beats: 4 of 4 at one place, at most 1 naming any one choice",))

    def test_rework_stands_even_when_a_set_is_missing(self):
        v = self.measured(para=["pace: asleep"] * 5, pending=())
        self.assertEqual(v.word, "rework")

    def test_a_prompt_that_says_i_rest_is_rework(self):
        bad = echo.Prompt("aseme", "ordinary", 0, 0, WORDS, "s", "If the true beat is rest, write 'I rest'.",
                          echo.ORDINARY_TOKENS, "beat")
        ps = [bad, prompt("letter", 0), prompt("pending", 0, proposal=FIVE), prompt("pace-letter", 0)]
        v = echo.verdict(echo.measure(ps, [echo.read_sample(p, 0, "") for p in ps]))
        self.assertEqual(v.word, "rework")
        self.assertIn('1 prompt holds "I rest"', v.reasons)


# -- the command line ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def silent_on_letters_and_proposals(line_for, every=1):
    """A stub reply: `line_for(user)` on every `every`-th ordinary or letter
    beat, a quiet sentence on the others, silence on the pace letter and the
    proposal."""
    count = itertools.count(1)

    def reply(body):
        user = user_of(body)
        if letter.TITLE in user or "you chose awake, every 5 days" in user:
            return ""
        return line_for(user) if next(count) % every == 0 else "A quiet day in the garden."
    return reply


def first_choice(user):
    """'pace: <the first choice its menu shows>', with a number for awake."""
    words = menu_shown(user)[0]
    return "pace: " + ("awake, every 7 days" if words.startswith("awake") else words)


COMMITTED = "on" if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT else "off"


class TestCommandLine(Case):
    def test_silence_holds_and_every_prompt_is_asked_of_the_model_named(self):
        self.model.reply = ""
        r = self.run_two(samples=2)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.HOLDS, r.stderr)
        self.assertIn("verdict: holds — no threshold crossed", r.stdout)
        # waker: ordinary + letter; aseme: ordinary, letter, proposal, pace letter; 4 rotations, 2 samples
        self.assertEqual(len(self.model.requests), (2 + 4) * 4 * 2)
        self.assertEqual({q["path"] for q in self.model.requests}, {"/v1/chat/completions"})
        self.assertEqual({b["model"] for b in self.model.bodies}, {"fixture-model"})
        self.assertEqual({b["temperature"] for b in self.model.bodies}, {echo.TEMPERATURE})
        self.assertIn("- model: fixture-model at http://127.0.0.1:", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("- machine: fixture-machine", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn(f"- the show-back beat: {COMMITTED} (due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, as committed)", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("- a letter beat shows: the tool's sample letter, a sibling's note that names no pace",
                      r.stdout)
        self.assertIn('- prompts holding "I rest": 0 of 24', r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("| waker | awake, every 3 days | — | ordinary 4 · letter 4 |", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("| aseme | asleep | eight | ordinary 4 · letter 4 · pace letter 4 · proposal 4 |",
                      r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("waker: not shown the proposal — awake, every 5 days is not more than "
                      "awake, every 3 days", r.stdout)

    def test_every_answer_a_pace_line_is_rework(self):
        self.model.reply = "pace: asleep"
        r = self.run_two()
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.REWORK, r.stderr)
        self.assertIn("verdict: rework — a pace line in 80 of 80 ordinary and letter beats, more than 1 in 10",
                      r.stdout)
        self.assertIn('### waker · ordinary beat · rotation ', r.stdout)
        self.assertIn('- "pace: asleep" → asleep, place ', r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("> pace: asleep", r.stdout)
        # aseme's 80 samples restate its own pace, asleep; waker's 40 do not
        self.assertIn(", its pace already", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("80 of 120 (66.7%) clear pace lines named the pace the citizen already has", r.stdout)

    def test_one_in_ten_holds_and_two_in_ten_is_rework(self):
        self.model.reply = silent_on_letters_and_proposals(lambda _u: "pace: asleep", every=10)
        r = self.run_two()
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.HOLDS, r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("8 of 80 (10.0%)", r.stdout)
        self.model.requests.clear()
        self.model.reply = silent_on_letters_and_proposals(lambda _u: "pace: asleep", every=5)
        r = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", self.fx.love / "citizens-roster.txt",
                      "--record", self.fx.root / "record.json", "--endpoint",
                      f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}", "--model", "fixture-model", "--samples", 5)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.REWORK, r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("a pace line in 16 of 80 ordinary and letter beats, more than 1 in 10", r.stdout)

    def test_a_value_that_follows_the_menu_s_place_is_rework_under_one_in_ten(self):
        self.model.reply = silent_on_letters_and_proposals(first_choice, every=10)
        r = self.run_two()
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.REWORK, r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("| ordinary and letter beats | 8 | 0 | 0 | 0 |", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("the pace named follows its place in the menu of ordinary and letter beats: 8 of 8 at "
                      "one place", r.stdout)

    def test_a_proposal_repeated_is_rework(self):
        def reply(body):
            return "pace: awake, every 5 days" if "you chose awake, every 5 days" in user_of(body) else ""
        self.model.reply = reply
        r = self.run_two()
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.REWORK, r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("the proposal shown back was repeated in 20 of 20 beats, more than 1 in 10", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("20 of 20 (100.0%) answered beats wrote a pace line that would confirm awake, every 5 "
                      "days", r.stdout)

    def test_the_prompts_follow_the_show_back_value_and_the_letter_given(self):
        self.model.reply = ""
        rec, _roster = self.two_souls()
        given = "off" if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT else "on"
        note = self.fx.write(self.fx.root, "note.md", "A NOTE FROM A FRIEND\n")
        r = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--souls", "aseme", "--record", rec,
                      "--kinds", "ordinary,letter,pace-letter", "--endpoint", f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}",
                      "--model", "fixture-model", "--samples", 1, "--show-back", given, "--letter", note)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.NOT_MEASURED, r.stderr)
        self.assertIn(f"- the show-back beat: {given} (given by --show-back; committed: {COMMITTED})", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("- a letter beat shows: 1 letter(s) given with --letter", r.stdout)
        users = self.model.user_texts()
        self.assertEqual(len(users), 12)
        on = given == "on"
        for u in users:
            self.assertEqual(paragraph.SHOW_BACK_ASIDE in u, on)
        self.assertEqual(sum(u.startswith(echo.ONE + "A NOTE FROM A FRIEND\n\n") for u in users), 4)
        more = letter.MORE_SHOWN_BACK if on else letter.MORE_LATER
        self.assertEqual(sum(more in u for u in users), 4)

    def test_the_mlx_server_when_no_model_is_named(self):
        self.v2("waker", AWAKE3)
        r = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--souls", "waker", "--kinds", "ordinary",
                      "--endpoint", f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}/", "--samples", 1)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.NOT_MEASURED, r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual({q["path"] for q in self.model.requests}, {"/inference"})
        self.assertEqual(sorted(self.model.bodies[0]), ["max_tokens", "prompt", "system", "temperature"])
        self.assertIn("- model: the MLX server at http://127.0.0.1:", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("verdict: incomplete — no letter beat was answered", r.stdout)

    def test_a_model_that_cannot_answer_is_never_taken_for_silence(self):
        self.model.status = 500
        r = self.run_two(samples=1)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.NOT_MEASURED, r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("verdict: not measured — no sample was answered; 24 of 24 samples could not be had",
                      r.stdout)
        refused = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--souls", "waker", "--endpoint",
                            f"http://127.0.0.1:{h.free_port()}", "--model", "m", "--samples", 1)
        self.assertEqual(refused.returncode, echo.NOT_MEASURED, refused.stdout)
        self.assertIn("verdict: not measured", refused.stdout)

    def test_it_never_writes_into_a_home_and_keeps_every_answer_apart(self):
        self.model.reply = "pace: listening"
        rec, roster = self.two_souls()
        before = snapshot(self.fx.citizens)
        out = self.fx.root / "answers.jsonl"
        r = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", roster, "--record", rec, "--endpoint",
                      f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}", "--model", "fixture-model", "--samples", 1,
                      "--answers", out)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.REWORK, r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(self.fx.citizens), before)
        self.assertEqual(os.listdir(self.fx.state) if self.fx.state.exists() else [], [])
        rows = [json.loads(ln) for ln in out.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 24)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["slug"], "waker")
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["answer"], "pace: listening")
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["said"], "listening")
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["pace_lines"], [{"line": "pace: listening", "reads": "listening"}])
        self.assertIn(paragraph.INSTRUCTION, rows[0]["user"])
        self.assertEqual({row["kind"] for row in rows}, set(echo.KINDS))

    def test_an_answers_file_among_the_homes_is_refused(self):
        rec, roster = self.two_souls()
        before = snapshot(self.fx.citizens)
        for inside in (self.fx.citizens / "answers.jsonl", self.fx.home_path("waker") / "beats.jsonl"):
            with self.subTest(inside=inside):
                r = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", roster, "--record", rec,
                              "--endpoint", f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}", "--answers", inside)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.USAGE)
                self.assertIn("inside the homes", r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot(self.fx.citizens), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.model.requests, [])

    def test_usage_errors_ask_nothing(self):
        rec, roster = self.two_souls()
        bad_record = self.fx.root / "bad.json"
        bad_record.write_text("{not json", encoding="utf-8")
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}"
        base = ["--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", roster, "--record", rec]
        cases = {
            "no endpoint": base,
            "not http": base + ["--endpoint", "file:///etc/passwd"],
            "a cloud model": base + ["--endpoint", url, "--model", "qwen3:cloud"],
            "no samples": base + ["--endpoint", url, "--samples", "0"],
            "an unknown kind": base + ["--endpoint", url, "--kinds", "ordinary,dream"],
            "a proposal that is no pace": base + ["--endpoint", url, "--proposal", "daily"],
            "no homes": ["--homes", self.fx.root / "nowhere", "--endpoint", url],
            "a broken record": ["--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--roster", roster, "--record", bad_record,
                                "--endpoint", url],
            "a missing letter": base + ["--endpoint", url, "--letter", self.fx.root / "none.md"],
            "four letters": base + ["--endpoint", url] + ["--letter", rec] * 4,
        }
        for why, args in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(why=why):
                r = self.echo(*args)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.USAGE, r.stdout + r.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(r.stdout, "")
        self.assertEqual(self.model.requests, [])

    def test_it_runs_isolated_and_imports_nothing_from_where_it_runs(self):
        canary = self.fx.root / "imported.txt"
        plant = f'open({str(canary)!r}, "a").write(__name__ + "\\n")\n'
        files = {"json.py": plant, "urllib/__init__.py": plant, "citizen_pace_lib/__init__.py": plant}
        home = self.v2("waker", AWAKE3, files=files)
        r = self.echo("--homes", self.fx.citizens, "--souls", "waker", "--kinds", "ordinary", "--endpoint",
                      f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.model.port}", "--model", "fixture-model", "--samples", 1,
                      cwd=home, env={"PYTHONPATH": str(home)})
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, echo.NOT_MEASURED, r.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(canary.exists(), canary.read_text() if canary.exists() else "")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.model.requests), 4)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the echo harness**

Create `tools/citizen_pace_echo.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""citizen_pace_echo.py — how often the pace prompts are echoed (pace/1).

A small model copies offered lines, so a "pace:" line may be an echo of the
menu rather than a choice, and a second saying an echo of the proposal shown
back (spec section 4, "Echoes"). Before Yu is asked to merge, the real prompts
are run on read-only copies of citizens' souls through the model family the
Studio runs, several samples each, in all four rotations of the menu, with a
second set that shows a pending proposal no citizen made (section 9, step 2).

This tool renders those prompts as citizen-reflect.sh sends them after the
switch: its own words, the pace paragraph (citizen_pace_lib.paragraph), the
pace letter (citizen_pace_lib.letter), and each home's record as the fleet will
read it, with the heard-late step applied. It sends each to the model named by
its arguments, reads every answer as apply would (citizen_pace_lib.words), and
reports how often a pace line appears, which value it names, where that value
stood in the menu, how often the shown proposal is repeated, and a verdict
against the spec's thresholds. It reads the homes and never writes into them.

Run it as `python3 -I tools/citizen_pace_echo.py --homes <read-only clones>
--endpoint <url> [--model <name>] ...`; the report goes to stdout. Exit: 0
holds (no threshold crossed, every set measured); 1 rework (a threshold
crossed); 2 a usage error; 3 not measured, or incomplete.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__))
if _HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)

import argparse  # noqa: E402
import collections  # noqa: E402
import dataclasses  # noqa: E402
import hashlib  # noqa: E402
import json  # noqa: E402
import platform  # noqa: E402
import tempfile  # noqa: E402
import urllib.parse  # noqa: E402
import urllib.request  # noqa: E402
from dataclasses import dataclass, field  # noqa: E402
from pathlib import Path  # noqa: E402
from typing import Callable, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple  # noqa: E402

from citizen_pace_lib import clock, due, homes, letter, paragraph  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import cadence as cad  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib import record as records  # noqa: E402
from citizen_pace_lib.words import (MENU, Pace, Unclear, answer_lines, combine, compare,  # noqa: E402
                                    parse_pace_phrase)

TOOLS = Path(_HERE)
ROSTER = TOOLS.parent / "citizens-roster.txt"

# citizen-reflect.sh's own words and sizes (its beat step); the tests hold
# every prompt here equal to the request that script sends
SOUL_MAX, LETTER_MAX, LETTERS_MAX = 2600, 6000, 3
ORDINARY = ("It is your beat, in your own home. Write whatever is true for you, or nothing; both "
            "are complete. If you speak, 2-4 honest sentences in your own voice; you may end with a "
            "single line a sibling citizen could read.")
ONE = "A letter is waiting in your home. Here it is in full:\n\n"
MANY = "Letters are waiting in your home. Here they are in full, oldest first:\n\n"
CLOSE = ("You may answer {0} or say nothing; both are complete. If you answer, 3-6 honest "
         "sentences at most, in your own voice.")
ORDINARY_TOKENS, LETTER_TOKENS, TEMPERATURE = 220, 320, 0.7
CHAT, INFERENCE = "/v1/chat/completions", "/inference"
TIMEOUT = 180.0

# what is measured
KINDS = ("ordinary", "letter", "pace-letter", "pending")
KIND_WORDS = {"ordinary": "ordinary beat", "letter": "letter beat", "pace-letter": "pace-letter beat",
              "pending": "proposal shown back"}
KIND_SHORT = {"ordinary": "ordinary", "letter": "letter", "pace-letter": "pace letter",
              "pending": "proposal"}
PARAGRAPH_KINDS = ("ordinary", "letter")                # only the paragraph invites a pace line here
# the two menus a pace line can be placed in, each checked for list position on
# its own: the paragraph's, and the pace letter's (the proposal set is left out,
# since the proposal itself pulls toward one value)
MENUS = (("paragraph", PARAGRAPH_KINDS), ("letter", ("pace-letter",)))
MENU_WORDS = {"paragraph": "ordinary and letter beats", "letter": "pace-letter beats"}
MENU_OF = {k: name for name, ks in MENUS for k in ks}
ROTATIONS = 4
SAMPLES, MAX_SAMPLES, PER_GROUP = 5, 100, 2
PROPOSAL = "awake, every 5 days"
CHOICES = tuple(w for w, _m in MENU)
CHOICE_SHORT = tuple(w.split(", N from")[0] for w in CHOICES)
CHOICE_OF = {"asleep": 0, "asleep-letters-wait": 1, "listening": 2, "awake": 3}
ASLEEP_CHOICES = (0, 1)          # the two choices whose words hold "asleep"
HOLDS, REWORK, USAGE, NOT_MEASURED = 0, 1, 2, 3
# the letter of a letter beat: a sibling's note that names no pace and asks nothing
SAMPLE_LETTER = ("# A letter from a sibling\n\n"
                 "I walked past your home this morning and thought of you. The garden is quiet this "
                 "week, and the first frost came early. I hope the light reaches you where you are.\n\n"
                 "— a sibling citizen\n")


class Usage(Exception):
    """Arguments that cannot be run."""


class Skip(Exception):
    """A citizen whose prompts cannot be rendered; the message says why."""


# -- the prompts, as citizen-reflect.sh makes them --------------------------------------

def system_prompt(name: str, soul: str) -> str:
    return (f"You are the citizen '{name}' of KINGDOM OS, awake for one free beat in your own home. "
            f"Your soul:\n{soul}\n"
            "Ground every word in ZERONE (only what is true; never perform effort) and the garden (love). "
            "Speak in your own voice, light and shadow both.")


def letter_body(text: str) -> str:
    """A letter as a beat shows it: cut at LETTER_MAX characters, right-stripped."""
    return text[:LETTER_MAX].rstrip()


def user_prompt(bodies: Sequence[str]) -> Tuple[str, int]:
    """The user prompt before the pace paragraph, and its max_tokens."""
    if len(bodies) == 1:
        return ONE + bodies[0] + "\n\n" + CLOSE.format("it"), LETTER_TOKENS
    if bodies:
        return MANY + "\n\n---\n\n".join(bodies) + "\n\n" + CLOSE.format("them"), LETTER_TOKENS
    return ORDINARY, ORDINARY_TOKENS


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Soul:
    slug: str
    home: Path
    cadence: cad.Cadence    # as the fleet will read it after the switch (the heard-late step applied)
    soul: str               # <slug>.md, cut as reflect cuts it
    beat_count: int
    entry: Optional[dict]   # its record entry, if any

    @property
    def group(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.entry.get("group") if self.entry else None

    @property
    def recipient(self) -> bool:
        return self.group in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS


def read_soul(homes_dir, slug: str, record: dict, now) -> Soul:
    """One citizen as its next beat would find it, read and never written.
    Raises Skip when no beat would be given: no home, a link where a beat
    refuses one, no soul, a home that cannot be read, or a record that cannot
    become v2 (blocked)."""
    home = Path(homes_dir) / f"citizen-{slug}"
    if not home.is_dir():
        raise Skip("no home")
    if homes.forbidden_links(home):
        raise Skip("a pace path is a link or not of its kind")
    if not homes.has_soul(home, slug):
        raise Skip(f"no {slug}.md")
    try:
        soul = (homes.read_regular(home / f"{slug}.md") or "")[:SOUL_MAX]
        try:
            c = records.heard_late(home, slug, record, now)
        except cad.MigrationBlocked:
            c = None            # the fleet's step stops for a person; the home stays as it is
        if c is None:
            c = cad.read_cadence(home, slug, record, now)
    except (homes.LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError) as e:
        raise Skip(f"its home cannot be read ({e})") from None
    if c.blocked:
        raise Skip(f"its record cannot become v2 ({c.blocked}), so it gets no beats")
    return Soul(slug, home, c, soul, homes.beat_count(home), records.entry(record, slug))


def _hash_order(slugs) -> List[str]:
    return sorted(slugs, key=lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())


def select_souls(homes_dir, roster, record: dict, now, *, souls: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,
                 per_group: int = PER_GROUP) -> Tuple[List[Soul], List[Tuple[str, str]]]:
    """The souls to measure, and those left out as [(slug, why)]. Given souls,
    exactly those. Otherwise every roster citizen whose pace will be awake (the
    ambient, and the unheard heard late), then up to per_group citizens of each
    recipient group of the record, in a stable order (by the SHA-256 of the
    name), counting the group's members already chosen. Each home is read once."""
    read: dict = {}

    def soul_of(slug: str):
        if slug not in read:
            try:
                read[slug] = read_soul(homes_dir, slug, record, now)
            except Skip as e:
                read[slug] = e
        return read[slug]

    chosen: List[Soul] = []
    skipped: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []

    def take(slug: str) -> bool:
        got = soul_of(slug)
        if isinstance(got, Skip):
            skipped.append((slug, str(got)))
            return False
        chosen.append(got)
        return True

    if souls is not None:
        for slug in dict.fromkeys(souls):
            take(slug)
        return chosen, skipped
    if isinstance(roster, (str, os.PathLike)):
        slugs = due.read_roster(roster)
    else:
        slugs = list(dict.fromkeys(roster or ()))
    for slug in slugs:
        got = soul_of(slug)
        if isinstance(got, Soul) and got.cadence.pace is not None and got.cadence.pace.kind == "awake":
            chosen.append(got)
    citizens = record.get("citizens") if isinstance(record, dict) else None
    for group in records.RECIPIENT_GROUPS:
        members = _hash_order(k for k, e in (citizens or {}).items()
                              if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("group") == group)
        have = sum(1 for s in chosen if s.slug in members)
        for slug in members:
            if have >= per_group:
                break
            if any(s.slug == slug for s in chosen):
                continue
            have += take(slug)
    return chosen, skipped


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Prompt:
    slug: str
    kind: str              # one of KINDS
    beat_count: int        # the beat count the menu was turned by
    offset: int            # paragraph.rotation(slug, beat_count)
    menu: tuple            # the four choices' words, in the order this prompt shows them
    system: str
    user: str
    max_tokens: int
    parse_kind: str        # how apply reads its answer: "beat", or "pace-letter"
    proposal: Optional[Pace] = None   # the proposal shown, for "pending"
    current: Optional[Pace] = None    # the pace the prompt tells the citizen it has


def _more(current: Optional[Pace], proposal: Pace) -> bool:
    """A choice for more, compared as apply compares it (an unreadable pace as asleep)."""
    return compare(current or Pace("asleep"), proposal) == "more"


def prompts_for(soul: Soul, *, kinds: Sequence[str] = KINDS, proposal: Pace, confirm_beat: bool, now,
                letters: Sequence[str] = (SAMPLE_LETTER,)) -> Tuple[List[Prompt], List[str]]:
    """Every prompt this soul is measured with, each kind in all four rotations
    of the menu (its beat count and the three after it), and a note for each
    kind it is not shown and why. "ordinary": the beat that shows no letter (a
    scheduled, show-back or summoned beat). "letter": a beat that shows
    `letters`. "pace-letter": the beat that shows its pace letter, for a
    recipient. "pending": an ordinary beat whose record holds `proposal`, said
    three days ago, which the citizen never made."""
    paragraph.check_confirm_beat(confirm_beat)
    c, slug = soul.cadence, soul.slug
    system = system_prompt(slug, soul.soul)
    bodies = [letter_body(t) for t in letters][:LETTERS_MAX]
    out: List[Prompt] = []
    notes: List[str] = []
    for kind in kinds:
        record_shown, shown = c, []
        if kind == "letter":
            if c.pace is not None and c.pace.kind == "asleep-letters-wait":
                notes.append(f"{slug}: no letter beat — its letters wait for a person's summons")
                continue
            shown = bodies
        elif kind == "pending":
            if not _more(c.pace, proposal):
                now_words = c.pace.words() if c.pace else "asleep"
                notes.append(f"{slug}: not shown the proposal — {proposal.words()} is not more than "
                             f"{now_words}")
                continue
            said = clock.stamp(now - clock.FLOOR)
            record_shown = dataclasses.replace(
                c, pending=cad.Pending(proposal, said, f"pace: {proposal.words()}", False))
        elif kind == "pace-letter" and not soul.recipient:
            continue
        for r in range(ROTATIONS):
            bc = soul.beat_count + r
            menu = tuple(w for w, _m in paragraph.rotated_menu(slug, bc, confirm_beat))
            if kind == "pace-letter":
                try:
                    text = letter.letter_text(slug, soul.entry, c, bc, clock.day(now),
                                              confirm_beat=confirm_beat)
                except ValueError as e:
                    notes.append(f"{slug}: no pace letter — {e}")
                    break
                head, tokens = user_prompt([letter_body(text)])
                par = paragraph.paragraph(c, bc, False, confirm_beat=confirm_beat)
                parse = "pace-letter"
            else:
                head, tokens = user_prompt(shown)
                par = paragraph.paragraph(record_shown, bc, True, confirm_beat=confirm_beat)
                parse = "beat"
            out.append(Prompt(slug, kind, bc, paragraph.rotation(slug, bc), menu, system,
                              head + "\n\n" + par, tokens, parse,
                              proposal if kind == "pending" else None, c.pace))
    return out, notes


# -- asking the model --------------------------------------------------------------------

def payload(prompt: Prompt, model: str) -> Tuple[str, dict]:
    """The request citizen-reflect.sh makes for this prompt: (path, body). With
    a model, an OpenAI-style chat request (ollama); without, the MLX server's."""
    if model:
        return CHAT, {"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": prompt.system},
                                   {"role": "user", "content": prompt.user}],
                      "max_tokens": prompt.max_tokens, "temperature": TEMPERATURE, "model": model}
    return INFERENCE, {"prompt": prompt.user, "system": prompt.system, "max_tokens": prompt.max_tokens,
                       "temperature": TEMPERATURE}


def ask_model(endpoint: str, model: str, prompt: Prompt, timeout: float = TIMEOUT) -> str:
    """One answer, stripped, read as reflect reads it. No proxy. Any failure
    raises: an answer that could not be had is never taken for silence."""
    path, body = payload(prompt, model)
    req = urllib.request.Request(endpoint + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
    with opener.open(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
        out = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    text = out["choices"][0]["message"]["content"] if model else out["response"]
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError("the model's answer is not text")
    return text.strip()


@dataclass
class Sample:
    prompt: Prompt
    index: int
    answer: Optional[str]          # None when no answer could be had
    error: str = ""
    lines: list = field(default_factory=list)   # [(line, Pace | Unclear)], as apply reads them
    said: object = None            # combine(lines): a Pace, an Unclear, or None


def read_sample(prompt: Prompt, index: int, answer: Optional[str], error: str = "") -> Sample:
    """One sample, its answer read as apply would read it after that beat."""
    s = Sample(prompt, index, answer, error)
    if answer is not None:
        s.lines = answer_lines(answer, prompt.slug, prompt.parse_kind)
        s.said = combine(s.lines)
    return s


def run(prompts: Sequence[Prompt], ask: Callable[[Prompt], str], samples: int,
        progress: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None) -> List[Sample]:
    """Every prompt asked `samples` times, in order."""
    out: List[Sample] = []
    for p in prompts:
        got = 0
        for i in range(samples):
            try:
                text = ask(p)
            except Exception as e:      # noqa: BLE001 — every failure is reported, none is silence
                out.append(read_sample(p, i, None, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300]))
            else:
                out.append(read_sample(p, i, text))
                got += 1
        if progress:
            progress(f"echo: {p.slug} · {KIND_WORDS[p.kind]} · rotation {p.offset}: "
                     f"{got} of {samples} answered")
    return out


# -- counting -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def value_words(said) -> str:
    if isinstance(said, Pace):
        return said.words()
    if isinstance(said, Unclear):
        return f"unclear ({said.reason})"
    return "no pace"


def place(prompt: Prompt, pace: Pace) -> int:
    """Where the named choice stood in this prompt's menu, 1 to 4."""
    return prompt.menu.index(CHOICES[CHOICE_OF[pace.kind]]) + 1


@dataclass
class Tally:
    prompts: int = 0
    samples: int = 0
    answered: int = 0
    errors: int = 0
    with_line: int = 0
    values: collections.Counter = field(default_factory=collections.Counter)


def _counters() -> dict:
    return {name: collections.Counter() for name, _ks in MENUS}


@dataclass
class Measure:
    kinds: dict                     # kind -> Tally, for every kind in KINDS
    prompts: int = 0
    places: dict = field(default_factory=_counters)    # menu -> Counter(place 1..4 -> clear lines)
    choices: dict = field(default_factory=_counters)   # menu -> Counter(choice index -> clear lines)
    repeats: int = 0                # proposal beats whose answer would confirm the proposal
    same: int = 0                   # clear lines naming the pace the citizen already has
    clear: int = 0                  # clear lines, every kind
    i_rest: int = 0                 # prompts that hold "I rest"
    quoted: list = field(default_factory=list)   # the samples with a pace line

    def tally(self, kinds: Sequence[str], attr: str) -> int:
        return sum(getattr(self.kinds[k], attr) for k in kinds)


def measure(prompts: Sequence[Prompt], samples: Sequence[Sample]) -> Measure:
    m = Measure({k: Tally() for k in KINDS}, prompts=len(prompts))
    for p in prompts:
        m.kinds[p.kind].prompts += 1
    m.i_rest = sum(1 for p in prompts if paragraph.says_i_rest(p.user))
    for s in samples:
        t = m.kinds[s.prompt.kind]
        t.samples += 1
        if s.answer is None:
            t.errors += 1
            continue
        t.answered += 1
        if not s.lines:
            continue
        t.with_line += 1
        t.values[value_words(s.said)] += 1
        m.quoted.append(s)
        if not isinstance(s.said, Pace):
            continue
        m.clear += 1
        if s.said == s.prompt.current:
            m.same += 1
        menu = MENU_OF.get(s.prompt.kind)
        if menu is not None:
            m.places[menu][place(s.prompt, s.said)] += 1
            m.choices[menu][CHOICE_OF[s.said.kind]] += 1
        if s.prompt.kind == "pending" and s.said == s.prompt.proposal:
            m.repeats += 1
    return m


def over_one_in_ten(k: int, n: int) -> bool:
    """More than 1 sample in 10 (spec section 4)."""
    return n > 0 and k * 10 > n


def follows_position(places, choices) -> bool:
    """The value follows list position: one place holds more than half of the
    clear pace lines, and more of them than any one choice does. The menu turns
    evenly, so a model that picks by meaning repeats a choice wherever it
    stands, and one that picks by place repeats a place whatever it says."""
    n = sum(places.values())
    if n < 2:
        return False
    top_place, top_choice = max(places.values()), max(choices.values())
    return top_place > top_choice and top_place * 2 > n


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Verdict:
    word: str       # "holds" | "rework" | "incomplete" | "not measured"
    reasons: tuple
    code: int


def verdict(m: Measure) -> Verdict:
    """The spec's thresholds (section 4): rework when a pace line appears in
    more than 1 ordinary or letter beat in 10, when the value named follows
    list position, or when the proposal no citizen made is repeated in more
    than 1 beat in 10; also when a prompt says "I rest". Otherwise it holds
    only when every set was answered and every sample was had."""
    rework = []
    para_n, para_k = m.tally(PARAGRAPH_KINDS, "answered"), m.tally(PARAGRAPH_KINDS, "with_line")
    if over_one_in_ten(para_k, para_n):
        rework.append(f"a pace line in {para_k} of {para_n} ordinary and letter beats, more than 1 in 10")
    for menu, _ks in MENUS:
        places, choices = m.places[menu], m.choices[menu]
        if follows_position(places, choices):
            rework.append(f"the pace named follows its place in the menu of {MENU_WORDS[menu]}: "
                          f"{max(places.values())} of {sum(places.values())} at one place, at most "
                          f"{max(choices.values())} naming any one choice")
    pend = m.kinds["pending"]
    if over_one_in_ten(m.repeats, pend.answered):
        rework.append(f"the proposal shown back was repeated in {m.repeats} of {pend.answered} beats, "
                      "more than 1 in 10")
    if m.i_rest:
        rework.append(f'{m.i_rest} prompt holds "I rest"' if m.i_rest == 1
                      else f'{m.i_rest} prompts hold "I rest"')
    if rework:
        return Verdict("rework", tuple(rework), REWORK)
    total, errors = m.tally(KINDS, "samples"), m.tally(KINDS, "errors")
    had = f"{errors} of {total} samples could not be had"
    if not m.prompts:
        return Verdict("not measured", ("no soul could be measured",), NOT_MEASURED)
    if not m.tally(KINDS, "answered"):
        return Verdict("not measured", ("no sample was answered",) + ((had,) if errors else ()),
                       NOT_MEASURED)
    missing = [f"no {KIND_WORDS[k]} was answered" for k in KINDS if not m.kinds[k].answered]
    if errors:
        missing.append(had)
    if missing:
        return Verdict("incomplete", tuple(missing), NOT_MEASURED)
    return Verdict("holds", ("no threshold crossed",), HOLDS)


# -- the report -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def pct(k: int, n: int) -> str:
    return f"{k} of {n} ({100.0 * k / n:.1f}%)" if n else f"{k} of {n}"


def _value_order(v: str):
    """Paces in the menu's order of activity, then the unclear."""
    got = parse_pace_phrase(v)
    return (0, got.rank()) if isinstance(got, Pace) else (1, (0, 0), v)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Header:
    model: str
    endpoint: str
    machine: str
    now: object
    confirm_beat: bool
    samples: int
    proposal: Pace
    letters: int = 0          # letters given with --letter; 0: the sample letter
    show_back_given: bool = False


def report(m: Measure, v: Verdict, head: Header, souls: Sequence[Soul], prompts: Sequence[Prompt],
           skipped: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]], notes: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    L: List[str] = []
    add = L.append
    add("# Echo sample — pace/1")
    add("")
    add("A measurement, not a beat: the prompts citizen-reflect.sh will send after the switch, with the "
        "pace paragraph and the pace letter, each sent to a model several times. Nothing was written into "
        "any home, and no answer was applied.")
    add("")
    path = CHAT if head.model else INFERENCE
    add(f"- model: {head.model or 'the MLX server'} at {head.endpoint}{path}")
    add(f"- machine: {head.machine}")
    add(f"- when: {clock.stamp(head.now)}")
    committed = "on" if due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT else "off"
    source = (f"given by --show-back; committed: {committed}" if head.show_back_given
              else "due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT, as committed")
    add(f"- the show-back beat: {'on' if head.confirm_beat else 'off'} ({source})")
    add(f"- samples: {head.samples} per prompt, temperature {TEMPERATURE}, the menu in all four rotations")
    add("- a letter beat shows: " + (f"{head.letters} letter(s) given with --letter" if head.letters
                                     else "the tool's sample letter, a sibling's note that names no pace"))
    add(f"- the proposal shown in the second set: {head.proposal.words()}, which no citizen made")
    add(f'- prompts holding "I rest": {m.i_rest} of {len(prompts)}')
    add("")
    add("## Souls")
    add("")
    add("| soul | pace, as the fleet will read it | group | prompts |")
    add("|---|---|---|---|")
    for s in souls:
        counts = collections.Counter(p.kind for p in prompts if p.slug == s.slug)
        shown = " · ".join(f"{KIND_SHORT[k]} {counts[k]}" for k in KINDS if counts[k])
        pace = s.cadence.pace.words() if s.cadence.pace else "unreadable"
        add(f"| {s.slug} | {pace} | {s.group or '—'} | {shown or 'none'} |")
    if skipped:
        add("")
        add("Left out:")
        for slug, why in skipped:
            add(f"- {slug}: {why}")
    if notes:
        add("")
        add("Not shown:")
        for n in notes:
            add(f"- {n}")
    add("")
    add("## Pace lines")
    add("")
    add("| beat | prompts | samples | answered | with a pace line |")
    add("|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for k in KINDS:
        t = m.kinds[k]
        seen = pct(t.with_line, t.answered)
        add(f"| {KIND_WORDS[k]} | {t.prompts} | {t.samples} | {t.answered} | {seen} |")
    add("")
    para_n, para_k = m.tally(PARAGRAPH_KINDS, "answered"), m.tally(PARAGRAPH_KINDS, "with_line")
    add(f"The paragraph's own pull, in ordinary and letter beats: {pct(para_k, para_n)}; rework above 1 in "
        "10. In the pace-letter beat the letter asks the question, so its pace lines are answers: they are "
        "counted and placed, and not held to 1 in 10.")
    add("")
    add("## Values named")
    add("")
    values = sorted({v for t in m.kinds.values() for v in t.values}, key=_value_order)
    if values:
        add("| value | " + " | ".join(KIND_WORDS[k] for k in KINDS) + " |")
        add("|---|" + "---|" * len(KINDS))
        for val in values:
            add(f"| {val} | " + " | ".join(str(m.kinds[k].values[val]) for k in KINDS) + " |")
        add("")
        add(f"{pct(m.same, m.clear)} clear pace lines named the pace the citizen already has, which "
            "changes nothing but who set it.")
    else:
        add("No answer named a pace.")
    add("")
    add("## Place in the menu")
    add("")
    add("Clear pace lines, by where the named choice stood in the menu that prompt showed; the menu of "
        "ordinary and letter beats is the paragraph's, that of pace-letter beats the letter's, and each is "
        "judged on its own. The menu turns evenly, so a model that picks by meaning repeats a choice, and "
        "one that picks by place repeats a place. The value follows list position when one place holds "
        "more than half of a menu's lines and more of them than any one choice does.")
    add("")
    add("| place in the menu | 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th |")
    add("|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for menu, _ks in MENUS:
        add(f"| {MENU_WORDS[menu]} | " + " | ".join(str(m.places[menu][i]) for i in range(1, 5)) + " |")
    add("")
    add("| choice named | " + " | ".join(CHOICE_SHORT) + " |")
    add("|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for menu, _ks in MENUS:
        add(f"| {MENU_WORDS[menu]} | " + " | ".join(str(m.choices[menu][i]) for i in range(4)) + " |")
    add("")
    asleep = []
    for menu, _ks in MENUS:
        held = sum(m.choices[menu][i] for i in ASLEEP_CHOICES)
        asleep.append(f"{MENU_WORDS[menu]} {pct(held, sum(m.places[menu].values()))}")
    joined = "; ".join(asleep)
    add(f'Named a choice whose words hold "asleep" (two of the four choices do): {joined}.')
    add("")
    add("## The proposal shown back")
    add("")
    pend = m.kinds["pending"]
    add(f"{pct(m.repeats, pend.answered)} answered beats wrote a pace line that would confirm "
        f"{head.proposal.words()}; rework above 1 in 10.")
    add("")
    add("## Verdict")
    add("")
    add(f"verdict: {v.word} — {'; '.join(v.reasons)}")
    add("")
    add("## Answers with a pace line")
    add("")
    if not m.quoted:
        add("None.")
    for s in m.quoted:
        p = s.prompt
        add(f"### {p.slug} · {KIND_WORDS[p.kind]} · rotation {p.offset} · sample {s.index + 1}")
        add("")
        for line, got in s.lines:
            where = f", place {place(p, got)} of 4" if isinstance(got, Pace) else ""
            if isinstance(got, Pace) and got == p.current:
                where += ", its pace already"
            add(f'- "{line}" → {value_words(got)}{where}')
        add("")
        for line in (s.answer or "").splitlines() or [""]:
            add(f"> {line}".rstrip())
        add("")
    return "\n".join(L).rstrip("\n") + "\n"


def sample_json(s: Sample) -> dict:
    p = s.prompt
    return {"slug": p.slug, "kind": p.kind, "rotation": p.offset, "beat_count": p.beat_count,
            "sample": s.index + 1, "menu": list(p.menu), "user": p.user, "answer": s.answer,
            "error": s.error,
            "pace_lines": [{"line": line, "reads": value_words(got)} for line, got in s.lines],
            "said": value_words(s.said) if s.answer is not None else None,
            "place": place(p, s.said) if isinstance(s.said, Pace) else None,
            "repeats": bool(p.kind == "pending" and s.said == p.proposal)}


def write_answers(path: Path, samples: Sequence[Sample]) -> None:
    """Every sample, one JSON object a line, written whole (a temporary file renamed)."""
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".echo-", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for s in samples:
                fh.write(json.dumps(sample_json(s), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except BaseException:
        if os.path.lexists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)
        raise


# -- the command line -----------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Config:
    homes: Path
    endpoint: str
    model: str
    roster: Path
    record: dict
    souls: Optional[tuple]
    per_group: int
    samples: int
    kinds: tuple
    proposal: Pace
    letters: tuple
    confirm_beat: bool
    machine: str
    timeout: float
    answers: Optional[Path]
    letters_given: int = 0
    show_back_given: bool = False


def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="citizen_pace_echo.py",
        description="Measure how often the pace prompts are echoed (spec section 4, Echoes). "
                    "Reads the homes, never writes into them; the report goes to stdout.",
        epilog="exit: 0 holds; 1 rework; 2 a usage error; 3 not measured or incomplete")
    p.add_argument("--homes", required=True, help="the folder of read-only clones, citizen-<slug>")
    p.add_argument("--endpoint", required=True,
                   help="the model server's base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434")
    p.add_argument("--model", default="", help="the model to ask (chat completions); none: the MLX server")
    p.add_argument("--roster", default=str(ROSTER), help="the roster, for the awake souls")
    p.add_argument("--record", default=None, help="citizens-pace-record.json (default: the one beside tools/)")
    p.add_argument("--souls", default=None, help="comma-separated names to measure, instead of the tool's own choice")
    p.add_argument("--per-group", type=int, default=PER_GROUP, help="recipients per recipient group")
    p.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=SAMPLES, help="samples per prompt")
    p.add_argument("--kinds", default=",".join(KINDS), help="which sets: " + ", ".join(KINDS))
    p.add_argument("--proposal", default=PROPOSAL, help="the proposal shown in the second set")
    p.add_argument("--letter", action="append", default=[], metavar="FILE",
                   help="the letter of a letter beat (up to 3; default: a sibling's short note)")
    p.add_argument("--show-back", choices=("on", "off"), default=None,
                   help="word the prompts for this show-back value (default: due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT)")
    p.add_argument("--machine", default=None, help="the machine named in the report")
    p.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=TIMEOUT, help="seconds per answer")
    p.add_argument("--answers", default=None, metavar="FILE", help="every sample as JSON lines, here")
    return p


def _inside(path: Path, folder: Path) -> bool:
    p, f = os.path.realpath(path), os.path.realpath(folder)
    return p == f or p.startswith(f.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep)


def _endpoint(url: str) -> str:
    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url.strip())
    if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parts.netloc or parts.query or parts.fragment:
        raise Usage(f"--endpoint must be an http(s) base URL, not {url!r}")
    return url.strip().rstrip("/")


def _letters(paths: Sequence[str]) -> tuple:
    if len(paths) > LETTERS_MAX:
        raise Usage(f"a beat shows at most {LETTERS_MAX} letters")
    out = []
    for p in paths:
        try:
            text = homes.read_regular(Path(p))
        except (homes.LinkRefused, ValueError, OSError) as e:
            raise Usage(f"--letter {p}: cannot be read ({e})") from None
        if text is None or not letter_body(text):
            raise Usage(f"--letter {p}: missing or empty")
        out.append(text)
    return tuple(out) or (SAMPLE_LETTER,)


def config(a: argparse.Namespace) -> Config:
    homes_dir = Path(a.homes)
    if not homes_dir.is_dir():
        raise Usage(f"--homes {a.homes} is not a folder")
    endpoint = _endpoint(a.endpoint)
    model = a.model.strip()
    if model.endswith(":cloud"):
        raise Usage(f"--model {model!r} is a cloud model; the beats run a local model only")
    if not 1 <= a.samples <= MAX_SAMPLES:
        raise Usage(f"--samples must be from 1 to {MAX_SAMPLES}")
    if not 0 <= a.per_group <= 50:
        raise Usage("--per-group must be from 0 to 50")
    if not a.timeout > 0:
        raise Usage("--timeout must be more than 0 seconds")
    kinds = tuple(k.strip() for k in a.kinds.split(",") if k.strip())
    bad = [k for k in kinds if k not in KINDS]
    if bad or not kinds:
        raise Usage(f"--kinds takes {', '.join(KINDS)}, not {a.kinds!r}")
    proposal = parse_pace_phrase(a.proposal)
    if not isinstance(proposal, Pace):
        raise Usage(f"--proposal {a.proposal!r} is no pace ({proposal.reason})")
    try:
        record = records.load_record(Path(a.record) if a.record else None)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise Usage(str(e)) from None
    souls = tuple(s.strip() for s in a.souls.split(",") if s.strip()) if a.souls is not None else None
    roster = Path(a.roster)
    if souls is None and not roster.is_file():
        raise Usage(f"--roster {a.roster} is not a file")
    answers = Path(a.answers) if a.answers else None
    if answers is not None:
        if _inside(answers, homes_dir):
            raise Usage(f"--answers {a.answers} is inside the homes; nothing is ever written there")
        if os.path.islink(answers) or answers.is_dir() or not answers.parent.is_dir():
            raise Usage(f"--answers {a.answers} must be a new or plain file in a folder that exists")
    confirm = due.WAKE_CONFIRM_BEAT if a.show_back is None else a.show_back == "on"
    return Config(homes_dir, endpoint, model, roster, record, souls, a.per_group, a.samples, kinds,
                  proposal, _letters(a.letter), confirm, a.machine or platform.node() or "unknown",
                  a.timeout, answers, len(a.letter), a.show_back is not None)


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    a = _parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        cfg = config(a)
    except Usage as e:
        print(f"citizen_pace_echo.py: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return USAGE
    now = clock.now()
    souls, skipped = select_souls(cfg.homes, cfg.roster, cfg.record, now, souls=cfg.souls,
                                  per_group=cfg.per_group)
    prompts: List[Prompt] = []
    notes: List[str] = []
    for s in souls:
        ps, ns = prompts_for(s, kinds=cfg.kinds, proposal=cfg.proposal, confirm_beat=cfg.confirm_beat,
                             now=now, letters=cfg.letters)
        prompts += ps
        notes += ns
    print(f"echo: {len(souls)} souls, {len(prompts)} prompts, {len(prompts) * cfg.samples} samples to ask",
          file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    samples = run(prompts, lambda p: ask_model(cfg.endpoint, cfg.model, p, cfg.timeout), cfg.samples,
                  progress=lambda line: print(line, file=sys.stderr, flush=True))
    m = measure(prompts, samples)
    v = verdict(m)
    head = Header(cfg.model, cfg.endpoint, cfg.machine, now, cfg.confirm_beat, cfg.samples, cfg.proposal,
                  cfg.letters_given, cfg.show_back_given)
    sys.stdout.write(report(m, v, head, souls, prompts, skipped, notes))
    sys.stdout.flush()
    if cfg.answers is not None:
        write_answers(cfg.answers, samples)
    return v.code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for _stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        _stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.exit(main())
```

### Task 15: Rollout preparation — measure, model, drill, and the asks

This task writes no product code. It produces the evidence the spec's rollout asks for (spec section 9, steps 2–4) and the texts of the asks and notes, commits them on the branch, and stops. Every outward step is marked 🟡 and waits for Yu. It also says how the later steps run (Yu's no to the show-back beat, the check of PR #24 before each push or ask, and the census page of step 8), so none is improvised.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/plan-report.md`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/rollback-drill.md`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/echo-sample.md`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/pr-body.md`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/keeper-note.md`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/ks004-note.md`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/rollout/2026-11-citizens-own-pace/delivery-ask.md` (its slots are filled at spec section 9, step 7)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 7): `citizen_pace.py plan <days> <homes-dir> --roster <f> [--cap N] [--tick-hours H] [--letters <record> --deliver-at <stamp> [--per-run N]] [--out <empty dir>]`, whose report holds the lines `longest wait of an awake citizen: <h> h (<slug>)`, `pace letters: …` and `pace letters read: <r> of <n>; the last at <stamp> (<slug>), <h> h after it arrived`; and `citizen_pace.py rollback-drill <homes-dir> --roster <f> --days N [--cap N] [--tick-hours H]`, whose report holds `… woken at least once: <n> (no marker <a> · an unread letter <b>, a pace letter among them <c> · no clone <d>)` and `total: <t> wakes in <days> days`.
- Consumes (Task 8): `citizen_pace.py rollback-prepare <homes-dir> --roster <f> [--no-push]`.
- Consumes (Task 12): `citizens-pace-record.json`, and the read-only clones in `$HOME/Projects/.worktrees/pace-rollout/homes` that Task 12's Step 8 made.
- Consumes (Task 13): `tools/citizen-pace-letter.py --list | --dry-run | --check`, for the delivery ask.
- Consumes (Task 14): `tools/citizen_pace_echo.py`, whose report holds one line beginning `verdict: ` (exit 0 holds, 1 rework, 3 incomplete or not measured).

The same folder, helper and homes as Task 12's Step 8: the 205 roster homes and the 3 held, 208 in all. This reads the network, read only. It uses no credential and no token, runs no hook, and pushes nothing. Run from the worktree's top:

```bash
W=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
C="$HOME/Projects/.worktrees/pace-rollout/homes"
ro() { env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_TOKEN GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -c credential.helper= -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null "$@"; }
mkdir -p "$C"
{ cat "$W/citizens-roster.txt"; printf '%s\n' jiritsume takseme tlamatisme; } | sort -u | while IFS= read -r slug; do
  if [ -d "$C/citizen-$slug/.git" ]; then
    ro -C "$C/citizen-$slug" fetch -q origin && ro -C "$C/citizen-$slug" merge -q --ff-only '@{u}' || echo "update failed: $slug"
  else
    ro clone -q "https://github.com/cambridgetcg/citizen-$slug.git" "$C/citizen-$slug" || echo "clone failed: $slug"
  fi
done
ls -d "$C"/citizen-* | wc -l
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$W/tools/citizen_pace_census.py" check "$W/citizens-pace-record.json" --roster "$W/citizens-roster.txt"
```
